original: taittirīya brāhmaṇam kāṇḍa 1 pauroḍāśika kāṇḍa? prapāṭhaka: 1 agnyādhānam anuvāka 1 { 1.1.1.1} brahma saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | kṣatraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | iṣaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | ūrjaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | rayiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | puṣṭiṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | prajāṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam |
analyzed: taittirīya brāhmaṇam kāṇḍa pauroḍāśika kāṇḍa prapāṭhaka agnyādhānam anuvāka 1 brahma saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam kṣatram saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam iṣam saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam ūrjam saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam rayim saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam puṣṭim saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam prajām saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam

original: paśūn saṃdhattaṃ tān me jinvatam | stuto 'si janadhāḥ | devās tvā śukrapāḥ praṇayantu |
analyzed: paśūn saṃdhattam tān me jinvatam stutaḥ si jana dhāḥ devāḥ tvā śukra pāḥ praṇayantu

original: { 1.1.1.2} suvīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi | śukraḥ śukraśociṣā | stuto 'si janadhāḥ
analyzed: su vīrāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi śukraḥ śukra śociṣā stutaḥ si jana dhāḥ

original: | devās tvā manthipāḥ praṇayantu | suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi | manthī manthiśociṣā | saṃjagmānau diva ā pṛthivyāyuḥ | saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | prāṇaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam | apānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam |
analyzed: devāḥ tvā manthi pāḥ praṇayantu su prajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhi manthī manthi śociṣā saṃjagmānau divaḥ ā pṛthivi āyuḥ saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam prāṇam saṃdhattam tam me jinvatam apānam saṃdhattam tam me jinvatam

original: { 1.1.1.3} vyānaṃ saṃdhattaṃ taṃ me jinvatam | cakṣuḥ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | śrotraṃ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | manaḥ saṃdhattaṃ tan me jinvatam | vācaṃ saṃdhattaṃ tāṃ me jinvatam | āyuḥ stha āyur me dhattam | āyur yajñāya dhattam | āyur yajñapataye dhattam | prāṇaḥ sthaḥ prāṇaṃ me dhattaṃ | prāṇaṃ yajñāya dhattam |
analyzed: vyānam saṃdhattam tam me jinvatam cakṣuḥ saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam śrotram saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam manaḥ saṃdhattam tat me jinvatam vācam saṃdhattam tām me jinvatam āyuḥ sthaḥ āyuḥ me dhattam āyuḥ yajñāya dhattam āyuḥ yajñapataye dhattam prāṇaḥ sthaḥ prāṇam me dhattam prāṇam yajñāya dhattam

original: { 1.1.1.4} prāṇaṃ yajñapataye dhattam | cakṣuḥ sthaś cakṣur me dhattam | cakṣur yajñāya dhattam | cakṣur yajñapataye dhattam | śrotraṃ sthaḥ śrotraṃ me dhattam | śrotraṃ yajñāya dhattam | śrotraṃ yajñapataye dhattam | tau devau śukrāmanthinau | kalpayataṃ daivīr viśaḥ | kalpayataṃ mānuṣīḥ |
analyzed: prāṇam yajñapataye dhattam cakṣuḥ sthaḥ cakṣuḥ me dhattam cakṣuḥ yajñāya dhattam cakṣuḥ yajñapataye dhattam śrotram sthaḥ śrotram me dhattam śrotram yajñāya dhattam śrotram yajñapataye dhattam tau devau śukrāmanthinau kalpayatam daivīḥ viśaḥ kalpayatam mānuṣīḥ

original: { 1.1.1.5} iṣamūrjam asmāsu dhattam | prāṇān paśuṣu | prajāṃ mayi ca yajamāne ca | nirastaḥ śaṇḍaḥ | nirasto markaḥ | apanuttau śaṇḍām arkau sahāmunā | śukrasya samid asi | manthinaḥ samid asi | sa prathamaḥ saṃkṛtir viśvakarmā | sa prathamo mitro varuṇo agniḥ | sa prathamo bṛhaspatiś cikitvān | tasmā indrāya sutam ājuhomi |
analyzed: iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dhattam prāṇān paśuṣu prajām mayi ca yajamāne ca nirastaḥ śaṇḍaḥ nirastaḥ markaḥ apanuttau śaṇḍām arkau saha amunā śukrasya samidh asi manthinaḥ samidh asi sa prathamaḥ saṃkṛtiḥ viśvakarmā sa prathamaḥ mitraḥ varuṇaḥ agniḥ sa prathamaḥ bṛhaspatiḥ cikitvān tasmai indrāya sutam ājuhomi

original: 1.1.2 anuvāka 2 agnyādhānam { 1.1.2.1} kṛttikāsv agnim ādadhīta | etad vā agner nakṣatram | yat kṛttikāḥ | svāyām evainaṃ devatāyām ādhāya | brahmavarcasī bhavati | mukhaṃ vā etan nakṣatrāṇām | yat kṛttikāḥ | yaḥ kṛttikāsv agnim ādhatte | mukhya eva bhavati | atho khalu
analyzed: kṛttikāsu agnim ādadhīta etat vai agneḥ nakṣatram yat kṛttikāḥ svāyām eva enam devatāyām ādhāya brahmavarcasī bhavati mukham vai etat nakṣatrāṇām yat kṛttikāḥ yaḥ kṛttikāsu agnim ādhatte mukhyaḥ eva bhavati atha u khalu

original: { 1.1.2.2} agninakṣatram ity apacāyanti | gṛhān ha dāhuko bhavati | prajāpatī rohiṇyām agnim asṛjata | taṃ devā rohiṇyām ādadhata | tato vai te sarvān rohān arohan | tad rohiṇyai rohiṇitvam | yo rohiṇyām agnim ādhatte | ṛdhnoty eva | sarvān rohān rohati | devā vai bhadrāḥ santo 'gnim ādhitsanta
analyzed: agni nakṣatram iti apacāyanti gṛhān ha dāhukaḥ bhavati prajāpatiḥ rohiṇyām agnim asṛjata tam devāḥ rohiṇyām ādadhata tatas vai te sarvān rohān arohan tat rohiṇyai rohiṇi tvam yaḥ rohiṇyām agnim ādhatte ṛdhnoti eva sarvān rohān rohati devāḥ vai bhadrāḥ santaḥ gnim ādhitsanta

original: { 1.1.2.3} teṣām anāhito 'gnir āsīt | athaibhyo vāmaṃ vasv apākrāmat | te punarvasvor ādadhata | tato vai tān vāmaṃ vasūpāvartata | yaḥ purā bhadraḥ san pāpīyānt syāt | sa punarvasvor agnim ādadhīta | punar evainaṃ vāmaṃ vasūpāvartate | bhadro bhavati | yaḥ kāmayeta dānakāmā me prajāḥ syur iti | sa pūrvayoḥ phalgunyor agnim ādadhīta |
analyzed: teṣām an āhitaḥ gniḥ āsīt atha ebhyaḥ vāmam vasu apākrāmat te punarvasvoḥ ādadhata tatas vai tān vāmam vasu upāvartata yaḥ purā bhadraḥ san pāpīyān syāt sa punarvasvoḥ agnim ādadhīta punar eva enam vāmam vasu upāvartate bhadraḥ bhavati yaḥ kāmayeta dāna kāmāḥ me prajāḥ syuḥ iti sa pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoḥ agnim ādadhīta

original: { 1.1.2.4} aryamṇo vā etan nakṣatram | yat pūrve phalgunī | aryamā-iti tam āhur yo dadāti | dānakāmā asmai prajā bhavanti | yaḥ kāmayeta bhagī syām iti | sa uttarayoḥ phalgunyor agnim ādadhīta | bhagasya vā etan nakṣatram | yad uttare phalgunī | bhagy eva bhavati | kālakañjā vai nāma-asurā āsan |
analyzed: aryamṇaḥ vai etat nakṣatram yat pūrve phalgunī aryamā iti tam āhuḥ yaḥ dadāti dāna kāmāḥ asmai prajāḥ bhavanti yaḥ kāmayeta bhagī syām iti saḥ uttarayoḥ phalgunyoḥ agnim ādadhīta bhagasya vai etat nakṣatram yat uttare phalgunī bhagī eva bhavati kālakañjāḥ vai nāma asurāḥ āsan

original: { 1.1.2.5} te suvargāya lokāya-agnim acinvanta | puruṣa iṣṭakām upādadhāt puruṣa iṣṭakām | sa indro brāhmaṇo bruvāṇa iṣṭakām upādhatta | eṣā me citrā nāmeti | te suvargaṃ lokam āprārohan | sa indra iṣṭakām āvṛhat | te 'vākīryanta | ye 'vākīryanta | ta ūrṇāvabhayo 'bhavan | dvāv udapatatām |
analyzed: te suvargāya lokāya agnim acinvanta puruṣaḥ iṣṭakām upādadhāt puruṣaḥ iṣṭakām saḥ indraḥ brāhmaṇaḥ bruvāṇaḥ iṣṭakām upādhatte eṣā me citrā nāma iti te suvargam lokam āprārohan saḥ indraḥ iṣṭakām āvṛhat te vā akīryanta ye vā akīryanta te ūrṇāvabhayaḥ bhavan dvau udapatatām

original: { 1.1.2.6} tau divyau śvānāv abhavatām | yo bhrātṛvyavānt syāt | sa citrāyām agnim ādadhīta | avakīrya-eva bhrātṛvyān | ojo balam indriyaṃ vīryam ātman dhatte | vasantā brāhmaṇo 'gnim ādadhīta | vasanto vai brāhmaṇasya-ṛtuḥ | sva evainam ṛtāv ādhāya | brahmavarcasī bhavati | mukhaṃ vā etad ṛtūnām |
analyzed: tau divyau śvānau abhavatām yaḥ bhrātṛvyavān syāt sa citrāyām agnim ādadhīta avakīrya eva bhrātṛvyān ojaḥ balam indriyam vīryam ātman dhatte vasantā brāhmaṇaḥ gnim ādadhīta vasantaḥ vai brāhmaṇasya ṛtuḥ sve eva enam ṛtau ādhāya brahmavarcasī bhavati mukham vai etat ṛtūnām

original: { 1.1.2.7} yad vasantaḥ | yo vasanta-agnim ādhatte | mukhya eva bhavati | atho yonimantam evainaṃ prajātam ādhatte | grīṣme rājanya ādadhīta | grīṣmo vai rājanyasya-ṛtuḥ | sva evainam ṛtāv ādhāya | indriyāvī bhavati | śaradi vaiśya ādadhīta | śarad vai vaiśyasya-ṛtuḥ
analyzed: yat vasantaḥ yaḥ vasantaagnim ādhatte mukhyaḥ eva bhavati atha u yonimantam eva enam prajātam ādhatte grīṣme rājanyaḥ ādadhīta grīṣmaḥ vai rājanyasya ṛtuḥ sve eva enam ṛtau ādhāya indriyāvī bhavati śaradi vaiśyaḥ ādadhīta śarad vai vaiśyasya ṛtuḥ

original: { 1.1.2.8} sva evainam ṛtāv ādhāya | paśumān bhavati | na pūrvayoḥ phalgunyor agnim ādadhīta | eṣā vai jaghanyā rātriḥ saṃvatsarasya | yat pūrve phalgunī | pṛṣṭita eva saṃvatsarasya-agnim ādhāya | pāpīyān bhavati | uttarayor ādadhīta | eṣā vai prathamā rātriḥ saṃvatsarasya | yad uttare phalgunī | mukhata eva saṃvatsarasya-agnim ādhāya |
analyzed: sve eva enam ṛtau ādhāya paśumān bhavati na pūrvayoḥ phalgunyoḥ agnim ādadhīta eṣā vai jaghanyā rātriḥ saṃvatsarasya yat pūrve phalgunī pṛṣṭitas eva saṃvatsarasya agnim ādhāya pāpīyān bhavati uttarayoḥ ādadhīta eṣā vai prathamā rātriḥ saṃvatsarasya yat uttare phalgunī mukhatas eva saṃvatsarasya agnim ādhāya

original: vasīyān bhavati | atho khalu | yadā-evainaṃ yajña upanamet | atha-ādadhīta | saivāsya-ṛddhiḥ |
analyzed: vasīyān bhavati atha u khalu yadā eva enam yajñaḥ upanamet atha ādadhīta sā eva asya ṛddhiḥ

original: 1.1.3 anuvāka 3 agnyādhānam { 1.1.3.1} uddhanti | yad evāsyā amedhyam | tad apahanti | apo 'vokṣati śāntyai | sikatā nivapati | etad vā agner vaiśvānarasya rūpam | rūpeṇaiva vaiśvānaram avarunddhe | ūṣān nivapati | puṣṭir vā eṣā prajananam | yad ūṣāḥ |
analyzed: uddhan yat eva asyāḥ amedhyam tat apahanti apaḥ vokṣati śāntyai sikatāḥ nivapati etat vai agneḥ vaiśvānarasya rūpam rūpeṇa eva vaiśvānaram avarunddhe ūṣān nivapati puṣṭiḥ vai eṣā prajananam yat ūṣāḥ

original: { 1.1.3.2} puṣṭyām eva prajanane 'gnim ādhatte | atho saṃjñāna eva | saṃjñānaṃ hy etat paśūnām | yad ūṣāḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī saha-ā''stām | te viyatī abrūtām | astv eva nau saha yajñiyam iti | yad amuṣyā yajñiyam āsīt | tad asyām adadhāt | ta ūṣā abhavan |
analyzed: puṣṭyām eva prajanane gnim ādhatte atha u saṃjñāne eva saṃjñānam hi etat paśūnām yat ūṣāḥ dyāvāpṛthivī saha āstām te viyatī abrūtām astu eva nau saha yajñiyam iti yat amuṣyāḥ yajñiyam āsīt tat asyām adadhāt te ūṣāḥ abhavan

original: { 1.1.3.3} yad asyā yajñiyam āsīt | tad amuṣyām adadhāt | tad adaś candramasi kṛṣṇam | ūṣān nivapann ado dhyāyet | dyāvāpṛthivyor eva yajñiye 'gnim ādhatte | agnir devebhyo nilāyata | ākhū rūpaṃ kṛtvā | sa pṛthivīṃ prāviśat | sa ūtīḥ kurvāṇaḥ pṛthivīm anu samacarat | 0 tad ākhukarīṣam abhavat |
analyzed: yat asyāḥ yajñiyam āsīt tat amuṣyām adadhāt tat adaḥ candramasi kṛṣṇam ūṣān nivapan adaḥ dhyāyet dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ eva yajñiye gnim ādhatte agniḥ devebhyaḥ nilāyate ākhuḥ rūpam kṛtvā sa pṛthivīm prāviśat saḥ ūtīḥ kurvāṇaḥ pṛthivīm anu samacarat tat ākhu karīṣam abhavat

original: { 1.1.3.4} yad ākhukarīṣaṃ saṃbhāro bhavati | yad evāsya tatra nyaktam | tad eva-avarunddhe | ūrjaṃ vā etaṃ rasaṃ pṛthivyā upadīkā uddihanti | yad valmīkam | yad valmīkavapā saṃbhāro bhavati | ūrjam eva rasaṃ pṛthivyā avarunddhe | atho śrotram eva | śrotraṃ hy etat pṛthivyāḥ | yad valmīkaḥ
analyzed: yat ākhu karīṣam saṃbhāraḥ bhavati yat eva asya tatra nyaktam tat eva avarunddhe ūrjam vai etam rasam pṛthivyāḥ upadīkāḥ uddihanti yat valmīkam yat valmīka vapā saṃbhāraḥ bhavati ūrjam eva rasam pṛthivyāḥ avarunddhe atha u śrotram eva śrotram hi etat pṛthivyāḥ yat valmīkaḥ

original: { 1.1.3.5} abadhiro bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāsām annam upākṣīyata | tābhyaḥ sūdam upa prābhinat | tato vai tāsām annaṃ na-akṣīyata | yasya sūdaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | nāsya gṛhe 'nnaṃ kṣīyate | āpo vā idam agre salilam āsīt | tena prajāpatir aśrāmyat |
analyzed: a badhiraḥ bhavati yaḥ evam veda prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tāsām annam upākṣīyata tābhyaḥ sūdam upa prābhinat tatas vai tāsām annam na akṣīyata yasya sūdaḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati na asya gṛhe nnam kṣīyate āpaḥ vai idam agre salilam āsīt tena prajāpatiḥ aśrāmyat

original: { 1.1.3.6} katham idaṃ syād iti | so 'paśyat puṣkaraparṇaṃ tiṣṭhat | so 'manyata | asti vai tat | yasminn idam adhi tiṣṭhati-iti | sa varāho rūpaṃ kṛtvā-upa nyamajjat | sa pṛthivīm adha ārchat | tasyā upahatya-udamajjat | tat puṣkaraparṇe 'prathayat | yad aprathayat |
analyzed: katham idam syāt iti saḥ u paśyat puṣkaraparṇam tiṣṭhat saḥ manyata asti vai tat yasmin idam adhi tiṣṭhati iti sa varāhaḥ rūpam kṛtvā upa nyamajjat sa pṛthivīm adhas ārchat tasyāḥ upahatya udamajjat tat puṣkaraparṇe prathayat yat aprathayat

original: { 1.1.3.7} tat pṛthivyai pṛthivitvam | abhūd vā idam iti | tad bhūmyai bhūmitvam | tāṃ diśo 'nu vātaḥ samavahat | tāṃ śarkarābhir adṛṃhat | śaṃ vai no 'bhūd iti | tac charkarāṇāṃ śarkaratvam | yad varāhavihataṃ saṃbhāro bhavati | asyām evācchambaṭkāram agnim ādhatte | śarkarā bhavanti dhṛtyai |
analyzed: tat pṛthivyai pṛthivi tvam abhūt vai idam iti tat bhūmyai bhūmi tvam tām diśaḥ nu vātaḥ samavahat tām śarkarābhiḥ adṛṃhat śam vai naḥ bhūt iti tat śarkarāṇām śarkara tvam yat varāha vihatam saṃbhāraḥ bhavati asyām eva a chambaṭkāram agnim ādhatte śarkarāḥ bhavanti dhṛtyai

original: { 1.1.3.8} atho śaṃtvāya | saretā agnir ādheya ity āhuḥ | āpo varuṇasya patnaya āsan | tā agnir abhyadhyāyat | tāḥ samabhavan | tasya retaḥ parāpatat | tad dhiraṇyam abhavat | yad dhiraṇyam upāsyati | saretasam evāgnim ādhatte | puruṣa in nvai svād retaso bībhatsata ity āhuḥ |
analyzed: atha u śaṃtvāya sa retāḥ agniḥ ādheyaḥ iti āhuḥ āpaḥ varuṇasya patnayaḥ āsan tāḥ agniḥ abhyadhyāyat tāḥ samabhavan tasya retaḥ parāpatat tat hiraṇyam abhavat yat hiraṇyam upāsyati sa retasam eva agnim ādhatte puruṣaḥ id nvai svāt retasaḥ bībhatsate iti āhuḥ

original: { 1.1.3.9} uttarata upāsyaty abībhatsāyai | ati prayacchati | ārtim eva-atiprayacchati | agnir devebhyo nilāyata | aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | so 'śvatthe saṃvatsaram atiṣṭhat | tad aśvatthasyāśvatthatvam | yad āśvatthaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | yad evāsya tatra nyaktam | tad eva-avarunddhe |
analyzed: uttaratas upāsyati a bībhatsāyai ati prayacchati ārtim eva atiprayacchati agniḥ devebhyaḥ nilāyata aśvaḥ rūpam kṛtvā saḥ śvatthe saṃvatsaram atiṣṭhat tat aśvatthasya aśvattha tvam yat āśvatthaḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati yat eva asya tatra nyaktam tat eva avarunddhe

original: { 1.1.3.10} devā vā ūrjaṃ vyabhajanta | tata udumbara udatiṣṭhat | ūrg vā udumbaraḥ | yad audumbaraḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | ūrjam eva-avarunddhe | tṛtīyasyām ito divi soma āsīt | taṃ gāyatryā-aharat | tasya parṇam acchidyata | tat parṇo 'bhavat | tat parṇasya parṇatvam |
analyzed: devāḥ vai ūrjam vyabhajanta tatas udumbaraḥ udatiṣṭhat ūrj vai udumbaraḥ yat audumbaraḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati ūrjam eva avarunddhe tṛtīyasyām itas divi somaḥ āsīt tam gāyatryā aharat tasya parṇam acchidyata tat parṇaḥ bhavat tat parṇasya parṇa tvam

original: { 1.1.3.11} yasya parṇamayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | somapītham eva-avarunddhe | devā vai brahmann avadanta | tat parṇa upāśṛṇot | suśravā vai nāma | yat parṇamayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | brahmavarcasam eva-avarunddhe | prajāpatir agnim asṛjata | so 'bibhet pra mā dhakṣyati-iti | taṃ śamyāśamayat |
analyzed: yasya parṇa mayaḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati soma pītham eva avarunddhe devāḥ vai brahman avadanta tat parṇaḥ upāśṛṇot suśravāḥ vai nāma yat parṇa mayaḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati brahmavarcasam eva avarunddhe prajāpatiḥ agnim asṛjata saḥ bibhet pra mā dhakṣyati iti tam śamyā aśamayat

original: { 1.1.3.12} tac chamyai śamitvaṃ | yac chamīmayaḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | śāntyā apradāhāya | agneḥ sṛṣṭasya yataḥ | vikaṅkataṃ bhā ārcchat | yad vaikaṅkataḥ saṃbhāro bhavati | bhā eva-avarunddhe | sahṛdayo 'gnir ādheya ity āhuḥ | maruto 'dbhir agnim atamayan | tasya tāntasya hṛdayam ācchindan | sāśanir abhavat |
analyzed: tat śamyai śami tvam yat śamī mayaḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati śāntyai a pradāhāya agneḥ sṛṣṭasya yataḥ vikaṅkatam bhās ārcchat yat vaikaṅkataḥ saṃbhāraḥ bhavati bhās eva avarunddhe sa hṛdayaḥ gniḥ ādheyaḥ iti āhuḥ marutaḥ dbhiḥ agnim atamayan tasya tāntasya hṛdayam ācchindan sa aśaniḥ abhavat

original: yad aśanihatasya vṛkṣasya sambhāro bhavati | sahṛdayam eva-agnim ādhatte |
analyzed: yat aśani hatasya vṛkṣasya sambhāraḥ bhavati sahṛdayam eva agnim ādhatte

original: anuvāka 4 agnyādhānam { 1.1.4.1} dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣv agnim ādadhīta | dvādaśa māsāḥ samvatsaraḥ | saṃvatsarād evainam avarudhya-ādhatte | yad dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣv ādadhīta | parimitam avarundhīta | cakṣurnimita ādadhīta | iyad dvādaśavikrāmā3 iti | parimitaṃ caiva-aparimitaṃ ca-avarunddhe | anṛtaṃ vai vācā vadati | anṛtaṃ manasā dhyāyati |
analyzed: anuvāka 4 agnyādhānam dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣu agnim ādadhīta dvādaśa māsāḥ samvatsaraḥ saṃvatsarāt eva enam avarudhya ādhatte yat dvādaśasu vikrāmeṣu ādadhīta parimitam avarundhīta cakṣuḥ nimitaḥ ādadhīta iyat dvādaśa vikrāmāḥ iti parimitam ca eva aparimitam ca avarunddhe anṛtam vai vācā vadati anṛtam manasā dhyāyati

original: { 1.1.4.2} cakṣur vai satyam | adrā3g ity āha | adarśam iti | tat satyam | yaś cakṣurnimite 'gnim ādhatte | satya evainam ādhatte | tasmād āhitāgnir na-anṛtaṃ vadet | nāsya brāhmaṇo 'nāśvān gṛhe vaset | satye hy asyāgnir āhitaḥ | āgneyī vai rātriḥ |
analyzed: cakṣuḥ vai satyam adrāk iti āha adarśam iti tat satyam yaḥ cakṣuḥ nimite gnim ādhatte satye eva enam ādhatte tasmāt āhitāgniḥ na anṛtam vadet na asya brāhmaṇaḥ na aśvān gṛhe vaset satye hi asya agniḥ āhitaḥ āgneyī vai rātriḥ

original: { 1.1.4.3} āgneyāḥ paśavaḥ | aindram ahaḥ | naktaṃ gārhapatyam ādadhāti | paśūn eva-avarunddhe | divā-āhavanīyam | indriyam evāvarunddhe | ardhodite sūrya āhavanīyam ādadhāti | etasmin vai loke prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | prajā eva tad yajamānaḥ sṛjate | atho bhūtaṃ caiva bhaviṣyac ca-avarunddhe |
analyzed: āgneyāḥ paśavaḥ aindram ahar naktam gārhapatyam ādadhāti paśūn eva avarunddhe divā āhavanīyam indriyam eva avarunddhe ardha udite sūrye āhavanīyam ādadhāti etasmin vai loke prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata prajāḥ eva tat yajamānaḥ sṛjate atha u bhūtam ca eva bhaviṣyat ca avarunddhe

original: { 1.1.4.4} iḍā vai mānavī yajñānukāśiny āsīt | sā'śṛṇot | asurā agnim ādadhata iti | tad agacchat | ta āhavanīyam agra ādadhata | atha gārhapatyam | atha-anvāhāryapacanam | sobravīt | pratīcy eṣāṃ śrīr agāt | bhadrā bhūtvā parābhaviṣyantīti |
analyzed: iḍā vai mānavī yajña anukāśinī āsīt sā aśṛṇot asurāḥ agnim ādadhate iti tat agacchat te āhavanīyam agre ādadhata atha gārhapatyam atha anvāhāryapacanam sā ubravīt pratīcī eṣām śrīḥ agāt bhadrāḥ bhūtvā parābhaviṣyanti iti

original: { 1.1.4.5} yasyaivam agnir ādhīyate | pratīcy asya śrīr eti | bhadro bhūtvā parābhavati | sā'śṛṇot | devā agnim ādadhata iti | tad agacchat | te 'nvāhāryapacanam agra ādadhata | atha gārhapatyam | atha-āhavanīyam | sā'bravīt
analyzed: yasya evam agniḥ ādhīyate pratīcī asya śrīḥ eti bhadraḥ bhūtvā parābhavati sā aśṛṇot devāḥ agnim ādadhate iti tat agacchat te nu āhāryapacanam agre ādadhata atha gārhapatyam atha āhavanīyam sā bravīt

original: { 1.1.4.6} prācy eṣāṃ śrīr agāt | bhadrā bhūtvā suvargaṃ lokam eṣyanti | prajāṃ tu na vetsyanta iti | yasyaivam agnir ādhīyate | prācy asya śrīr eti | bhadro bhūtvā suvargaṃ lokam eti | prajāṃ tu na vindate | sābravīd iḍā manum | tathā vā ahaṃ tava-agnim ādhāsyāmi | yathā pra prajayā paśubhir mithunair janiṣyase |
analyzed: prācī eṣām śrīḥ agāt bhadrāḥ bhūtvā suvargam lokam eṣyanti prajām tu na vetsyante iti yasya evam agniḥ ādhīyate prācī asya śrīḥ eti bhadraḥ bhūtvā suvargam lokam eti prajām tu na vindate sā abravīt iḍā manum tathā vai aham tava agnim ādhāsyāmi yathā pra prajayā paśubhiḥ mithunaiḥ janiṣyase

original: { 1.1.4.7} praty asmiṃl loke sthāsyasi | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jeṣyasīti | gārhapatyam agra ādadhāt | gārhapatyaṃ vā anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante | gārhapatyenaivāsmai prajāṃ paśūn prājanayat | atha-anvāhāryapacanam | tiryaṅṅ iva vā ayaṃ lokaḥ | asminn eva tena loke pratyatiṣṭhat | atha-āhavanīyam | 0 tenaiva suvargaṃ lokam abhyajayat |
analyzed: prati asmin loke sthāsyasi abhi suvargam lokam jeṣyasi iti gārhapatyam agre ādadhāt gārhapatyam vai anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ prajāyante gārhapatyena eva asmai prajām paśūn prājanayat atha anvāhāryapacanam tiryaṅ iva vai ayam lokaḥ asmin eva tena loke pratyatiṣṭhat atha āhavanīyam tena eva suvargam lokam abhyajayat

original: { 1.1.4.8} yasyaivam agnir ādhīyate | pra prajayā paśubhir mithunair jāyate | praty asmiṃl loke tiṣṭhati | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yasya vā ayathādevatam agnir ādhīyate | ā devatābhyo vṛścyate | pāpīyān bhavati | yasya yathādevatam | na devatābhya ā vṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati |
analyzed: yasya evam agniḥ ādhīyate pra prajayā paśubhiḥ mithunaiḥ jāyate prati asmin loke tiṣṭhati abhi suvargam lokam jayati yasya vai a yathādevatam agniḥ ādhīyate ā devatābhyaḥ vṛścyate pāpīyān bhavati yasya yathādevatam na devatābhyaḥ ā vṛścyate vasīyān bhavati

original: { 1.1.4.9} bhṛgūṇāṃ tvā-aṅgirasāṃ vratapate vratena-ādadhāmīti bhṛgvaṅgirasām ādadhyāt | ādityānāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratena-ādadhāmīty anyāsāṃ brāhmaṇīnāṃ prajānām | varuṇasya tvā rājño vratapate vratena-ādadhāmīti rājñaḥ | indrasya tvā-indriyeṇa vratapate vratena-ādadhāmi-iti rājanyasya |
analyzed: bhṛgūṇām tvā aṅgirasām vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti bhṛgu aṅgirasām ādadhyāt ādityānām tvā devānām vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti anyāsām brāhmaṇīnām prajānām varuṇasya tvā rājñaḥ vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti rājñaḥ indrasya tvā aindriyeṇa vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti rājanyasya

original: manos tvā grāmaṇyo vratapate vratena-ādadhāmīti vaiśyasya | ṛbhūṇāṃ tvā devānāṃ vratapate vratena-ādadhāmi-iti rathakārasya | yathādevatam agnir ādhīyate | na devatābhya ā vṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati |
analyzed: manoḥ tvā grāmaṇyaḥ vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti vaiśyasya ṛbhūṇām tvā devānām vrata pate vratena ādadhāmi iti rathakārasya yathādevatam agniḥ ādhīyate na devatābhyaḥ ā vṛścyate vasīyān bhavati

original: anuvāka 5 agnyādhānam { 1.1.5.1} prajāpatir vācaḥ satyam apaśyat | tena-agnim ādhatta | tena vai sa ārdhnot | bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar ity āha | etad vai vācaḥ satyam | ya etena-agnim ādhatte | ṛdhnoty eva | atho satyaprāśūr eva bhavati | atho ya evaṃ vidvān abhicarati | stṛṇuta evainam
analyzed: anuvāka 5 agnyādhānam prajāpatiḥ vācaḥ satyam apaśyat tena agnim ādhatta tena vai saḥ ārdhnot bhūḥ bhuvaḥ suvar iti āha etat vai vācaḥ satyam yaḥ etena agnim ādhatte ṛdhnoti eva atha u satya prāśūḥ eva bhavati atha u yaḥ evam vidvān abhicarati stṛṇute eva enam

original: { 1.1.5.2} bhūr ity āha | prajā eva tad yajamānaḥ sṛjate | bhuva ity āha | asminn eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | suvar ity āha | suvarga eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | tribhir akṣarair gārhapatyam ādadhāti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣv evainaṃ lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ādhatte | sarvaiḥ pañcabhir āhavanīyam |
analyzed: bhūḥ iti āha prajāḥ eva tat yajamānaḥ sṛjate bhuvaḥ iti āha asmin eva loke pratitiṣṭhati suvar iti āha suvarge eva loke pratitiṣṭhati tribhiḥ akṣaraiḥ gārhapatyam ādadhāti trayaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣu eva enam lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ādhatte sarvaiḥ pañcabhiḥ āhavanīyam

original: { 1.1.5.3} suvargāya vā eṣa lokāya-ādhīyate | yad āhavanīyaḥ | suvarga evāsmai loke vācaḥ satyaṃ sarvam āpnoti | tribhir gārhapatyam ādadhāti | pañcabhir āhavanīyam | aṣṭau saṃpadyante | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī |gāyatro 'gniḥ | yāvān evāgniḥ | tam ādhatte |
analyzed: suvargāya vai eṣa lokāya ādhīyate yat āhavanīyaḥ suvarge eva asmai loke vācaḥ satyam sarvam āpnoti tribhiḥ gārhapatyam ādadhāti pañcabhiḥ āhavanīyam aṣṭau saṃpadyante aṣṭa akṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraḥ gniḥ yāvān eva agniḥ tam ādhatte

original: { 1.1.5.4} prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā asmāt sṛṣṭāḥ parācīr āyann | tābhyo jyotir udagṛhṇāt | taṃ jyotiḥ paśyantīḥ prajā abhi samāvartanta | upari-iva-agnim udgrṛhṇīyād uddharan | jyotir eva paśyantīḥ prajā yajamānam abhi samāvartante | prajāpater akṣy aśvayat | tat parāpatat | tad aśvo 'bhavat | tad aśvasya-aśvatvam |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tāḥ asmāt sṛṣṭāḥ parācīḥ āyan tābhyaḥ jyotiḥ udagṛhṇāt tam jyotiḥ paśyantīḥ prajāḥ abhi samāvartante upari iva agnim udgrṛhṇīyāt uddharan jyotiḥ eva paśyantīḥ prajāḥ yajamānam abhi samāvartante prajāpateḥ akṣi aśvayat tat parāpatat tat aśvaḥ bhavat tat aśvasya aśva tvam

original: { 1.1.5.5} eṣa vai prajāpatiḥ | yad agniḥ prājāpatyo 'śvaḥ | yad aśvaṃ purastān nayati | svam eva cakṣuḥ paśyan prajāpatir anūdeti | vajrī vā eṣaḥ | yad aśvaḥ | yad aśvaṃ purastān nayati | jātān eva bhrātṛvyān praṇudate | punar āvartayati |
analyzed: eṣa vai prajāpatiḥ yat agniḥ śvas yat aśvam purastāt nayati svam eva cakṣuḥ paśyan prajāpatiḥ anūdeti vajrī vai eṣaḥ yat aśvaḥ yat aśvam purastāt nayati jātān eva bhrātṛvyān praṇudate punar āvartayati

original: { 1.1.5.6} janiṣyamāṇān eva pratinudate | ny āhavanīyo gārhapatyam akāmayata | ni gārhapatya āhavanīyam | tau vibhājaṃ nāśaknot | so 'śvaḥ pūrvavāḍ bhūtvā | prāñcaṃ pūrvam udavahat | tat pūrvavāhaḥ pūrvavāṭtvam | yad aśvaṃ purastān nayati | vibhaktir evainayoḥ sā | atho nānāvīryāv evainau kurute |
analyzed: janiṣyamāṇān eva pratinudate ni āhavanīyaḥ gārhapatyam akāmayata ni gārhapatyaḥ āhavanīyam tau vibhājam na aśaknot saḥ śvas pūrva vāh bhūtvā prāñcam pūrvam udavahat tat pūrva vāhaḥ pūrva vāh tvam yat aśvam purastāt nayati vibhaktiḥ eva enayoḥ sā atha u nānā vīryau eva enau kurute

original: { 1.1.5.7} yad upary-upari śiro haret | prāṇān vicchindyāt | adho'dhaḥ śiro harati | prāṇānāṃ gopīthāya | iyaty agre harati | atha-iyaty atha-iyati | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣv evainaṃ lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ādhatte | prajāpatir agnim asṛjata | so 'bibhet pra mā dhakṣyatīti |
analyzed: yat upari upari śiraḥ haret prāṇān vicchindyāt adhodhas śiraḥ harati prāṇānām gopīthāya iyati agre harati atha eyati atha eyati trayaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣu eva enam lokeṣu pratiṣṭhitam ādhatte prajāpatiḥ agnim asṛjata saḥ bibhet pra mā dhakṣyati iti

original: { 1.1.5.8} tasya tredhā mahimānaṃ vyauhat | śāntyā apradāhāya | yat tredhā-agnir ādhīyate | mahimānam evāsya tad vyūhati | śāntyā apradāhāya | punar āvartayati | mahimānam evāsya saṃdadhāti | paśur vā eṣaḥ | yad aśvaḥ | eṣa rudraḥ |
analyzed: tasya tredhā mahimānam vyauhat śāntyai a pradāhāya yat tredhā agniḥ ādhīyate mahimānam eva asya tat vyūhati śāntyai a pradāhāya punar āvartayati mahimānam eva asya saṃdadhāti paśuḥ vai eṣaḥ yat aśvaḥ eṣa rudraḥ

original: { 1.1.5.9} yad agniḥ | yad aśvasya pade 'gnim ādadhyāt | rudrāya paśūn apidadhyāt | apaśur yajamānaḥ syāt | yan nā''kramayet | anavaruddhā asya paśavaḥ syuḥ | pārśvata ākramayet | yathāhitasya-agner aṅgārā abhyavavarteran | avaruddhā asya paśavo bhavanti | na rudrāya-apidadhāti |
analyzed: yat agniḥ yat aśvasya pade gnim ādadhyāt rudrāya paśūn apidadhyāt apaśuḥ yajamānaḥ syāt yat na ākramayet an avaruddhāḥ asya paśavaḥ syuḥ pārśvatas ākramayet yathā āhitasya agneḥ aṅgārāḥ abhyavavarteran avaruddhāḥ asya paśavaḥ bhavanti na rudrāya apidadhāti

original: { 1.1.5.10} trīṇi havīṃṣi nirvapati | virāja eva vikrāntaṃ yajamāno 'nu vikramate | agnaye pavamānāya | agnaye pāvakāya | agnaye śucaye | yad agnaye pavamānāya nirvapati | punāty evainam | yad agnaye pāvakāya | pūta evāsminn annādyaṃ dadhāti | yad agnaye śucaye | brahmavarcasam evāsminn upariṣṭād dadhāti |
analyzed: trīṇi havīṃṣi nirvapati virāje eva vikrāntam yajamānaḥ nu vikramate agnaye pavamānāya agnaye pāvakāya agnaye śucaye yat agnaye pavamānāya nirvapati punāti eva enam yat agnaye pāvakāya pūte eva asmin annādyam dadhāti yat agnaye śucaye brahmavarcasam eva asmin upariṣṭāt dadhāti

original: anuvāka 6 agnyādhānam { 1.1.6.1} devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsann | te devā vijayam upayantaḥ | agnau vāmaṃ vasu saṃ nyadadhata | idam u no bhaviṣyati | yadi no jeṣyanti-iti | tad agnir na-utsaham aśaknot | tat tredhā vinyadadhāt | paśuṣu tṛtīyam | apsu tṛtīyam | āditye tṛtīyam |
analyzed: deva asurāḥ saṃyat āsan te devāḥ vijayam upayantaḥ agnau vāmam vasu sam nyadadhata idam u naḥ bhaviṣyati yadi naḥ jeṣyanti iti tat agniḥ na autsaham aśaknot tat tredhā vinyadadhāt paśuṣu tṛtīyam apsu tṛtīyam āditye tṛtīyam

original: { 1.1.6.2} tad devā vijitya | punar avārurutsanta | te 'gnaye pavamānāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapan | paśavo vā agniḥ pavamānaḥ | yad eva paśuṣv āsīt | tat tena-avārundhata | te 'gnaye pāvakāya | āpo vā agniḥ pāvakaḥ | yad eva-apsv āsīt | tat tena-avārundhata |
analyzed: tat devāḥ vijitya punar avārurutsanta te gnaye pavamānāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam niravapan paśavaḥ vai agniḥ pavamānaḥ yat eva paśuṣu āsīt tat tena avārundhata te gnaye pāvakāya āpaḥ vai agniḥ pāvakaḥ yat eva apsu āsīt tat tena avārundhata

original: { 1.1.6.3} te 'gnaye śucaye | asau vā ādityo 'gniḥ śuciḥ | yad evā''ditya āsīt | tat tena-avārundhata | brahmavādino vadanti | tanuvo vāvaitā agnyādheyasya | āgneyo vā aṣṭākapālo 'gnyādheyam iti | yat taṃ nirvapet | na-etāni | yathā''tmā syāt |
analyzed: te gnaye śucaye asau vai ādityaḥ gniḥ śuciḥ yat eva ādityaḥ āsīt tat tena avārundhata brahma vādinaḥ vadanti tanuvaḥ vāva etāḥ agnyādheyasya āgneyaḥ vai aṣṭākapālaḥ gnyādheyam iti yat tam nirvapet na etāni yathā ātmā syāt

original: { 1.1.6.4} na-aṅgāni | tādṛg eva tat | yad etāni nirvapet | na tam | yathāṅgāni syuḥ | na-ātmā | tādṛg eva tat | ubhayāni saha nirupyāṇi | yajñasya sātmatvāya | ubhayaṃ vā etasya-indriyaṃ vīryam āpyate |

original: { 1.2.1.19} antarikṣasya poṣeṇa | sarvapaśum ādadhe | ajījanann amṛtaṃ martyāsaḥ | asremāṇaṃ taraṇiṃ vīḍujambham | daśa svasāro agruvaḥ samīcīḥ | pumāṃsaṃ jātam abhi saṃrabhantām | prajāpates tvā prāṇena-abhi prāṇimi | pūṣṇaḥ poṣeṇa mahyam | dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya | śataṃ śaradbhya āyuṣe varcase |

original: { 1.2.1.20} jīvātvai puṇyāya | ahaṃ tvad asmi mad asi tvam etat | mama-asi yonis tava yonir asmi | mamaiva san vaha havyāny agne | putraḥ pitre lokakṛj jātavedaḥ | prāṇe tvā-amṛtam ādadhāmi | annādam annādyāya | goptāraṃ guptyai | sugārhapatyo vidahann arātīḥ | uṣasaḥ śreyasīśśreyasīr dadhat

original: { 1.2.1.21} agne sapatnāṃ apa bādhamānaḥ | rāyas poṣam iṣamūrjam asmāsu dhehi | imā u mām upa tiṣṭhantu rāyaḥ | ābhiḥ prajābhir iha saṃ vaseya | iho iḍā tiṣṭhatu viśvarūpī | madhye vasor dīdihi jātavedaḥ | ojase balāya tvā-udyacche | vṛṣaṇe śuṣmāya-āyuṣe varcase | sapatnatūr asi vṛtratūḥ | yas te deveṣu mahimā suvargaḥ |
analyzed: agne sapatnām apa bādhamānaḥ rāyaḥ poṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dhehi imāḥ u mām upa tiṣṭhantu rāyaḥ ābhiḥ prajābhiḥ iha sam vaseya iha u iḍā tiṣṭhatu viśvarūpī madhye vasoḥ dīdihi jātavedaḥ ojase balāya tvā udyacche vṛṣaṇe śuṣmāya āyuṣe varcase sapatnatūr asi vṛtratūr yaḥ te deveṣu mahimā suvar gaḥ

original: { 1.2.1.22} yas ta ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭaḥ | puṣṭir yā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe | tayā {ānaṃdā. tayā |} no agne juṣamāṇa ehi | divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pary antarikṣāt | vātāt paśubhyo adhy oṣadhībhyaḥ | yatra-yatra jātavedaḥ saṃbabhūtha | tato no agne juṣamāṇa ehi | prācīm anu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvān | agner agne puro agnir bhaveha | viśvā āśā dīdyāno vi bhāhi |
analyzed: yaḥ te ātmā paśuṣu praviṣṭaḥ puṣṭiḥ yā te manuṣyeṣu paprathe tayā ānaṃdā tayā naḥ agne juṣamāṇaḥ ehi divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ pari antarikṣāt vātāt paśubhyaḥ adhi oṣadhībhyaḥ yatra yatra jātavedaḥ saṃbabhūtha tatas naḥ agne juṣamāṇaḥ ehi prācīm anu pradiśam prehi vidvān agneḥ agne puras agniḥ bhava iha viśvāḥ āśāḥ dīdyānaḥ vi bhāhi

original: { 1.2.3.3} sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | asāv ādityaḥ śiraḥ prajānām | śīrṣann eva prajānāṃ prāṇān dadhāti | tasmāt sapta śīrṣan prāṇāḥ | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | asurān parābhāvya | sa imāṃl lokān abhyajayat | tasyāsau loko 'nabhijita āsīt | taṃ viśvakarmā bhūtvābhyajayat | yad vaiśvakarmaṇo gṛhyate |

original: { 1.2.4.2} devā vā ādityasya suvargasya lokasya | parāco 'tipādād abibhayuḥ | taṃ chandobhir adṛṃhan dhṛtyai | devā vā ādityasya suvargasya lokasya | avāco 'vapādād abibhayuḥ | taṃ pañcabhī raśmibhir udavayann | tasmād ekaviṃśe 'han pañca divākīrtyāni kriyante | raśmayo vai divākīrtyāni | ye gāyatre | te gāyatrīṣūttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ |
analyzed: devāḥ vai ādityasya suvargasya lokasya parācaḥ tipādāt abibhayuḥ tam chandobhiḥ adṛṃhan dhṛtyai devāḥ vai ādityasya suvargasya lokasya avācaḥ vapādāt abibhayuḥ tam pañcabhiḥ raśmibhiḥ udavayan tasmāt ekaviṃśe han pañca divākīrtyāni kriyante raśmayaḥ vai divākīrtyāni ye gāyatre te gāyatrīṣu uttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ

original: { 1.2.4.3} mahādivākīrtyaṃ hotuḥ pṛṣṭham | vikarṇaṃ brahmasāma | bhāso 'gniṣṭomaḥ | athaitāni parāṇi | parair vai devā ādityaṃ suvargaṃ lokam apārayann | yad apārayann | tat parāṇāṃ paratvam | pārayanty enaṃ parāṇi | ya evaṃ veda | athaitāni sparāṇi | sparairvai devā ādityaṃ suvargaṃ lokam aspārayann | yad aspārayann | tat sparāṇāṃ sparatvam |
analyzed: mahādivākīrtyam hotuḥ pṛṣṭham vikarṇam brahma sāma bhāsaḥ gniṣṭomaḥ atha etāni parāṇi paraiḥ vai devāḥ ādityam suvargam lokam apārayan yat apārayan tat parāṇām para tvam pārayanti enam parāṇi yaḥ evam veda atha etāni sparāṇi sparaiḥ vai devāḥ ādityam suvargam lokam aspārayan yat aspārayan tat sparāṇām spara tvam

analyzed: spārayanti enam sparāṇi yaḥ evam veda

original: anuvāka 5 gavāmayanaśeṣaḥ { 1.2.5.1} apratiṣṭhāṃ vā ete gacchanti | yeṣāṃ saṃvatsare 'nāpte 'tha | ekādaśiny āpyate | vaiṣṇavaṃ vāmanam ālabhante | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñam evālabhante pratiṣṭhityai | aindrāgnam ālabhante | indrāgnī vai devānām ayātayāmānau | ye eva devate ayātayāmnī | te evālabhante |
analyzed: anuvāka gavāmayana śeṣaḥ a pratiṣṭhām vai ete gacchanti yeṣām saṃvatsare na āpte ekādaśinī āpyate vaiṣṇavam vāmanam ālabhante yajñaḥ vai viṣṇuḥ yajñam eva ālabhante pratiṣṭhityai aindrāgnam ālabhante indra agnī vai devānām ayātayāmānau ye eva devate ayātayāmnī te eva ālabhante

original: { 1.2.5.2} vaiśvadevam ālabhante | devatā evāvarundhate | dyāvāpṛthivyāṃ dhenum ālabhante | dyāvāpṛthivyor eva prati tiṣṭhanti | vāyavyaṃ vatsam ālabhante | vāyur evaibhyo yathāyatanād devatā avarundhe | ādityām aviṃ vaśām ālabhante | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyām eva pratitiṣṭhanti | maitrāvaruṇīm ālabhante |
analyzed: vaiśvadevam ālabhante devatāḥ eva avarundhate dyāvāpṛthivyām dhenum ālabhante dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ eva prati tiṣṭhanti vāyavyam vatsam ālabhante vāyuḥ eva ebhyaḥ yathā āyatanāt devatāḥ avarundhe ādityām avim vaśām ālabhante iyam vai aditiḥ asyām eva pratitiṣṭhanti maitrāvaruṇīm ālabhante

original: { 1.2.5.3} mitreṇaiva yajñasya sviṣṭaṃ śamayanti | varuṇena duriṣṭam | prājāpatyaṃ tūparaṃ mahāvrata ālabhante | prājāpatyo 'tigrāhyo gṛhyate | ahar eva rūpeṇa samardhayanti | atho ahna evaiṣa balir hriyate | āgneyam ālabhante prati prajñātyai | ajapetvān vā ete pūrvair māsair avarundhate | yad ete gavyāḥ paśava ālabhyante |
analyzed: mitreṇa eva yajñasya su iṣṭam śamayanti varuṇena duriṣṭam prājāpatyam tūparam mahāvrate ālabhante prājāpatyaḥ u tigrāhyaḥ gṛhyate ahar eva rūpeṇa samardhayanti atha u ahne eva eṣa baliḥ hriyate āgneyam ālabhante prati prajñātyai aja petvān vai ete pūrvaiḥ māsaiḥ avarundhate yat ete gavyāḥ paśavaḥ ālabhyante

original: ubhayeṣāṃ paśūnām avarudhyai | { 1.2.5.4} yad atiriktām ekādaśinīm ālabheran | apriyaṃ bhrātṛvyam abhyatiricyeta | yad dvaudvau paśū samasyeyuḥ | kanīya āyuḥ kurvīran | yad ete brāhmaṇavantaḥ paśava ālabhyante | nāpriyaṃ bhrātṛvyam abhyatiricyate | na kanīya āyuḥ kurvate |
analyzed: ubhayeṣām paśūnām avarudhyai 1254 yat atiriktām ekādaśinīm ālabheran apriyam bhrātṛvyam abhyatiricyeta yat dvau dvau paśū samasyeyuḥ kanīyaḥ āyuḥ kurvīran yat ete brāhmaṇavantaḥ paśavaḥ ālabhyante na apriyam bhrātṛvyam abhyatiricyate na kanīyaḥ āyuḥ kurvate

original: anuvāka 6 gavāmayanaśeṣaḥ { 1.2.6.1} prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā vṛtto 'śayat | taṃ devā bhūtānāṃ rasaṃ tejaḥ saṃbhṛtya | tenainam abhiṣajyan | mahān avavartīti | tan mahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | mahad vratam iti | tan mahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | mahato vratam iti | tan mahāvratasya mahāvratatvam | pañcaviṃśaḥ stomo bhavati |
analyzed: anuvāka 6 gavāmayana śeṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā śayat tam devāḥ bhūtānām rasam tejaḥ saṃbhṛtya tena enam abhiṣajyan mahān avavarti iti tat mahāvratasya mahāvrata tvam mahat vratam iti tat mahāvratasya mahāvrata tvam mahataḥ vratam iti tat mahāvratasya mahāvrata tvam pañcaviṃśaḥ stomaḥ bhavati

original: { 1.2.6.2} caturviṃśatyardhamāsaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ | yad vā etasmin saṃvatsare 'dhi prājāyata | tad annaṃ pañcaviṃśam abhavat | madhyataḥ kriyate | madhyato hy annam aśitaṃ dhinoti | atho madhyata eva prajānāmūrg dhīyate | atha yad vā idam antataḥ kriyate | tasmād udante prajāḥ samedhante | antataḥ kriyate prajananāyaiva | trivṛc chiro bhavati |
analyzed: caturviṃśati ardha māsaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ yat vai etasmin saṃvatsare dhi prājāyata tat annam pañcaviṃśam abhavat madhyataḥ kriyate madhyataḥ hi annam aśitam dhinoti atha u madhyataḥ eva prajānām ūrj dhīyate atha yat vai idam antataḥ kriyate tasmāt udante prajāḥ samedhante antataḥ kriyate prajananāya eva trivṛt śiraḥ bhavati

original: { 1.2.6.3} tredhā vihitaṃ hi śiraḥ | loma cchavīr asthi | parācā stuvanti | tasmāt tat sadṛg eva | na medyato 'nu medyati | na kṛśyato 'nu kṛśyati | pañcadaśo 'nyaḥ pakṣo bhavati | saptadaśo 'nyaḥ | tasmād vayāṃsy anyataram ardham abhi paryāvartante | anyatarato hi tad garīyaḥ kriyate |
analyzed: tredhā vihitam hi śiraḥ loma chavīḥ asthi parācā stuvanti tasmāt tat sadṛś eva na medyataḥ nu medyati na kṛśyataḥ nu kṛśyati pañcadaśaḥ nyaḥ pakṣaḥ bhavati saptadaśaḥ nyaḥ tasmāt vayāṃsi anyataram ardham abhi paryāvartante anyataratas hi tat garīyaḥ kriyate

original: { 1.2.6.4} pañcaviṃśa ātmā bhavati | tasmān madhyataḥ paśavo variṣṭhāḥ | ekaviṃśaṃ puccham | dvipadāsu stuvanti pratiṣṭhityai | sarveṇa saha stuvanti | sarveṇa hy ātmanātmanvī | sahotpatanti | ekaikām ucchiṃṣanti | ātmann hy aṅgāni baddhāni | na vā etena sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ |
analyzed: pañcaviṃśaḥ ātmā bhavati tasmāt madhyataḥ paśavaḥ variṣṭhāḥ ekaviṃśam puccham dvipadāsu stuvanti pratiṣṭhityai sarveṇa saha stuvanti sarveṇa hi ātmanā ātmanvī saha utpatanti ekaikām ucchiṃṣanti ātman hi aṅgāni baddhāni na vai etena sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ

original: { 1.2.6.5} yad ita-ito lomāni dato nakhān | parimādaḥ kriyante | tāny eva tena pratyupyante | audumbaras talpo bhavati | ūrg vā annam udumbaraḥ | ūrja evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | yasya talpasadyam anabhijitaṃ syāt | sa devānāṃ sāmyakṣe | talpasadyam abhijayānīti talpam āruhyodgāyet | talpasadyam evābhijayati |
analyzed: yat ita etaḥ lomāni dataḥ nakhān parimādaḥ kriyante tāni eva tena pratyupyante audumbaraḥ talpaḥ bhavati ūrj vai annam udumbaraḥ ūrjaḥ eva annādyasya avaruddhyai yasya talpasadyam an abhijitam syāt sa devānām sāmyakṣe talpasadyam abhijayāni iti talpam āruhya udgāyet talpasadyam eva abhijayati

original: { 1.2.6.6} yasya talpasadyam abhijitaṃ syāt | sa devānāṃ sāmyakṣe | talpasadyaṃ mā parājeṣīti talpam āruhyodgāyet | na talpasadyaṃ parājayate | pleṅkhe śaṃsati | maho vai pleṅkhaḥ | mahasa evānnādyasyāvaruddhyai | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | ta āditye vyāyacchanta | taṃ devāḥ samajayan |
analyzed: yasya talpasadyam abhijitam syāt sa devānām sāmyakṣe talpasadyam mā parājeṣi iti talpam āruhya udgāyet na talpasadyam parājayate pleṅkhe śaṃsati mahaḥ vai pleṅkhaḥ mahasaḥ eva annādyasya avaruddhyai deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan te āditye vyāyacchanta tam devāḥ samajayan

original: { 1.2.6.7} brāhmaṇaś ca śūdraś ca carmakarte vyāyacchete | daivyo vai varṇo brāhmaṇaḥ | asuryaḥ śūdraḥ | ime 'rātsur ime subhūtam akrann ity anyataro brūyāt | ima udvāsīkāriṇa ime durbhūtam akrann ity anyataraḥ | yad evaiṣāṃ sukṛtaṃ yā rāddhiḥ | tad anyataro 'bhiśrīṇāti | yad evaiṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ yā rāddhiḥ | tad anyataro 'pahanti |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ ca śūdraḥ ca carma karte vyāyacchete daivyaḥ vai varṇaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ asuryaḥ śūdraḥ ime rātsuḥ ime subhūtam akran iti anyataraḥ brūyāt ime udvāsīkāriṇaḥ ime durbhūtam akran iti anyataraḥ yat eva eṣām sukṛtam yā rāddhiḥ tat anyataraḥ bhiśrīṇāti yat eva eṣām duṣkṛtam yā rāddhiḥ tat anyataraḥ upahanti

original: brāhmaṇaḥ saṃjayati | amum evādityaṃ bhrātṛvyasya saṃvindante |
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ saṃjayati amum eva ādityam bhrātṛvyasya saṃvindante

original: prapāṭhaka: 3 vājapeyaḥ anuvāka 1 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.1.1} devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devā vijayam upayantaḥ | agnīṣomayos tejasvinīs tanūs saṃnyadadhata | idam u no bhaviṣyati | yadi no jeṣyantīti | tenāgnīṣomāv apākrāmatām | te devā vijitya | agnīṣomāv anvaicchan | te 'gnim anvavindann ṛtuṣūtsannam |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 3 vājapeyaḥ anuvāka 1 vājapeyaḥ deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan te devāḥ vijayam upayantaḥ agnīṣomayoḥ tejasvinīḥ tanūḥ saṃnyadadhata idam u naḥ bhaviṣyati yadi naḥ jeṣyanti iti tena agnīṣomau apākrāmatām te devāḥ vijitya agnīṣomau anvaicchan te gnim anvavindan ṛtuṣu utsannam

original: tasya vibhaktībhis tejasvinīs tanūr avārundhata |
analyzed: tasya vibhaktībhiḥ tejasvinīḥ tanūḥ avārundhata

original: { 1.3.1.2} te somam anvavindan | tam aghnan | tasya yathābhijñāyaṃ tanūr vyagṛhṇata | te grahā abhavan | tad grahāṇāṃ grahatvam | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo grahā gṛhyante | tasya tv eva gṛhītāḥ | nānāgneyaṃ punarādheye kuryāt | yad anāgneyaṃ punarādheye kuryāt | vyṛddham eva tat {ānaṃdā. eva tat} |
analyzed: te somam anvavindan tam aghnan tasya yathā abhijñāyam tanūḥ vyagṛhṇata te grahāḥ abhavan tat grahāṇām graha tvam yasya evam viduṣaḥ grahāḥ gṛhyante tasya tu eva gṛhītāḥ na an āgneyam punarādheye kuryāt yat an āgneyam punarādheye kuryāt vyṛddham eva tat ānaṃdāḥ eva tat

original: { 1.3.1.3} anāgneyaṃ vā etat kriyate | yat samidhas tanūn apātam iḍo barhir yajati | ubhāv āgneyāv ājyabhāgau syātām | anājyabhāgau bhavata ity āhuḥ | yad ubhāv āgneyāv anvañcāv iti | agnaye pavamānāyottaraḥ syāt | yat pavamānāya | tenājyabhāgaḥ | tena saumyaḥ | budhanvaty āgneyasyājyabhāgasya puro'nuvākyā bhavati |
analyzed: an āgneyam vai etat kriyate yat samidhaḥ tanūn apātam iḍaḥ barhiḥ yajati ubhau āgneyau ājyabhāgau syātām an ājyabhāgau bhavataḥ iti āhuḥ yat ubhau āgneyau anvañcau iti agnaye pavamānāya uttaraḥ syāt yat pavamānāya tena ājyabhāgaḥ tena saumyaḥ budhanvatī āgneyasya ājyabhāgasya puronuvākyā bhavati

original: { 1.3.1.4} yathā suptaṃ bodhayati | tādṛg eva tat | agninyaktāḥ patnīsaṃyājānām ṛcaḥ syuḥ | tenāgneyaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati | ekadhā tejasvinīṃ devatāmupaitīty āhuḥ | sainam īśvarā pradaha iti | neti brūyāt | prajananaṃ vā agniḥ | prajananam evopaitīti | kṛtayajuḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāra ity āhuḥ |
analyzed: yathā suptam bodhayati tādṛś eva tat agni nyaktāḥ patnīsaṃyājānām ṛcaḥ syuḥ tena āgneyam sarvam bhavati ekadhā tejasvinīm devatām upaiti iti āhuḥ sā enam īśvarā pradahe iti na iti brūyāt prajananam vai agniḥ prajananam eva upaiti iti kṛta yajuḥ saṃbhṛta saṃbhāraḥ iti āhuḥ

original: { 1.3.1.5} na saṃbhṛtyāḥ saṃbhārāḥ | na yajuḥ kāryam iti | atho khalu | saṃbhṛtyā eva saṃbhārāḥ | kāryaṃ yajuḥ | punarādheyasya samṛddhyai | tenopāṃśu pracarati | eṣya iva vā eṣaḥ | yat punarādheyaḥ | yathopāṃśu naṣṭam icchati |
analyzed: na saṃbhṛtyāḥ saṃbhārāḥ na yajuḥ kāryam iti atha u khalu saṃbhṛtyāḥ eva saṃbhārāḥ kāryam yajuḥ punarādheyasya samṛddhyai tena upāṃśu pracarati eṣyaḥ iva vai eṣaḥ yat punarādheyaḥ yathā upāṃśu naṣṭam icchati

original: { 1.3.1.6} tādṛg eva tat | uccaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtam utsṛjati | yathā naṣṭaṃ vittvā prāhāyam iti | tādṛg eva tat | ekadhā tejasvinīṃ devatām upaitīty āhuḥ | sainam īśvarā pradaha iti | tat tathā nopaiti | prayājānūyājeṣv eva vibhaktīḥ kuryāt | yathāpūrvam ājyabhāgau syātām | evaṃ patnīsaṃyājāḥ |
analyzed: tādṛś eva tat uccais sviṣṭakṛtam utsṛjati yathā naṣṭam vittvā prāha ayam iti tādṛś eva tat ekadhā tejasvinīm devatām upaiti iti āhuḥ sā enam īśvarā pradahe iti tat tathā na upaiti prayāja anūyājeṣu eva vibhaktīḥ kuryāt yathāpūrvam ājyabhāgau syātām evam patnīsaṃyājāḥ

original: { 1.3.1.7} tad vaiśvānaravat prajananavattaram upaitīti | tad āhuḥ | vyṛddhaṃ vā etat | anāgneyaṃ vā etat kriyata iti | neti brūyāt | agniṃ prathamaṃ vibhaktīnāṃ yajati | agnim uttamaṃ patnīsaṃyājānām | tenāgneyam | tena samṛddhaṃ kriyata iti |
analyzed: tat vaiśvānara vat prajananavattaram upaiti iti tat āhuḥ vyṛddham vai etat an āgneyam vai etat kriyate iti na iti brūyāt agnim prathamam vibhaktīnām yajati agnim uttamam patnīsaṃyājānām tena āgneyam tena samṛddham kriyate iti

original: anuvāka 2 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.2.1} devā vai yathādarśaṃ yajñān āharanta | yo 'gniṣṭomam | ya ukthyam | yo 'tirātram | te sahaiva sarve vājapeyam apaśyan | te | anyonyasmai nātiṣṭhanta | aham anena yajā iti | te 'bruvan | ājim asya dhāvāmeti |
analyzed: anuvāka 2 vājapeyaḥ devāḥ vai yathādarśam yajñān āharanta yaḥ ugniṣṭomam yaḥ ukthyam yaḥ tirātram te saha eva sarve vājapeyam apaśyan te anyonyasmai na atiṣṭhanta aham anena yajā iti te bruvan ājim asya dhāvāma iti

original: { 1.3.2.2} tasminn ājim adhāvan | taṃ bṛhaspatir udajayat | tenāyajata | sa svārājyam agacchat | tam indro 'bravīt | mām anena yājayeti | tenendram ayājayat | so 'graṃ devatānāṃ paryait | agacchat svārājyam | atiṣṭhantāsmai jyaiṣṭhyāya |
analyzed: tasmin ājim adhāvan tam bṛhaspatiḥ udajayat tena ayajata sa svārājyam agacchat tam indraḥ bravīt mām anena yājaya iti tena indram ayājayat saḥ devatānām paryait agacchat svārājyam atiṣṭhanta asmai jyaiṣṭhyāya

original: { 1.3.2.3} ya evaṃ vidvān vājapeyena yajate | gacchati svārājyam | agraṃ samānānāṃ paryeti | tiṣṭhante 'smai jyaiṣṭhyāya | sa vā eṣa brāhmaṇasya caiva rājanyasya ca yajñaḥ | taṃ vā etaṃ vājapeya ity āhuḥ | vājāpyo vā eṣaḥ | vājaṃ hy etena devā aipsann | somo vai vājapeyaḥ | yo vai somaṃ vājapeyaṃ veda |
analyzed: yaḥ evam vidvān vājapeyena yajate gacchati svārājyam agram samānānām paryeti tiṣṭhante smai jyaiṣṭhyāya sa vai eṣa brāhmaṇasya ca eva rājanyasya ca yajñaḥ tam vai etam vājapeyaḥ iti āhuḥ vājāpyaḥ vai eṣaḥ vājam hi etena devāḥ aipsan somaḥ vai vājapeyaḥ yaḥ vai somam vājapeyam veda

original: { 1.3.2.11} vājy evainaṃ pītvā bhavati | āsya vājī jāyate | annaṃ vai vājapeyaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | atty annam | āsyānnādo jāyate | brahma vai vājapeyaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | atti brahmaṇānnam | āsya brahmā jāyate |
analyzed: vājī eva enam pītvā bhavati ā asya vājī jāyate annam vai vājapeyaḥ yaḥ evam veda atti annam ā asya anna ādaḥ jāyate brahma vai vājapeyaḥ yaḥ evam veda atti brahmaṇā annam ā asya brahmā jāyate

original: { 1.3.2.12} vāg vai vājasya prasavaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | karoti vācā vīryam | ainaṃ vācā gacchati | apivatīṃ vācaṃ vadati | prajāpatir devebhyo yajñān vyādiśat | sa ātman vājapeyam adhatta | taṃ devā abruvan | eṣa vāva yajñaḥ | yad vājapeyaḥ |
analyzed: vāc vai vājasya prasavaḥ yaḥ evam veda karoti vācā vīryam ā enam vācā gacchati apivatīm vācam vadati prajāpatiḥ devebhyaḥ yajñān vyādiśat saḥ ātman vājapeyam adhatta tam devāḥ abruvan eṣa vāva yajñaḥ yat vājapeyaḥ

original: { 1.3.2.6} apy eva no 'tra-astv iti | tebhya etān ujjitīḥ prāyacchat | tā vā etā ujjitayo vyākhyāyante | yajñasya sarvatvāya | devatānām anirbhāgāya | devā vai brahmaṇaś cānnasya ca śamalam apāghnan | yad brahmaṇaḥ śamalam āsīt | sā gāthā nārāśaṃsy abhavat | yad annasya | sā surā |
analyzed: api eva naḥ traastu iti tebhyaḥ etān ujjitīḥ prāyacchat tāḥ vai etāḥ ujjitayaḥ vyākhyāyante yajñasya sarva tvāya devatānām a nirbhāgāya devāḥ vai brahmaṇaḥ ca annasya ca śamalam apāghnan yat brahmaṇaḥ śamalam āsīt sā gāthā nārāśaṃsī abhavat yat annasya sā surā

original: { 1.3.2.7} tasmād gāyataś ca mattasya ca na pratigṛhyam | yatpratigṛhṇīyāt | śamalaṃ pratigṛhṇīyāt | sarvā vā etasya vāco 'varuddhāḥ | yo vājapeyayājī | yā pṛthivyāṃ yāgnau yā rathantare | yāntarikṣe yā vāyau yā vāmadevye | yā divi yāditye yā bṛhati | yāpsu yauṣadhīṣu yā vanaspatiṣu | tasmād vājapeyayājy ārtvijīnaḥ | sarvā hy asya vāco 'varuddhāḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt gāyataḥ ca mattasya ca na pratigṛhyam yat pratigṛhṇīyāt śamalam pratigṛhṇīyāt sarvāḥ vai etasya vācaḥ varuddhāḥ yaḥ vājapeya yājī yā pṛthivyām yā agnau yā rathantare yā antarikṣe yāḥ vāyau yāḥ vāmadevye yāḥ divi yā āditye yāḥ bṛhati yā apsu yā oṣadhīṣu yāḥ vanaspatiṣu tasmāt vājapeya yājī ārtvijīnaḥ sarvāḥ hi asya vācaḥ varuddhāḥ

original: anuvāka 3 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.3.1} devā vai yad anyair grahair yajñasya nāvārundhata | tad atigrāhyair atigrāhyāvārundhata| tad atigrāhyāṇām atigrāhyatvam | yad atigrāhyā gṛhyante | yad evānyair grahair yajñasya nāvarundhe | tad eva tair atigṛhyāvarundhe | pañca gṛhyante | pāṅkto yajñaḥ | yāvān eva yajñaḥ | tam āptvāvarundhe |
analyzed: anuvāka 3 vājapeyaḥ devāḥ vai yat anyaiḥ grahaiḥ yajñasya na avārundhata tat atigrāhyaiḥ atigrāhyau ārundhata tat atigrāhyāṇām atigrāhya tvam yat atigrāhyāḥ gṛhyante yat eva anyaiḥ grahaiḥ yajñasya na avarundhe tat eva taiḥ atigṛhya avarundhe pañca gṛhyante pāṅktaḥ yajñaḥ yāvān eva yajñaḥ tam āptvā avarundhe

original: { 1.3.3.2} sarva aindrā bhavanti | ekadhaiva yajamāna indriyaṃ dadhati | saptadaśa prājāpatyā grahā gṛhyante | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpater āptyai | ekayarcā gṛhṇāti | ekadhaiva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | somagrahāṃś ca surāgrahāṃś ca gṛhṇāti | etad vai devānāṃ paramam annam | yat somaḥ |
analyzed: sarve aindrāḥ bhavanti ekadhā eva yajamāne indriyam dadhati saptadaśa prājāpatyāḥ grahāḥ gṛhyante saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpateḥ āptyai ekayā ṛcā gṛhṇāti ekadhā eva yajamāne vīryam dadhāti soma grahān ca surā grahān ca gṛhṇāti etat vai devānām paramam annam yat somaḥ

original: { 1.3.3.3} etan manuṣyāṇām | yat surā | parameṇaivāsmā annādyenāvaram annādyam avarundhe | somagrahān gṛhṇāti | brahmaṇo vā etat tejaḥ | yat somaḥ | brahmaṇa eva tejasā tejo yajamāne dadhāti | surāgrahān gṛhṇāti | annasya vā etac chamalam | yat surā |
analyzed: etat manuṣyāṇām yat surā parameṇa eva asmai annādyena avaram annādyam avarundhe soma grahān gṛhṇāti brahmaṇaḥ vai etat tejaḥ yat somaḥ brahmaṇaḥ eva tejasā tejaḥ yajamāne dadhāti surā grahān gṛhṇāti annasya vai etat śamalam yat surā

original: { 1.3.3.4} annasyaiva śamalena śamalaṃ yajamānād apahanti | somagrahāṃś ca surāgrahāṃś ca gṛhṇāti | pumān vai somaḥ | strī surā | tan mithunam | mithunam evāsya tad yajñe karoti prajananāya | ātmānam eva somagrahaiḥ spṛṇoti | jāyāṃ surāgrahaiḥ | tasmād vājapeyayājy amuṣmiṃl loke striyaṃ saṃbhavati | vājapeyābhijitaṃ hy asya |
analyzed: annasya eva śamalena śamalam yajamānāt apahanti soma grahān ca surā grahān ca gṛhṇāti pumān vai somaḥ strī surā tat mithunam mithunam eva asya tat yajñe karoti prajananāya ātmānam eva soma grahaiḥ spṛṇoti jāyām surā grahaiḥ tasmāt vājapeya yājī amuṣmin loke striyam saṃbhavati vājapeya abhijitam hi asya

original: { 1.3.3.5} pūrve somagrahā gṛhyante | apare surāgrahāḥ | purokṣaṃ somagrahān sādayati | paścādakṣaṃ surāgrahān | pāpavasyasasya vidhṛtyai | eṣa vai yajamānaḥ | yat somaḥ | annaṃ surā | somagrahāṃś ca surāgrahāṃś ca vyatiṣajati | annādyenaivainaṃ vyatiṣajati |
analyzed: pūrve soma grahāḥ gṛhyante apare surā grahāḥ purokṣam soma grahān sādayati paścāt akṣam surā grahān pāpavasyasasya vidhṛtyai eṣa vai yajamānaḥ yat somaḥ annam surā soma grahān ca surā grahān ca vyatiṣajati annādyena eva enam vyatiṣajati

original: { 1.3.3.6} saṃpṛcaḥ stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktety āha | annaṃ vai bhadram | annādyenaivainaṃ saṃsṛjati | annasya vā etac chamalam | yat surā | pāpmeva khalu vai śamalam | pāpmanā vā etam etacchamalena vyatiṣajati | yat somagrahāṃś ca surāgrahāṃś ca vyatiṣajati | vipṛcaḥ stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅktety āha | pāpmanaivainaṃ śamalena vyāvartayati |
analyzed: saṃpṛcaḥ stha sam mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta iti āha annam vai bhadram annādyena eva enam saṃsṛjati annasya vai etat śamalam yat surā pāpmā iva khalu vai śamalam pāpmanā vai etam etat śamalena vyatiṣajati yat soma grahān ca surā grahān ca vyatiṣajati vipṛcaḥ stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta iti āha pāpmanā eva enam śamalena vyāvartayati

original: { 1.3.3.7} tasmād vājapeyayājī pūto medhyo dakṣiṇyaḥ | prāṅ dravati somagrahaiḥ | amum eva tair lokam abhijayati | pratyaṅ surāgrahaiḥ | imam eva tair lokam abhijayati | pratiṣṭhanti somagrahaiḥ | yāvad eva satyam | tena sūyate | vājasṛdbhyaḥ surāgrahān haranti | anṛtenaiva viśaṃ saṃsṛjati | hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇaṃ dadāti | madhavyo 'sānīti |
analyzed: tasmāt vājapeya yājī pūtaḥ medhyaḥ dakṣiṇyaḥ prāṅ dravati soma grahaiḥ amum eva taiḥ lokam abhijayati pratyaṅ surā grahaiḥ imam eva taiḥ lokam abhijayati pratiṣṭhanti soma grahaiḥ yāvat eva satyam tena sūyate vāja sṛdbhyaḥ surā grahān haranti anṛtena eva viśam saṃsṛjati hiraṇya pātram madhoḥ pūrṇam dadāti madhavyaḥ u sāni iti

original: ekadhā brahmaṇa upaharati | ekadhaiva yajamāna āyus tejo dadhāti |
analyzed: ekadhā brahmaṇe upaharati ekadhā eva yajamāne āyuḥ tejaḥ dadhāti

original: anuvāka 4 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.4.1} brahmavādino vadanti | na-agniṣṭomo na-ukthyaḥ | na ṣoḍaśī na-atirātraḥ | atha kasmād vājapeye sarve yajñakratavo 'varudhyanta iti | paśubhir iti brūyāt | āgneyaṃ paśum ālabhate | agniṣṭomam eva tena-avarundhe | aindrāgnena-ukthyam | aindreṇa ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotram | sārasvatyā-atirātram |
analyzed: anuvāka 4 vājapeyaḥ brahma vādinaḥ vadanti na agniṣṭomaḥ na ukthyaḥ na ṣoḍaśī na atirātraḥ atha kasmāt vājapeye sarve yajña kratavaḥ varudhyante iti paśubhiḥ iti brūyāt āgneyam paśum ālabhate agniṣṭomam eva tena avarundhe aindrāgnena aukthyam aindreṇa ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotram sārasvatyā atirātram

original: { 1.3.4.2} mārutyā bṛhataḥ stotram | etāvanto vai yajñakratavaḥ | tān paśubhir eva-avarundhe | ātmānam eva spṛṇoty agniṣṭomena | prāṇāpānāv ukthyena | vīryaṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa | vācam atirātreṇa | prajāṃ bṛhataḥ stotreṇa | imam eva lokam abhijayaty agniṣṭomena | antarikṣam ukthyena |
analyzed: mārutyāḥ bṛhataḥ stotram etāvantaḥ vai yajñakratavaḥ tān paśubhiḥ eva avarundhe ātmānam eva spṛṇoti agniṣṭomena prāṇa apānau ukthyena vīryam ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa vācam atirātreṇa prajām bṛhataḥ stotreṇa imam eva lokam abhijayati agniṣṭomena antarikṣam ukthyena

original: { 1.3.4.3} suvargaṃ lokaṃ ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa | devayānān eva patha ārohaty atirātreṇa | nākaṃ rohati bṛhataḥ stotreṇa | teja evātman dhatta āgneyena paśunā | ojo balam aindrāgnena | indriyam aindreṇa | vācaṃ sārasvatyā | ubhāv eva devalokaṃ ca manuṣyalokaṃ ca-abhijayati mārutyā vaśayā | saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūn ālabhate | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
analyzed: suvargam lokam ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotreṇa deva yānān eva pathaḥ ārohati atirātreṇa nākam rohati bṛhataḥ stotreṇa tejaḥ eva ātman dhatte āgneyena paśunā ojaḥ balam aindrāgnena indriyam aindreṇa vācam sārasvatyāḥ ubhau eva deva lokam ca manuṣya lokam ca abhijayati mārutyā vaśayā saptadaśa prājāpatyān paśūn ālabhate saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ

original: { 1.3.4.4} prajāpater āptyai | śyāmā ekarūpā bhavanti | evam iva hi prajāpatiḥ samṛddhyai | tān paryagnikṛtān utsṛjati | maruto yajñam ajighāṃsan prajāpateḥ | tebhya etāṃ mārutīṃ vaśām ālabhata | tayaivainān aśamayat | mārutyā pracarya | etān saṃjñapayet | maruta eva śamayitvā |
analyzed: prajāpateḥ āptyai śyāmāḥ eka rūpāḥ bhavanti evam iva hi prajāpatiḥ samṛddhyai tān paryagnikṛtān utsṛjati marutaḥ yajñam ajighāṃsan prajāpateḥ tebhyaḥ etām mārutīm vaśām ālabhata tayā eva enān aśamayat mārutyā pracarya etān saṃjñapayet marutaḥ eva śamayitvā

original: { 1.3.4.5} etaiḥ pracarati | yajñasya-aghātāya | ekadhā vapā juhoti | ekadevatyā hi | ete | atho ekadhaiva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | naivāreṇa saptadaśaśarāveṇaitarhi pracarati | etat puroḍāśā hy ete | atho paśūnām eva cchidram apidadhāti | sārasvatyā-uttamayā pracarati | vāg vai sarasvatī | tasmāt prāṇānāṃ vāg uttamā |
analyzed: etaiḥ pracarati yajñasya aghātāya ekadhā vapāḥ juhoti eka devatyāḥ hi ete atha u ekadhā eva yajamāne vīryam dadhāti naivāreṇa saptadaśa śarāveṇa etarhi pracarati etat puroḍāśāḥ hi ete atha u paśūnām eva chidram apidadhāti sārasvatyā uttamayā pracarati vāc vai sarasvatī tasmāt prāṇānām vāc uttamā

original: atho prajāpatāv eva yajñaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | prajāpatir hi vāk | apannadatī bhavati | tasmān manuṣyāḥ sarvāṃ vācaṃ vadanti |
analyzed: atha u prajāpatau eva yajñam pratiṣṭhāpayati prajāpatiḥ hi vāc a panna datī bhavati tasmāt manuṣyāḥ sarvām vācam vadanti

original: anuvāka 5 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.5.1} sāvitraṃ juhoti karmaṇaḥ karmaṇaḥ purastāt | kas tad veda-ity āhuḥ | yad vājapeyasya pūrvaṃ yad aparam iti | savitṛprasūta eva yathāpūrvaṃ karmāṇi karoti | savane-savane juhoti | ākramaṇam eva tat setuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | vācaspatir vācam adya svadāti na ity āha |
analyzed: sāvitra juhoti karmaṇaḥ karmaṇaḥ purastāt kaḥ tat veda iti āhuḥ yat vājapeyasya pūrvam yat aparam iti savitṛ prasūtaḥ eva yathāpūrvam karmāṇi karoti savane savane juhoti ākramaṇam eva tat setum yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai vācaspatiḥ vācam adya svadāti naḥ iti āha

original: vāg vai devānāṃ purānnam āsīt | vācam evāsmā annaṃ svadayati |
analyzed: vāc vai devānām purā annam āsīt vācam eva asmai annam svadayati

original: { 1.3.5.2} indrasya vajro 'si vārtraghna iti ratham upāvaharati vijityai | vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīm ity āha | yac caiva-iyam | yac ca-asyām adhi | tadeva-avarundhe | atho tasminn eva-ubhaye 'bhiṣicyate | apsv antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam ity aśvān palpūlayati | apsu vā aśvasya tṛtīyaṃ praviṣṭam | tad anuvenan - avaplavate |
analyzed: indrasya vajraḥ si vārtraghnaḥ iti ratham upāvaharati vijityai vājasya nu prasave mātaram mahīm iti āha yat ca eva eyam yat ca asyām adhi tat eva avarundhe atha u tasmin eva aubhaye bhiṣicyate apsu antar amṛtam apsu bheṣajam iti aśvān palpūlayati apsu vai aśvasya tṛtīyam praviṣṭam tat anuvenan avaplavate

original: yad apsu palpūlayati |
analyzed: yat apsu palpūlayati

original: anuvāka 9 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.9.1} nṛṣadaṃ tvā-ity āha | prajā vai nṝn | prajānām evaitena sūyate | druṣadam ity āha | vanaspatayo vai dru | vanaspatīnām evaitena sūyate | bhuvanasadam ity āha | yadā vai vasīyān bhavati | bhuvanam agann iti vai tam āhuḥ | bhuvanam evaitena gacchati |
analyzed: anuvāka 9 vājapeyaḥ nṛṣadam tvā iti āha prajāḥ vai nṝn prajānām eva etena sūyate druṣadam iti āha vanaspatayaḥ vai dru vanaspatīnām eva etena sūyate bhuvana sadam iti āha yadā vai vasīyān bhavati bhuvanam agan iti vai tam āhuḥ bhuvanam eva etena gacchati

original: { 1.3.9.2} apsuṣadaṃ tvā ghṛtasadam ity āha | apām evaitena ghṛtasya sūyate | vyomasadam ity āha | yadā vai vasīyān bhavati | vyomāgann iti vai tam āhuḥ | vyomaivaitena gacchati | pṛthiviṣadaṃ tvā-antarikṣasadam ity āha | eṣām evaitena lokānāṃ sūyate | tasmād vājapeyayājī na kaṃ cana pratyavarohati | apīva hi devatānāṃ sūyate |
analyzed: apsuṣadam tvā ghṛta sadam iti āha apām eva etena ghṛtasya sūyate vyoma sadam iti āha yadā vai vasīyān bhavati vyoma agan iti vai tam āhuḥ vyoma eva etena gacchati pṛthiviṣadam tvā antarikṣa sadam iti āha eṣām eva etena lokānām sūyate tasmāt vājapeya yājī na kam cana pratyavarohati api iva hi devatānām sūyate

original: { 1.3.9.2} nākasadam ity āha | yadā vai vasīyān bhavati | nākam agann iti vaitam āhuḥ | nākam evaitena gacchati | ye grahāḥ pañcajanīnā ity āha | pañcajanānām evaitena sūyate | apāṃ rasam ud vayasam ity āha | apām evaitena rasasya sūyate | sūryaraśmiṃ samābhṛtam ity āha saśukratvāya |
analyzed: nākasadam iti āha yadā vai vasīyān bhavati nākam agan iti vā etam āhuḥ nākam eva etena gacchati ye grahāḥ pañcajanīnāḥ iti āha pañcajanānām eva etena sūyate apām rasam ud vayasam iti āha apām eva etena rasasya sūyate sūrya raśmim samābhṛtam iti āha sa śukra tvāya

original: anuvāka 10 vājapeyaḥ { 1.3.10.1} indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | asurān parābhāvya | so 'māvāsyāṃ praty āgacchat | te pitaraḥ pūrvedyur āgacchan | pitṝn yajño 'gacchat | taṃ devāḥ punar ayācanta | tam ebhyo na punar adaduḥ | te 'bruvan varaṃ vṛṇāmahai | atha vaḥ punar dāsyāmaḥ | asmabhyam eva pūrvedyuḥ kriyātā iti |
analyzed: indraḥ vṛtram hatvā asurān parābhāvya saḥ māvāsyām prati āgacchat te pitaraḥ pūrvedyus āgacchan pitṝn yajñaḥ gacchat tam devāḥ punar ayācanta tam ebhyaḥ na punar adaduḥ te bruvan varam vṛṇāmahai atha vaḥ punar dāsyāmaḥ asmabhyam eva pūrvedyus kriyātai iti

original: { 1.3.10.2} tam ebhyaḥ punar adaduḥ | tasmāt pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ kriyate | yat pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyuḥ karoti | pitṛbhya eva tad yajñaṃ niṣkrīya yajamānaḥ pratanute | somāya pitṛpītāya svadhā nama ity āha | pitur eva-adhi somapītham avarundhe | na hi pitā pramīyamāṇa āhaiṣa somapītha iti | indriyaṃ vai somapīthaḥ | indriyam eva somapītham avarundhe |
analyzed: tam ebhyaḥ punar adaduḥ tasmāt pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyus kriyate yat pitṛbhyaḥ pūrvedyus karoti pitṛbhyaḥ eva tat yajñam niṣkrīya yajamānaḥ pratanute somāya pitṛ pītāya svadhā namaḥ iti āha pituḥ eva adhi soma pītham avarundhe na hi pitā pramīyamāṇaḥ āha eṣa soma pīthaḥ iti indriyam vai soma pīthaḥ indriyam eva soma pītham avarundhe

original: tena-indriyeṇa dvitīyāṃ jāyām abhyaśnute |
analyzed: tena aindriyeṇa dvitīyām jāyām abhyaśnute

original: { 1.3.10.3} etad vai brāhmaṇaṃ purā vājaśravasā vidām akrann | tasmāt te dve-dve jāye abhyākṣata | ya evaṃ veda | abhi dvitīyāṃ jāyām aśnute | agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā nama ity āha | ya eva pitṝṇām agniḥ | taṃ prīṇāti | tisra āhutīr juhoti | trir nidadhāti | ṣaṭ saṃpadyante |
analyzed: etat vai brāhmaṇam purā vājaśravasā vidām akran tasmāt te dve dve jāye abhyākṣata yaḥ evam veda abhi dvitīyām jāyām aśnute agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ iti āha yaḥ eva pitṝṇām agniḥ tam prīṇāti tisraḥ āhutīḥ juhoti tris nidadhāti ṣaṭ saṃpadyante

original: { 1.3.10.4} ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūn eva prīṇāti | tūṣṇīṃ mekṣaṇam ādadhāti | asti vā hi ṣaṣṭha ṛtur na vā | devān vai pitṝn prītān | manuṣyāḥ pitaro 'nu prapipate | tisra āhutīr juhoti trir nidadhāti | ṣaṭ saṃpadyante | ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ |
analyzed: ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ ṛtūn eva prīṇāti tūṣṇīm mekṣaṇam ādadhāti asti vā hi ṣaṣṭhaḥ ṛtuḥ na vā devān vai pitṝn prītān manuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ nu prapipate tisraḥ āhutīḥ juhoti tris nidadhāti ṣaṭ saṃpadyante ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ

original: { 1.3.10.5} ṛtavaḥ khalu vai devāḥ pitaraḥ | ṛtūn eva devān pitṝn prīṇāti | tān prītān | manuṣyāḥ pitaro 'nu prapipate | sakṛdācchinnaṃ barhir bhavati | sakṛd iva hi pitaraḥ | trir nidadhāti | tṛtīye vā ito loke pitaraḥ | tān eva prīṇāti | parāṅ āvartate |
analyzed: ṛtavaḥ khalu vai devāḥ pitaraḥ ṛtūn eva devān pitṝn prīṇāti tān prītān manuṣyāḥ pitaraḥ nu prapipate sakṛdācchinnam barhiḥ bhavati sakṛt iva hi pitaraḥ tris nidadhāti tṛtīye vai itas loke pitaraḥ tān eva prīṇāti parāṅ āvartate

original: { 1.3.10.61} hlīkā hi pitaraḥ | ā-uṣmaṇo vyāvṛta upāste | ūṣmabhāgā hi pitaraḥ | brahmavādino vadanti | prāśyā3ṃ na prāśyā3m iti | yat prāśnīyāt | janyam annam adyāt | pramāyukaḥ syāt | yan na prāśnīyāt | ahavi syāt |
analyzed: hlīkāḥ hi pitaraḥ āuṣmaṇaḥ vyāvṛtaḥ upāste ūṣma bhāgāḥ hi pitaraḥ brahma vādinaḥ vadanti prāśyam na prāśyam iti yat prāśnīyāt janyam annam adyāt pramāyukaḥ syāt yat na prāśnīyāt a havi syāt

original: { 1.3.10.7} pitṛbhya āvṛścyeta | avaghreyam eva | tan na-iva prāśitaṃ na-iva-aprāśitam | vīraṃ vā vai pitaraḥ prayanto haranti | vīraṃ vā dadati | daśāṃ cchinatti | haraṇabhāgā hi pitaraḥ | pitṝn eva niravadayate | uttara āyuṣi loma chindīta | pitṝṇāṃ hy etarhi nedīyaḥ |
analyzed: pitṛbhyaḥ āvṛścyeta avaghreyam eva tat na eva prāśitam na eva a prāśitam vīram vā vai pitaraḥ prayantaḥ haranti vīram vā dadati daśām chinatti haraṇa bhāgāḥ hi pitaraḥ pitṝn eva niravadayate uttare āyuṣi loma chindīta pitṝṇām hi etarhi nedīyaḥ

original: { 1.3.10.8} namaskaroti | namaskāro hi pitṝṇām | namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ śuṣmāya | namo vaḥ pitaro jīvāya | namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai | namo vaḥ pitaro manyave | namo vaḥ pitaro ghorāya | pitaro namo vaḥ | ya etasmin loke stha |
analyzed: namaskaroti namaskāraḥ hi pitṝṇām namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ rasāya namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ śuṣmāya namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ jīvāya namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhāyai namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ manyave namaḥ vaḥ pitaraḥ ghorāya pitaraḥ namaḥ vaḥ ye etasmin loke stha

original: { 1.3.10.9} yuṣmāṃs te 'nu | ye 'smin loke | māṃ te 'nu | ya etasmiṃl loke stha | yūyaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭhā bhūyāsta | ye 'smiṃl loke | ahaṃ teṣāṃ vasiṣṭho bhūyāsam ity āha | vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ vidvān pitṛbhyaḥ karoti | eṣa vai manuṣyāṇāṃ yajñaḥ |
analyzed: yuṣmān te nu ye smin loke mām te nu ye etasmin loke stha yūyam teṣām vasiṣṭhāḥ bhūyāsta ye smin loke aham teṣām vasiṣṭhaḥ bhūyāsam iti āha vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānām bhavati yaḥ evam vidvān pitṛbhyaḥ karoti eṣa vai manuṣyāṇām yajñaḥ

original: { 1.3.10.10} devānāṃ vā itare yajñāḥ | tena vā etat pitṛloke carati | yaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ karoti | sa īśvaraḥ prametoḥ | prājāpatyayā-ṛcā punar aiti | yajño vai prajāpatiḥ | yajñenaiva saha punar aiti | na pramāyuko bhavati | pitṛloke vā etad yajamānaś carati | yat pitṛbhyaḥ karoti | sa īśvara ārtim ārtoḥ |
analyzed: devānām vai itare yajñāḥ tena vai etat pitṛ loke carati yaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ karoti saḥ īśvaraḥ prametoḥ prājāpatyayā ṛcā punar aiti yajñaḥ vai prajāpatiḥ yajñena eva saha punar aiti na pramāyukaḥ bhavati pitṛ loke vai etat yajamānaḥ carati yat pitṛbhyaḥ karoti saḥ īśvaraḥ ārtim ārtoḥ

original: prajāpatis tvā vainaṃ tata unnetum arhati-ity āhuḥ | yat prājāpatyayā-ṛcā {prājāpatyayarcā} punar aiti | prajāpatir evainaṃ tata unnayati | na-ārtim ārchati yajamānaḥ |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ tvā vā enam tatas unnetum arhati iti āhuḥ yat prājāpatyayā ṛcā prājāpatyayā ṛcā punar aiti prajāpatiḥ eva enam tatas unnayati na ārtim ārchati yajamānaḥ

original: prapāṭhaka: 4 anuvāka 1 grahāḥ { 1.4.1.1} ubhaye vā ete prajāpater adhyasṛjyanta | devāś ca-asurāś ca | tān na vyajānāt | ime 'nya ime 'nya iti | sa devānaṃśūn akarot | tān abhyaṣuṇot | tān pavitreṇa-apunāt | tān parastāt pavitrasya vyagṛhṇāt | te grahā abhavan | tad grahāṇāṃ grahatvam |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 4 anuvāka grahāḥ ubhaye vai ete prajāpateḥ adhyasṛjyanta devāḥ ca asurāḥ ca tān na vyajānāt ime nyaḥ ime nyaḥ iti sa devān aṃśūn akarot tān abhyaṣuṇot tān pavitreṇa apunāt tān parastāt pavitrasya vyagṛhṇāt te grahāḥ abhavan tat grahāṇām graha tvam

original: { 1.4.1.2} devatā vā etā yajamānasya gṛhe gṛhyante | yad grahāḥ | vidur enaṃ devāḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣa ete grahā gṛhyante | eṣā vai somasya-āhutiḥ | yad upāṃśuḥ | somena devāṃs tarpayāṇi-iti khalu vai somena yajate | yad upāṃśuṃ juhoti | somenaiva tad devāṃs tarpayati | yad grahāñ juhoti |
analyzed: devatāḥ vai etāḥ yajamānasya gṛhe gṛhyante yat grahāḥ viduḥ enam devāḥ yasya evam viduṣaḥ ete grahāḥ gṛhyante eṣā vai somasya āhutiḥ yat upāṃśuḥ somena devān tarpayāṇi iti khalu vai somena yajate yat upāṃśum juhoti somena eva tat devān tarpayati yat grahān juhoti

original: { 1.4.1.3} devā eva tad devān gacchanti | yac camasāñ juhoti | tenaiva-anurūpeṇa yajamānaḥ suvargaṃ lokam eti | kiṃ nv etad agra āsīd ity āhuḥ | yat pātrāṇi-iti | iyaṃ vā etad agra āsīt | mṛnmayāni vā etāny āsan | tair devā na vyāvṛtam agacchan | ta etāni dārumayāṇi pātrāṇy apaśyan | 0 tāny akurvata |
analyzed: devāḥ eva tat devān gacchanti yat camasān juhoti tena eva anurūpeṇa yajamānaḥ suvargam lokam eti kim nu etat agre āsīt iti āhuḥ yat pātrāṇi iti iyam vai etat agre āsīt mṛd mayāni vai etāni āsan taiḥ devāḥ na vyāvṛtam agacchan te etāni dāru mayāṇi pātrāṇi apaśyan tāni akurvata

original: { 1.4.1.4} tair vai te vyāvṛtam agacchan | yad dārumayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti | vyāvṛtam eva tair yajamāno gacchati | yāni dārumayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti | amum eva tair lokam abhijayati | yāni mṛnmayāni | imameva tair lokam abhijayati | brahmavādino vadanti | kāś catasraḥ sthālīr vāyavyāḥ somagrahaṇīr iti | devā vai pṛśnim aduhran |
analyzed: taiḥ vai te vyāvṛtam agacchan yat dāru mayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti vyāvṛtam eva taiḥ yajamānaḥ gacchati yāni dāru mayāṇi pātrāṇi bhavanti amum eva taiḥ lokam abhijayati yāni mṛd mayāni imam eva taiḥ lokam abhijayati brahma vādinaḥ vadanti kāḥ catasraḥ sthālīḥ vāyavyāḥ soma grahaṇīḥ iti devāḥ vai pṛśnim aduhran

original: { 1.4.1.5} tasyā ete stanā āsan | iyaṃ vai pṛśniḥ | tām ādityā ādityasthālyā catuṣpadaḥ paśūn aduhran | yad ādityasthālī bhavati | catuṣpada eva tayā paśūn yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tām indra ukthyasthālyā-indriyam aduhat | yad ukthyasthālī bhavati | indriyam eva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tāṃ viśve devā āgrayaṇasthālyā-ūrjam aduhran |
analyzed: tasyāḥ ete stanāḥ āsan iyam vai pṛśniḥ tām ādityāḥ āditya sthālyā catuṣpadaḥ paśūn aduhran yat āditya sthālī bhavati catuṣpadaḥ eva tayā paśūn yajamānaḥ imām duhe tām indraḥ ukthya sthālyā aindriyam aduhat yat ukthya sthālī bhavati indriyam eva tayā yajamānaḥ imām duhe tām viśve devāḥ āgrayaṇa sthālyā ūrjam aduhran

original: yad āgrayaṇasthālī bhavati |
analyzed: yat āgrayaṇa sthālī bhavati

original: { 1.4.1.6} ūrjam eva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | tāṃ manuṣyā dhruvasthālyā-āyur aduhran | yad dhruvasthālī bhavati | āyur eva tayā yajamāna imāṃ duhe | sthālyā gṛhṇāti | vāyavyena juhoti | tasmād anyena pātreṇa paśūn duhanti | anyena pratigṛhṇanti | atho vyāvṛtam eva tad yajamāno gacchati |
analyzed: ūrjam eva tayā yajamānaḥ imām duhe tām manuṣyāḥ dhruva sthālyā āyuḥ aduhran yat dhruva sthālī bhavati āyuḥ eva tayā yajamānaḥ imām duhe sthālyā gṛhṇāti vāyavyena juhoti tasmāt anyena pātreṇa paśūn duhanti anyena pratigṛhṇanti atha u vyāvṛtam eva tat yajamānaḥ gacchati

original: anuvāka 2 sautrāmaṇiśeṣāmantrāḥ { 1.4.2.1} yuvaṃ surāmam aśvinā | namucāv āsure sacā | vipipānā śubhaspatī | indraṃ karmasvāvatam | putram iva pitarāv aśvinā-ubhā | indra-āvataṃ karmaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ | yat surāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ | sarasvatī tvā maghavann abhīṣṇāt | ahāvy agne havir āsye te | sruci-iva { srucīvaṃ} ghṛtaṃ camū iva somaḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 2 sautrāmaṇi śeṣā mantrāḥ yuvam su rāmam aśvinā namucau āsure sacā vipipānā śubhaspatī indram putram iva pitarau aśvinā ubhau indra āvatam karmaṇā daṃsanābhiḥ yat su rāmam vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavan abhīṣṇāt ahāvi agne haviḥ āsye te sruci iva srucīvam ghṛtam camū iva somaḥ

original: { 1.4.2.2} vājasaniṃ rayim asme suvīram | praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam | yasminn aśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇaḥ | vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ | kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase | hṛdā matiṃ janaya cārum agnaye | nānā hi vāṃ devahitaṃ sado mitam | mā saṃsṛkṣāthāṃ parame vyoman | surā tvam asi śuṣmiṇī soma eṣaḥ | 0 mā mā hiṃsīḥ svāṃ yonim āviśan |
analyzed: vāja sanim rayim asme su vīram praśastam dhehi yaśasam bṛhantam yasmin aśvāsaḥ ṛṣabhāsaḥ ukṣaṇaḥ vaśāḥ meṣāḥ avasṛṣṭāsaḥ āhutāḥ kīlāla pe soma pṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matim janaya cārum agnaye nānā hi vām deva hitam sadaḥ mitam mā saṃsṛkṣāthām parame vyoman surā tvam asi śuṣmiṇī somaḥ eṣaḥ mā mā hiṃsīḥ svām yonim āviśan

original: { 1.4.2.3} yad atra śiṣṭaṃ rasinaḥ sutasya | yad indro apibac-śacībhiḥ | ahaṃ tad asya manasā śivena | somaṃ rājānam iha bhakṣayāmi | dve srutī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇām | ahaṃ devānām uta martyānām | tābhyām idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti | antarā pūrvam aparaṃ ca ketum | yas te deva varuṇa gāyatrachandāḥ pāśaḥ | taṃ ta etena-avayaje |
