original: śipiviṣṭavatīṣu kurvanti śipiviṣṭo vai devānāṃ puṣṭaṃ | puṣṭyā-evainaṃ samardhayanti | hotuś camasam anu-unnayante | hotā-anuśaṃsati | madhyata eva yajñaṃ samādadhāti |
analyzed: śipiviṣṭavatīṣu kurvanti śipiviṣṭaḥ vai devānām puṣṭam puṣṭyā eva enam samardhayanti hotuḥ camasam anu unnayante hotā anuśaṃsati madhyataḥ eva yajñam samādadhāti

original: anuvāka 6 ekagrāmavartibahusomayāga viśeṣaḥ { 1.4.6.1} ekaiko vai janatāyām indraḥ | ekaṃ vā etāv indram abhi saṃsunutaḥ | yau dvau saṃsunutaḥ | prajāpatir vā eṣa vitāyate | yad yajñaḥ | tasya grāvāṇo dantāḥ | anyataraṃ vā ete saṃsunvator nirbapsati | pūrveṇa-upasṛtyā devatā ity āhuḥ | pūrvopasṛtasya vai śreyān bhavati |
analyzed: eka grāma varti bahu soma yāga viśeṣaḥ ekaikaḥ vai janatāyām indraḥ ekam vai etau indram abhi saṃsunutaḥ yau dvau saṃsunutaḥ prajāpatiḥ vai eṣa vitāyate yat yajñaḥ tasya grāvāṇaḥ dantāḥ anyataram vai ete saṃsunvatoḥ nirbapsati pūrveṇa aupasṛtyāḥ devatāḥ iti āhuḥ pūrva upasṛtasya vai śreyān bhavati

original: etivanty ājyāni bhavanty abhijityai |
analyzed: etivanti ājyāni bhavanti abhijityai

original: { 1.4.6.2} marutvatīḥ pratipadaḥ | maruto vai devānām aparājitam āyatanam | devānām eva-aparājita āyatane yatate | ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavataḥ | iyaṃ vāva rathantaram | asau bṛhat | ābhyām evainam antareti | vācaś ca manasaś ca | prāṇāc ca-apānāc ca | divaś ca pṛthivyāś ca |
analyzed: marutvatīḥ pratipadaḥ marutaḥ vai devānām aparājitam āyatanam devānām eva aparājitaḥ āyatane yatate ubhe bṛhat rathantare bhavataḥ iyam vāva rathantaram asau bṛhat ābhyām eva enam antareti vācaḥ ca manasaḥ ca prāṇāt ca apānāt ca divaḥ ca pṛthivyāḥ ca

original: { 1.4.6.3} sarvasmād vittād vedyāt | abhivarto brahmasāmaṃ bhavati | suvargasya lokasya-abhivṛttyai | abhijid bhavati | suvargasya lokasya-abhijityai | viśvajid bhavati | viśvasya jityai | yasya bhūyāṃso yajñakratava ity āhuḥ | sa devatā vṛṅkta iti | yady agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ parastāt syāt |
analyzed: sarvasmāt vittāt vedyāt abhivartaḥ brahma sāmam bhavati suvargasya lokasya abhivṛttyai abhijit bhavati suvargasya lokasya abhijityai viśvajit bhavati viśvasya jityai yasya bhūyāṃsaḥ yajña kratavaḥ iti āhuḥ sa devatāḥ vṛṅkte iti yadi agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ parastāt syāt

original: { 1.4.6.4} ukthyaṃ kurvīta | yady ukthyaḥ syāt | atirātraṃ kurvīta | yajñakratubhir evāsya devatā vṛṅkte | yo vai chandobhir abhibhavati | sa saṃsunvator abhibhavati | saṃveśāya tvā-upaveśāya tvā-ity āha | chandāṃsi vai saṃveśa upaveṣaḥ | chandobhir evāsya chandāṃsy abhibhavati | iṣṭargo vā ṛtvijām adhvaryuḥ |
analyzed: ukthyam kurvīta yadi ukthyaḥ syāt atirātram kurvīta yajñakratubhiḥ eva asya devatāḥ vṛṅkte yaḥ vai chandobhiḥ abhibhavati sa saṃsunvatoḥ abhibhavati saṃveśāya tvā upaveśāya tvā iti āha chandāṃsi vai saṃveśaḥ upaveṣaḥ chandobhiḥ eva asya chandāṃsi abhibhavati iṣṭargaḥ vai ṛtvijām adhvaryuḥ

original: { 1.4.6.36} iṣṭargaḥ khalu vai pūrvo 'rṣṭuḥ kṣīyate | prāṇāpānau mṛtyor mā pātam ity āha | prāṇāpānayoreva śrayate | prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭam ity āha | nainaṃ purā-āyuṣaḥ prāṇāpānau jahitaḥ | ārtiṃ vā ete niyanti | yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānāṃ pramīyate | taṃ yad avavarjeyuḥ | krūrakṛtām ivaiṣāṃ lokaḥ syāt | āhara daha-iti brūyāt |
analyzed: iṣṭa ṛgaḥ khalu vai pūrvaḥ ṛṣṭuḥ kṣīyate prāṇa apānau mṛtyoḥ mā pātam iti āha prāṇa apānayoḥ eva śrayate prāṇa apānau mā mā hāsiṣṭam iti āha na enam purā āyuṣaḥ prāṇa apānau jahitaḥ ārtim vai ete niyanti yeṣām dīkṣitānām pramīyate tam yat avavarjeyuḥ krūra kṛtām iva eṣām lokaḥ syāt āhara daha eti brūyāt

original: { 1.4.6.6} taṃ dakṣiṇato vedyai nidhāya | sarparājñiyā ṛgbhiḥ stuyuḥ | iyaṃ vai sarpato rājñī | asyā evainaṃ paridadati | vyṛddhaṃ tad ity āhuḥ | yat stutam ananuśastam iti | hotā prathamaḥ prācīnāvītī mārjālīyaṃ parīyāt | yāmīr anubruvan | sarparājñīnāṃ kīrtayet | ubhayor evainaṃ lokayoḥ paridadati |
analyzed: tam dakṣiṇatas vedyai nidhāya sarparājñiyāḥ ṛgbhiḥ stuyuḥ iyam vai sarpataḥ rājñī asyai eva enam paridadati vyṛddham tat iti āhuḥ yat stutam an anuśastam iti hotā prathamaḥ prācīnāvītī mārjālīyam parīyāt yāmīḥ anubruvan sarparājñīnām kīrtayet ubhayoḥ eva enam lokayoḥ paridadati

original: { 1.4.6.7} atho dhuvanty evainam | atho 'nye vā'smai hnuvate | triḥ pariyanti | traya ime lokāḥ | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyo dhuvate | triḥ punaḥ pariyanti | ṣaṭ saṃpadyante | ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtubhir evainaṃ dhuvate | agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipadaṃ kurvīran | rathantarasāmaiṣāṃ somaḥ syāt | āyur evā''tman dadhate | atho pāpmānam eva vijahato yanti |
analyzed: atha u dhuvanti eva enam atha u nye vā asmai hnuvate tris pariyanti trayaḥ ime lokāḥ ebhyaḥ eva enam lokebhyaḥ dhuvate tris punar pariyanti ṣaṭ saṃpadyante ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ ṛtubhiḥ eva enam dhuvate agne āyūṃṣi pavase iti pratipadam kurvīran rathantara sāma eṣām somaḥ syāt āyuḥ eva ātman dadhate atha u pāpmānam eva vijahataḥ yanti

original: anuvāka 7 yūpavirohaṇādi prāyaścittāni { 1.4.7.1} asuryaṃ vā etasmād varṇaṃ kṛtvā | paśavo vīryam apakrāmanti | yasya yūpo virohati | tvāṣṭraṃ bahurūpam ālabheta | tvaṣṭā vai rūpāṇām īśe | ya eva rūpāṇām īśe | so 'smin paśūn vīryaṃ yacchati | na-asmāt paśavo vīryam apa krāmanti | ārtiṃ vā ete niyanti | yeṣāṃ dīkṣitānām agnir udvāyati |
analyzed: anuvāka 7 yūpa virohaṇa ādi prāyaścittāni asuryam vai etasmāt varṇam kṛtvā paśavaḥ vīryam apakrāmanti yasya yūpaḥ virohati tvāṣṭram bahu rūpam ālabheta tvaṣṭā vai rūpāṇām īśe yaḥ eva rūpāṇām īśe saḥ smin paśūn vīryam yacchati na asmāt paśavaḥ vīryam apa krāmanti ārtim vai ete niyanti yeṣām dīkṣitānām agniḥ udvāyati

original: { 1.4.7.2} yad āhavanīya udvāyet | yat taṃ manthet | vicchindyāt | bhrātṛvyam asmai janayet | yad āhavanīya udvāyet | āgnīdhrād uddharet | yad āgnīdhra udvāyet | gārhapatyād uddharet | yad gārhapatya udvāyet | ata eva punar manthet |
analyzed: yat āhavanīyaḥ udvāyet yat tam manthet vicchindyāt bhrātṛvyam asmai janayet yat āhavanīyaḥ udvāyet āgnīdhrāt uddharet yat āgnīdhraḥ udvāyet gārhapatyāt uddharet yat gārhapatyaḥ udvāyet atas eva punar manthet

original: { 1.4.7.3} atra vāva sa nilayate | yatra khalu vai nilīnam uttamaṃ paśyanti | tadenam icchanti | yasmād dāror udvāyet | tasya-araṇī kuryāt | krumukam api kuryāt | eṣā vā agneḥ priyā tanūḥ | yat krumukaḥ | priyayā-evainaṃ tanuvā samardhayati | gārhapatyaṃ manthati |
analyzed: atra vāva sa nilayate yatra khalu vai nilīnam uttamam paśyanti tat enam icchanti yasmāt dāroḥ udvāyet tasya araṇī kuryāt krumukam api kuryāt eṣā vai agneḥ priyā tanūḥ yat krumukaḥ priyayā eva enam tanuvā samardhayati gārhapatyam manthati

original: { 1.4.7.4} gārhapatyo vā agner yoniḥ | svād evainaṃ yoner janayati | na-asmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | yasya soma upadasyet | suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dvedhā vicchidya | ṛjīṣe 'nyad ādhūnuyāt | juhuyād anyat | somam eva-abhiṣuṇoti | somaṃ juhoti | somasya vā abhiṣūyamāṇasya priyā tanūr udakrāmat |
analyzed: gārhapatyaḥ vai agneḥ yoniḥ svāt eva enam yoneḥ janayati na asmai bhrātṛvyam janayati yasya somaḥ upadasyet suvarṇam hiraṇyam dvedhā vicchidya ṛjīṣe ādhūnuyāt juhuyāt anyat somam eva abhiṣuṇoti somam juhoti somasya vai abhiṣūyamāṇasya priyā tanūḥ udakrāmat

original: { 1.4.7.5} tat suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyam abhavat | yat suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ kurvanti | priyayā-evainaṃ tanuvā samardhayanti | yasya-akrītaṃ somam apahareyuḥ | krīṇīyād eva | sā-eva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | yasya krītam apahareyuḥ | ādārāṃśca phālgunāni ca-abhiṣuṇuyāt | gāyatrī yaṃ somam āharat | tasya yo 'ṃśuḥ parāpatat |
analyzed: tat suvarṇam hiraṇyam abhavat yat suvarṇam hiraṇyam kurvanti priyayā eva enam tanuvā samardhayanti yasya a krītam somam apahareyuḥ krīṇīyāt eva sā eva tatas prāyaścittiḥ yasya krītam apahareyuḥ ādārān ca phālgunāni ca abhiṣuṇuyāt gāyatrī yam somam āharat tasya yaḥ ṃśuḥ parāpatat

original: { 1.4.7.6} ta ādārā abhavan | indro vṛtram ahan | tasya valkaḥ parāpatat | tāni phālgunāny abhavan | paśavo vai phālgunāni | paśavaḥ somo rājā | yad ādārāṃś ca phālgunāni ca-abhiṣuṇoti | somam eva rājānamabhiṣuṇoti | śṛtena prātaḥsavane śrīṇīyāt | dadhnā madhyaṃdine |
analyzed: te ādārāḥ abhavan indraḥ vṛtram ahan tasya valkaḥ parāpatat tāni phālgunāni abhavan paśavaḥ vai phālgunāni paśavaḥ somaḥ rājā yat ādārān ca phālgunāni ca abhiṣuṇoti somam eva rājānam abhiṣuṇoti śṛtena prātaḥsavane śrīṇīyāt dadhnā madhyaṃdine

original: { 1.4.7.7} nītamiśreṇa tṛtīyasavane | agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ syād rathantarasāma | ya eva-ṛtvijo vṛtāḥ syuḥ | ta enaṃ yājayeyuḥ | ekāṃ gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt tebhya eva | punaḥ somaṃ krīṇīyāt | yajñenaiva tad yajñam icchati | sā-eva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ | sarvābhyo vā eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānam āgurate | yaḥ sattrāya-āgurate |
analyzed: nīta miśreṇa tṛtīyasavane agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ syāt rathantara sāma ye eva ṛtvijaḥ vṛtāḥ syuḥ te enam yājayeyuḥ ekām gām dakṣiṇām dadyāt tebhyaḥ eva punar somam krīṇīyāt yajñena eva tat yajñam icchati sā eva tatas prāyaścittiḥ sarvābhyaḥ vai eṣa devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhyaḥ ātmānam āgurate yaḥ sattrāya āgurate

original: etāvān khalu vai puruṣaḥ | yāvad asya vittam | sarvavedasena yajeta | sarvapṛṣṭho 'sya somaḥ syāt | sarvābhya eva devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhya ātmānaṃ niṣkrīṇīte |
analyzed: etāvān khalu vai puruṣaḥ yāvat asya vittam sarvavedasena yajeta sarva pṛṣṭhaḥ sya somaḥ syāt sarvābhyaḥ eva devatābhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhebhyaḥ ātmānam niṣkrīṇīte

original: anuvāka 8 śuddhihetavo mantrāḥ { 1.4.8.1} pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ | pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu mā | punantu mā devajanāḥ | punantu manavo dhiyā | punantu viśva āyavaḥ | jātavedaḥ pavitravat | pavitreṇa punāhi mā | śukreṇa deva dīdyat | agne kratvā kratūṃranu |
analyzed: anuvāka 8 śuddhi hetavaḥ mantrāḥ pavamānaḥ suvarjanaḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ yaḥ potā sa punātu mā punantu mā deva janāḥ punantu manavaḥ dhiyā punantu viśve āyavaḥ jātavedaḥ pavitravat pavitreṇa punāhi mā śukreṇa deva dīdyat agne kratvā kratūṃr anu

original: { 1.4.8.2} yat te pavitram arciṣi | agne vitatam antarā | brahma tena punīmahe | ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ | pavitreṇa savena ca | idaṃ brahma punīmahe | vaiśvadevī punatī devy āgāt | yasyai bahvīs tanuvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ | tayā madantaḥ sadhamādyeṣu | vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām |
analyzed: yat te pavitram arciṣi agne vitatam antarā brahma tena punīmahe ubhābhyām deva savitar pavitreṇa savena ca idam brahma punīmahe vaiśvadevī punatī devī āgāt yasyai bahvīḥ tanuvaḥ vīta pṛṣṭhāḥ tayā madantaḥ sadhamādyeṣu vayam syāma patayaḥ rayīṇām

original: { 1.4.8.3} vaiśvānaro raśmibhir mā punātu | vātaḥ prāṇena-iṣiro mayobhūḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhiḥ | ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām | bṛhadbhiḥ savitastṛbhiḥ | varṣiṣṭhair deva manmabhiḥ | agne dakṣaiḥ punāhi mā | yena devā apunata | yena-āpo divyaṃ kaśaḥ | tena divyena brahmaṇā |
analyzed: vaiśvānaraḥ raśmibhiḥ mā punātu vātaḥ prāṇena aiṣiraḥ mayobhūḥ dyāvāpṛthivī payasā payobhiḥ ṛtāvarī yajñiye mā punītām bṛhadbhiḥ savitar tṛbhiḥ varṣiṣṭhaiḥ deva manmabhiḥ agne dakṣaiḥ punāhi mā yena devāḥ apunata yena apaḥ divyam kaśaḥ tena divyena brahmaṇā

original: { 1.4.8.4} idaṃ brahma punīmahe | yaḥ pāvamānīr adhyeti | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam | sarvaṃ sa pūtam aśnāti | svaditaṃ mātariśvanā | pāvamānīr yo adhyeti | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaṃ rasam | tasmai sarasvatī duhe | kṣīraṃ sarpir madhūdakam | pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ |
analyzed: idam brahma punīmahe yaḥ pāvamānīḥ adhyeti ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtam rasam sarvam sa pūtam aśnāti svaditam mātariśvanā pāvamānīḥ yaḥ adhyeti ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtam rasam tasmai sarasvatī duhe kṣīram sarpiḥ madhu udakam pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ

original: { 1.4.8.5} sudughā hi payasvatīḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛto rasaḥ | brāhmaṇeṣv amṛtaṃ hitam | pāvamānīr diśantu naḥ | imaṃ lokam atho amum | kāmān samardhayantu naḥ | devīr devaiḥ samābhṛtāḥ | pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ | sudughā hi ghṛtaścutaḥ | ṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛto rasaḥ |
analyzed: sudughāḥ hi payasvatīḥ ṛṣibhiḥ saṃbhṛtaḥ rasaḥ brāhmaṇeṣu amṛtam hitam pāvamānīḥ diśantu naḥ imam lokam atha u amum kāmān samardhayantu naḥ devīḥ devaiḥ samābhṛtāḥ pāvamānīḥ svastyayanīḥ sudughāḥ hi ghṛtaścutaḥ ṛṣibhiḥ sambhṛtaḥ rasaḥ

original: { 1.4.8.6} brāhmaṇeṣv amṛtaṃ hitam | yena devāḥ pavitreṇa | ātmānaṃ punate sadā | tena sahasradhāreṇa | pāvamānyaḥ punantu mā | prājāpatyaṃ pavitram | śata-udyāmaṃ hiraṇmayam | tena brahmavido vayam | pūtaṃ brahma punīmahe | indraḥ sunītī saha mā punātu | somaḥ svastyā varuṇaḥ samīcyā | yamo rājā pramṛṇābhiḥ punātu mā |
analyzed: brāhmaṇeṣu amṛtam hitam yena devāḥ pavitreṇa ātmānam punate sadā tena sahasra dhāreṇa pāvamānyaḥ punantu mā prājāpatyam pavitram śata audyāmam hiraṇmayam tena brahma vidaḥ vayam pūtam brahma punīmahe indraḥ sunītī saha mā punātu somaḥ svastyā varuṇaḥ samīcyā yamaḥ rājā pramṛṇābhiḥ punātu mā

original: jātavedā mā-ūrjayantyā punātu |
analyzed: jātavedāḥ mā ūrjayantyā punātu

original: anuvāka 9 rājasūyagata cāturmāsyaśeṣaḥ { 1.4.9.1} prajā vai satram āsata tapas tapyamānā ajuhvatīḥ | devā apaśyaṃ camasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām | tam upa-udatiṣṭhantam ajuhavuḥ | tena-ardhamāsa ūrjam avārundhata | tasmād ardhamāse devā ijyante | pitaro 'paśyaṃ camasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām | tam upa-udatiṣṭhantam ajuhavuḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 9 rājasūya gata cāturmāsya śeṣaḥ prajāḥ vai satram āsata tapaḥ tapyamānāḥ ajuhvatīḥ devāḥ apaśyam camasam ghṛtasya pūrṇam svadhām tam upa udatiṣṭhantam ajuhavuḥ tena ardha māse ūrjam avārundhata tasmāt ardha māse devāḥ ijyante pitaraḥ paśyam camasam ghṛtasya pūrṇam svadhām tam upa udatiṣṭhantam ajuhavuḥ

original: tena māsyūrjam avārundhata | tasmān māsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate | manuṣyā apaśyaṃ camasaṃ ghṛtasya pūrṇaṃ svadhām |
analyzed: tena māsi ūrjam avārundhata tasmāt māsi pitṛbhyaḥ kriyate manuṣyāḥ apaśyam camasam ghṛtasya pūrṇam svadhām

original: { 1.5.1.2} bṛhaspates tiṣyaḥ | juhvataḥ parastād yajamānā avastāt | sarpāṇām āśreṣāḥ | abhyāgacchantaḥ parastād abhyānṛtyanto 'vastāt | pitṛṇāṃ maghāḥ | rudantaḥ parastād apabhraṃśo 'vastāt | aryamṇaḥ pūrve phalgunī | jāyā parastād ṛṣabho 'vastāt | bhagasya-uttare | vahatavaḥ parastād vahamānā avastāt |

analyzed: indrasya rohiṇī śṛṇat parastāt pratiśṛṇat avastāt nirṛtyai mūla varhaṇī pratibhañjantaḥ parastāt pratiśṛṇantaḥ vastāt apām pūrvāḥ aṣāḍhāḥ varcaḥ parastāt samitiḥ avastāt viśveṣām devānām uttarāḥ abhijayat parastāt abhijitam avastāt viṣṇoḥ śroṇā pṛcchamānāḥ parastāt panthāḥ avastāt

analyzed: anuvāka 2 karma anuṣṭhānāya puṇya kālaḥ yat puṇyam nakṣatram tat baṭ kurvīta aupavyuṣam yadā vai sūryaḥ udeti atha nakṣatram na eti yāvati tatra sūryaḥ gacchet yatra jaghanyam paśyet tāvati kurvīta yad kārī syāt puṇya ahe eva kurute evam ha vai yajñeṣum ca śatadyumnam ca mātsyaḥ niravasāyayān cakāra

original: { 1.5.2.2} yo vai nakṣatriyaṃ prajāpatiṃ veda | ubhayor enaṃ lokayor viduḥ | hasta eva-asya hastaḥ | citrā śiraḥ | niṣṭyā hṛdayam | ūrū viśākhe | pratiṣṭhā-anūrādhāḥ | eṣa vai nakṣatriyaḥ prajāpatiḥ | ya evaṃ veda | ubhayor enaṃ lokayor viduḥ |

original: { 1.5.2.3} asmiṃś ca-amuṣmiṃś ca | yāṃ kāmayeta duhitaraṃ priyā syād iti | tāṃ niṣṭyāyāṃ dadyāt | priyā-eva bhavati | naiva tu punar āgacchati | abhijit- nāma nakṣatram | upariṣṭād aṣāḍhānām | avastāt-śroṇāyai | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devās tasmin nakṣatre 'bhyajayan |

original: { 1.5.11.2} etāni vāva tāni jyotīṃṣi | ya etasya stomāḥ | so 'bravīt | saptadaśena hriyamāṇo vyaleśiṣi | bhiṣajyata mā-iti | tam aśvinau dhānābhir abhiṣajyatām | pūṣā karambheṇa | bhāratī parivāpeṇa | mitrāvaruṇau payasyayā | tad āhuḥ |
analyzed: etāni vāva tāni jyotīṃṣi ye etasya stomāḥ saḥ bravīt saptadaśena hriyamāṇaḥ vyaleśiṣi bhiṣajyata mā iti tam aśvinau dhānābhiḥ abhiṣajyatām pūṣā karambheṇa bhāratī parivāpeṇa mitrāvaruṇau payasyayā tat āhuḥ

original: { 1.5.11.3} yad aśvibhyāṃ dhānāḥ | pūṣṇaḥ karambhaḥ | bhāratyai parivāpaḥ | mitrāvaruṇayoḥ payasyātha | kasmād eteṣāṃ haviṣām indram eva yajanti-iti | etā hy enaṃ devatā iti brūyāt | etair havirbhir abhiṣajyaṃs tasmād iti | taṃ vasavo 'ṣṭākapālena prātaḥsavane 'bhiṣajyan | rudrā ekādaśakapālena mādhyandine savane |
analyzed: yat aśvibhyām dhānāḥ pūṣṇaḥ karambhaḥ bhāratyai parivāpaḥ mitrāvaruṇayoḥ payasyā atha kasmāt eteṣām haviṣām indram eva yajanti iti etāḥ hi enam devatāḥ iti brūyāt etaiḥ havirbhiḥ abhiṣajyan tasmāt iti tam vasavaḥ ṣṭākapālena prātaḥsavane bhiṣajyan rudrāḥ ekādaśa kapālena mādhyandine savane

original: { 1.5.11.4} sa yad aṣṭākapālān prātaḥsavane kuryāt | ekādaśa kapālān mādhyandine savane | dvādaśakapālāṃs tṛtīyasavane | viloma tad yajñasya kriyeta | ekādaśakapālān eva prātaḥsavane kuryāt | ekādaśakapālān mādhyandine savane | ekādaśakapālāṃs tṛtīyasavane | yajñasya salomatvāya | tad āhuḥ | yad vasūnāṃ prātaḥsavanam |
analyzed: sa yat aṣṭākapālān prātaḥsavane kuryāt ekādaśa kapālān mādhyandine savane dvādaśa kapālān tṛtīyasavane viloma tat yajñasya kriyeta ekādaśa kapālān eva prātaḥsavane kuryāt ekādaśa kapālān mādhyandine savane ekādaśa kapālān tṛtīyasavane yajñasya saloma tvāya tat āhuḥ yat vasūnām prātaḥsavanam

original: rudrāṇāṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam | viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ tṛtīyasavanam | atha kasmād eteṣāṃ haviṣām indram eva yajanti-iti | etā hy enaṃ devatā iti brūyāt | etair havirbhir abhiṣajyaṃs tasmād iti |
analyzed: rudrāṇām mādhyandinam savanam viśveṣām devānām tṛtīyasavanam atha kasmāt eteṣām haviṣām indram eva yajanti iti etāḥ hi enam devatāḥ iti brūyāt etaiḥ havirbhiḥ abhiṣajyan tasmāt iti

original: anuvāka 12 sapta chandāṃsi { 1.5.12.1} tasyā vāco 'vapādād abibhayuḥ | tam eteṣu saptasu chandaḥsv aśrayan | yad aśrayan | tat-śrāyantīyasya śrāyantīyatvam | yad avārayan | tad vāravantīyasya vāravantīyatvam | tasyā vāca eva-avapādād abibhayuḥ | tasmā etāni sapta caturuttarāṇi chandāṃsy upādadhuḥ | teṣām ati trīṇy aricyanta | na trīṇy udabhavan |
analyzed: sapta chandāṃsi tasyāḥ vācaḥ vapādāt abibhayuḥ tam eteṣu saptasu chandaḥsu aśrayan yat aśrayan tat śrāyantīyasya śrāyantīya tvam yat avārayan tat vāravantīyasya vāravantīya tvam tasyāḥ vācaḥ eva avapādāt abibhayuḥ tasmai etāni sapta catur uttarāṇi chandāṃsi upādadhuḥ teṣām ati trīṇi aricyanta na trīṇi udabhavan

original: { 1.5.12.2} sa bṛhatīm eva-aspṛśat | dvābhyām akṣarābhyām | ahorātrābhyām eva | tad āhuḥ | katamā sā devākṣarā bṛhatī | yasyāṃ tat pratyatiṣṭhat | dvādaśa paurṇamāsyaḥ | dvādaśa-aṣṭakāḥ | dvādaśa-amāvāsyāḥ | eṣā vāva sā devākṣarā bṛhatī |
analyzed: sa bṛhatīm eva aspṛśat dvābhyām akṣarābhyām ahar rātrābhyām eva tat āhuḥ katamā sā deva akṣarā bṛhatī yasyām tat pratyatiṣṭhat dvādaśa paurṇamāsyaḥ dvādaśa aṣṭakāḥ dvādaśa amāvāsyāḥ eṣā vāva sā deva akṣarā bṛhatī

original: { 1.5.12.3} yasyāṃ tat pratyatiṣṭhad iti | yāni ca chandāṃsy atyaricyanta | yāni ca na-udabhavan | tāni nirvīryāṇi hīnāny amanyanta | sā'bravīd bṛhatī | mām eva bhūtvā | mām upa saṃśrayata-iti | caturbhir akṣarair anuṣṭug bṛhatīṃ na-udabhavat | caturbhir akṣaraiḥ paṅktir bṛhatīm atyaricyata | tasyām etāni catvāry akṣarāṇy apacchidya-ādadhāt |
analyzed: yasyām tat pratyatiṣṭhat iti yāni ca chandāṃsi atyaricyanta yāni ca na udabhavan tāni nirvīryāṇi hīnāni amanyanta sā bravīt bṛhatī mām eva bhūtvā mām upa saṃśrayata eti caturbhiḥ akṣaraiḥ anuṣṭubh bṛhatīm na udabhavat caturbhiḥ akṣaraiḥ paṅktiḥ bṛhatīm atyaricyata tasyām etāni catvāri akṣarāṇi apacchidya ādadhāt

original: { 1.5.12.4} te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām | aṣṭābhir akṣarair uṣṇig bṛhatīṃ na-udabhavat | aṣṭābhir akṣarais triṣṭug bṛhatīm atyaricyata | tasyām etāny aṣṭāv akṣarāṇy apacchidya-ādadhāt | te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām | dvādaśabhir akṣarair gāyatrī bṛhatīṃ na-udabhavat |
analyzed: te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām aṣṭābhiḥ akṣaraiḥ uṣṇih bṛhatīm nau udabhavat aṣṭābhiḥ akṣaraiḥ triṣṭubh bṛhatīm atyaricyata tasyām etāni aṣṭau akṣarāṇi apacchidya ādadhāt te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām dvādaśabhiḥ akṣaraiḥ gāyatrī bṛhatīm nau udabhavat

original: dvādaśabhir akṣarair jagatī bṛhatīm atyaricyata | tasyām etāni dvādaśa-akṣarāṇy apacchidya-ādadhāt |
analyzed: dvādaśabhiḥ akṣaraiḥ jagatī bṛhatīm atyaricyata tasyām etāni dvādaśa akṣarāṇi apacchidya ādadhāt

original: { 1.5.12.5} te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā | bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām | so 'bravīt prajāpatiḥ | chandāṃsi ratho me bhavat | yuṣmābhir aham etam adhvānam anu saṃcarāṇi-iti | tasya gāyatrī ca jagatī ca pakṣāv abhavatām | uṣṇik ca triṣṭup ca praṣṭyau | anuṣṭup ca paṅktiś ca dhuryau | bṛhaty eva-uddhir abhavat | sa etaṃ chandoratham āsthāya |
analyzed: te bṛhatī eva bhūtvā bṛhatīm upa samaśrayatām saḥ bravīt prajāpatiḥ chandāṃsi rathaḥ me bhavat yuṣmābhiḥ aham etam adhvānam anu saṃcarāṇi iti tasya gāyatrī ca jagatī ca pakṣau abhavatām uṣṇih ca triṣṭubh ca praṣṭyau anuṣṭubh ca paṅktiḥ ca dhuryau bṛhatī eva oddhiḥ abhavat saḥ etam chandaḥ ratham āsthāya

original: etam adhvānam anu samacarat | etaṃ ha vai chandoratham āsthāya | etam adhvānam anu saṃcarati | yenaiṣa etat saṃcarati | ya evaṃ vidvān somena yajate | ya u cainam evaṃ veda |
analyzed: etam adhvānam anu samacarat etam ha vai chandaḥ ratham āsthāya etam adhvānam anu saṃcarati yena eṣaḥ etat saṃcarati yaḥ evam vidvān somena yajate yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: prapāṭhaka: 6 rājasūyaḥ anuvāka 1 { 1.6.1.1} anumatyai puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante | tan nairṛtam ekakapālam | iyaṃ vā anumatiḥ | iyaṃ nirṛtiḥ | nairṛtena pūrveṇa pracarati | pāpmānam eva nirṛtiṃ pūrvāṃ niravadayate | ekakapālo bhavati | ekadhā-eva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | yad ahutvā gārhapatya īyuḥ |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 6 rājasūya anuvāka 1 anumatyai puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam nirvapati ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyāḥ avaśīyante tat nairṛtam eka kapālam iyam vai anumatiḥ iyam nirṛtiḥ nairṛtena pūrveṇa pracarati pāpmānam eva nirṛtim pūrvām niravadayate eka kapālaḥ bhavati ekadhā eva nirṛtim niravadayate yat a hutvā gārhapatye īyuḥ

original: { 1.6.1.2} rudro bhūtvā-agnir anūtthāya | adhvaryuṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca hanyāt | vīhi svāhā-āhutiṃ juṣāṇa ity āha | āhutyā-evainaṃ śamayati | na-ārtim ārchaty adhvaryur na yajamānaḥ | eka-ulmukena yanti | tad dhi nirṛtyai bhāgadheyam | imāṃ diśam nayati | eṣā vai nirṛtyai dik | svāyām eva diśi nirṛtiṃ niravadayate |
analyzed: rudraḥ bhūtvā agniḥ anūtthāya adhvaryum ca yajamānam ca hanyāt vīhi svāhā āhutim juṣāṇaḥ iti āha āhutyā eva enam śamayati na ārtim ārchati adhvaryuḥ na yajamānaḥ eka aulmukena yanti tat hi nirṛtyai bhāgadheyam imām diśam nayati eṣā vai nirṛtyai diś svāyām eva diśi nirṛtim niravadayate

original: { 1.6.1.3} svakṛta iriṇe juhoti pradare vā | etad vai nirṛtyā āyatanam | sva evā''yatane nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | eṣa te nirṛte bhāga ity āha | nirdiśaty evainām | bhūte haviṣmaty asi-ity āha | bhūtim eva-upāvartate | muñca-imam aṃhasa ity āha | aṃhasa evainaṃ muñcati | aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ juhoti |
analyzed: svakṛte iriṇe juhoti pradare vai etat vai nirṛtyāḥ āyatanam sve eva āyatane nirṛtim niravadayate eṣa te nirṛte bhāgaḥ iti āha nirdiśati eva enām bhūte haviṣmatī asi iti āha bhūtim eva upāvartate muñca emam aṃhasaḥ iti āha aṃhasaḥ eva enam muñcati aṅguṣṭhābhyām juhoti

original: { 1.6.1.4} antata eva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇatūṣaṃ dakṣiṇā | etad vai nirṛtyai rūpam | rūpeṇaiva nirṛtiṃ niravadayate | apratīkṣam āyanti | nirṛtyā antarhityai | svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāra-iti punar etya gārhapatye juhoti | āhutyā-eva namasyanto gārhapatyamupāvartante | ānumatena pracarati | iyaṃ vā anumatiḥ |
analyzed: antatas eva nirṛtim niravadayate kṛṣṇam vāsaḥ kṛṣṇa tūṣam dakṣiṇā etat vai nirṛtyai rūpam rūpeṇa eva nirṛtim niravadayate a pratīkṣam āyanti nirṛtyāḥ antarhityai svāhā namaḥ yaḥ idam cakāra eti punar etya gārhapatye juhoti āhutyā eva namasyantaḥ gārhapatyam upāvartante ānumatena pracarati iyam vai anumatiḥ

original: { 1.6.1.5} iyam evāsmai rājyam anumanyate | dhenur dakṣiṇā | imām eva dhenuṃ kurute | ādityaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | ubhayīṣv eva prajāsv abhiṣicyate | daivīṣu ca mānuṣīṣu ca | varo dakṣiṇā | varo hi rājyaṃ samṛddhyai | āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ |
analyzed: iyam eva asmai rājyam anumanyate dhenuḥ dakṣiṇā imām eva dhenum kurute ādityam carum nirvapati ubhayīṣu eva prajāsu abhiṣicyate daivīṣu ca mānuṣīṣu ca varaḥ dakṣiṇā varaḥ hi rājyam samṛddhyai āgnāvaiṣṇavam ekādaśa kapālam nirvapati agniḥ sarvāḥ devatāḥ

original: { 1.6.1.6} viṣṇur yajñaḥ | devatāś caiva yajñaṃ ca-avarundhe | vāmano vahī dakṣiṇā | yad vahī | tena-āgneyaḥ | yad vāmanaḥ | tena vaiṣṇavaḥ samṛddhyai | agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | agnīṣomābhyāṃ vā indro vṛtram ahann iti | yad agnīṣomīyam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati |
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ yajñaḥ devatāḥ ca eva yajñam ca avarundhe vāmanaḥ vahī dakṣiṇā yat vahī tena āgneyaḥ yat vāmanaḥ tena vaiṣṇavaḥ samṛddhyai agnīṣomīyam ekādaśa kapālam nirvapati agnīṣomābhyām vai indraḥ vṛtram ahan iti yat agnīṣomīyam ekādaśa kapālam nirvapati

original: { 1.6.1.7} vārtraghnam eva vijityai | hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | devatābhiś ca-indriyeṇa ca vyārdhyata | sa etam aindrāgnam ekādaśakapālam apaśyat | taṃ niravapat | tena vai sa devatāś ca-indriyaṃ cāvārundhe| yad aindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | devatāś caiva tena-indriyaṃ ca yajamāno 'varundhe | ṛṣabho vahī dakṣiṇā |
analyzed: vārtraghnam eva vijityai hiraṇyam dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai indraḥ vṛtram hatvā devatābhiḥ ca aindriyeṇa ca vyārdhyata saḥ etam aindrāgnam ekādaśa kapālam apaśyat tam niravapat tena vai sa devatāḥ ca aindriyam ca avārundhe yat aindrāgnam ekādaśa kapālam nirvapati devatāḥ ca eva tena aindriyam ca yajamānaḥ varundhe ṛṣabhaḥ vahī dakṣiṇā

original: { 1.6.1.8} yad vahī | tena-āgneyaḥ | yad ṛṣabhaḥ | tena-aindraḥ samṛddhyai | āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | aindraṃ dadhi | yad āgneyo bhavati | agnir vai yajñamukham | yajñamukham eva-ṛddhiṃ purāstād dhatte | yad aindraṃ dadhi |
analyzed: yat vahī tena āgneyaḥ yat ṛṣabhaḥ tena aindraḥ samṛddhyai āgneyam aṣṭākapālam nirvapati aindram dadhi yat āgneyaḥ bhavati agniḥ vai yajña mukham yajña mukham eva ṛddhim purāstāt dhatte yat aindram dadhi

original: { 1.6.1.9} indriyam eva-avarundhe | ṛṣabho vahī dakṣiṇā | yad vahī | tena-āgneyaḥ | yad ṛṣabhaḥ | tena-aindraḥ samṛddhyai | yāvatīr vai prajā oṣadhīnām ahutānām āśnan | tāḥ parābhavan | āgrayaṇaṃ bhavati hutādyāya | yajamānasya-aparābhāvāya |
analyzed: indriyam eva avarundhe ṛṣabhaḥ vahī dakṣiṇā yat vahī tena āgneyaḥ yat ṛṣabhaḥ tena aindraḥ samṛddhyai yāvatīḥ vai prajāḥ oṣadhīnām a hutānām āśnan tāḥ parābhavan āgrayaṇam bhavati huta adyāya yajamānasya a parābhāvāya

original: { 1.6.1.10} devā vā oṣadhīṣv ājim ayuḥ | tā indrāgnī udajayatām | tāv etam aindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ niravṛṇātām | yad aindrāgno bhavaty ujjityai | dvādaśakapālo bhavati | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ | saṃvatsareṇaivāsmā annam avarundhe | vaiśvadevaś carur bhavati | vaiśvadevaṃ vā annam | annam evāsmai svadayati |
analyzed: devāḥ vai oṣadhīṣu ājim ayuḥ tau indra agnī udajayatām tau etam aindrāgnam dvādaśa kapālam niravṛṇātām yat aindrāgnaḥ bhavati ujjityai dvādaśa kapālaḥ bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsareṇa eva asmai annam avarundhe vaiśvadevaḥ caruḥ bhavati vaiśvadevam vai annam annam eva asmai svadayati

original: { 1.6.1.11} prathamajo vatso dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | saumyaṃ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | somo vā akṛṣṭapacyasya {akṛṣṭapacasya} rājā | akṛṣṭapacyam evāsmai svadayati | vāso dakṣiṇā | saumyaṃ hi devatayā vāsaḥ samṛddhyai | sarasvatyai caruṃ nirvapati | sarasvate carum | mithunam eva-avarundhe | mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai |
analyzed: prathama jaḥ vatsaḥ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai saumyam śyāmākam carum nirvapati somaḥ vai akṛṣṭapacyasya akṛṣṭapacasya rājā akṛṣṭapacyam eva asmai svadayati vāsaḥ dakṣiṇā saumyam hi devatayā vāsaḥ samṛddhyai sarasvatyai carum nirvapati sarasvate carum mithunam eva avarundhe mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai

original: eti vā eṣa yajñamukhād ṛddhyāḥ | yo 'gner devatāyā eti | aṣṭāv etāni havīṃṣi bhavanti | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatro 'gniḥ | tenaiva yajñamukhād ṛddhyā agner devatāyai na-eti |
analyzed: eti vai eṣa yajña mukhāt ṛddhyāḥ yaḥ gneḥ devatāyai eti aṣṭau etāni havīṃṣi bhavanti aṣṭa akṣarā gāyatrī gāyatraḥ gniḥ tena eva yajña mukhāt ṛddhyāḥ agneḥ devatāyai na eti

original: anuvāka 2 rājasūye vaiśvadevaḥ { 1.6.2.1} vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāḥ sṛṣṭā na prājāyanta | so 'gnir akāmayata | aham imāḥ prajanayeyam iti | sa prajāpataye | śucam adadhāt | so 'śocat prajām icchamānaḥ | tasmād yaṃ ca prajā bhunakti yaṃ ca na | tāv ubhau śocataḥ prajām icchamānau | tāsv agnim apyasṛjat | tā agnir adhyait |
analyzed: anuvāka 2 rājasūye vaiśvadevaḥ vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ na prājāyanta saḥ gniḥ akāmayata aham imāḥ prajanayeyam iti sa prajāpataye śucam adadhāt saḥ śocat prajām icchamānaḥ tasmāt yam ca prajā bhunakti yam ca na tau ubhau śocataḥ prajām icchamānau tāsu agnim apyasṛjat tāḥ agniḥ adhyait

original: { 1.6.2.2} somo reto 'dadhāt | savitā prājanayat | sarasvatī vācam adadhāt | pūṣā-apoṣayat | te vā ete triḥ saṃvatsarasya prayujyante | ye devāḥ puṣṭipatayaḥ | saṃvatsaro vai prajāpatiḥ | saṃvatsareṇaivāsmai prajāḥ prājanayat | tāḥ prajā jātā maruto 'ghnan | asmān api na prāyukṣata-iti |
analyzed: somaḥ retaḥ dadhāt savitā prājanayat sarasvatī vācam adadhāt pūṣā apoṣayat te vai ete tris saṃvatsarasya prayujyante ye devāḥ puṣṭi patayaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ vai prajāpatiḥ saṃvatsareṇa eva asmai prajāḥ prājanayat tāḥ prajāḥ jātāḥ marutaḥ ghnan asmān api na prāyukṣata eti

original: { 1.6.2.3} sa etaṃ prajāpatir mārutaṃ saptakapālam apaśyat | taṃ niravapat | tato vai prajābhyo 'kalpata | yan māruto nirupyate | yajñasya klṛptyai | prajānām aghātāya | saptakapālo bhavati | saptagaṇā vai marutaḥ | gaṇaśa evāsmai viśaṃ kalpayati | sa prajāpatir aśocat |
analyzed: saḥ etam prajāpatiḥ mārutam sapta kapālam apaśyat tam niravapat tatas vai prajābhyaḥ kalpata yat mārutaḥ nirupyate yajñasya klṛptyai prajānām aghātāya sapta kapālaḥ bhavati sapta gaṇāḥ vai marutaḥ gaṇaśas eva asmai viśam kalpayati sa prajāpatiḥ aśocat

original: { 1.6.2.4} yāḥ pūrvāḥ prajā asṛkṣi | marutas tā avadhiṣuḥ | katham aparāḥ sṛjeyā-iti | tasya śuṣma āṇḍaṃ bhūtaṃ niravartata | tad vyudaharat | tad apoṣayat | tat prājāyata | āṇḍasya vā etad rūpam | yad āmikṣā | yad vyuddharati |
analyzed: yāḥ pūrvāḥ prajāḥ asṛkṣi marutaḥ tāḥ avadhiṣuḥ katham aparāḥ sṛjeya iti tasya śuṣmaḥ āṇḍam bhūtam niravartata tat vyudaharat tat apoṣayat tat prājāyata āṇḍasya vai etat rūpam yat āmikṣā yat vyuddharati

original: { 1.6.2.5} prajā eva tad yajamānaḥ poṣayati | vaiśvadevy āmikṣā bhavati | vaiśvadevyo vai prajāḥ | prajā evāsmai prajanayati | vājinam ānayati | prajāsv eva prajātāsu reto dadhāti | dyāvāpṛthivya ekakapālo bhavati | prajā eva prajātā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām ubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | deva-asurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | so 'gnir abravīt |
analyzed: prajāḥ eva tat yajamānaḥ poṣayati vaiśvadevī āmikṣā bhavati vaiśvadevyaḥ vai prajāḥ prajāḥ eva asmai prajanayati vājinam ānayati prajāsu eva prajātāsu retaḥ dadhāti dyāvāpṛthivyaḥ eka kapālaḥ bhavati prajāḥ eva prajātāḥ dyāvāpṛthivībhyām ubhayatas parigṛhṇāti deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan saḥ agniḥ abravīt

original: { 1.6.2.6} mām agre yajata | mayā mukhena-asurāñ jeṣyatha-iti | māṃ dvitīyam iti somo 'bravīt | mayā rājñā jeṣyatha-iti | māṃ tṛtīyam iti savitā | mayā prasūtā jeṣyatha-iti | māṃ caturthīm iti sarasvatī | indriyaṃ vo 'haṃ dhāsyāmi-iti māṃ pañcamam iti pūṣā | mayā pratiṣṭhayā jeṣyatha-iti |
analyzed: mām agre yajata mayā mukhena asurān jeṣyatha eti mām dvitīyam iti somaḥ bravīt mayā rājñā jeṣyatha eti mām tṛtīyam iti savitā mayā prasūtā jeṣyatha eti mām caturthīm iti sarasvatī indriyam vaḥ ham dhāsyāmi iti mām pañcamam iti pūṣā mayā pratiṣṭhayā jeṣyatha eti

original: { 1.6.2.7} te 'gninā mukhena-asurān ajayan | somena rājñā | savitrā prasūtāḥ | sarasvatī-indriyam adadhāt | pūṣā pratiṣṭhā-āsīt | tato vai devā vyajayanta | yad etāni havīṃṣi nirupyante vijityai | na-uttaravedim upavapati | paśavo vā uttaravediḥ | ajātā iva hy etarhi paśavaḥ |
analyzed: te gninā mukhena asurān ajayan somena rājñā savitrā prasūtāḥ sarasvatī indriyam adadhāt pūṣā pratiṣṭhā āsīt tatas vai devāḥ vyajayanta yat etāni havīṃṣi nirupyante vijityai na auttaravedim upavapati paśavaḥ vai uttaravediḥ a jātāḥ iva hi etarhi paśavaḥ

original: anuvāka 3 rājasūye vaiśvadevaḥ { 1.6.3.1} trivṛd barhir bhavati | mātā pitā putraḥ | tad eva tan mithunam | ulbaṃ garbho jarāyu | tad eva tan mithunam | tredhā barhiḥ saṃnaddhaṃ bhavati | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati | ekadhā punaḥ saṃnaddhaṃ bhavati | eka iva hy ayaṃ lokaḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 3 rājasūye vaiśvadevaḥ trivṛt barhiḥ bhavati mātā pitā putraḥ tat eva tat mithunam ulbam garbhaḥ jarāyu tat eva tat mithunam tredhā barhiḥ saṃnaddham bhavati trayaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣu eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati ekadhā punar saṃnaddham bhavati ekaḥ iva hi ayam lokaḥ

original: { 1.6.3.2} asminn eva tena loke pratitiṣṭhati | prasuvo bhavanti | prathamajām eva puṣṭim avarundhe | prathamajo vatso dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai | pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti | paśavo vai pṛṣadājyam | paśūnevāvarundhe | pañcagṛhītaṃ bhavati | pāṅktā hi paśavaḥ | bahurūpaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: asmin eva tena loke pratitiṣṭhati prasuvaḥ bhavanti prathama jām eva puṣṭim avarundhe prathama jaḥ vatsaḥ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai pṛṣadājyam gṛhṇāti paśavaḥ vai pṛṣadājyam paśūn eva avarundhe pañca gṛhītam bhavati pāṅktāḥ hi paśavaḥ bahu rūpam bhavati

original: { 1.6.3.3} bahurūpā hi paśavaḥ samṛddhyai | agniṃ manthanti | agnimukhā vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | yad agniṃ manthanti | agnimukhā eva tat prajā yajamānaḥ sṛjate | nava prayājā ijyante | nava-anūyājāḥ | aṣṭau havīṃṣi | dvāv āghārau | dvāv ājyabhāgau |
analyzed: bahu rūpāḥ hi paśavaḥ samṛddhyai agnim manthanti agni mukhāḥ vai prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata yat agnim manthanti agni mukhāḥ eva tat prajāḥ yajamānaḥ sṛjate nava prayājāḥ ijyante nava anūyājāḥ aṣṭau havīṃṣi dvau āghārau dvau ājyabhāgau

original: { 1.6.3.4} triṃśat saṃpadyante | triṃśadakṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājā-eva-annādyam avarundhe | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | teja ājyam | yad ekakapāla ājyam ānayati | yajamānam eva tejasā samardhayati | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | paśava ājyam |
analyzed: triṃśat saṃpadyante triṃśat akṣarā virāj annam virāj virājā eva annādyam avarundhe yajamānaḥ vai eka kapālaḥ tejaḥ ājyam yat eka kapāle ājyam ānayati yajamānam eva tejasā samardhayati yajamānaḥ vai eka kapālaḥ paśavaḥ ājyam

original: { 1.6.3.5} yad ekakapāla ājyam ānayati | yajamānam eva paśubhiḥ samardhayati | yad alpam ānayet | alpā enaṃ paśavo bhuñjanta upatiṣṭheran | yad bahu- ānayet | bahava enaṃ paśavo bhuñjanta upatiṣṭheran | bahv ānīya-āviḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ kuryāt | bahava evainaṃ paśavo bhuñjanta upatiṣṭhante | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | yad ekakapālasya-avadyet |
analyzed: yat eka kapāle ājyam ānayati yajamānam eva paśubhiḥ samardhayati yat alpam ānayet alpāḥ enam paśavaḥ bhuñjantaḥ upatiṣṭheran yat bahu ānayet bahavaḥ enam paśavaḥ bhuñjantaḥ upatiṣṭheran bahu ānīya āvis pṛṣṭham kuryāt bahavaḥ eva enam paśavaḥ bhuñjantaḥ upatiṣṭhante yajamānaḥ vai eka kapālaḥ yat eka kapālasya avadyet

original: { 1.6.3.6} yajamānasya-avadyet | ud vā madyed yajamānaḥ | pra vā mīyeta | sakṛd eva hotavyaḥ | sakṛd iva hi suvargo lokaḥ | hutvā-abhijuhoti | yajamānam eva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayitvā | tejasā samardhayati | yajamāno vā ekakapālaḥ | suvargo loka āhavanīyaḥ |
analyzed: yajamānasya avadyet ud vā madyet yajamānaḥ pra vā mīyeta sakṛt eva hotavyaḥ sakṛt iva hi suvargaḥ lokaḥ hutvā abhijuhoti yajamānam eva suvargam lokam gamayitvā tejasā samardhayati yajamānaḥ vai eka kapālaḥ suvargaḥ lokaḥ āhavanīyaḥ

original: { 1.6.3.7} yad ekakapālam āhavanīye juhoti | yajamānam eva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | yad dhastena juhuyāt | suvargāl lokād yajamānamavavidhyet | srucā juhoti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | yat prāṅ padyeta | devalokam abhijayet | yad dakṣiṇā pitṛlokam | yat pratyak |
analyzed: yat eka kapālam āhavanīye juhoti yajamānam eva suvargam lokam gamayati yat hastena juhuyāt suvargāt lokāt yajamānam avavidhyet srucā juhoti suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai yat prāṅ padyeta deva lokam abhijayet yat dakṣiṇā pitṛ lokam yat pratyak

original: { 1.6.3.8} rakṣāṃsi yajñaṃ hanyuḥ | yad udaṅ | manuṣyalokam abhijayet | pratiṣṭhito hotavyaḥ | ekakapālaṃ vai pratitiṣṭhantaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī anu pratitiṣṭhataḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūn yajñaḥ | yajñaṃ yajamānaḥ | yajamānaṃ prajāḥ | tasmāt pratiṣṭhito hotavyaḥ |
analyzed: rakṣāṃsi yajñam hanyuḥ yat udaṅ manuṣya lokam abhijayet pratiṣṭhitaḥ hotavyaḥ eka kapālam vai pratitiṣṭhantam dyāvāpṛthivī anu pratitiṣṭhataḥ dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtavaḥ ṛtūn yajñaḥ yajñam yajamānaḥ yajamānam prajāḥ tasmāt pratiṣṭhitaḥ hotavyaḥ

original: { 1.6.3.9} vājino yajati | agnir vāyuḥ sūryaḥ | te vai vājinaḥ | tāneva tad yajati | atho khalv āhuḥ | chandāṃsi vai vājina iti | tāny eva tad yajati | ṛksāme vā indrasya harī somapānau | tayoḥ paridhaya ādhānam | vājinaṃ bhāgadheyam |
analyzed: vājinaḥ yajati agniḥ vāyuḥ sūryaḥ te vai vājinaḥ tān eva tat yajati atha u khalu āhuḥ chandāṃsi vai vājinaḥ iti tāni eva tat yajati ṛk sāme vai indrasya harī soma pānau tayoḥ paridhayaḥ ādhānam vājinam bhāgadheyam

original: { 1.6.3.10} yad aprahṛtya paridhīñ juhuyāt | antarādhānābhyāṃ ghāsaṃ {dyā saṃ} prayacchet | prahṛtya paridhīñ juhoti | nirādhānābhyām eva ghāsaṃ { dyā saṃ} prayacchati | barhiṣi viṣiñcan vājinam ānayati | prajā vai barhiḥ | reto vājinam | prajāsv eva reto dadhāti | samupahūya bhakṣayanti | etat somapīthā hy ete | atho ātmann eva reto dadhate |
analyzed: yat a prahṛtya paridhīn juhuyāt antarādhānābhyām ghāsam sam prayacchet prahṛtya paridhīn juhoti nirādhānābhyām eva ghāsam sam prayacchati barhiṣi viṣiñcan vājinam ānayati prajāḥ vai barhiḥ retaḥ vājinam prajāsu eva retaḥ dadhāti samupahūya bhakṣayanti etat soma pīthāḥ hi ete atha u ātman eva retaḥ dadhate

original: yajamāna uttamo bhakṣayati | paśavo vai vājinam | yajamāna eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayanti |
analyzed: yajamānaḥ uttamaḥ bhakṣayati paśavaḥ vai vājinam yajamāne eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayanti

original: anuvāka 4 rājasūye varuṇapraghāsaḥ { 1.6.4.1} prajāpatiḥ savitā bhūtvā prajā asṛjata | tā enam atyamanyanta | tā asmād apākrāman | tā varuṇo bhūtvā prajā varuṇena-agrāhayat | tāḥ prajā varuṇagṛhītāḥ | prajāpatiṃ punar upādhāvan nātham icchamānāḥ | sa etān prajāpatir varuṇapraghāsān apaśyat | tān niravapat | tair vai sa prajā varuṇapāśād amuñcat |
analyzed: rājasūya varuṇapraghāsaḥ prajāpatiḥ savitā bhūtvā prajāḥ asṛjata tāḥ enam atyamanyanta tāḥ asmāt apākrāman tāḥ varuṇaḥ bhūtvā prajāḥ varuṇena agrāhayat tāḥ prajāḥ varuṇa gṛhītāḥ prajāpatim punar upādhāvan nātham icchamānāḥ saḥ etān prajāpatiḥ varuṇapraghāsān apaśyat tān niravapat taiḥ vai sa prajāḥ varuṇa pāśāt amuñcat

original: yad varuṇapraghāsā nirupyante |
analyzed: yat varuṇapraghāsāḥ nirupyante

original: { 1.6.4.2} prajānām avaruṇagrāhāya | tāsāṃ dakṣiṇo bāhur nyakna āsīt | savyaḥ prasṛtaḥ | sa etāṃ dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇato vedim udahan | tato vai sa prajānāṃ dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ prāsārayat | yad dvitīyāṃ dakṣiṇato vedim uddhanti | tasmāc cāturmāsyayājy amuṣmiṃl loka ubhayābāhuḥ | yajña-abhijitaṃ hy asya | pṛthamātrād vedī asaṃbhinne bhavataḥ |
analyzed: prajānām a varuṇa grāhāya tāsām dakṣiṇaḥ bāhuḥ nyaknaḥ āsīt savyaḥ prasṛtaḥ saḥ etām dvitīyām dakṣiṇatas vedim udahan tatas vai sa prajānām dakṣiṇam bāhum prāsārayat yat dvitīyām dakṣiṇatas vedim uddhanti tasmāt cāturmāsya yājī amuṣmin loke ubhayābāhuḥ yajña abhijitam hi asya pṛtha mātrāt vedī a saṃbhinne bhavataḥ

original: { 1.6.4.31} tasmāt pṛthamātraṃ vyaṃsau | uttarasyāṃ vedyām uttaravedim upavapati | paśavo vā uttaravediḥ | paśūn eva-avarundhe | atho yajñaparuṣo 'nantarityai | etad brāhmaṇāny eva pañca havīṃṣi | athaiṣa aindrāgno bhavati | prāṇāpānau vā etau devānām | yad indrāgnī | yad aindrāgno bhavati |
analyzed: tasmāt pṛtha mātram vyaṃsau uttarasyām vedyām uttaravedim upavapati paśavaḥ vai uttaravediḥ paśūn eva avarundhe atha u yajña paruṣaḥ nantarityai etat brāhmaṇāni eva pañca havīṃṣi atha eṣa aindrāgnaḥ bhavati prāṇa apānau vai etau devānām yat indra agnī yat aindrāgnaḥ bhavati

original: { 1.6.4.4} prāṇāpānāv eva-avarundhe | ojo balaṃ vā etau devānām | yad indrāgnī | yad aindrāgno bhavati | ojo balam eva-avarundhe | māruty āmikṣā bhavati | vāruṇy āmikṣā | meṣī ca meṣaś ca bhavataḥ | mithunā eva prajā varuṇapāśān muñcati | lomaśau bhavato medhyatvāya |
analyzed: prāṇa apānau eva avarundhe ojaḥ balam vai etau devānām yat indra agnī yat aindrāgnaḥ bhavati ojaḥ balam eva avarundhe mārutī āmikṣā bhavati vāruṇī āmikṣā meṣī ca meṣaḥ ca bhavataḥ mithunāḥ eva prajāḥ varuṇa pāśāt muñcati lomaśau bhavataḥ medhya tvāya

original: { 1.6.4.5} śamīparṇāny upavapati | ghāsam evā''bhyām apiyacchati | prajāpatim annādyaṃ na-upānamat | sa etena śata-idhmena haviṣā-annādyam avārundha | yat paraḥśatāni śamīparṇāni bhavanti | annādyasya-avaruddhyai | saumyāni vai karīrāṇi | saumyā khalu vā āhutir divo vṛṣṭiṃ cyāvayati | yat karīrāṇi bhavanti |
analyzed: śamī parṇāni upavapati ghāsam eva ābhyām apiyacchati prajāpatim annādyam na aupānamat saḥ etena śata aidhmena haviṣā annādyam avārundha yat paraḥśatāni śamī parṇāni bhavanti annādyasya avaruddhyai saumyāni vai karīrāṇi saumyā khalu vai āhutiḥ divaḥ vṛṣṭim cyāvayati yat karīrāṇi bhavanti

original: saumyayā-eva-āhutyā divo vṛṣṭim avarundhe | kāya ekakapālo bhavati | prajānāṃ kantvāya { kaṃtvāya} | pratipūruṣaṃ karambhapātrāṇi bhavanti | jātā eva prajā varuṇapāśān muñcati | ekam atiriktam | janiṣyamāṇā eva prajā varuṇapāśān muñcati |
analyzed: saumyayā eva āhutyā divaḥ vṛṣṭim avarundhe kāyaḥ eka kapālaḥ bhavati prajānām kantvāya kaṃtvāya pratipūruṣam karambha pātrāṇi bhavanti jātāḥ eva prajāḥ varuṇa pāśāt muñcati ekam atiriktam janiṣyamāṇāḥ eva prajāḥ varuṇa pāśāt muñcati

original: anuvāka 5 rājasūye varuṇapraghāsaḥ { 1.6.5.1} uttarasyāṃ vedyām anyāni havīṃṣi sādayati | dakṣiṇāyāṃ mārutīm | apadhuram evaināṃ yunakti | atho oja evāsām avaharati | tasmād brahmaṇaś ca kṣattrāc ca viśo 'nyato 'pakramiṇīḥ | mārutyā pūrvayā pracarati | anṛtam evā-avayajate | vāruṇyā-uttarayā | antata eva {evaṃ} varuṇam avayajate |
analyzed: anuvāka 5 rājasūye varuṇapraghāsaḥ uttarasyām vedyām anyāni havīṃṣi sādayati dakṣiṇāyām mārutīm apadhuram eva enām yunakti atha u ojaḥ eva āsām avaharati tasmāt brahmaṇaḥ ca kṣattrāt ca viśaḥ nyatas upakramiṇīḥ mārutyā pūrvayā pracarati anṛtam eva avayajate vāruṇyā uttarayā antatas eva evam varuṇam avayajate

original: yad eva-adhvaryuḥ karoti |
analyzed: yat eva adhvaryuḥ karoti

original: { 1.6.5.2} tat pratiprasthātā karoti | tasmād yat- śreyān karoti | tat pāpīyān karoti | patnīṃ vācayati | medhyām evaināṃ karoti | atho tapa evainām upanayati | yat- jāraṃ santaṃ na prabrūyāt | priyaṃ jñātiṃ rundhyāt | asau me jāra iti nirdiśet | nirdiśya-evainaṃ varuṇapāśena grāhayati |

original: { 1.6.5.6} apsu vai varuṇaḥ | sākṣād eva varuṇam avayajate | pratiyuto varuṇasya pāśa ity āha | varuṇapāśād eva nirmucyate | apratīkṣam āyanti | varuṇasya-antarhityai | edho 'syedhiṣīmahi-ity āha | samidhā-eva-agniṃ namasyanta upāyanti | tejo 'si tejo mayi dhehi-ity āha | teja evā''tman dhatte |

original: anuvāka 6 rājasūye sākamedhaḥ { 1.6.6.1} deva-asurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | so 'gnir abravīt | mama-iyam anīkavatī tanūḥ | tāṃ prīṇīta | atha-asurān abhibhaviṣyatha-iti | te devā agnaye 'nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapan | so 'gnir anīkavān svena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ | caturdhā-anīkāny ajanayata | tato devā abhavan | parā-asurāḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 6 rājasūye sākamedhaḥ deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan saḥ gniḥ abravīt mama eyam anīkavatī tanūḥ tām prīṇīta atha asurān abhibhaviṣyatha eti te devāḥ agnaye nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam niravapan saḥ gniḥ anīkavān svena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ caturdhā anīkāni ajanayata tatas devāḥ abhavan parā asurāḥ

original: { 1.6.6.2} yad agnaye 'nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | agnim eva-anīkavantaṃ svena bhagadheyena prīṇāti | so 'gnir anīkavān svena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ | caturdhā-anīkāni janayate | asau vā ādityo 'gnir anīkavān | tasya raśmayo 'nīkāni | sākaṃ sūryeṇa-udyatā nirvapati | sākṣād evāsmā anīkāni janayati | te 'surāḥ parājitā yantaḥ |
analyzed: yat agnaye nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam nirvapati agnim eva anīkavantam svena bhagadheyena prīṇāti saḥ gniḥ anīkavān svena bhāgadheyena prītaḥ caturdhā anīkāni janayate asau vai ādityaḥ gniḥ anīkavān tasya raśmayaḥ nīkāni sākam sūryeṇa audyatāḥ nirvapati sākṣāt eva asmai anīkāni janayati te surāḥ parājitāḥ yantaḥ

original: dyāvāpṛthivī upāśrayan |
analyzed: dyāvāpṛthivī upāśrayan

original: { 1.6.6.3} te devā marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaś caruṃ niravapan | tāṃ dyāvāpṛthivībhyām eva-ubhayataḥ samatapan | yan marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyaś caruṃ nirvapati | dyāvāpṛthivībhyām eva tad ubhayato yajamāno bhrātṛvyān saṃtapati | madhyaṃdine nirvapati | tarhi hite 'kṣṇiṣṭhaṃ tapati | carur bhavati | sarvata evainān saṃtapati |

analyzed: te devāḥ śvas vijayinaḥ santaḥ sarvāsām dugdhe gṛhamedhīyam carum niravapan

original: { 1.6.6.4} āśitā eva-adya-upavasāma | kasya vā ha-idam | kasya vā śvo bhaviteti | sa śṛto 'bhavat | tasya-ahutasya na-aśnann | na hi devā ahutasya-aśnanti | te 'bruvan | kasmā imaṃ hoṣyāma iti | marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhya ity abruvan | taṃ marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo 'juhavuḥ |

original: { 1.6.6.5} tato devā abhavan | parā-asurāḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo gṛhe juhvati | bhavaty ātmanā | parā-asya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | yad vai yajñasya pākatrā kriyate | paśavyaṃ tat | pākatrā vā etat kriyate | yan na-idhmābarhir bhavati | na sāmidhenīr anvāha |
analyzed: tatas devāḥ abhavan parā asurāḥ yasya evam viduṣaḥ marudbhyaḥ gṛhamedhibhyaḥ gṛhe juhvati bhavati ātmanā parā asya bhrātṛvyaḥ bhavati yat vai yajñasya pākatrā kriyate paśavyam tat pākatrā vai etat kriyate yat na aidhmābarhiḥ bhavati na sāmidhenīḥ anvāha

original: { 1.6.6.6} na prayājā ijyante | na-anūyājāḥ | ya evaṃ veda | paśumān bhavati | ājyabhāgau yajati | yajñasyaiva cakṣuṣī na-antareti | maruto gṛhamedhino yajati | bhāgadheyena-evainān samardhayati | agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati pratiṣṭhityai | iḍānto bhavati | paśavo vā iḍā | paśuṣv eva-upariṣṭāt pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: na prayājāḥ ijyante na anūyājāḥ yaḥ evam veda paśumān bhavati ājyabhāgau yajati yajñasya eva cakṣuṣī na antareti marutaḥ gṛhamedhinaḥ yajati bhāgadheyena eva enān samardhayati agnim sviṣṭakṛtam yajati pratiṣṭhityai iḍā antaḥ bhavati paśavaḥ vai iḍā paśuṣu eva upariṣṭāt pratitiṣṭhati

original: anuvāka 7 rājasūye sākamedhaḥ { 1.6.7.1} yat patnī gṛhamedhīyasya-aśnīyāt | gṛhamedhy eva syāt | vi tv asya yajña ṛdhyeta | yan na-aśnīyāt | agṛhamedhī syāt | na-asya yajño vyr̥ddhyeta | prativeśaṃ paceyuḥ | tasya-aśnīyāt | gṛhamedhy eva bhavati | na-asya yajño vyṛdhyate |
analyzed: anuvāka 7 rājasūye sākamedhaḥ yat patnī gṛhamedhīyasya aśnīyāt gṛhamedhī eva syāt vi tu asya yajñaḥ ṛdhyeta yat na aśnīyāt a gṛhamedhī syāt na asya yajñaḥ vyr̥ddhyeta prativeśam paceyuḥ tasya aśnīyāt gṛhamedhī eva bhavati na asya yajñaḥ vyṛdhyate

original: { 1.6.7.2} te devā gṛhamedhīyena-iṣṭvā | āśitā abhavan | āñjata-abhyañjata | anu vatsān avāsayan | tebhyo 'surāḥ kṣudhaṃ prāhiṇvan | sā deveṣu lokam avittvā | asurān punar agacchat | gṛhamedhīyena-iṣṭvā | āśitā bhavanti | āñjate 'bhyañjate |
analyzed: te devāḥ gṛhamedhīyena eṣṭvā āśitāḥ abhavan āñjata abhyañjata anu vatsān avāsayan tebhyaḥ surāḥ kṣudham prāhiṇvan sā deveṣu lokam a vittvā asurān punar agacchat gṛhamedhīyena eṣṭvā āśitāḥ bhavanti āñjate bhyañjate

original: { 1.6.7.3} anu vatsān vāsayanti | bhrātṛvyāyaiva tad yajamānaḥ kṣudhaṃ prahiṇoti | te devā gṛhamedhīyena-iṣṭvā | indrāya niṣkāsaṃ nyadadhuḥ | asmān eva śva indro nihitabhāga upāvartiteti | tān indro nihitabhāga upāvartata | gṛhamedhīyena-iṣṭvā | indrāya niṣkāsaṃ nidadhyāt | indra evainaṃ nihitabhāga upāvartate | gārhapatye juhoti |
analyzed: anu vatsān vāsayanti bhrātṛvyāya eva tat yajamānaḥ kṣudham prahiṇoti te devāḥ gṛhamedhīyena eṣṭvā indrāya niṣkāsam nyadadhuḥ asmān eva śvas indraḥ nihita bhāgaḥ upāvartitā iti tān indraḥ nihita bhāgaḥ upāvartata gṛhamedhīyena eṣṭvā indrāya niṣkāsam nidadhyāt indraḥ eva enam nihita bhāgaḥ upāvartate gārhapatye juhoti

original: { 1.6.7.4} bhāgadheyenaivainaṃ samardhayati | ṛṣabham āhvayati | vaṣaṭkāra evāsya saḥ | atho indriyam eva tad vīryaṃ yajamāno bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte | indro vṛtraṃ hatvā | parāṃ parāvatam agacchat | apārādham iti manyamānaḥ | so 'bravīt | ka idaṃ vediṣyati-iti | te 'bruvan maruto varaṃ vṛṇāmahai |
analyzed: bhāgadheyena eva enam samardhayati ṛṣabham āhvayati vaṣaṭkāraḥ eva asya saḥ atha u indriyam eva tat vīryam yajamānaḥ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte indraḥ vṛtram hatvā parām parāvatam agacchat apārādham iti manyamānaḥ saḥ bravīt kaḥ idam vediṣyati iti te bruvan marutaḥ varam vṛṇāmahai

original: { 1.6.7.5} atha vayaṃ vedāma | asmabhyam eva prathamaṃ havirnirupyātā iti | ta enam adhyakrīḍan | tat krīḍināṃ krīḍitvam | yan marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ prathamaṃ havir nirupyate vijityai | sākaṃ sūryeṇa-udyatā nirvapati | etasmin vai loka indro vṛtram ahan samṛddhyai | etad brāhmaṇāny eva pañca havīṃṣi | etad brāhmaṇa aindrāgnaḥ |
analyzed: atha vayam vedāma asmabhyam eva prathamam haviḥ nirupyate iti te enam adhyakrīḍan tat krīḍinām krīḍi tvam yat marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ prathamam haviḥ nirupyate vijityai sākam sūryeṇa audyatā nirvapati etasmin vai loke indraḥ vṛtram ahan samṛddhyai etat brāhmaṇāni eva pañca havīṃṣi etat brāhmaṇaḥ aindrāgnaḥ

original: athaiṣa aindraś carur bhavati | { 1.6.7.5} uddhāraṃ vā etam indra udaharata | vṛtraṃ hatvā | anyāsu devatāsv adhi | yad eṣa aindraś carur bhavati | uddhāram eva taṃ yajamāna uddharate | anyāsu prajāsv adhi | vaiśvakarmaṇa ekakapālo bhavati | viśvāny eva tena karmāṇi yajamāno 'varundhe |
analyzed: atha eṣa aindraḥ caruḥ bhavati uddhāram vai etam indraḥ udaharata vṛtram hatvā anyāsu devatāsu adhi yat eṣaḥ aindraḥ caruḥ bhavati uddhāram eva tam yajamānaḥ uddharate anyāsu prajāsu adhi vaiśvakarmaṇaḥ eka kapālaḥ bhavati viśvāni eva tena karmāṇi yajamānaḥ varundhe

original: anuvāka 8 rājasūye piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ { 1.6.8.1} vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tā varuṇapraghāsair varuṇapāśād amuñcat | sākamedhaiḥ pratyasthāpayat | tryambakair rudraṃ niravādayata | pitṛyajñena suvargaṃ lokam agamayat | yad vaiśvadevena yajate | prajā eva tad yajamānaḥ sṛjate | tā varuṇapraghāsair varuṇapāśān muñcati |
analyzed: rājasūya piṇḍapitṛyajñaḥ vaiśvadevena vai prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tāḥ varuṇapraghāsaiḥ varuṇa pāśāt amuñcat sākamedhaiḥ pratyasthāpayat tryambakaiḥ rudram niravādayata pitṛ yajñena suvargam lokam agamayat yat vaiśvadevena yajate prajāḥ eva tat yajamānaḥ sṛjate tāḥ varuṇapraghāsaiḥ varuṇa pāśāt muñcati

original: sākamedhaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati | tryambakair rudraṃ niravadayate |
analyzed: sākamedhaiḥ pratiṣṭhāpayati tryambakaiḥ rudram niravadayate

original: { 1.6.8.2} pitṛyajñena suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | dakṣiṇataḥ prācīnāvītī nirvapati | dakṣiṇāvṛd dhi pitṛṇām | anādṛtya tat | uttarata eva-upavīya nirvapet | ubhaye hi devāś ca pitaraś ca-ijyante | atho yad eva dakṣiṇārdhe 'dhiśrayati | tena dakṣiṇāvṛt | somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśaṃ ṣaṭkapālaṃ nirvapati | saṃvatsaro vai somaḥ pitṛmān |
analyzed: pitṛ yajñena suvargam lokam gamayati dakṣiṇatas prācīnāvītī nirvapati dakṣiṇa āvṛt hi pitṛṇām an ādṛtya tat uttaratas eva aupavīya nirvapet ubhaye hi devāḥ ca pitaraḥ ca ejyante atha u yat eva dakṣiṇa ardhe dhiśrayati tena dakṣiṇa āvṛt somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśam ṣaṣ kapālam nirvapati saṃvatsaraḥ vai somaḥ pitṛmān

original: { 1.6.8.3} saṃvatsaram eva prīṇāti | pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānāḥ | māsā vai pitaro barhiṣadaḥ | māsān eva prīṇāti | yasmin vā ṛtau puruṣaḥ pramīyate | so 'sya-amuṣmiṃl loke bhavati | bahurūpā dhānā bhavanti | ahorātrāṇām abhijityai | pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo mantham | ardhamāsā vai pitaro 'gniṣvāttāḥ |
analyzed: saṃvatsaram eva prīṇāti pitṛbhyaḥ barhiṣadbhyaḥ dhānāḥ māsāḥ vai pitaraḥ barhiṣadaḥ māsān eva prīṇāti yasmin vai ṛtau puruṣaḥ pramīyate saḥ sya amuṣmin loke bhavati bahu rūpāḥ dhānāḥ bhavanti ahar rātrāṇām abhijityai pitṛbhyaḥ gniṣvāttebhyaḥ mantham ardha māsāḥ vai pitaraḥ gniṣvāttāḥ

original: { 1.6.8.4} ardhamāsān eva prīṇāti | abhivānyāyai dugdhe bhavati | sā hi pitṛdevatyaṃ duhe | yat pūrṇam | tan manuṣyāṇām | uparyardho devānām | ardhaḥ pitṛṇām | ardha upamanthati | ardho hi pitṛṇām | ekayā-upamanthati |
analyzed: ardha māsān eva prīṇāti abhivānyāyai dugdhe bhavati sā hi pitṛ devatyam duhe yat pūrṇam tat manuṣyāṇām upari ardhaḥ devānām ardhaḥ pitṛṇām ardhe upamanthati ardhaḥ hi pitṛṇām ekayā upamanthati

original: { 1.6.8.5} ekā hi pitṛṇām | dakṣiṇā-upamanthati | dakṣiṇāvṛddhi pitṛṇām | anārabhya-upamanthati | taddhi pitṝn gacchati | imāṃ diśaṃ vedim uddhanti | ubhaye hi devāś ca pitaraś ca-ijyante | catuḥsraktir bhavati | sarvā hy anu diśaḥ pitaraḥ | akhātā bhavati |
analyzed: ekā hi pitṛṇām dakṣiṇā upamanthati dakṣiṇā vṛt hi pitṛṇām an ārabhya upamanthati tat hi pitṝn gacchati imām diśam vedim uddhanti ubhaye hi devāḥ ca pitaraḥ ca ejyante catur sraktiḥ bhavati sarvāḥ hi anu diśaḥ pitaraḥ a khātā bhavati

original: { 1.6.9.4} ṛtūnāṃ saṃtatyai | pra-evaibhyaḥ pūrvayā puro'nuvākyayā-āha | praṇayati dvitīyayā | gamayati yājyayā | tṛtīye vā ito loke pitaraḥ | ahna evainān {evaināṃ} pūrvayā puro'nuvākyayā-atyānayati | rātriyai dvitīyayā | ā-evainān yājyayā gamayati | dakṣiṇato 'vadāya | udaṅṅ atikrāmati vyāvṛttyai |
analyzed: ṛtūnām saṃtatyai pra eva ebhyaḥ pūrvayā puronuvākyayā āha praṇayati dvitīyayā gamayati yājyayā tṛtīye vai itas loke pitaraḥ ahne eva enān eva enām pūrvayā puronuvākyayā atyānayati rātriyai dvitīyayā ā eva enān yājyayā gamayati dakṣiṇatas vadāya udaṅ atikrāmati vyāvṛttyai

original: { 1.6.9.5} ā svadhā-ity āśrāvayati | astu svadhā-iti pratyāśrāvayati | svadhā nama iti vaṣaṭkaroti | svadhākāro hi pitṛṇām | somam agre yajati | somaprayājā hi pitaraḥ | somaṃ pitṛmantaṃ yajati | saṃvatsaro vai somaḥ pitṛmān | saṃvatsaram eva tad yajati | pitṝn barhiṣado yajati |
analyzed: ā svadhā iti āśrāvayati astu svadhā iti pratyāśrāvayati svadhā namaḥ iti vaṣaṭkaroti svadhākāraḥ hi pitṛṇām somam agre yajati soma prayājāḥ hi pitaraḥ somam pitṛmantam yajati saṃvatsaraḥ vai somaḥ pitṛmān saṃvatsaram eva tat yajati pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ yajati

original: { 1.6.9.6} ye vai yajvānaḥ | te pitaro barhiṣadaḥ | tān eva tad yajati | pitṝn agniṣvāttān yajati | ye vā ayajvāno gṛhamedhinaḥ | te pitaro 'gniṣvāttāḥ | tān eva tad yajati | agniṃ kavyavāhanaṃ yajati | ya eva pitṛṇām agniḥ | tam eva tad yajati |
analyzed: ye vai yajvānaḥ te pitaraḥ barhiṣadaḥ tān eva tat yajati pitṝn agniṣvāttān yajati ye vai ayajvānaḥ gṛhamedhinaḥ te pitaraḥ gniṣvāttāḥ tān eva tat yajati agnim kavyavāhanam yajati yaḥ eva pitṛṇām agniḥ tam eva tat yajati

original: { 1.6.9.7} atho yathā-agniṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati | tādṛg eva tat | etat te tata ye ca tvām anv iti tisṛṣu sraktīṣu nidadhāti | tasmād ā tṛtīyāt puruṣān nāmanigṛhṇanti { nāma na gṛhṇanti?} | etāvanto hi-ijyante | atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam ity āha | hlīkā hi pitaraḥ | udañco niṣkrāmanti | eṣā vai manuṣyāṇāṃ dik |
analyzed: atha u yathā agnim sviṣṭakṛtam yajati tādṛś eva tat etat te tata ye ca tvām anu iti tisṛṣu sraktīṣu nidadhāti tasmāt ā tṛtīyāt puruṣāt nāma nigṛhṇanti nāma na gṛhṇanti etāvantaḥ hi ijyante atra pitaraḥ yathābhāgam mandadhvam iti āha hlīkāḥ hi pitaraḥ udañcaḥ niṣkrāmanti eṣā vai manuṣyāṇām diś

original: { 1.6.10.2} tad dhi rudrasya bhāgadheyam | imāṃ diśaṃ yanti | eṣā vai rudrasya dik | svāyām eva diśi rudraṃ niravadayate | rudro vā apaśukāgrā āhutyai na-atiṣṭhata | asau te paśur iti nirdiśed yaṃ dviṣyāt | yam eva dveṣṭi | tam asmai paśuṃ nirdiśati | yadi na dviṣyāt | ākhus te paśur iti brūyāt |

original: { 1.6.10.4} eṣa te rudra bhāgaḥ saha svasrā-ambikayā ity āha | śarad vā asya-ambikā svasā | tayā vā eṣa hinasti | yaṃ hinasti | tayā-evainaṃ saha śamayati | bheṣajaṃ gava ity āha | yāvanta eva grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ | tebhyo bheṣajaṃ karoti | ava-amba rudram adimahi-ity āha | āśiṣam evaitām āśāste |

original: { 1.6.10.5} tryambakaṃ yajāmaha ity āha | mṛtyor mukṣīya mā-amṛtād iti vāva-etad āha | utkiranti | bhagasya līpsante | mūte kṛtvā sajanti | yathā janaṃ yate 'vasaṃ {yatevasaṃ} karoti | tādṛg eva tat | eṣa te rudra bhāga ity āha niravattyai | apratīkṣam āyanti | apaḥ pariṣiñcati | rudrasya-antarhityai | pra vā ete 'smāl lokāc cyavante |
analyzed: tryambakam yajāmahe iti āha mṛtyoḥ mukṣīya mā amṛtāt iti vāva etat āha utkiranti bhagasya līpsante mūte kṛtvā sajanti yathā janam yate vasam yatevasam karoti tādṛś eva tat eṣa te rudra bhāgaḥ iti āha niravattyai a pratīkṣam āyanti apaḥ pariṣiñcati rudrasya antarhityai pra vai ete smāt lokāt cyavante

analyzed: prapāṭhaka 7 anuvāka rājasūye śunāsīraḥ etat brāhmaṇāni eva pañca havīṃṣi atha aindrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśam dvādaśa kapālam nirvapati saṃvatsaraḥ vai indra śunāsīraḥ saṃvatsareṇa eva asmai annam avarundhe vāyavyam payaḥ bhavati vāyuḥ vai vṛṣṭyai pradāpayitā saḥ eva asmai vṛṣṭim pradāpayati sauryaḥ eka kapālaḥ bhavati

original: āyuṣy eva-indriye pratitiṣṭhati | mārutasya ca-ekaviṃśatikapālasya vaiśvadevyai ca-āmikṣāyā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati | devatābhir evainam ubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | apāṃ naptre svāhā-ūrjo naptre svāhā-agnaye gṛhapataye svāhā-iti tisra āhutīr juhoti | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: āyuṣi eva aindriye pratitiṣṭhati mārutasya ca ekaviṃśati kapālasya vaiśvadevyai ca āmikṣāyāḥ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte samavadyati devatābhiḥ eva enam ubhayatas parigṛhṇāti apām naptre svāhā ūrjaḥ naptre svāhā agnaye gṛhapataye svāhā iti tisraḥ āhutīḥ juhoti trayaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣu eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati

original: prapāṭhaka: 8 anuvāka 1 rājasūye saṃsṛpāṃ haviḥ { 1.8.1.1} varuṇasya suṣuvāṇasya daśadhā-indriyaṃ vīryaṃ parāpatat | tat saṃsṛdbhir anusamasarpat | tat saṃsṛpāṃ saṃsṛttvam | agninā devena prathame 'hann anuprāyuṅkta | sarasvatyā vācā dvitīye | savitrā prasavena tṛtīye | pūṣṇā paśubhiś caturthe | bṛhaspatinā brahmaṇā pañcame |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 8 anuvāka rājasūye saṃsṛpām haviḥ varuṇasya suṣuvāṇasya daśadhā indriyam vīryam parāpatat tat saṃsṛdbhiḥ anusamasarpat tat saṃsṛpām saṃsṛt tvam agninā devena prathame han anuprāyuṅkta sarasvatyā vācā dvitīye savitrā prasavena tṛtīye pūṣṇā paśubhiḥ caturthe bṛhaspatinā brahmaṇā pañcame

original: indreṇa devena ṣaṣṭhe | varuṇena svayā devatayā saptame |
analyzed: indreṇa devena ṣaṣṭhe varuṇena svayā devatayā saptame

original: { 1.8.1.2} somena rājñā-aṣṭame | tvaṣṭrā rūpeṇa navame | viṣṇunā yajñena-āpnot | yat saṃsṛpo bhavanti | indriyam eva tad vīryaṃ yajamāna āpnoti | pūrvā-pūrvā vedir bhavati | indriyasya vīryasya-avaruddhyai | purastād upasadāṃ saumyena pracarati | somo vai retodhāḥ | reta eva tad dadhāti | antarā tvāṣṭreṇa | reta eva hitaṃ tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi vikaroti |
analyzed: somena rājñā aṣṭame tvaṣṭrā rūpeṇa navame viṣṇunā yajñena āpnot yat saṃsṛpaḥ bhavanti indriyam eva tat vīryam yajamānaḥ āpnoti pūrva apūrvā vediḥ bhavati indriyasya vīryasya avaruddhyai purastāt upasadām saumyena pracarati somaḥ vai retaḥ dhāḥ retaḥ eva tat dadhāti antarā tvāṣṭreṇa retaḥ eva hitam tvaṣṭā rūpāṇi vikaroti

original: upariṣṭād vaiṣṇavena | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajña eva-antataḥ pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: upariṣṭāt vaiṣṇavena yajñaḥ vai viṣṇuḥ yajñe eva antatas pratitiṣṭhati

original: anuvāka 2 rājasūye daśapeyavidhiḥ { 1.8.2.1} jāmi vā etat kurvanti | yat sadyo dīkṣayanti | sadyaḥ somaṃ krīṇanti | puṇḍarisrajāṃ prayacchaty ajāmitvāya | aṅgirasaḥ suvargaṃ lokaṃ yantaḥ | apsu dīkṣātapasī prāveśayan | tat {yat} puṇḍarīkam abhavat | yat puṇḍarisrajāṃ prayacchati | sākṣād eva dīkṣātapasī avarundhe |
analyzed: anuvāka 2 rājasūye daśapeya vidhiḥ jāmi vai etat kurvanti yat sadyas dīkṣayanti sadyas somam krīṇanti puṇḍari srajām prayacchati ajāmi tvāya aṅgirasaḥ suvargam lokam yantaḥ apsu dīkṣā tapasī prāveśayan tat yat puṇḍarīkam abhavat yat puṇḍari srajām prayacchati sākṣāt eva dīkṣā tapasī avarundhe

original: daśabhir vatsataraiḥ somaṃ krīṇāti | daśa-akṣarā virāṭ |
analyzed: daśabhiḥ vatsataraiḥ somam krīṇāti daśa akṣarā virāj

original: { 1.8.2.2} annaṃ virāṭ | virājā-eva-annādyam avarundhe | muṣkarā bhavanti sa-indratvāya | daśapeyo bhavati | annādyasya-avaruddhyai | śataṃ brāhmaṇāḥ pibanti | śata-āyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata-indriyaḥ | āyuṣy eva-indriye pratitiṣṭhati | saptadaśaṃ stotraṃ bhavati | saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ |
analyzed: annam virāj virājā eva annādyam avarundhe muṣkarāḥ bhavanti sa aindra tvāya daśapeyaḥ bhavati annādyasya avaruddhyai śatam brāhmaṇāḥ pibanti śata āyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata aindriyaḥ āyuṣi eva aindriye pratitiṣṭhati saptadaśam stotram bhavati saptadaśaḥ prajāpatiḥ

original: { 1.8.2.3} prajāpater āptyai | prakāśāv adhvaryave dadāti { prāksāśāvadhvaryave dadat} | prakāśam evainaṃ gamayati | srajam udgātre | vy evāsmai vāsayati | rukmaṃ hotre | ādityam evāsmā unnayati | aśvaṃ prastotṛpratihartṛbhyām | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpater āptyai |
analyzed: prajāpateḥ āptyai prakāśau adhvaryave dadāti prāc sāśau adhvaryave dadat prakāśam eva enam gamayati srajam udgātre vi eva asmai vāsayati rukmam hotre ādityam eva asmai unnayati aśvam prastotṛ pratihartṛbhyām prājāpatyaḥ vai aśvaḥ prajāpateḥ āptyai

original: { 1.8.2.4} dvādaśa paṣṭhauhīr brahmaṇe | āyur eva-avarundhe | vaśāṃ maitrāvaruṇāya | rāṣṭram eva vaśy akaḥ | ṛṣabhaṃ brāhmaṇācchaṃsine | rāṣṭram eva-indriyāvyakaḥ | vāsasī neṣṭāpotṛbhyāṃ | pavitre evāsyaite | sthūri yavācitam acchāvākāya | antata eva vvaruṇam avayajate |
analyzed: dvādaśa paṣṭhauhīḥ brahmaṇe āyuḥ eva avarundhe vaśām maitrāvaruṇāya rāṣṭram eva vaśī akaḥ ṛṣabham brāhmaṇācchaṃsine rāṣṭram eva aindriyāvī akaḥ vāsasī neṣṭāpotṛbhyām pavitre eva asya ete sthūri yava ācitam acchāvākāya antatas eva vvaruṇam avayajate

original: { 1.8.2.5} anaḍvāham agnīdhe | vahnir vā anaḍvān | vahnir agnīt | vahninā-eva vahni yajñasya-avarundhe | indrasya suṣuvāṇasya tredhā-indriyaṃ vīryaṃ parāpatat | bhṛgus tṛtīyam abhavat | śrāyantīyaṃ tṛtīyam | sarasvatī tṛtīyam | bhārgavo hotā bhavati | śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāmaṃ bhavati | vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāmam | sārasvatīr apo gṛhṇāti |
analyzed: anaḍvāham agnīdhe vahniḥ vai anaḍvān vahniḥ agnīdh vahninā eva vahni yajñasya avarundhe indrasya suṣuvāṇasya tredhā indriyam vīryam parāpatat bhṛguḥ tṛtīyam abhavat śrāyantīyam tṛtīyam sarasvatī tṛtīyam bhārgavaḥ hotā bhavati śrāyantīyam brahmasāmam bhavati vāravantīyam agniṣṭoma sāmam sārasvatīḥ apaḥ gṛhṇāti

original: indriyasya vīryasya-avaruddhyai | śrāyantīyaṃ brahmasāmaṃ bhavati | indriyam evāsmin vīryaṃ śrayati | vāravantīyam agniṣṭomasāmam | indriyam evāsmin vīryaṃ vārayati |
analyzed: indriyasya vīryasya avaruddhyai śrāyantīyam brahma sāmam bhavati indriyam eva asmin vīryam śrayati vāravantīyam agniṣṭoma sāmam indriyam eva asmin vīryam vārayati

original: anuvāka 3 { 1.8.3.1} īśvaro vā eṣa diśo 'nūnmaditoḥ | yaṃ diśo 'nu vyāsthāpayanti | diśām aveṣṭayo bhavanti | dikṣv eva pratitiṣṭhaty anunmādāya | pañca devatā yajati | pañca diśaḥ | dikṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati | haviṣo-haviṣa iṣṭvā bārhaspatyam abhighārayayati | yajamānadevatyo vai bṛhaspatiḥ | yajamānam eva tejasā samardhayati |
analyzed: īśvaraḥ vai eṣa diśaḥ nu unmaditoḥ yam diśaḥ nu vyāsthāpayanti diśām aveṣṭayaḥ bhavanti dikṣu eva pratitiṣṭhati an unmādāya pañca devatāḥ yajati pañca diśaḥ dikṣu eva pratitiṣṭhati haviṣaḥ haviṣaḥ iṣṭvā bārhaspatyam abhighārayayati yajamāna devatyaḥ vai bṛhaspatiḥ yajamānam eva tejasā samardhayati

original: { 1.8.3.2} ādityāṃ malhāṃ {ahlāṃ} garbhiṇīm ālabhate | mārutīṃ pṛśniṃ paṣṭhauhīm | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | ādityayā pūrvayā pracarati | mārutyā-uttarayā | rāṣṭra eva viśam anubadhnāti | uccair ādityāyā āśrāvayati | upāṃśu mārutyai | tasmād rāṣṭraṃ viśam ativadati | garbhiṇy ādityā bhavati |
analyzed: ādityām malhām ahlām garbhiṇīm ālabhate mārutīm pṛśnim paṣṭhauhīm viśam ca eva asmai rāṣṭram ca samīcī dadhāti ādityayā pūrvayā pracarati mārutyā uttarayā rāṣṭre eva viśam anubadhnāti uccais ādityāyāḥ āśrāvayati upāṃśu mārutyai tasmāt rāṣṭram viśam ativadati garbhiṇī ādityā bhavati

original: { 1.8.3.3} indriyaṃ vai garbhaḥ | rāṣṭram eva-indriyāvyakaḥ | agarbhā mārutī | viḍ vai marutaḥ | viśam eva nirindriyām akaḥ | deva-asurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te devā aśvinoḥ pūṣan vācaḥ satyaṃ saṃnidhāya | anṛtena-asurān abhyabhavan | te 'śvibhyāṃ pūṣṇe puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ niravapan | tato vai te vācaḥ satyam avārundhata |
analyzed: indriyam vai garbhaḥ rāṣṭram eva aindriyau akaḥ agarbhā mārutī viś vai marutaḥ viśam eva nirindriyām akaḥ deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan te devāḥ aśvinoḥ pūṣan vācaḥ satyam saṃnidhāya anṛtena asurān abhyabhavan te śvibhyām pūṣṇe puroḍāśam dvādaśa kapālam niravapan tatas vai te vācaḥ satyam avārundhata

original: { 1.8.3.4} yad aśvibhyāṃ pūṣṇe puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati | anṛtena-eva bhrātṛvyān abhibhūya | vācaḥ satyam avarundhe | sarasvate satyavāce carum | pūrvam eva-uditam | uttareṇa-abhigṛṇāti | savitre satyaprasavāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ prasūtyai | dūtān prahiṇoti | āvida etā bhavanti | āvidam evainaṃ gamayanti |
analyzed: yat aśvibhyām pūṣṇe puroḍāśam dvādaśa kapālam nirvapati anṛtena eva bhrātṛvyān abhibhūya vācaḥ satyam avarundhe sarasvate satya vāce carum pūrvam eva uditam uttareṇa abhigṛṇāti savitre satya prasavāya puroḍāśam dvādaśa kapālam prasūtyai dūtān prahiṇoti āvidaḥ etāḥ bhavanti āvidam eva enam gamayanti

original: atho dūtebhya eva na cchidyate | tisṛdhanvaṃ śuṣkadṛtir dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai |
analyzed: atha u dūtebhyaḥ eva na chidyate tisṛdhanvam śuṣka dṛtiḥ dakṣiṇā samṛddhyai

original: anuvāka 4 rājasūye prayujāṃ havirvidhiḥ { 1.8.4.1} āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati | tasmāt-śiśire kurupañcālāḥ prāñco yānti | saumyaṃ carum | tasmād vasantaṃ vyavasāya-ādayanti | sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālam | tasmāt purastād yavānāṃ savitrā virundhate | bārhaspatyaṃ carum | savitrā-eva virudhya | brahmaṇā yavān ādadhate | tvāṣṭram aṣṭākapālam |
analyzed: anuvāka 4 rājasūye prayujām haviḥ vidhiḥ āgneyam aṣṭākapālam nirvapati tasmāt śiśire kuru pañcālāḥ prāñcaḥ yānti saumyam carum tasmāt vasantam sāvitram dvādaśa kapālam tasmāt purastāt yavānām savitrā virundhate bārhaspatyam carum savitrā eva virudhya brahmaṇā yavān ādadhate tvāṣṭram aṣṭākapālam

original: { 1.8.4.2} rūpāṇy eva tena kurvate | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālam | tasmāj jaghanye naidāghe pratyañcaḥ kurupañcālā yānti | sārasvataṃ caruṃ nirvapati | tasmāt prāvṛṣi sarvā vāco vadanti | pauṣṇena vyavasyanti | maitreṇa kṛṣante | vāruṇena vidhṛtā āsate | kṣaitrapatyena pācayante | ādityena-ādadhate |
analyzed: rūpāṇi eva tena kurvate vaiśvānaram dvādaśa kapālam tasmāt jaghanye naidāghe pratyañcaḥ kuru pañcālāḥ yānti sārasvatam carum nirvapati tasmāt prāvṛṣi sarvāḥ vācaḥ vadanti pauṣṇena vyavasyanti maitreṇa kṛṣante vāruṇena vidhṛtāḥ āsate kṣaitrapatyena pācayante ādityena ādadhate

original: { 1.8.4.3} māsi-māsy etāni havīṃṣi nirupyāṇi-ity āhuḥ | tenaiva-ṛtūn prayuṅkta iti | atho khalv āhuḥ | kaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ jīviṣyati-iti | ṣaḍ eva pūrvedyur nirupyāṇi | ṣaḍ uttaredyuḥ | tenaiva-ṛtūn prayuṅkte | dakṣiṇo rathavāhanavāhaḥ pūrveṣāṃ dakṣiṇā | uttara uttareṣām | saṃvatsarasyaiva-antau yunakti | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai |
analyzed: māsi māsi etāni havīṃṣi nirupyāṇi iti āhuḥ tena eva ṛtūn prayuṅkte iti atha u khalu āhuḥ kaḥ saṃvatsaram jīviṣyati iti ṣaḍ eva pūrvedyus nirupyāṇi ṣaḍ uttaredyus tena eva ṛtūn prayuṅkte dakṣiṇaḥ rathavāhana vāhaḥ pūrveṣām dakṣiṇā uttaraḥ uttareṣām saṃvatsarasya eva antau yunakti suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

original: anuvāka 5 rājasūye sautrāmaṇīyāgavidhiḥ { 1.8.5.1} indrasya suṣuvāṇasya daśadhā-indriyaṃ vīryaṃ parāpatat | sa yat prathamaṃ niraṣṭhīvat | tat kvalam abhavat | yad dvitīyam | tad badaram | yat tṛtīyam | tat karkandhu | yan nastaḥ | sa siṃhaḥ | yad akṣyoḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 5 rājasūye sautrāmaṇī yāga vidhiḥ indrasya suṣuvāṇasya daśadhā indriyam vīryam parāpatat sa yat prathamam niraṣṭhīvat tat kvalam abhavat yat dvitīyam tat badaram yat tṛtīyam tat karkandhu yat nastas sa siṃhaḥ yat akṣyoḥ

original: { 1.8.5.2} sa śārdūlaḥ | yat karṇayoḥ | sa vṛkaḥ | ya ūrdhvaḥ | sa somaḥ | yā-avācī | sā surā | trayāḥ saktavo bhavanti | indriyasya-avaruddhyai | trayāṇi lomāni |
analyzed: sa śārdūlaḥ yat karṇayoḥ sa vṛkaḥ yaḥ ūrdhvaḥ sa somaḥ yā avācī sā surā trayāḥ saktavaḥ bhavanti indriyasya avaruddhyai trayāṇi lomāni

original: { 1.8.5.3} tviṣim eva-avarundhe | trayo grahāḥ | vīryam eva-avarundhe | nāmnā daśamī | nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ | nābhir daśamī | prāṇā indriyaṃ vīryam | prāṇān eva-indriyaṃ vīryaṃ yajamāna ātman dhatte | sīsena klībāt-śaṣpāṇi krīṇāti | na vā etad ayo na hiraṇyam |
analyzed: tviṣim eva avarundhe trayaḥ grahāḥ vīryam eva avarundhe nāmnā daśamī nava vai puruṣe prāṇāḥ nābhiḥ daśamī prāṇāḥ indriyam vīryam prāṇān eva aindriyam vīryam yajamānaḥ ātman dhatte sīsena klībāt śaṣpāṇi krīṇāti na vai etat ayaḥ na hiraṇyam

original: { 1.8.5.4} yat sīsam | na strī na pumān | yat klībaḥ | na somo na surā | yat sautrāmaṇī samṛddhyai | svādvīṃ tvā svādunā-ity āha | somam evaināṃ karoti | somo 'sy aśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasva-indrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva-ity āha | etābhyo hy eṣā devatābhyaḥ pacyate | tisraḥ saṃsṛṣṭā vasati |
analyzed: yat sīsam na strī na pumān yat klībaḥ na somaḥ na surā yat sautrāmaṇī samṛddhyai svādvīm tvā svādunā iti āha somam eva enām karoti somaḥ u si aśvibhyām pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasva aindrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva iti āha etābhyaḥ hi eṣā devatābhyaḥ pacyate tisraḥ saṃsṛṣṭāḥ vasati

original: { 1.8.5.5} tisro hi rātrīḥ krītaḥ somo vasati | punātu te parisrutam iti yajuṣā punāti vyāvṛttyai {ānaṃdā. vyāvṛtyai} | pavitreṇa punāti | pavitreṇa hi somaṃ punanti | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā-ity āha | vāreṇa hi somaṃ punanti | vāyuḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa-iti na-etayā punīyāt | vyṛddhā hy eṣā | atipavitasyaitayā punīyāt |
analyzed: tisraḥ hi rātrīḥ krītaḥ somaḥ vasati punātu te parisrutam iti yajuṣā punāti vyāvṛttyai ānaṃdā vyāvṛtyai pavitreṇa punāti pavitreṇa hi somam punanti vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā iti āha vāreṇa hi somam punanti vāyuḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa eti na etayā punīyāt vyṛddhā hi eṣā atipavitasya etayā punīyāt

original: kuvid aṅga-ity aniruktayā prājāpatyayā gṛhṇāti |
analyzed: kuvid aṅga eti aniruktayā prājāpatyayā gṛhṇāti

original: { 1.8.5.6} aniruktaḥ prajāpatiḥ | prajāpater āptyai | ekayā-ṛcā gṛhṇāti | ekadhā-eva yajamāne vīryaṃ dadhāti | āśvinaṃ dhūmram ālabhate | aśvinau vai devānāṃ bhiṣajau | tābhyām evāsmai bheṣajaṃ karoti | sārasvataṃ meṣam | vāg vai sarasvatī | vācā-evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | aindram ṛṣabhaṃ sa-indratvāya |
analyzed: aniruktaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajāpateḥ āptyai ekayā ṛcā gṛhṇāti ekadhā eva yajamāne vīryam dadhāti āśvinam dhūmram ālabhate aśvinau vai devānām bhiṣajau tābhyām eva asmai bheṣajam karoti sārasvatam meṣam vāc vai sarasvatī vācā eva enam bhiṣajyati aindram ṛṣabham sa aindra tvāya

original: anuvāka 6 rājasūye sautrāmaṇividhiḥ { 1.8.6.21} yat triṣu yūpeṣv ālabheta | bahirdhā-asmād indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dadhyāt | bhrātṛvyam asmai janayet | ekayūpa ālabhate | ekadhā-evāsminn indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dadhāti | na-asmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | na-eteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ puroḍāśā bhavanti | grahapuroḍāśā hy ete |

original: { 2.1.5.9} ya evaṃ veda | upa-enam upasado namanti | vindata upasattāram | yo vā agnihotrasya-āśrāvitaṃ pratyāśrāvitaṃ hotāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ vaṣaṭkāraṃ veda | tasya tv eva hutam | prāṇo vā agnihotrasya-āśrāvitam | apānaḥ pratyāśrāvitam | mano hotā | cakṣur brahmā | nimeṣo vaṣaṭkāraḥ |

original: { 2.1.5.10} ya evaṃ veda | tasya tv eva hutam | sāyaṃyāvānaś ca vai devāḥ prātaryāvāṇaś ca-agnihotriṇo gṛham āgacchanti | tān yan na tarpayet | prajayā-asya paśubhir vitiṣṭheran | yat tarpayet | tṛptā enaṃ prajayā paśubhis tarpayeyuḥ | sajūr devaiḥ sāyaṃ yāvabhir iti sāyaṃ saṃmṛśati | sajūr devaiḥ prātar yāvabhir iti prātaḥ |

original: { 2.1.6.2} cakṣuṣa ādityaḥ | teṣāṃ hutād ajāyata gaur eva | tasyai payasi vyāyacchanta | mama hutād ajani mama-iti | te prajāpatiṃ praśnam āyan | sa ādityo 'gnim abravīt | yataro nau jayāt | tan nau saha-asad iti | kasya-eko { kasyaiko} { kasyai ko} 'hauṣīd iti prajāpatir abravīt kasya-eka { kasyaiko} kasyai ka} iti | prāṇānām aham ity agniḥ |
analyzed: cakṣuṣaḥ ādityaḥ teṣām hutāt ajāyata gauḥ eva tasyai payasi vyāyacchanta mama hutāt ajani mama eti te prajāpatim praśnam āyan saḥ ādityaḥ gnim abravīt yataraḥ nau jayāt tat nau saha asat iti kasya ekaḥ kasya ekaḥ kasyai kaḥ hauṣīt iti prajāpatiḥ abravīt kasya eka kasya ekaḥ kaḥ iti prāṇānām aham iti agniḥ

original: { 2.1.6.3} tanuvā aham iti vāyuḥ | cakṣuṣo 'ham ity ādityaḥ | ya eva prāṇānām ahauṣīt | tasya hutād ajani-iti | agner hutād ajani-iti | tad agnihotrasya-agnihotratvam | gaur vā agnihotram | ya evaṃ veda gaur agnihotram iti | prāṇāpānābhyām eva-agniṃ samardhayati | avyardhukaḥ prāṇāpānābhyāṃ bhavati |

original: { 2.1.6.4} ya evaṃ veda | tau vāyur abravīt | anu mā-ābhajatam iti | yad eva gārhapatye 'dhiśritya-āhavanīyam abhyuddravān | tena tvāṃ prīṇān ity abrūtām | tasmād yad gārhapatye 'dhiśritya-āhavanīyam abhyuddravati | vāyum eva tena prīṇāti | prajāpatir devatāḥ sṛjamānaḥ | agnim eva devatānāṃ prathamam asṛjata | so 'nyad ālambhyam avittvā|
analyzed: yaḥ evam veda tau vāyuḥ abravīt anu mā ābhajatam iti yat eva gārhapatye dhiśritya āhavanīyam abhyuddravān tena tvām prīṇān iti abrūtām tasmāt yat gārhapatye dhiśritya āhavanīyam abhyuddravati vāyum eva tena prīṇāti prajāpatiḥ devatāḥ sṛjamānaḥ agnim eva devatānām prathamam asṛjata saḥ nyat ālambhyam a vittvā

original: { 2.1.6.5} prajāpatim abhi paryāvartata | sa mṛtyor abibhet | so 'mum ādityam ātmano niramimīta | taṃ hutvā parāṅ paryāvartata | tato vai sa mṛtyum apājayat | apa mṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | tasmād yasyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ | utaikāham uta dvyahaṃ na juhvati | hutam evāsya bhavati | asau hy ādityo 'gnihotram |
analyzed: prajāpatim abhi paryāvartata sa mṛtyoḥ abibhet saḥ mum ādityam ātmanaḥ niramimīta tam hutvā parāṅ paryāvartata tatas vai sa mṛtyum apājayat apa mṛtyum jayati yaḥ evam veda tasmāt yasya evam viduṣaḥ uta ekāham uta dvi aham na juhvati hutam eva asya bhavati asau hi ādityaḥ gnihotram

original: anuvāka 7 agnihotre haviṣaḥ sarvadevatāsambandhena praśaṃsā { 2.1.7.7} raudraṃ gavi | vāyavyam upasṛṣṭam | āśvinaṃ duhyamānam | saumyaṃ dugdham | vāruṇam adhiśritam | vaiśvadevā bhindavaḥ | pauṣṇam udantam | sārasvataṃ viṣyandamānam | maitraṃ śaraḥ | dhātur udvāsitam | bṛhaspater unnītam | savituḥ prakrāntam | dyāvāpṛthivyaṃ hriyamāṇam |
analyzed: anuvāka 7 agnihotre haviṣaḥ sarva devatā sambandhena praśaṃsā raudram gavi vāyavyam upasṛṣṭam āśvinam duhyamānam saumyam dugdham vāruṇam adhiśritam vaiśvadevāḥ bhindavaḥ pauṣṇam udantam sārasvatam viṣyandamānam maitram śaraḥ dhātuḥ udvāsitam bṛhaspateḥ unnītam savituḥ prakrāntam dyāvāpṛthivyam hriyamāṇam

analyzed: anayā eva enat pratigṛhṇāti vaiśvānaryā ṛcā ratham pratigṛhṇāti vaiśvānaraḥ vai devatayā rathaḥ svayā eva enam devatayā pratigṛhṇāti tena amṛta tvam aśyām iti āha amṛtam eva ātman dhatte vayaḥ dātre iti āha vayaḥ eva enam kṛtvā suvargam lokam gamayati mayaḥ mahyam astu pratigrahītre iti āha

analyzed: kāmaḥ hi dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmam samudram āviśa iti āha samudraḥ iva hi kāmaḥ na eva hi kāmasya antaḥ sti na samudrasya kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi iti āha yena kāmena pratigṛhṇāti saḥ eva enam amuṣmin loke kāmaḥ āgacchati kāma etat te eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇā iti āha kāmaḥ eva tat yajamānaḥ muṣmin loke dakṣiṇām icchati
