original: { 2.2.6.3} caturhotṝn hotā vyācaṣṭe | stutam anuśaṃsati śāntyai | anto vā eṣa yajñasya | yad daśamam ahaḥ | etat khalu vai devānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ brahma | yac caturhotāraḥ | daśame 'haṃś caturhotṝn vyācaṣṭe | yajñasyaiva-antaṃ gatvā | paramaṃ devānāṃ guhyaṃ brahmāvarundhe | tad eva prakāśaṃ gamayati |
analyzed: caturhotṝn hotā vyācaṣṭe stutam anuśaṃsati śāntyai antaḥ vai eṣa yajñasya yat daśamam ahar etat khalu vai devānām paramam guhyam brahma yat caturhotāraḥ daśame han caturhotṝn vyācaṣṭe yajñasya eva antam gatvā paramam devānām guhyam brahma avarundhe tat eva prakāśam gamayati

original: { 2.2.6.4} tad enaṃ prakāśaṃ gatam | prakāśaṃ prajānāṃ gamayati | vācaṃ yacchati | yajñasya dhṛtyai | yajamānadevatyaṃ vā ahaḥ | bhrātṛvyadevatyā rātriḥ | ahnā rātriṃ dhyāyet | bhrātṛvyasyaiva tal lokaṃ vṛṅkte | yad divā vācaṃ visṛjet | ahar bhrātṛvyāya-ucchiṃṣet | yan naktaṃ visṛjet | rātriṃ bhrātṛvyāya-ucchiṃṣet | adhivṛkṣasūrye vācaṃ visṛjati |
analyzed: tat enam prakāśam gatam prakāśam prajānām gamayati vācam yacchati yajñasya dhṛtyai yajamāna devatyam vai ahar bhrātṛvya devatyā rātriḥ ahnā rātrim dhyāyet bhrātṛvyasya eva tat lokam vṛṅkte yat divā vācam visṛjet ahar bhrātṛvyāya ucchiṃṣet yat naktam visṛjet rātrim bhrātṛvyāya ucchiṃṣet adhi vṛkṣa sūrye vācam visṛjati

original: etāvantam evāsmai lokam ucchiṃṣati | yāvad ādityo 'stameti |
analyzed: etāvantam eva asmai lokam ucchiṃṣati yāvat āditya u stam iti

original: anuvāka 7 { 2.2.7.1} prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ samaśliṣyan | tā rūpeṇa-anuprāviśat | tasmād āhuḥ | rūpaṃ vai prajāpatir iti | tā nāmnā-anuprāviśat | tasmād āhuḥ | nāma vai prajāpatir iti | tasmād apy āmitrau saṃgatya | nāmnā ced dhvayete |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ samaśliṣyan tāḥ rūpeṇa anuprāviśat tasmāt āhuḥ rūpam vai prajāpatiḥ iti tāḥ nāmnā anuprāviśat tasmāt āhuḥ nāma vai prajāpatiḥ iti tasmāt api āmitrau saṃgatya nāmnā ced dhvayete

original: { 2.2.7.2} mitram eva bhavataḥ | prajāpatir deva-asurān asṛjata | sa indram api na-asṛjata | taṃ devā abruvan | indraṃ no janaya-iti | sa ātmann indram apaśyat | tam asṛjata | taṃ triṣṭug vīryaṃ bhūtvā-anuprāviśat | tasya vajraḥ pañcadaśo hasta āpadyata | tena-udayya-asurān abhyabhavat |
analyzed: mitram eva bhavataḥ prajāpatiḥ deva asurān asṛjata saḥ indram api na asṛjata tam devāḥ abruvan indram naḥ janaya eti saḥ ātman indram apaśyat tam asṛjata tam triṣṭubh vīryam bhūtvā anuprāviśat tasya vajraḥ pañcadaśaḥ haste āpadyata tena audayya asurān abhyabhavat

original: { 2.2.7.3} ya evaṃ veda | abhi bhrātṛvyān bhavati | te devā asurair vijitya | suvargaṃ lokam āyan | te 'muṣmin-loke vyakṣudhyan | te 'bruvan | amutaḥ pradānaṃ vā upajijīvima-iti | te saptahotāraṃ yajñaṃ vidhāya-ayāsyam | āṅgīrasaṃ prāhiṇvan | etena-amutra kalpaya-iti |
analyzed: yaḥ evam veda abhi bhrātṛvyān bhavati te devāḥ asuraiḥ vijitya suvargam lokam āyan te muṣmin loke vyakṣudhyan te bruvan amutas pradānam vai upajijīvima eti te saptahotāram yajñam vidhāya ayāsyam āṅgīrasam prāhiṇvan etena amutra kalpaya eti

original: { 2.2.7.4} tasya vā iyaṃ klṛptiḥ | yad idaṃ kiṃ ca | ya evaṃ veda | kalpate 'smai | sa vā ayaṃ manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā | amutra sadbhyo devebhyo havyaṃ vahati | ya evaṃ veda | upa-enaṃ yajño namati | so 'manyata | abhi vā ime 'smāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ kamiṣyanta iti | sa vācaspate hṛd iti vyāharat | tasmāt puttró hṛdayam |
analyzed: tasya vai iyam klṛptiḥ yat idam kim ca yaḥ evam veda kalpate smai sa vai ayam manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā amutra sadbhyaḥ devebhyaḥ havyam vahati yaḥ evam veda upa enam yajñaḥ namati saḥ manyata abhi vai ime smāt lokāt amum lokam kamiṣyante iti sa vācaspate hṛd iti vyāharat tasmāt puttró hṛdayam

original: tasmād asmāl lokād amuṃ lokaṃ na-abhikāmayante | putro hi hṛdayam |
analyzed: tasmāt asmāt lokāt amum lokam na abhikāmayante putraḥ hi hṛdayam

original: anuvāka 8 { 2.2.8.1} devā vai caturhotṛbhir yajñam atanvata | te vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa-ajayanta | abhi suvargaṃ lokam ajayan | ya evaṃ vidvāṃś caturhotṛbhir yajñaṃ tanute | vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa jayate | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | ṣaḍḍhotrā prāyaṇīyam āsādayati | amuṣmai vai lokāya ṣaḍḍhotā | ghnanti khalu vā etat somam | yad abhiṣuṇvanti |
analyzed: devāḥ vai caturhotṛbhiḥ yajñam atanvata te vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa ajayanta abhi suvargam lokam ajayan yaḥ evam vidvān caturhotṛbhiḥ yajñam tanute vi pāpmanā bhrātṛvyeṇa jayate abhi suvargam lokam jayati ṣaḍḍhotrā prāyaṇīyam āsādayati amuṣmai vai lokāya ṣaḍḍhotā ghnanti khalu vai etat somam yat abhiṣuṇvanti

original: { 2.2.8.2} ṛjudhā-evainam amuṃ lokaṃ gamayati | caturhotrā-ātithyam | yaśo vai caturhotā | yaśa evā''tman dhatte | pañcahotrā paśum upasādayati | suvargyo vai pañcahotā | yajamānaḥ paśuḥ | yajamānam eva suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati | grahān gṛhītvā saptahotāraṃ juhoti | indriyaṃ vai saptahotā |
analyzed: ṛjudhā eva enam amum lokam gamayati caturhotrā ātithyam yaśaḥ vai caturhotā yaśaḥ eva ātman dhatte pañcahotrā paśum upasādayati suvargyaḥ vai pañcahotā yajamānaḥ paśuḥ yajamānam eva suvargam lokam gamayati grahān gṛhītvā saptahotāram juhoti indriyam vai saptahotā

original: { 2.2.8.3} indriyam evā''tman dhatte | yo vai caturhotṝn anusavanaṃ tarpayati | tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | upa-enaṃ somapītho namati | bahiṣpavamāne daśahotāraṃ vyācakṣīta | mādhyandine pavamāne caturhotāram | ārbhave pavamāne pañcahotāram | pitṛyajñe ṣaḍḍhotāram | yajñāyajñiyasya stotre saptahotāram | anusavanam evaināṃs tarpayati |
analyzed: indriyam eva ātman dhatte yaḥ vai caturhotṝn anusavanam tarpayati tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ upa enam soma pīthaḥ namati bahiṣpavamāne daśahotāram vyācakṣīta mādhyandine pavamāne caturhotāram ārbhave pavamāne pañcahotāram pitṛyajñe ṣaḍḍhotāram yajñāyajñiyasya stotre saptahotāram anusavanam eva enān tarpayati

original: { 2.2.8.4} tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | upa-enaṃ somapītho namati | devā vai caturhotṛbhiḥ sattram āsata | ṛddhiparimitaṃ yaśaskāmāḥ | te 'bruvan | yan naḥ prathamaṃ yaśa ṛcchāt | sarveṣāṃ nas tat saha-asad iti | somaś caturhotrā | agniḥ pañcahotrā | dhātā ṣaḍḍhotrā |
analyzed: tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ upa enam soma pīthaḥ namati devāḥ vai caturhotṛbhiḥ sattram āsate ṛddhi parimitam yaśaskāmāḥ te bruvan yat naḥ prathamam yaśaḥ ṛcchāt sarveṣām naḥ tat saha asat iti somaḥ caturhotrā agniḥ pañcahotrā dhātā ṣaḍḍhotrā

original: { 2.2.8.5} indraḥ saptahotrā | prajāpatir daśahotrā | teṣāṃ somaṃ rājānaṃ yaśa ārccat | tan nyakāmayata | tena-apākrāmat | tena pralāyam acarat | taṃ devāḥ praiṣaiḥ praiṣam aicchan | tat praiṣāṇāṃ praiṣatvam | nividbhir nyavedayan | tan nividāṃ nivittvam |
analyzed: indraḥ saptahotrā prajāpatiḥ daśahotrā teṣām somam rājānam yaśaḥ ārccat tat nyakāmayata tena apākrāmat tena pralāyam acarat tam devāḥ praiṣaiḥ praiṣam aicchan tat praiṣāṇām praiṣa tvam nividbhiḥ nyavedayan tat nividām nivid tvam

original: { 2.2.8.6} āprībhir āpnuvan |tad āprīṇām āpritvam | tam aghnan | tasya yaśo vyagṛhṇata | te grahā abhavan | tad grahāṇāṃ grahatvam | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo grahā gṛhyante | tasya tv eva gṛhītāḥ | te 'bruvan | yo vai naḥ śreṣṭho 'bhūt |
analyzed: āprībhiḥ āpnuvan tat āprīṇām āpri tvam tam aghnan tasya yaśaḥ vyagṛhṇata te grahāḥ abhavan tat grahāṇām graha tvam yasya evam viduṣaḥ grahāḥ gṛhyante tasya tu eva gṛhītāḥ te bruvan yaḥ vai naḥ śreṣṭhaḥ bhūt

original: { 2.2.8.7} tam avadhiṣma | punar imaṃ suvāmahā iti | taṃ chandobhir asuvanta | tac chandasāṃ chandastvam | sāmnā samānayan | tat sāmnaḥ sāmatvam | ukthair udasthāpayan | tad ukthānām ukthatvam | ya evaṃ veda | praty eva tiṣṭhati |
analyzed: tam avadhiṣma punar imam suvāmahai iti tam chandobhiḥ asuvanta tat chandasām chandaḥ tvam sāmnā samānayan tat sāmnaḥ sāma tvam ukthaiḥ udasthāpayan tat ukthānām uktha tvam yaḥ evam veda prati eva tiṣṭhati

original: { 2.2.8.8} sarvam āyur eti | somo vai yaśaḥ | ya evaṃ vidvānt somam āgacchati | yaśa evainam ṛcchati | tasmād āhuḥ | yaś caivaṃ veda yaś ca na | tāv ubhau somam āgacchataḥ | somo hi yaśaḥ | taṃ tvā va yaśa ṛcchati-ity āhuḥ | 0 yaḥ some somaṃ prāha-iti | 1 tasmāt some somaḥ procyaḥ | 2 yaśa evainam ṛcchati |
analyzed: sarvam āyuḥ eti somaḥ vai yaśaḥ yaḥ evam vidvān somam āgacchati yaśaḥ eva enam ṛcchati tasmāt āhuḥ yaḥ ca evam veda yaḥ ca na tau ubhau somam āgacchataḥ somaḥ hi yaśaḥ tam tvā yaśaḥ ṛcchati iti āhuḥ yaḥ some somam prāha eti tasmāt some somaḥ procyaḥ 2 yaśaḥ eva enam ṛcchati

original: anuvāka 9 { 2.2.9.1} idaṃ vā agre na-eva kiṃ cana-āsīt | na dyaur āsīt | na pṛthivī | na-antarikṣam | tad asad eva san mano 'kuruta syām iti | tad atapyata | tasmāt tepānād dhūmo 'jāyata | tad bhūyo 'tapyata | tasmāt tepānād agnir ajāyata | tad bhūyo 'tapyata |
analyzed: idam vai agre na eva kim cana āsīt na dyauḥ āsīt na pṛthivī na antarikṣam tat asat eva sat mano kuruta syām iti tat atapyata tasmāt tepānāt dhūmaḥ jāyata tat bhūyas tapyata tasmāt tepānāt agniḥ ajāyata tat bhūyas tapyata

original: { 2.2.9.2} tasmāt tepānāj jyotir ajāyata | tad bhūyo 'tapyata | tasmāt tepānād arcir ajāyata | tad bhūyo 'tapyata | tasmāt tepānān marīcayo 'jāyanta | tad bhūyo 'tapyata | tasmāt tepānād udārā ajāyanta | tad bhūyo 'tapyata | tad abbʰram iva samahanyata | tad vastim abhinat |
analyzed: tasmāt tepānāt jyotiḥ ajāyata tat bhūyas tapyata tasmāt tepānāt arciḥ ajāyata tat bhūyas tapyata tasmāt tepānāt marīcayaḥ jāyanta tat bhūyas tapyata tasmāt tepānāt udārāḥ ajāyanta tat bhūyas tapyata tat abbʰram iva samahanyata tat vastim abhinat

original: { 2.2.9.3} sa samudro 'bhavat | tasmāt samudrasya na pibanti | prajananam iva hi manyante | tasmāt paśor jāyamānād āpaḥ purast ādyanti | tad daśahotā-anvasṛjyata | prajāpatir vai daśahotā | ya evaṃ tapaso vīryaṃ vidvāṃs tapyate | bhavaty eva | tad vā idam āpas salilam āsīt | so 'rodīt prajāpatiḥ |
analyzed: sa samudraḥ bhavat tasmāt samudrasya na pibanti prajananam iva hi manyante tasmāt paśoḥ jāyamānāt āpaḥ purast ādyanti tat daśahotā anvasṛjyata prajāpatiḥ vai daśahotā yaḥ evam tapasaḥ vīryam vidvān tapyate bhavati eva tat vai idam āpaḥ salilam āsīt saḥ rodīt prajāpatiḥ

original: { 2.2.9.4} sa kasmā ajñi | yady asyā apratiṣṭhāyā iti | yad apsv avāpadyata | sā pṛthivyabhavat | yad vyamṛṣṭa | tad antarikṣam abhavat | yad ūrdhvam udamṛṣṭa | sā dyaur abhavat | yad arodīt | tad anayo rodastvam |
analyzed: sa kasmai ajñi yadi asyāḥ apratiṣṭhāyāḥ iti yat apsu avāpadyata sā pṛthivī abhavat yat vyamṛṣṭa tat antarikṣam abhavat yat ūrdhvam udamṛṣṭa sā dyauḥ abhavat yat arodīt tat anayoḥ rodaḥ tvam

original: { 2.2.9.5} ya evaṃ veda | na-asya gṛhe rudanti | etad vā eṣāṃ lokānāṃ janma | ya evam eṣāṃ lokānāṃ janma veda | na-eṣu lokeṣv ārtim ārcchati | sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhām avindata | sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vittvā-akāmayata prajāyeya-iti | sa tapo 'tapyata | so 'ntarvān abhavat | sa jaghanād asurān asṛjata |
analyzed: yaḥ evam veda na asya gṛhe rudanti etat vai eṣām lokānām janma yaḥ evam eṣām lokānām janma veda na eṣu lokeṣu ārtim ārcchati saḥ imām pratiṣṭhām avindata saḥ imām pratiṣṭhām vittvā akāmayata prajāyeya eti sa tapaḥ u tapyata saḥ ntarvān abhavat sa jaghanāt asurān asṛjata

original: { 2.2.9.6} tebhyo mṛnmaye pātre 'nnam aduhat | yā-asya sā tanūr āsīt | tām apāhata | sā tamisrā-abhavat | so 'kāmayata prajāyeya-iti | sa tapo 'tapyata | so 'ntarvān abhavat | sa prajananād eva prajā asṛjata | tasmād imā bhūyiṣṭhāḥ | prajananād dhy enā asṛjata |
analyzed: tebhyaḥ mṛd maye pātre nnam aduhat yā asya sā tanūḥ āsīt tām apāhata sā tamisrā abhavat saḥ kāmayata prajāyeya eti sa tapaḥ tapyata saḥ ntarvān abhavat sa prajananāt eva prajāḥ asṛjata tasmāt imāḥ bhūyiṣṭhāḥ prajananāt hi enāḥ asṛjata

original: { 2.2.9.7} tābhyo dārumaye pātre payo 'duhata | yā-asya sā tanūr āsīt | tām apāhata sā jotsnā-abhavat | so 'kāmayata prajāyeya-iti | sa tapo 'tapyata | so 'ntarvān abhavat | sa upapakṣābhyām eva-ṛtūn asṛjata | tebhyo rajate pātre ghṛtam aduhat | yā-asya sā tanūr āsīt |
analyzed: tābhyaḥ dāru maye pātre payaḥ duhata yā asya sā tanūḥ āsīt tām apāhata sā jotsnā abhavat saḥ kāmayata prajāyeya eti sa tapaḥ u tapyata saḥ ntarvān abhavat saḥ upapakṣābhyām eva ṛtūn asṛjata tebhyaḥ rajate pātre ghṛtam aduhat yā asya sā tanūḥ āsīt

original: { 2.2.9.8} tam apāhata | so 'horātrayoḥ sandhir abhavat | so 'kāmayata prajāyeya-iti | sa tapo 'tapyata | so 'natarvān abhavat | sa mukhād devān asṛjata | tebhyo harite pātre somam aduhata | yā-asya sā tanūr āsīt | tām apāhata | tad ahar abhavat |
analyzed: tam apāhata saḥ haritayoḥ sandhiḥ abhavat saḥ kāmayata prajāyeya eti sa tapaḥ u tapyata saḥ natarvān abhavat sa mukhāt devān asṛjata tebhyaḥ harite pātre somam aduhata yā asya sā tanūḥ āsīt tām apāhata tat ahar abhavat

original: { 2.2.9.9} ete vai prajāpater dohāḥ | ya evaṃ veda | duha eva prajāḥ | divā vai no 'bhūd iti | tad devānāṃ devatvam | ya evaṃ devānāṃ devatvaṃ veda | devavān eva bhvati | etad vā ahorātrāṇāṃ janma | ya evam ahorātrāṇāṃ janma veda | na-ahorātreṣv ārtim ārcchati |
analyzed: ete vai prajāpateḥ dohāḥ yaḥ evam veda duhe eva prajāḥ divā vai naḥ bhūt iti tat devānām deva tvam yaḥ evam devānām deva tvam veda devavān eva bhvati etat vai ahar rātrāṇām janma yaḥ evam ahar rātrāṇām janma veda na ahar rātreṣu ārtim ārcchati

original: { 2.2.9.10} asato 'dhi mano 'sṛjyata | manaḥ prajāpatim asṛjata | prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata | tad vā idaṃ manasy eva paramaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | yad idaṃ kiṃ ca | tad etat-śvòvasyasaṃ nāma brahma | vyucchantī vyucchanty asmai vasyasī vasyasī vyucchati | prajāyate prajayā paśubhiḥ | pra parameṣṭhino mātrām āpnoti | ya evaṃ veda |
analyzed: asataḥ dhi manaḥ sṛjyata manaḥ prajāpatim asṛjata prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ asṛjata tat vai idam manasi eva paramam pratiṣṭhitam yat idam kim ca tat etat śvòvasyasam nāma brahma vyucchantī vyucchantī asmai vasyasī vasyasī vyucchati prajāyate prajayā paśubhiḥ pra parameṣṭhinaḥ mātrām āpnoti yaḥ evam veda

original: anuvāka 10 { 2.2.10.1} prajāpatir indram asṛjata-ānujāvaraṃ devānām | taṃ prāhiṇot | parehi | eteṣāṃ devānām adhipatir edhi-iti | taṃ devā abruvan | kas tvam asi | vayaṃ vai tvat-śreyāṃsaḥ sma iti | so 'bravīt | kas tvam asi vayaṃ vai tvat-śreyāṃsaḥ sma iti mā devā avocann iti | atha vā idaṃ tarhi prajāpatau hara āsīt |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ indram asṛjata ānujāvaram devānām tam prāhiṇot parehi eteṣām devānām adhipatiḥ edhi iti tam devāḥ abruvan kaḥ tvam asi vayam vai tvat śreyāṃsaḥ smaḥ iti saḥ bravīt kaḥ tvam asi vayam vai tvat śreyāṃsaḥ smaḥ iti mā devāḥ avocan iti atha vai idam tarhi prajāpatau haraḥ āsīt

original: { 2.2.10.2} yad asminn āditye | tad enam abravīt | etan me prayaccha | atha-aham eteṣāṃ devānām adhipatir bhaviṣyāmi-iti | ko 'haṃ syām ity abravīt | etat pradāya-iti | etat syā ity abravīt | yad etad bravīṣi-iti | ko ha vai nāma prajāpatiḥ | ya evaṃ veda |
analyzed: yat asmin āditye tat enam abravīt etat me prayaccha atha aham eteṣām devānām adhipatiḥ bhaviṣyāmi iti kaḥ ham syām iti abravīt etat pradāya eti etat syāḥ iti abravīt yat etat bravīṣi iti kaḥ ha vai nāma prajāpatiḥ yaḥ evam veda

original: { 2.2.10.3} vidur enaṃ nāmnā | tad asmai rukmaṃ kṛtvā pratyamuñcat | tato vā indro devānām adhipatir abhavat | ya evaṃ veda | adhipatir eva samānānāṃ bhavati | so 'manyata | kiṃ-kiṃ vā akaram iti | sa candraṃ ma āhara-iti { |} prālapat | tac candramasaś candramastvam | ya evaṃ veda |

original: { 2.2.10.4} candravān eva bhavati | taṃ devā abruvan | suvīryo maryā yathā gopāyata iti | tat sūryasya sūryatvam | ya evaṃ veda | nainaṃ dabhnoti | kaś ca na-asmin vā idam indriyaṃ pratyasthād iti | tad indrasya-indratvam | ya evaṃ veda | indriyāvy eva bhavati |
analyzed: candravān eva bhavati tam devāḥ abruvan su vīryaḥ maryā yathā gopāyata iti tat sūryasya sūrya tvam yaḥ evam veda na enam dabhnoti kaḥ ca na asmin vai idam indriyam pratyasthāt iti tat indrasya aindra tvam yaḥ evam veda indriyāvī eva bhavati

original: { 2.2.10.5} ayaṃ vā idaṃ paramo 'bhūd iti | tat parameṣṭhinaḥ parameṣṭhitvam | ya evaṃ veda | paramām eva kāṣṭhāṃ gacchati | taṃ devāḥ samantaṃ paryaviśan | vasavaḥ purastāt | rudrā dakṣiṇataḥ | ādityāḥ paścāt | viśve devā uttarataḥ | aṅgirasaḥ pratyañcam |
analyzed: ayam vai idam paramaḥ bhūt iti tat parameṣṭhinaḥ parameṣṭhi tvam yaḥ evam veda paramām eva kāṣṭhām gacchati tam devāḥ samantam paryaviśan vasavaḥ purastāt rudrāḥ dakṣiṇatas ādityāḥ paścāt viśve devāḥ uttaratas aṅgirasaḥ pratyañcam

original: { 2.2.10.6} sādhyāḥ parāñcam | ya evaṃ veda | upa-enaṃ samānāḥ saṃviśanti | sa prajāpatir eva bhūtvā prajā āvayat | tā asmai na-atiṣṭhanta-annādyāya | tā mukhaṃ purastāt paśyantīḥ | dakṣiṇataḥ paryāyan | sa dakṣiṇataḥ paryavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastāt paśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ |
analyzed: sādhyāḥ parāñcam yaḥ evam veda upa enam samānāḥ saṃviśanti sa prajāpatiḥ eva bhūtvā prajāḥ āvayat tāḥ asmai na atiṣṭhanta annādyāya tāḥ mukham purastāt paśyantīḥ dakṣiṇatas paryāyan sa dakṣiṇatas paryavartayata tāḥ mukham purastāt paśyantīḥ mukham dakṣiṇatas

original: { 2.2.10.7} paścāt paryāyan | sa paścāt paryavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastāt paśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | mukhaṃ paścāt | uttarataḥ paryāyan | sā uttarataḥ paryavartayata | tā mukhaṃ purastāt paśyantīḥ | mukhaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ | mukhaṃ paścāt | { 2.2.10.8} mukham uttarataḥ | ūrdhvā udāyan | sa upariṣṭān nyavartayata | tāḥ sarvatomukho bhūtvā-āvayat |
analyzed: paścāt paryāyan sa paścāt paryavartayata tāḥ mukham purastāt paśyantīḥ mukham dakṣiṇatas mukham paścāt uttaratas paryāyan sā uttaratas paryavartayata tāḥ mukham purastāt paśyantīḥ mukham dakṣiṇatas mukham paścāt mukham uttaratas ūrdhvāḥ udāyan saḥ upariṣṭāt nyavartayata tāḥ sarvatomukhaḥ bhūtvā āāvayat

original: tato vai tasmai prajā atiṣṭhanta-annādyāya | ya evaṃ vidvān pari ca vartayate ni ca | prajāpatir eva bhutvā prajā atti | tiṣṭhante 'smai prajā annādyāya | annāda eva bhavati |
analyzed: tatas vai tasmai prajāḥ atiṣṭhanta annādyāya yaḥ evam vidvān pari ca vartayate ni ca prajāpatiḥ eva bhutvā prajāḥ atti tiṣṭhante smai prajāḥ annādyāya anna ādaḥ eva bhavati

original: anuvāka 11 { 2.2.11.1} prajāpatir akāmayata bahor bhūyānt syām iti | sa etaṃ daśahotāram apaśyat | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti bahor bhūyān abhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta bahor bhūyānt syām iti | sa daśahotāraṃ prayuñjīta | bahor eva bhūyān bhavati | so 'kāmayata vīro ma ājāyeta-iti | sa daśahotuś caturhotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ akāmayata bahoḥ bhūyān syām iti saḥ etam daśahotāram apaśyat tam prāyuṅkta tasya prayukti bahoḥ bhūyān abhavat yaḥ kāmayeta bahoḥ bhūyān syām iti sa daśahotāram prayuñjīta bahoḥ eva bhūyān bhavati saḥ kāmayata vīraḥ me ājāyeta eti sa daśahotuḥ caturhotāram niramimīta tam prāyuṅkta

original: { 2.2.11.2} tasya prayukti-indro 'jāyata | yaḥ kāmayeta vīro ma ājāyeta-iti | sa caturhotāraṃ prayuñjīta | ā-asya vīro jāyate | so 'kāmayata paśumānt syām iti | sa caturhotuḥ pañcahotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti paśumān abhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta paśumānt syām iti | sa pañcahotāraṃ prayuñjīta |
analyzed: tasya prayukti indraḥ jāyata yaḥ kāmayeta vīraḥ me ājāyeta eti sa caturhotāram prayuñjīta ā asya vīraḥ jāyate saḥ kāmayata paśumān syām iti sa caturhotuḥ pañcahotāram niramimīta tam prāyuṅkta tasya prayukti paśumān abhavat yaḥ kāmayeta paśumān syām iti sa pañcahotāram prayuñjīta

original: { 2.2.11.3} paśumān eva bhavati | so 'kāmayata-ṛtavo me kalperann iti | sa pañcahotuḥ ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukty ṛtavo 'smā akalpanta | yaḥ kāmayeta-ṛtavo me kalperann iti | sa ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ prayuñjīta | kalpante 'smā ṛtavaḥ | so 'kāmayata somapaḥ somayājī syām | ā me somapaḥ somayājī jāyeta-iti |
analyzed: paśumān eva bhavati saḥ kāmayata ṛtavaḥ me kalperan iti sa pañcahotuḥ ṣaḍḍhotāram niramimīta tam prāyuṅkta tasya prayuktī ṛtavaḥ smai akalpanta yaḥ kāmayeta ṛtavaḥ me kalperan iti sa ṣaḍḍhotāram prayuñjīta kalpante smai ṛtavaḥ saḥ kāmayata soma paḥ soma yājī syām ā me soma paḥ soma yājī jāyeta eti

original: { 2.2.11.4} sa ṣaḍḍhotuḥ saptahotāraṃ niramimīta | taṃ prāyuṅkta | tasya prayukti somapaḥ somayājy abhavat | ā-asya somapaḥ somayājy ajāyata | yaḥ kāmayeta somapaḥ somayājī syām | ā me somapaḥ somayājī jāyeta-iti | sa saptahotāraṃ prayuñjīta | somapa eva somayājī bhavati | ā-asya somapaḥ somayājī jāyate | sa vā eṣa paśuḥ pañcadhā pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: sa ṣaḍḍhotuḥ saptahotāram niramimīta tam prāyuṅkta tasya prayukti somapaḥ soma yājī abhavat ā asya somapaḥ soma yājī ajāyata yaḥ kāmayeta somapaḥ soma yājī syām ā me somapaḥ soma yājī jāyeta eti sa saptahotāram prayuñjīta somapaḥ eva soma yājī bhavati ā asya somapaḥ soma yājī jāyate sa vai eṣa paśuḥ pañcadhā pratitiṣṭhati

original: { 2.2.11.5} padbhir mukhena | te devāḥ paśūn vittvā | suvargaṃ lokam āyan | te 'muṣmin-loke vyakṣudhyan | te 'bruvan | amutaḥ pradānaṃ vā upajijīvima-iti | te saptahotāraṃ yajñaṃ vidhāya-ayāsyam | āṅgīrasaṃ prāhiṇvan | etena-amutra kalpaya-iti | tasya ā iyaṃ klṛptiḥ |
analyzed: padbhiḥ mukhena te devāḥ paśūn vittvā suvargam lokam āyan te muṣmin loke vyakṣudhyan te bruvan amutas pradānam vai upajijīvima eti te saptahotāram yajñam vidhāya ayāsyam āṅgīrasam prāhiṇvan etena amutra kalpaya eti tasya ā iyam klṛptiḥ

original: { 2.2.11.6} yad idaṃ kiñ ca | ya evaṃ veda kalpate 'smai | sa vā ayaṃ manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā | amutra sadbhyo devebhyo havyaṃ vahati | ya evaṃ veda | upa-enaṃ yajño namati | yo vai caturhotṛṇāṃ nidānaṃ veda | nidānavān bhavati | agnihotraṃ vai daśahotur nidānam | darśapūrṇamāsau caturhotuḥ | cāturmāsyāni pañcahotuḥ | paśubandhaḥ ṣaḍḍhotuḥ |
analyzed: yat idam kim ca yaḥ evam veda kalpate smai sa vai ayam manuṣyeṣu yajñaḥ saptahotā amutra sadbhyaḥ devebhyaḥ havyam vahati yaḥ evam veda upa enam yajñaḥ namati yaḥ vai caturhotṛṇām nidānam veda nidānavān bhavati agnihotram vai daśahotuḥ nidānam darśa pūrṇamāsau caturhotuḥ cāturmāsyāni pañcahotuḥ paśubandhaḥ ṣaḍḍhotuḥ

original: saumyo 'dhvaraḥ saptahotuḥ | etad vai caturhotṛṇāṃ nidānam | ya evaṃ veda | nidānavān bhavati |
analyzed: saumyaḥ dhvaraḥ saptahotuḥ etat vai caturhotṛṇām nidānam yaḥ evam veda nidānavān bhavati

original: prapāṭhaka: 3 anuvāka 1 { 2.3.1.1} brahmavādino vadanti | kiṃ caturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvam iti | yad evaiṣu caturdhā hotāraḥ | tena caturhotāraḥ | tasmāc caturhotāra ucyante | tac caturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvam | somo vai caturhotā | agniḥ pañcahotā | dhātā ṣaḍḍhotā | indraḥ saptahotā |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 3 anuvāka 1 brahma vādinaḥ vadanti kim caturhotṛṇām caturhotṛ tvam iti yat eva eṣu caturdhā hotāraḥ tena caturhotāraḥ tasmāt caturhotāraḥ ucyante tat caturhotṛṇām caturhotṛ tvam somaḥ vai caturhotā agniḥ pañcahotā dhātā ṣaḍḍhotā indraḥ saptahotā

original: { 2.3.1.2} prajāpatir daśahotā | ya evaṃ caturhotṛṇām ṛddhiṃ veda | ṛdhnoty eva | ya eṣām evaṃ bandhutāṃ veda | bandhumān bhavati | ya eṣām evaṃ klṛptiṃ veda | kalpate 'smai | ya eṣām evam āyatanaṃ veda | āyatanavān bhavati | 0 ya eṣām evaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ veda |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ daśahotā yaḥ evam caturhotṛṇām ṛddhim veda ṛdhnoti eva yaḥ eṣām evam bandhutām veda bandhumān bhavati yaḥ eṣām evam klṛptim veda kalpate smai yaḥ eṣām evam āyatanam veda āyatanavān bhavati yaḥ eṣām evam pratiṣṭhām veda

original: { 2.3.1.3} praty eva tiṣṭhati | brahmavādino vadanti | daśahotā caturhotā | pañcahotā ṣaḍḍhotā saptahotā | atha kasmāc caturhotāra ucyanta iti | indro vai caturhotā | indrāḥ khalu vai śreṣṭho devatānām upadeśanāt | ya evam indraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ devatānām upadeśanād veda | vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānāṃ bhavati |
analyzed: prati eva tiṣṭhati brahma vādinaḥ vadanti daśahotā caturhotā pañcahotā ṣaḍḍhotā saptahotā atha kasmāt caturhotāraḥ ucyante iti indraḥ vai caturhotā indrāḥ khalu vai śreṣṭhaḥ devatānām upadeśanāt yaḥ evam indram śreṣṭham devatānām upadeśanāt veda vasiṣṭhaḥ samānānām bhavati

original: tasmāt-śreṣṭham āyantaṃ prathamena-eva-anubudhyante | ayam āgan | ayam avāsād iti | kīrtir asya pūrvā-āgacchati janatām āyataḥ | atho enaṃ prathamena-eva-anubudhyante | ayam āgan | ayam avāsād iti |
analyzed: tasmāt śreṣṭham āyantam prathamena eva anubudhyante ayam āgan ayam avāsāt iti kīrtiḥ asya pūrvā āgacchati janatām āyataḥ atha u enam prathamena eva anubudhyante ayam āgan ayam avāsāt iti

original: anuvāka 2 { 2.3.2.1} dakṣiṇāṃ pratigrahīṣyant saptadaśa kṛtvo 'pānyāt | ātmānam eva samindhe | tejase vīryāya | atho prajāpatir evaināṃ bhūtvā pratigṛhṇāti | ātmano 'nārtyai | yady enam ārtvijyād vṛtaṃ {ānaṃdā. vrataṃ} santaṃ nirháreran | āgnīdhre juhuyād daśahotāram | caturgṛhītena-ājyena | purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan | pratilomaṃ vigrāham |
analyzed: dakṣiṇām pratigrahīṣyan saptadaśa kṛtvā u pānyāt ātmānam eva samindhe tejase vīryāya atha u prajāpatiḥ eva enām bhūtvā pratigṛhṇāti ātmanaḥ nārtyai yadi enam ārtvijyāt vṛtam ānaṃdāḥ vratam santam nirháreran āgnīdhre juhuyāt daśahotāram caturgṛhītena ājyena purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan pratilomam vigrāham

original: { 2.3.2.2} prāṇān evāsya-upadāsayati | yad enaṃ punar upaśikṣeyuḥ | āgnīdhra eva juhuyād daśahotāram | caturgṛhītena-ājyena | paścāt prāṅ āsīnaḥ | anulomam avigrāham | prāṇān evāsmai kalpayati | prāyaścittī vāgg-hotety ṛtumukha ṛtumukhe juhoti | ṛtūn evāsmai kalpayati | kalpante 'smā ṛtavaḥ |
analyzed: prāṇān eva asya aupadāsayati yat enam punar upaśikṣeyuḥ āgnīdhre eva juhuyāt daśahotāram caturgṛhītena ājyena paścāt prāṅ āsīnaḥ anulomam a vigrāham prāṇān eva asmai kalpayati prāyaścittī vāc hotā iti ṛtu mukhe ṛtu mukhe juhoti ṛtūn eva asmai kalpayati kalpante smaḥ ṛtavaḥ

original: { 2.3.2.3} klṛptā asmā ṛtava āyanti | ṣaḍḍhotā vai bhūtvā prajāpatir idaṃ sarvam asṛjata | sa mano 'sṛjata | manaso 'dhi gāyatrīm asṛjata | tad gāyatrīṃ yaśa ārcchat | tām ālabhata | gāyatriyā adhi chandāṃsy asṛjata | chandobhyo 'dhi sāma | tat sāma yaśa ārcchat | tad ālabhata |
analyzed: klṛptāḥ asmai ṛtavaḥ āyanti ṣaḍḍhotā vai bhūtvā prajāpatiḥ idam sarvam asṛjata sa manaḥ sṛjata manasaḥ dhi gāyatrīm asṛjata tat gāyatrīm yaśaḥ ārcchat tām ālabhata gāyatriyāḥ adhi chandāṃsi asṛjata chandobhyaḥ dhi sāma tat sāma yaśaḥ ārcchat tat ālabhata

original: { 2.3.2.4} sāmno 'dhi yajūṃṣy asṛjata | yajurbhyo 'dhi viṣṇum | tad viṣṇuṃ yaśa ārcchat | tam ālabhata | viṣṇor adhy oṣadhīr asṛjata | oṣadhībhyo 'dhi somam | tat somaṃ yaśa ārcchat | tam ālabhata | somād adhi paśūn asṛjata | paśubhyo 'dhi-indram |
analyzed: sāmnaḥ dhi yajūṃṣi asṛjata yajurbhyaḥ dhi viṣṇum tat viṣṇum yaśaḥ ārcchat tam ālabhata viṣṇoḥ adhi oṣadhīḥ asṛjata oṣadhībhyaḥ dhi somam tat somam yaśaḥ ārcchat tam ālabhata somāt adhi paśūn asṛjata paśubhyaḥ dhi indram

original: { 2.3.2.5} tad indraṃ yaśa ārcchat | tad enaṃ na-atiprācyavata | indra iva yaśasvī bhavati | ya evaṃ veda na-enaṃ yaśo 'tipracyavate | yad vā idaṃ kiṃ ca | tat sarvam uttāna evā''ṅgīrasaḥ pratyagṛhṇāt | tad enaṃ pratigṛhītaṃ na-ahinat | yat kiṃ ca pratigṛhṇīyāt | tat sarvam uttānas tv āṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātv ity eva pratigṛhṇīyāt |
analyzed: tat indram yaśaḥ ārcchat tat enam na atiprācyavate indraḥ iva yaśasvī bhavati yaḥ evam veda na enam yaśaḥ utipracyavate yat vai idam kim ca tat sarvam uttānaḥ eva āṅgīrasaḥ pratyagṛhṇāt tat enam pratigṛhītam na ahinat yat kim ca pratigṛhṇīyāt tat sarvam uttānaḥ tu āṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu iti eva pratigṛhṇīyāt

original: iyaṃ vā uttāna āṅgīrasaḥ | anayā-evainat pratigṛhṇāti | na-enaṃ hinasti | barhiṣā pratīyād gāṃ vā-aśvaṃ vā | etad vai paśūnāṃ priyaṃ dhāma | priyeṇaivainaṃ dhāmnā pratyeti |
analyzed: iyam vai uttānaḥ āṅgīrasaḥ anayā eva enat pratigṛhṇāti na enam hinasti barhiṣā pratīyāt gām vā aśvam vai etat vai paśūnām priyam dhāma priyeṇa eva enam dhāmnā pratyeti

original: anuvāka 3 { 2.3.3.1} yo vā avidvān nivartayate | viśīrṣā sapāpmā-amuṣmin-loke bhavati | atha yo vidvān nivartayate | saśīrṣā vipāpmā-amuṣmin-loke bhavati | devatā vai sapta puṣṭikāmā nyavartayanta | agniś ca pṛthivī ca | vāyuś ca-antarikṣaṃ ca | ādityaś ca dyauś ca candramāḥ | agnir nyavartayata | sa sāhasram apuṣyat |
analyzed: yaḥ vai a vidvān nivartayate viśīrṣā sa pāpmā amuṣmin loke bhavati atha yaḥ vidvān nivartayate sa śīrṣā vipāpmā amuṣmin loke bhavati devatāḥ vai sapta puṣṭi kāmāḥ nyavartayanta agniḥ ca pṛthivī ca vāyuḥ ca antarikṣam ca ādityaḥ ca dyauḥ ca candramāḥ agniḥ nyavartayata sa sāhasram apuṣyat

original: { 2.3.3.2} pṛthivī nyavartayata | sa-oṣadhībhir vanaspatibhir apuṣyat | vāyur nyavartayata | sa marīcībhir apuṣyat | antarikṣaṃ nyavaratayata | tad vayobhir apuṣyat | ādityo nyavartayata | sa raśmibhir apuṣyat | dyaur nyavartayata | sā nakṣatrair apuṣyat | candramā nyavartayata | so 'horātrair ardhamāsair māsair ṛtubhiḥ saṃvatsarena-apuṣyat |
analyzed: pṛthivī nyavartayata saḥ oṣadhībhiḥ vanaspatibhiḥ apuṣyat vāyuḥ nyavartayata sa marīcībhiḥ apuṣyat antarikṣam nyavaratayata tat vayobhiḥ apuṣyat ādityaḥ nyavartayata sa raśmibhiḥ apuṣyat dyauḥ nyavartayata sā nakṣatraiḥ apuṣyat candramāḥ nyavartayata saḥ horātraiḥ ardha māsaiḥ māsaiḥ ṛtubhiḥ saṃvatsarena apuṣyat

original: tān poṣān puṣyati | yāṃs te 'puṣyan | ya evaṃ vidān ni ca vartayate pari ca |

original: { 2.8.2.4} yo daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣi | antar viśvāni vidmanā jigāti | acchā giro matayo devayantīḥ | agniṃ yanti draviṇaṃ bhikṣamāṇāḥ | susaṃdṛśaṃ supratīkaṃ svañcam | havyavāham aratiṃ mānuṣāṇām | agne tvam asmad yuyodhy amīvāḥ | anagnitrā abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ | punar asmabhyaṃ suvitāya deva | kṣāṃ viśvebhir ajarebhir yajatra |
analyzed: yaḥ daivyāni mānuṣā janūṃṣi antar viśvāni vidmanā jigāti acchā giraḥ matayaḥ devayantīḥ agnim yanti draviṇam bhikṣamāṇāḥ su saṃdṛśam su pratīkam svañcam havyavāham aratim mānuṣāṇām agne tvam asmat yuyodhi amīvāḥ anagnitrāḥ abhyamanta kṛṣṭīḥ punar asmabhyam suvitāya deva kṣām viśvebhiḥ ajarebhiḥ yajatra

original: { 2.8.2.5} agne tvaṃ pārayā navyo asmān | svastibhir ati durgāṇi viśvā | pūś ca pṛthvī bahulā na urvī | bhavā tokāya tanayāya śaṃ yoḥ | pra kāravo mananā vacyamānāḥ | devadrīcīṃ nayatha devayantaḥ | dakṣiṇāvāḍ vājinī prācy eti | havir bharanty agnaye ghṛtācī | indraṃ naro, yuje ratham, | jagṛbhṇā {ḍyumoṇṭa jagṛbhmā} te dakṣiṇām indra hastam |
analyzed: agne tvam pāraya navyaḥ asmān svastibhiḥ ati durgāṇi viśvā pūḥ ca pṛthvī bahulā naḥ urvī bhava tokāya tanayāya śam yoḥ pra kāravaḥ mananā vacyamānāḥ devadrīcīm nayatha devayantaḥ dakṣiṇāvāṭ vājinī prācī eti haviḥ bharantī agnaye ghṛtācī indram naraḥ yuje ratham jagṛbhṇāḥ ḍyumoṇṭa jagṛbhma te dakṣiṇām indra hastam

original: { 2.8.2.6} vasūyavo vasupate vasūnām | vidmā hi tvā gopatiṃ śūra gonām | asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ | tava-idaṃ viśvam abhitaḥ paśavyam | yat paśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya | gavām asi gopatir eka indra | bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ | sam indra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ | saṃ sūribhir maghavant saṃ svastyā | saṃ brahmaṇā devakṛtaṃ yad asti |
analyzed: vasūyavaḥ vasu pate vasūnām vidma hi tvā gopatim śūra gonām asmabhyam citram vṛṣaṇam rayim dāḥ tava edam viśvam abhitas paśavyam yat paśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya gavām asi gopatiḥ ekaḥ indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ sam indra naḥ manasā neṣi gobhiḥ sam sūribhiḥ maghavan sam svastyā sam brahmaṇā deva kṛtam yat asti

original: { 2.8.2.7} saṃ devānāṃ sumatyā yajñiyānām | ārāt-śatrum apa bādhasva dūram | ugro yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena | asme dhehi yavamad gomad indra | kṛdhī dhiyaṃ jaritre vājaratnām | ā vedhasaṃ, sa hi śuciḥ, | bṛhaspatiḥ prathamaṃ jāyamānaḥ | maho jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman | saptāsyas tuvijāto raveṇa | vi saptaraśmir adhamat tamāṃsi |
analyzed: sam devānām sumatyā yajñiyānām ārātśatrum apa bādhasva dūram ugraḥ yaḥ śambaḥ puruhūta tena asme dhehi yavamat gomat indra kṛdhi dhiyam jaritre vāja ratnām ā vedhasam sa hi śuciḥ bṛhaspatiḥ prathamam jāyamānaḥ mahaḥ jyotiṣaḥ parame vyoman sapta āsyaḥ tuvi jātaḥ raveṇa vi sapta raśmiḥ adhamat tamāṃsi

original: { 2.8.2.8} bṛhaspatiḥ samajayad vasūni | maho vrajān gomato deva eṣaḥ | apaḥ siṣāsant suvar apratīttaḥ | bṛhaspatir hanty amitram arkaiḥ | bṛhaspate pary, evā pitre, | ā no divaḥ, pāvīravī, | imā juhvānā, yas te stanaḥ, | sarasvaty abhi no neṣi, | iyaṃ śuṣmebhir bisakhā iva-arujat | sānu girīṇāṃ taviṣebhir ūrmibhiḥ |
analyzed: bṛhaspatiḥ samajayat vasūni mahaḥ vrajān gomataḥ devaḥ eṣaḥ apaḥ siṣāsan suvar apratīttaḥ bṛhaspatiḥ hanti amitram arkaiḥ bṛhaspate pari eva pitre ā naḥ divaḥ pāvīravī imā juhvānā yaḥ te stanaḥ sarasvati abhi naḥ neṣi iyam śuṣmebhiḥ bisakhā iva arujat sānu girīṇām taviṣebhiḥ ūrmibhiḥ

original: pārāvadaghnīm {ḍyumoṇṭa pārāvataghīm} avase suvṛktibhiḥ | sarasvatīm āvivāsema dhītibhiḥ |
analyzed: pārāvada ghnīm pārāvata ghīm avase suvṛktibhiḥ sarasvatīm āvivāsema dhītibhiḥ

original: anuvāka 3 { 2.8.3.1} somo dhenuṃ somo arvantam āśum | somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadātu | sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyam | pituḥśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśad asmai | aṣāḍhaṃ yutsu, tvaṃ soma kratubhiḥ, | yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti, | tvam imā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāḥ | tvam apo ajanayas tvaṃ gāḥ | tvamātatantha-urv antarikṣam | tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha |
analyzed: somaḥ dhenum somaḥ arvantam āśum somaḥ vīram karmaṇyam dadātu sādanyam vidathyam sabheyam pituḥśravaṇam yaḥ dadāśat asmai aṣāḍham yutsu tvam soma kratubhiḥ yā te dhāmāni haviṣā yajanti tvam imāḥ oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāḥ tvam apaḥ ajanayaḥ tvam gāḥ tvam ātatantha uru antarikṣam tvam jyotiṣā vi tamaḥ vavartha

original: { 2.8.3.2} yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām | yā parvateṣv oṣadhīṣv apsu | tebhir no viśvaiḥ sumanā aheḍan | rājant soma prati havyā gṛbhāya | viṣṇor nu kaṃ, tad asya priyam, | pra tad viṇuḥ, | paro mātrayā tanuvā vṛdhāna | na te mahitvam anvaśnuvanti | ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvam | paramasya vitse |
analyzed: yā te dhāmāni divi yā pṛthivyām yā parvateṣu oṣadhīṣu apsu tebhiḥ naḥ viśvaiḥ sumanāḥ a heḍan rājan soma prati havyā gṛbhāya viṣṇoḥ nu kam tat asya priyam pra tat viṇuḥ paras mātrayā tanuvā vṛdhāna na te mahitvam anvaśnuvanti ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyāḥ viṣṇo deva tvam paramasya vitse

original: { 2.8.3.3} vicakrame, trir devaḥ, | ā te maho, yo jāta eva. | abhi gotrāṇi. | ābhiḥ spṛdho mithatīr ariṣaṇyan | amitrasya vyathayā manyum indra ābhir viśvā abhiyujo viṣūcīḥ | āryāya viśo 'vatarīr dāsīḥ | ayaṃ śṛṇve adha jayann uta ghnan | ayam uta prakṛṇute yudhā gāḥ | yadā satyaṃ kṛṇute manyum indraḥ |
analyzed: vicakrame tris devaḥ ā te mahaḥ yaḥ jātaḥ eva abhi gotrāṇi ābhiḥ spṛdhaḥ mithatīḥ a riṣaṇyan amitrasya vyathaya manyum indraḥ ābhiḥ viśvāḥ abhiyujaḥ viṣūcīḥ āryāya viśaḥ vatarīḥ dāsīḥ ayam śṛṇve adha jayan uta ghnan ayam uta prakṛṇute yudhā gāḥ yadā satyam kṛṇute manyum indraḥ

original: { 2.8.3.4} viśvaṃ dṛḍhaṃ bhayata ejad asmāt | anu svadhām akṣarann āpo asya | avardhata madhya ā nāvyānām | sadhrīcīnena manasā tam indra ojiṣṭhena | hanmanā-ahann abhi dyūn | marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānam | akavāriṃ divyaṃ śāsam indram | viśvāsāham avase nūtanāya | ugraṃ sahodām iha taṃ huvema | janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya |
analyzed: viśvam dṛḍham bhayataḥ ejat asmāt anu svadhām akṣaran āpaḥ asya avardhata madhye ā nāvyānām sadhrīcīnena manasā tam indraḥ ojiṣṭhena hanmanā ahan abhi dyūn marutvantam vṛṣabham vāvṛdhānam a kavārim divyam śāsam indram viśvāsāham avase nūtanāya ugram sahaḥ dām iha tam huvema janiṣṭhāḥ ugraḥ sahase turāya

original: { 2.8.3.5} mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ | avardhann indraṃ marutaś cid atra | mātā yad vīraṃ dadhanad dhaniṣṭhā | kva syā vo marutaḥ svadhā-āsīt | yan mām ekaṃ samadhattā-ahihatye | ahaṃ hy ugras taviṣas tuviṣmān | viśvasya śatror anamaṃ vadhasnáiḥ | vṛtrasya tvā śvasathād īṣamāṇāḥ | viśve devā ajahur ye sakhāyaḥ |
analyzed: mandraḥ ojiṣṭhaḥ bahula abhimānaḥ avardhan indram marutaḥ cit atra mātā yat vīram dadhanat dhaniṣṭhā kva syāḥ vaḥ marutaḥ svadhā āsīt yat mām ekam samadhatta a ahi hatye aham hi ugraḥ taviṣaḥ tuviṣmān viśvasya śatroḥ anamam vadhasnáiḥ vṛtrasya tvā śvasathāt īṣamāṇāḥ viśve devāḥ ajahuḥ ye sakhāyaḥ

original: marudbhir indra sakhyaṃ te astu |
analyzed: marudbhiḥ indra sakhyam te astu

original: { 2.8.3.6} atha-imā viśvāḥ pṛtanā jayāsi | vadhīṃ { vardhīṃ ?} vṛtraṃ maruta indriyeṇa | svena bhāmena taviṣo babhūvān | aham etā manave viśvaścandrāḥ | sugā apaś cakara vajrabāhuḥ | sa yo vṛṣā vṛṣṇiyebhiḥ samokāḥ | maho divaḥ pṛthivyāś ca samrāṭ | satīnasattvā {ḍyumoṇṭa satīnasatvā} havyo bhareṣu | marutvān no bhavatv indra ūtī |
analyzed: atha emāḥ viśvāḥ pṛtanāḥ jayāsi vadhīm vardhīm vṛtram marutaḥ indriyeṇa svena bhāmena taviṣaḥ babhūvān aham etāḥ manave viśva ścandrāḥ su gāḥ apaḥ cakara vajra bāhuḥ sa yaḥ vṛṣā vṛṣṇiyebhiḥ samokāḥ mahaḥ divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ ca samrāj satīna sattvā ḍyumoṇṭa satīna satvā havyaḥ bhareṣu marutvān naḥ bhavatu indraḥ ūtī

original: indro vṛtram atarad vṛtratūrye |
analyzed: indraḥ vṛtram atarat vṛtratūrye

original: { 2.8.3.7} anādhṛṣyo maghavā śūra indraḥ | anv enaṃ viśo amadanta pūrviḥ | ayaṃ rājā jagataś carṣaṇīnām | sa eva vīraḥ sa u vīryāvān | sa ekarājo jagataḥ paraspāḥ | yadā vṛtram atarat-śūra indraḥ | atha-abhavad damitā-abhikratūnām | indro yajñaṃ vardhayan viśvavedāḥ | puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ havir naḥ | vṛtraṃ tīrtvā dānavaṃ vajrabāhuḥ |
analyzed: anādhṛṣyaḥ maghavā śūraḥ indraḥ anu enam viśaḥ amadanta pūrviḥ ayam rājā jagataḥ carṣaṇīnām saḥ eva vīraḥ saḥ u vīryāvān saḥ eka rājaḥ jagataḥ paraspāḥ yadā vṛtram atarat śūraḥ indraḥ atha abhavat damitā abhikratūnām indraḥ yajñam vardhayan viśva vedāḥ puroḍāśasya juṣatām haviḥ naḥ vṛtram tīrtvā dānavam vajra bāhuḥ

original: { 2.8.3.8} diśo 'dṛṃhad dṛṃhitā dṛṃhaṇena | imaṃ yajñaṃ vardhayan viśvavedāḥ | puroḍāśaṃ pratigṛbhṇātv indraḥ | yadā vṛtram atart-śūra indraḥ | atha-ekarājo abhavaj janānām | indro devān-śambarahatya āvat | indro devānām abhavat purogāḥ | indro yajñe haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ | vṛtratūr ṇo abhayaṃ śarma yaṃsat | yaḥ sapta sindhūṃr adadhāt pṛthivyām |
analyzed: diśaḥ dṛṃhat dṛṃhitā dṛṃhaṇena imam yajñam vardhayan viśva vedāḥ puroḍāśam pratigṛbhṇātu indraḥ yadā vṛtram atart śūraḥ indraḥ atha eka rājaḥ abhavat janānām indraḥ devān śambara hatye āvat indraḥ devānām abhavat purogāḥ indraḥ yajñe haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ vṛtratūr naḥ abhayam śarma yaṃsat yaḥ sapta sindhūṃr adadhāt pṛthivyām

original: yaḥ sapta lokān akṛṇod diśaś ca | indro haviṣmānt sagaṇo marudbhiḥ | vṛtratūr ṇo yajñam iha-upayāsat |
analyzed: yaḥ sapta lokān akṛṇot diśaḥ ca indraḥ haviṣmān sa gaṇaḥ marudbhiḥ vṛtratūr naḥ yajñam iha aupayāsat

original: anuvāka 4 { 2.8.4.1} indras tarasvān abhimātihā-ugraḥ | hiraṇyavāśīr iṣiraḥ suvarṣāḥ |tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasya | api bhadre saumanase syāma | hiraṇyavarṇo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu | abhimātihā-indraḥ pṛtanāsu jiṣṇuḥ | sa naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ viyaṃsat | yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ | indraṃ stuhi vajriṇaṃ stomapṛṣṭham {ḍyumoṇṭa somapṛṣṭham} |
analyzed: indraḥ tarasvān abhimāti hā augraḥ hiraṇya vāśīḥ iṣiraḥ su varṣāḥ tasya vayam sumatau yajñiyasya api bhadre saumanase syāma hiraṇya varṇaḥ abhayam kṛṇotu abhimāti hā aindraḥ pṛtanāsu jiṣṇuḥ sa naḥ śarma tri varūtham viyaṃsat yūyam pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ indram stuhi vajriṇam stoma pṛṣṭham soma pṛṣṭham

original: puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ havir naḥ |
analyzed: puroḍāśasya juṣatām haviḥ naḥ

original: { 2.8.4.2} hatvā-abhimātīḥ pṛtanāḥ sahasvān | atha-abhayaṃ kṛṇuhi { athābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi} viśvato naḥ | stuhi śūraṃ vajriṇam apratītam | abhimātihanaṃ puruhūtam indram | ya eka it-śatapatir janeṣu | tasmā indrāya havir ājuhota | indro devānām adhipāḥ purohitaḥ | diśāṃ patir abhavad vājinīvān | abhimātihā taviṣas tuviṣmān |
analyzed: hatvā abhimātīḥ pṛtanāḥ sahasvān atha abhayam kṛṇuhi atha abhayam kṛṇuhi viśvatas naḥ stuhi śūram vajriṇam apratītam abhimāti hanam puruhūtam indram yaḥ ekaḥ id śata patiḥ janeṣu tasmai indrāya haviḥ ājuhota indraḥ devānām adhipāḥ purohitaḥ diśām patiḥ abhavat vājinīvān abhimāti hā taviṣaḥ tuviṣmān

original: asmabhyaṃ citraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ rayiṃ dāt |
analyzed: asmabhyam citram vṛṣaṇam rayim dāt

original: { 2.8.4.3} ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī mahitvā | balena-adṛṃhad abhimātihā-indraḥ | sa no haviḥ pratigṛbhṇātu rātaye | devānāṃ devo nidhipā no avyāt | anavas te rathaṃ, vṛṣṇe yat te. | indrasya nu vīryāṇy, ahann ahim, | indro yāto 'vasitasya rājā | śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇo vajrabāhuḥ | sa-id u rājā kṣeti carṣaṇīnām | arān na nemiḥ pari tā babhūva |
analyzed: yaḥ ime dyāvāpṛthivī mahitvā balena adṛṃhat abhimāti hā aindraḥ sa naḥ haviḥ pratigṛbhṇātu rātaye devānām devaḥ nidhi pāḥ naḥ avyāt anavaḥ te ratham vṛṣṇe yat te indrasya nu vīryāṇi ahan ahim indraḥ yātaḥ vasitasya rājā śamasya ca śṛṅgiṇaḥ vajra bāhuḥ sa id u rājā kṣeti carṣaṇīnām arāt na nemiḥ pari tāḥ babhūva

original: { 2.8.4.4} abhi sidhmo ajigād asya śatrūn | vi tigmena vṛṣabheṇā puro 'bhet | saṃ vajreṇa-asṛjad vṛtram indraḥ | pra svāṃ matim atirat-śāśadānaḥ | viṣṇuṃ devaṃ varuṇamūtaye bhagam | medasā devā vapayā yajadhvam | tā no yajñam āgataṃ viśvadhenā | prajāvad asme draviṇā-iha dhattam | medasā devā vapayā yajadhvam | viṣṇuṃ ca devaṃ varuṇaṃ ca rātim |
analyzed: abhi sidhmaḥ ajigāt asya śatrūn vi tigmena vṛṣabheṇa puras bhet sam vajreṇa asṛjat vṛtram indraḥ pra svām matim atirat śāśadānaḥ viṣṇum devam varuṇam ūtaye bhagam medasā devāḥ vapayā yajadhvam tā naḥ yajñam āgatam viśvadhena prajāvat asme draviṇā iha dhattam medasā devāḥ vapayā yajadhvam viṣṇum ca devam varuṇam ca rātim

original: { 2.8.4.5} tā no amīvā apabādhamānau | imaṃ yajñaṃ juṣamāṇāv upetam | viṣṇūvaruṇā yuvam adhvarāya naḥ | viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam | dīrghaprayajyū haviṣā vṛdhānā | jyotiṣā-arātīr dahataṃ tamāṃsi | yayor ojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi | vīryebhir vīratamā śaviṣṭhā | yā patyete apratītā śahobhiḥ | viṣṇū agan varuṇā pūrvahūtau |
analyzed: tāḥ naḥ amīvāḥ apabādhamānau imam yajñam juṣamāṇau upetam viṣṇu varuṇā yuvam adhvarāya naḥ viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam dīrgha prayajyū haviṣā vṛdhānā jyotiṣā arātīḥ dahatam tamāṃsi yayoḥ ojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi vīryebhiḥ vīratamā śaviṣṭhā yā patyete apratītā śahobhiḥ viṣṇū agan varuṇā pūrva hūtau

original: { 2.8.4.6} viṣṇūvaruṇāv abhiśastipā vām | devā yajanta haviṣā ghṛtena | apa-amīvāṃ sedhataṃ rakṣasaś ca | athā dhattaṃ yajamānāya śaṃ yoḥ | aṃhomucā vṛṣabhā supratūrtī | devānāṃ devatamā śaviṣṭhā | viṣṇūvaruṇā pratiharyataṃ naḥ | idaṃ narā {ḍyumoṇṭa narā} prayatamūtaye haviḥ | mahī nu dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe | rucā bhavatāṃ śucayadbhir arkaiḥ |
analyzed: viṣṇu varuṇau abhiśasti pāḥ vām devāḥ yajanta haviṣā ghṛtena apa amīvām sedhatam rakṣasaḥ ca atha ā dhattam yajamānāya śam yoḥ aṃhaḥ mucā vṛṣabhā su pratūrtī devānām devatamā śaviṣṭhā viṣṇu varuṇā pratiharyatam naḥ idam narā narā prayatam ūtaye haviḥ mahī nu dyāvāpṛthivī iha jyeṣṭhe rucā bhavatām śucayadbhiḥ arkaiḥ

original: { 3.1.1.7} ye agnidagdhā ye 'nāgnidagdhāḥ | ye 'muṃ lokaṃ pitaraḥ kṣiyanti | yāṃś ca vidma yāṃ u ca na pravidma | maghāsu yajñaṃ sukṛtaṃ juṣantām | gavāṃ patiḥ phalgunīnām asi tvam | tad aryaman varuṇa mitra cāru | taṃ tvā vayaṃ sanitāraṃ sanīnām | jīvā jīvantam upa saṃviśema | yena-imā viśvā bhuvanāni saṃjitā | yasya devā anusaṃyanti cetaḥ |
analyzed: ye agni dagdhāḥ ye na agni dagdhāḥ ye mum lokam pitaraḥ kṣiyanti yān ca vidma yām u ca na pravidma maghāsu yajñam su kṛtam juṣantām gavām patiḥ phalgunīnām asi tvam tat aryaman varuṇa mitra cāru tam tvā vayam sanitāram sanīnām jīvāḥ jīvantam upa saṃviśema yena emā viśvā bhuvanāni saṃjitā yasya devāḥ anusaṃyanti cetaḥ

original: { 3.1.1.8} aryamā rājā-ajaras tuviṣmān | phalgunīnām ṛṣabho roravīti | śreṣṭho devānāṃ bhagavo bhaga-asi | tat tvā viduḥ phalgunīs tasya vittāt | asmabhyaṃ kṣatram ajaraṃ suvīryam | gomad aśvavad upa saṃnuda-iha | bhago ha dātā bhaga it pradātā | bhago devīḥ phalgunīr āviveśa | bhagasya-it taṃ prasavaṃ gamema | yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madema |
analyzed: aryamā rājā ajaraḥ tuviṣmān phalgunīnām ṛṣabhaḥ roravīti śreṣṭhaḥ devānām bhagavas bhaga asi tat tvā viduḥ phalgunīḥ tasya vittāt asmabhyam kṣatram ajaram su vīryam gomat aśvavat upa saṃnuda iha bhagaḥ ha dātā bhagaḥ id pradātā bhagaḥ devīḥ phalgunīḥ āviveśa bhagasya ed tam prasavam gamema yatra devaiḥ sadhamādam madema

original: { 3.1.1.9} āyātu devaḥ savitā-upayātu | hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena | vahan hastaṃ subhagaṃ vidmanāpasam | prayacchantaṃ papuriṃ puṇyam accha | hastaḥ prayacchatv amṛtaṃ vasīyaḥ | dakṣiṇena pratigṛbhṇīma enat | dātāram adya savitā videya | yo no hastāya prasuvāti yajñam | tvaṣṭā nakṣatram abhyeti citrām | subhaṃsasaṃ yuvatiṃ rocamānām |
analyzed: āyātu devaḥ savitā upayātu hiraṇyayena suvṛtā rathena vahan hastam subhagam vidmanā apasam prayacchantam papurim puṇyam accha hastaḥ prayacchatu amṛtam vasīyaḥ dakṣiṇena pratigṛbhṇīmaḥ enat dātāram adya savitā videya yaḥ naḥ hastāya prasuvāti yajñam tvaṣṭā nakṣatram abhyeti citrām su bhaṃsasam yuvatim rocamānām

original: { 3.1.1.10} niveśayann amṛtān martyāṃś ca | rūpāṇi piṃśan bhuvanāni viśvā | tan nas tvaṣṭā tad u citrā vicaṣṭām | tan nakṣatraṃ bhūridā astu mahyam | tan naḥ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ sanotu | gobhir no aśvaiḥ samanaktu yajñam | vāyur nakṣatram abhyeti niṣṭyām | tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabho roruvāṇaḥ | samīrayan bhuvanā mātariśvā | apa dveṣāṃsi nudatām arātīḥ |
analyzed: niveśayan amṛtān martyān ca rūpāṇi piṃśan bhuvanāni viśvā tat naḥ tvaṣṭā tat u citrāḥ vicaṣṭām tat nakṣatram bhūri dāḥ astu mahyam tat naḥ prajām vīravatīm sanotu gobhiḥ naḥ aśvaiḥ samanaktu yajñam vāyuḥ nakṣatram abhyeti niṣṭyām tigma śṛṅgaḥ vṛṣabhaḥ roruvāṇaḥ samīrayan bhuvanā mātariśvā apa dveṣāṃsi nudatām arātīḥ

original: { 3.1.1.11} tan no vāyus tad u niṣṭyā śṛṇotu | tan nakṣattraṃ bhūridā astu mahyam | tan no devāso anujānantu kāmam | yathā tarema duritāni viśvā | dūram asmat-śatravo yantu bhītāḥ | tad indrāgnī kṛṇutāṃ tad viśākhe | tan no devā anumadantu yajñam | paścāt purastād abhayaṃ no astu | nakṣatrāṇām adhipatnī viśākhe |
analyzed: tat naḥ vāyuḥ tat u niṣṭyā śṛṇotu tat nakṣattram bhūri dāḥ astu mahyam tat naḥ devāsaḥ anujānantu kāmam yathā tarema duritāni viśvā dūram asmad śatravaḥ yantu bhītāḥ tat indra agnī kṛṇutām tat viśākhe tat naḥ devāḥ anumadantu yajñam paścāt purastāt abhayam naḥ astu nakṣatrāṇām adhipatnī viśākhe

original: śreṣṭhāv indrāgnī bhuvanasya gopau |
analyzed: śreṣṭhau indra agnī bhuvanasya gopau

original: { 3.1.1.12} viṣūcaḥ śatrūn apabādhamānau | apa kṣudhaṃ nudatām arātim | pūrṇā paścād uta pūrṇā purastāt | ut-madhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya | tasyāṃ devā adhi saṃvasantaḥ | uttame nāka iha mādayantām | pṛthvī suvarcā yuvatiḥ sajoṣāḥ | paurṇamāsy udagāt-śobhamānā | āpyāyayantī duritāni viśvā | uruṃ duhāṃ {ḍyumoṇṭa duhāṃ} yajamānāya yajñam |
analyzed: viṣūcaḥ śatrūn apabādhamānau apa kṣudham nudatām arātim pūrṇā paścāt uta pūrṇā purastāt ut madhyataḥ paurṇamāsī jigāya tasyām devāḥ adhi saṃvasantaḥ uttame nāke iha mādayantām pṛthvī suvarcāḥ yuvatiḥ sajoṣāḥ paurṇamāsī udagāt śobhamānā āpyāyayantī duritāni viśvā urum duhām duhām yajamānāya yajñam

original: anuvāka 2 { 3.1.2.1} ṛdhyāsma havyair namasopasadya | mitraṃ devaṃ mitradheyaṃ no astu | anūrādhān haviṣā vardhayantaḥ | śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ savīrāḥ | citraṃ nakṣatram udagāt purastāt | anūrādhāsa iti yad vadanti | tan mitra eti pathibhir devayānaiḥ | hiraṇyayair vitatair antarikṣe | indro jyeṣṭhām anu nakṣatram eti |
analyzed: ṛdhyāsma havyaiḥ namasā upasadya mitram devam mitradheyam naḥ astu anūrādhān haviṣā vardhayantaḥ śatam jīvema śaradaḥ sa vīrāḥ citram nakṣatram udagāt purastāt anūrādhāsaḥ iti yat vadanti tat mitraḥ eti pathibhiḥ deva yānaiḥ hiraṇyayaiḥ vitataiḥ antarikṣe indraḥ jyeṣṭhām anu nakṣatram eti

original: yasmin vṛtraṃ vṛtratūrye tatāra |
analyzed: yasmin vṛtram vṛtratūrye tatāra

original: { 3.1.2.2} tasmin vayam amṛtaṃ duhānāḥ | kṣudhaṃ tarema duritiṃ duriṣṭim | purandarāya vṛṣabhāya dhṛṣṇave | aṣāḍhāya sahamānāya mīḍhuṣe | indrāya jyeṣṭhā madhumad duhānā | uruṃ kṛṇotu yajamānāya lokam | mūlaṃ prajāṃ vīravatīṃ videya | parācy etu nirṛtiḥ parācā | gobhir nakṣatraṃ paśubhiḥ samaktam | ahar bhūyād yajamānāya mahyam |
analyzed: tasmin vayam amṛtam duhānāḥ kṣudham tarema duritim duriṣṭim purandarāya vṛṣabhāya dhṛṣṇave aṣāḍhāya sahamānāya mīḍhuṣe indrāya jyeṣṭhāḥ madhumat duhānāḥ urum kṛṇotu yajamānāya lokam mūlam prajām vīravatīm videya parācī etu nirṛtiḥ parācā gobhiḥ nakṣatram paśubhiḥ samaktam ahar bhūyāt yajamānāya mahyam

original: { 3.1.2.3} ahar no adya suvite dadhātu | mūlaṃ nakṣatram iti yad vadanti | parācīṃ vācā nirṛtiṃ nudāmi | śivaṃ prajāyai śivam astu mahyam | yā divyā āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvuḥ | yā antarikṣa uta pārthivīr yāḥ | yāsām aṣāḍhā anuyanti kāmam | tā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu | yāś ca kūpyā yāś ca nādyāḥ samudriyāḥ | yāś ca vaiśantīr uta prāsacīr yāḥ |
analyzed: ahar naḥ adya suvite dadhātu mūlam nakṣatram iti yat vadanti parācīm vācā nirṛtim nudāmi śivam prajāyai śivam astu mahyam yāḥ divyāḥ āpaḥ payasā saṃbabhūvuḥ yāḥ antarikṣe uta pārthivīḥ yāḥ yāsām aṣāḍhāḥ anuyanti kāmam tāḥ naḥ āpaḥ śam syonāḥ bhavantu yāḥ ca kūpyāḥ yāḥ ca nādyāḥ samudriyāḥ yāḥ ca vaiśantīḥ uta prāsacīḥ yāḥ

original: { 3.1.2.4} yāsām aṣāḍhā madhu bhakṣayanti | tā na āpaḥ śaṃ syonā bhavantu | tan no viśve upaśṛṇvantu devāḥ | tad aṣāḍhā abhi saṃyantu yajñam | tan nakṣatraṃ prathatāṃ paśubhyaḥ | kṛṣir vṛṣṭir yajamānāya kalpatām | śubhrāḥ kanyā yuvatayaḥ supeśasaḥ | karmakṛtaḥ sukṛto vīryāvatīḥ | viśvān devān haviṣā vardhayantīḥ | aṣāḍhāḥ kāmam upayāntu yajñam |
analyzed: yāsām aṣāḍhāḥ madhu bhakṣayanti tāḥ naḥ āpaḥ śam syonāḥ bhavantu tat naḥ viśve upaśṛṇvantu devāḥ tat aṣāḍhāḥ abhi saṃyantu yajñam tat nakṣatram prathatām paśubhyaḥ kṛṣiḥ vṛṣṭiḥ yajamānāya kalpatām śubhrāḥ kanyāḥ yuvatayaḥ supeśasaḥ karma kṛtaḥ su kṛtaḥ vīryāvatīḥ viśvān devān haviṣā vardhayantīḥ aṣāḍhāḥ kāmam upayāntu yajñam

original: { 3.1.2.5} yasmin brahmābhyajayat sarvam etat | amuṃ ca lokam idamū ca sarvam | tan no nakṣatram abhijid vijitya | śriyaṃ dadhātv ahṛṇīyamānam | ubhau lokau brahmaṇā saṃjitemau | tan no nakṣatram abhijid vicaṣṭām | tasmin vayaṃ pṛtanāḥ saṃjayema | taṃ no devāso anujānantu kāmam | śṛṇvanti śroṇām amṛtasya gopām | puṇyām asyā upaśṛṇomi vācam |
analyzed: yasmin brahma abhyajayat sarvam etat amum ca lokam ca sarvam tat naḥ nakṣatram abhijit vijitya śriyam dadhātu a hṛṇīyamānam ubhau lokau brahmaṇā saṃjitā imau tat naḥ nakṣatram abhijit vicaṣṭām tasmin vayam pṛtanāḥ saṃjayema tam naḥ devāsaḥ anujānantu kāmam śṛṇvanti śroṇām amṛtasya gopām puṇyām asyāḥ upaśṛṇomi vācam

original: { 3.1.2.6} mahīṃ devīṃ viṣṇupatnīm ajūryām | pratīcīm enāṃ haviṣā yajāmaḥ | tredhā viṣṇur urugāyo vicakrame | mahīṃ divaṃ pṛthivīm antarikṣam | tat-śroṇā-eti śrava icchamānā | puṇyaṃ ślokaṃ yajamānāya kṛṇvatī | aṣṭau devā vasavaḥ somyāsaḥ | catasro devīr ajarāḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ | te yajñaṃ pāntu rajasaḥ parastāt | saṃvatsarīṇam amṛtaṃ svasti |
analyzed: mahīm devīm viṣṇu patnīm ajūryām pratīcīm enām haviṣā yajāmaḥ tredhā viṣṇuḥ uru gāyaḥ vicakrame mahīm divam pṛthivīm antarikṣam śravaḥ icchamānā puṇyam ślokam yajamānāya kṛṇvatī aṣṭau devāḥ vasavaḥ somyāsaḥ catasraḥ devīḥ ajarāḥ śraviṣṭhāḥ te yajñam pāntu rajasaḥ parastāt saṃvatsarīṇam amṛtam svasti

original: { 3.1.2.7} yajñaṃ naḥ pāntu vasavaḥ purastāt | dakṣiṇato 'bhiyantu śraviṣṭhāḥ | puṇyaṃ nakṣatram abhi saṃviśāma | mā no arātir aghaśaṃsā-āgann | kṣatrasya rājā varuṇo 'dhirājaḥ | nakṣatrāṇāṃ śatabhiṣag vasiṣṭhaḥ | tau devebhyaḥ kṛṇuto dīrgham āyuḥ | ' śataṃ sahasrā bheṣajāni dhattaḥ | yajñaṃ no rājā varuṇa upayātu |
analyzed: yajñam naḥ pāntu vasavaḥ purastāt dakṣiṇatas bhiyantu śraviṣṭhāḥ puṇyam nakṣatram abhi saṃviśāma mā naḥ arātiḥ agha śaṃsaḥ ā agan kṣatrasya rājā varuṇaḥ dhirājaḥ nakṣatrāṇām śatabhiṣaj vasiṣṭhaḥ tau devebhyaḥ kṛṇutaḥ dīrgham āyuḥ śatam sahasrā bheṣajāni dhattaḥ yajñam naḥ rājā varuṇaḥ upayātu

original: tan no viśve abhi saṃyantu devāḥ |
analyzed: tat naḥ viśve abhi saṃyantu devāḥ

original: { 3.1.2.8} tan no nakṣatraṃ śatabhiṣag juṣāṇam { śatabhigjuṣāṇam} | dīrgham āyuḥ pratirad bheṣajāni | aja ekapād udagāt purastāt | viśvā bhūtāni pratimodamānaḥ | tasya devāḥ prasavaṃ yanti sarve | proṣṭhapadāso amṛtasya gopāḥ | vibhrājamānaḥ samidhāna ugraḥ | ā-antarikṣam aruhad agaṃ dyām | taṃ sūryaṃ devam ajam ekapādam |
analyzed: tat naḥ nakṣatram śatabhiṣaj juṣāṇam śatabhiś juṣāṇam dīrgham āyuḥ pratirat bheṣajāni ajaḥ ekapād udagāt purastāt viśvā bhūtāni pratimodamānaḥ tasya devāḥ prasavam yanti sarve proṣṭhapadāsaḥ amṛtasya gopāḥ vibhrājamānaḥ samidhānaḥ ugraḥ ā antarikṣam aruhat agam dyām tam sūryam devam ajam ekapādam

original: proṣṭhapadāso anuyanti sarve |
analyzed: proṣṭhapadāsaḥ anuyanti sarve

original: { 3.1.2.9} ahir budhniyaḥ prathamāna eti | śreṣṭho devānām uta mānuṣāṇām | taṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somapāḥ somyāsaḥ | proṣṭhapadāso abhirakṣanti sarve | catvāra ekam abhi karma devāḥ | proṣṭhapadāsa iti yān vadanti | te budhniyaṃ pariṣadyaṃ stuvantaḥ | ahiṃ rakṣanti namasopasadya | pūṣā revaty anveti panthām | puṣṭipatī paśupā vājabastyau |
analyzed: ahiḥ budhniyaḥ prathamānaḥ eti śreṣṭhaḥ devānām uta mānuṣāṇām tam brāhmaṇāḥ soma pāḥ somyāsaḥ proṣṭhapadāsaḥ abhirakṣanti sarve catvāraḥ ekam abhi karma devāḥ proṣṭhapadāsaḥ iti yān vadanti te budhniyam pariṣadyam stuvantaḥ ahim rakṣanti namasā upasadya pūṣā revatī anveti panthām puṣṭi patī paśu pāḥ vājabastyau

original: { 3.1.2.10} imāni havyā prayatā juṣāṇā | sugair no yānair upayātāṃ yajñam | kṣudrān paśūn rakṣatu revatī naḥ | gāvo no aśvāṃ anvetu pūṣā | annaṃ rakṣantau bahudhā virūpam | vājaṃ sanutāṃ yajamānāya yajñam | tad aśvināv aśvayujā-upayātām | śubhaṃ gamiṣṭhau suyamebhir aśvaiḥ | svaṃ nakṣatraṃ haviṣā yajantau | madhvā saṃpṛktau yajuṣā samaktau |
analyzed: imāni havyā prayatā juṣāṇā sugaiḥ naḥ yānaiḥ upayātām yajñam kṣudrān paśūn rakṣatu revatī naḥ gāvaḥ naḥ aśvān anvetu pūṣā annam rakṣantau bahudhā virūpam vājam sanutām yajamānāya yajñam tat aśvinau aśvayujā upayātām śubham gamiṣṭhau su yamebhiḥ aśvaiḥ svam nakṣatram haviṣā yajantau madhvā saṃpṛktau yajuṣā samaktau

original: { 3.1.2.11} yau devānāṃ bhiṣajau havyavāhau | viśvasya dūtāv amṛtasya gopau | tau nakṣatraṃ jujuṣāṇā-upayātām | namo 'śvibhyāṃ kṛṇumo 'śvayugbhyām | apa pāpmānaṃ bharaṇīr bharantu | tad yamo rājā bhagavān vicaṣṭām | lokasya rājā mahato mahān hi | sugaṃ naḥ panthām abhayaṃ kṛṇotu | yasmin nakṣatre yama eti rājā | yasminn enam abhyaṣiñcanta devāḥ |
analyzed: yau devānām bhiṣajau havya vāhau viśvasya dūtau amṛtasya gopau tau nakṣatram jujuṣāṇau upayātām namaḥ śvibhyām kṛṇumaḥ śvayugbhyām apa pāpmānam bharaṇīḥ bharantu tat yamaḥ rājā bhagavān vicaṣṭām lokasya rājā mahataḥ mahān hi sugam naḥ panthām abhayam kṛṇotu yasmin nakṣatre yamaḥ eti rājā yasmin enam abhyaṣiñcanta devāḥ

original: tad asya citraṃ haviṣā yajāma | apa pāpmānaṃ bharaṇīr bharantu | niveśanī yat te devā adadhuḥ |
analyzed: tat asya citram haviṣā yajāma apa pāpmānam bharaṇīḥ bharantu niveśanī yat te devāḥ adadhuḥ

analyzed: navaḥ navaḥ bhavati taisaṃ2414 yam ādityāḥ aṃśum āpyāyayanti taisaṃ2414 yam ādityāḥ aṃśum āpyāyayanti taisaṃ2414 ye virūpe samanasā saṃvyayantī samānam tantum paritā tanota vibhū prabhū anubhū viśvatas huve te naḥ nakṣatre havam āgametam vayam devī brahmaṇā saṃvidānāḥ su ratnāsaḥ deva vītim dadhānāḥ ahorātre haviṣā vardhayantaḥ

analyzed: āpaḥ vai akāmayanta samudram kāmam abhijayema eti tāḥ etam adbhyaḥ ṣāḍhābhyaḥ carum niravapan tatas vai tāḥ samudram kāmam abhyajayan samudram ha vai kāmam abhijayati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti adbhyaḥ svāhā aṣāḍhābhyaḥ svāhā samudrāya svāhā kāmāya svāhā abhijityai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.5} viśve vai devā akāmayanta | anapajayyaṃ jayema-iti | ta etaṃ viśvebhyo devebhyo 'ṣāḍhābhyaś caruṃ niravapan | tato vai te 'napajayyam ajayann | anapajayyaṃ ha vai jayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā-aṣāḍhābhyaḥ svāhā | anapajayyāya svāhā jityai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: viśve vai devāḥ akāmayanta anapajayyam jayema eti te etam viśvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ ṣāḍhābhyaḥ carum niravapan tatas vai te napajayyam ajayan anapajayyam ha vai jayati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti viśvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ svāhā aṣāḍhābhyaḥ svāhā anapajayyāya svāhā jityai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.6} brahma vā akāmayata { akāmaya} | brahmalokam abhijayeyam iti | tad etaṃ brahmaṇe 'bhijite caruṃ niravapat | tato vai tad brahmalokam abhyajayat | brahmalokaṃ ha vā abhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | brahmaṇe svāhā-abhijite svāhā | brahmalokāya svāhā-abhijityai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: brahma vai akāmayata akāmaya brahma lokam abhijayeyam iti tat etam brahmaṇe bhijite carum niravapat tatas vai tat brahma lokam abhyajayat brahma lokam ha vai abhijayati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti brahmaṇe svāhā abhijite svāhā brahma lokāya svāhā abhijityai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.7} viṣṇur vā akāmayata | puṇyaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇvīya | na mā pāpī kīrtir āgacched iti | sa etaṃ viṣṇave śroṇāyai puroḍāśaṃ trikapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai sa puṇyaṃ ślokam aśṛṇuta | na-enaṃ pāpī kīrtir āgacchat | puṇyaṃ ha vai ślokaṃ śṛṇute | na-enaṃ pāpī kīrtir āgacchati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti |
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ vai akāmayata puṇyam ślokam śṛṇvīya na mā pāpī kīrtiḥ āgacchet iti saḥ etam viṣṇave śroṇāyai puroḍāśam tri kapālam niravapat tatas vai sa puṇyam ślokam aśṛṇuta na enam pāpī kīrtiḥ āgacchat puṇyam ha vai ślokam śṛṇute na enam pāpī kīrtiḥ āgacchati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti

original: viṣṇave svāhā śroṇāyai svāhā | ślokāya svāhā śrutāya svāhā-iti |
analyzed: viṣṇave svāhā śroṇāyai svāhā ślokāya svāhā śrutāya svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.8} vasavo vā akāmayanta | agraṃ devatānāṃ parīyāma-iti | ta etaṃ vasubhyaḥ śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapan | tato vai te 'graṃ devatānāṃ paryāyann | agraṃ ha vai samānānāṃ paryeti | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | vasubhyaḥ svāhā śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ svāhā | agrāya svāhā parītyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: vasavaḥ vai akāmayanta agram devatānām parīyāma eti te etam vasubhyaḥ śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam niravapan tatas vai te devatānām paryāyan agram ha vai samānānām paryeti yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti vasubhyaḥ svāhā śraviṣṭhābhyaḥ svāhā agrāya svāhā parītyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.9} indro vā akāmayata | dṛḍho 'śithilaḥ syām iti | sa etaṃ varuṇāya śatabhiṣaje bheṣajebhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ daśakapālaṃ niravapat kṛṣṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām | tato vai sa dṛḍho 'śithilo 'bhavat | dṛḍho ha vā aśithilo bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | varuṇāya svāhā śatabhiṣaje svāhā | bheṣajebhyaḥ svāhā-iti |
analyzed: indraḥ vai akāmayata dṛḍhaḥ u śithilaḥ syām iti saḥ etam varuṇāya śatabhiṣaje bheṣajebhyaḥ puroḍāśam daśa kapālam niravapat kṛṣṇānām vrīhīṇām tatas vai sa dṛḍhaḥ u śithilaḥ bhavat dṛḍhaḥ ha vai a śithilaḥ bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti varuṇāya svāhā śatabhiṣaje svāhā bheṣajebhyaḥ svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.10} ajo vā ekapād akāmayata | tejasvī brahmavarcasī syām iti | sa etam ajāya-ekapade proṣṭhapadebhyaś caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa tejasvī brahmavarcasy abhavat | tejasvī ha vai brahmavarcasī bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | ajāya-ekapade svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā |
analyzed: ajaḥ vai ekapād akāmayata tejasvī brahmavarcasī syām iti saḥ etam ajāya ekapade proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ carum niravapat tatas vai sa tejasvī brahmavarcasī abhavat tejasvī ha vai brahmavarcasī bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti ajāya ekapade svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā

original: tejase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāhā-iti |
analyzed: tejase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.11} ahir vai budhniyo 'kāmayata | imāṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ vindeya-iti | sa etam ahaye budhniyāya proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ puroḍāśaṃ bhūmikapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai sa imāṃ pratiṣṭhām avindata | imāṃ ha vai pratiṣṭhāṃ vindate | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | ahaye budhniyāya svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā |
analyzed: ahiḥ vai budhniyaḥ kāmayate imām pratiṣṭhām vindeya eti saḥ etam ahaye budhniyāya proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ puroḍāśam bhūmi kapālam niravapat tatas vai saḥ imām pratiṣṭhām avindata imām ha vai pratiṣṭhām vindate yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti ahaye budhniyāya svāhā proṣṭhapadebhyaḥ svāhā

original: pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.12} pūṣā vā akāmayata | paśumānt syām iti | sa etaṃ pūṣṇe revatyai caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa paśumān abhavat | paśumān ha vai bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | pūṣṇe svāhā revatyai svāhā | paśubhyaḥ svāhā-iti |
analyzed: pūṣā vai akāmayata paśumān syām iti saḥ etam pūṣṇe revatyai carum niravapat tatas vai sa paśumān abhavat paśumān ha vai bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti pūṣṇe svāhā revatyai svāhā paśubhyaḥ svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.13} aśvinau vā akāmayetām | śrotrasvināv abadhirau syāva-iti | tav etam aśvibhyām aśvayugbhyāṃ puroḍāśaṃ dvikapālaṃ niravapatām | tato vai tau śrotrasvināv abadhirāv abhavatām | śrotrasvī ha vā abadhiro bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | aśvibhyāṃ svāhā-aśvayugbhyāṃ svāhā |
analyzed: aśvinau vai akāmayetām śrotrasvinau a badhirau syau aiti tau etam aśvibhyām aśvayugbhyām puroḍāśam dvi kapālam niravapatām tatas vai tau śrotrasvinau a badhirau abhavatām śrotrasvī ha vai a badhiraḥ bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti aśvibhyām svāhā aśvayugbhyām svāhā

original: śrotrāya svāhā śrutyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: śrotrāya svāhā śrutyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.14} yamo vā akāmayata | pitṛṇāṃ rājyam abhijayeyam iti | sa etaṃ yamāyā-apabharaṇībhyaś caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa pitṛṇāṃ rājyam abhyajayat | samānānāṃ ha vai rājyam abhijayati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | yamāya svāhā-apabharaṇībhyaḥ svāhā | rājyāya svāhā-abhijityai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: yamaḥ vai akāmayata pitṛṇām rājyam abhijayeyam iti saḥ etam yamāya apabharaṇībhyaḥ carum niravapat tatas vai sa pitṛṇām rājyam abhyajayat samānānām ha vai rājyam abhijayati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti yamāya svāhā apabharaṇībhyaḥ svāhā rājyāya svāhā abhijityai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.5.15} athaitad amāvāsyāyā ājyaṃ nirvapati | kāmo vā amāvāsyā | kāma ājyam | kāmena-eva kāmaṃ samardhayati | kṣipram enaṃ sa kāma upanamati | yena kāmena yajate | so 'tra juhoti | amāvāsyāyai svāhā kāmāya svāhā-āgatyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: atha etat amāvāsyāyai ājyam nirvapati kāmaḥ vai amāvāsyā kāmaḥ ājyam kāmena eva kāmam samardhayati kṣipram enam sa kāmaḥ upanamati yena kāmena yajate saḥ u tra juhoti amāvāsyāyai svāhā kāmāya svāhā āgatyai svāhā iti

original: anuvāka 6 { 3.1.6.1} candramā vā akāmayata | ahorātrān ardhamāsān māsān ṛtūnt saṃvatsaram āptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnuyām iti | sa etaṃ candramase pratīdṛśyāyai puroḍāśaṃ pañcadaśakapālaṃ niravapat | tato vai so 'horātrān ardhamāsān māsān ṛtūnt saṃvatsaram āptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnot |
analyzed: candramāḥ vai akāmayata ahar rātrān ardha māsān māsān ṛtūn saṃvatsaram āptvā candramasaḥ sāyujyam salokatām āpnuyām iti saḥ etam candramase pratīdṛśyāyai puroḍāśam pañcadaśa kapālam niravapat tatas vai saḥ har rātrān ardha māsān māsān ṛtūn saṃvatsaram āptvā candramasaḥ sāyujyam salokatām āpnot

original: ahorātrān ha vā ardhamāsān māsān ṛtūnt saṃvatsaram āptvā | candramasaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | candramase svāhā pratīdṛśyāyai svāhā | ahorātrebhyaḥ svāhā-ardhamāsebhyaḥ svāhā | māsebhyaḥ svāhā-ṛtubhyaḥ svāhā | saṃvatsarāya svāhā-iti |
analyzed: ahar rātrān ha vai ardha māsān māsān ṛtūn saṃvatsaram āptvā candramasaḥ sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti candramase svāhā pratīdṛśyāyai svāhā ahar rātrebhyaḥ svāhā ardha māsebhyaḥ svāhā māsebhyaḥ svāhā ṛtubhyaḥ svāhā saṃvatsarāya svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.2} ahorātre vā akāmayetām | aty ahorātre mucyevahi | na nāv ahorātre āpnuyātām iti | te etam ahorātrābhyāṃ caruṃ niravapatām | dvayānāṃ vrīhīṇām | śuklānāṃ ca kṛṣṇānāṃ ca | savātyor dugdhe | śvetāyai ca kṛṣṇāyai ca | tato vai te aty ahorātre amucyete | na-ene ahorātre āpnutām | ati ha vā ahorātre mucyate | na-enam ahorātre āpnutaḥ |
analyzed: ahar rātre vai akāmayetām ati ahar rātre mucyevahi na nau ahar rātre āpnuyātām iti te etam ahar rātrābhyām carum niravapatām dvayānām vrīhīṇām śuklānām ca kṛṣṇānām ca dugdhe śvetāyai ca kṛṣṇāyai ca tatas vai te ati ahar rātre amucyete na ene ahar rātre āpnutām ati ha vai ahar rātre mucyate na enam ahar rātre āpnutaḥ

original: ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | ahne svāhā rātriyai svāhā | atimuktyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti ahne svāhā rātriyai svāhā atimuktyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.3} uṣā vā akāmayata | priyā-ādityasya subhagā syām iti | sa-etam uṣase caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sā priyā-ādityasya subhagā-abhavat | priyo ha vai samānānāṃ subhago bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhā | vyūṣuṣyai svāhā vyucchantyai svāhā | vyuṣṭāyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: uṣāḥ vai akāmayata priyā ādityasya subhagā syām iti saḥ etam uṣase carum niravapat tatas vai sā priyā ādityasya subhagā abhavat priyaḥ ha vai samānānām subhagaḥ bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti uṣase svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhā vyūṣuṣyai svāhā vyucchantyai svāhā vyuṣṭāyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.4} atha-etasmai nakṣatrāya caruṃ nirvapati | yathā tvaṃ devānām asi | evam ahaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ bhūyāsam iti | yathā ha vā etad devānām | evaṃ ha vā eṣa manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | nakṣatrāya svāhā-udeṣyate svāhā | udyate svāhā-uditāya svāhā | harase svāhā bharase svāhā |
analyzed: atha etasmai nakṣatrāya carum nirvapati yathā tvam devānām asi evam aham manuṣyāṇām bhūyāsam iti yathā ha vai etat devānām evam ha vai eṣa manuṣyāṇām bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ u tra juhoti nakṣatrāya svāhā udeṣyate svāhā udyate svāhā uditāya svāhā harase svāhā bharase svāhā

original: bhrājase svāhā tejase svāhā | tapase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāhā-iti |
analyzed: bhrājase svāhā tejase svāhā tapase svāhā brahmavarcasāya svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.5} sūryo vā akāmayata | nakṣatrāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhā syām iti | sa etaṃ sūryāya nakṣatrebhyaś caruṃ niravapat | tato vai sa nakṣatrāṇāṃ pratiṣṭhā-abhavat | pratiṣṭhā ha vai samānānāṃ bhavati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | sūryāya svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā | pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: sūryaḥ vai akāmayata nakṣatrāṇām pratiṣṭhā syām iti saḥ etam sūryāya nakṣatrebhyaḥ carum niravapat tatas vai sa nakṣatrāṇām pratiṣṭhā abhavat pratiṣṭhā ha vai samānānām bhavati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti sūryāya svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.6} atha-etam adityai caruṃ nirvapati | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati | so 'tra juhoti | adityai svāhā pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: atha etam adityai carum nirvapati iyam vai aditiḥ asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati saḥ u tra juhoti adityai svāhā pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā iti

original: { 3.1.6.7} atha-etaṃ viṣṇave caruṃ nirvapati | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajña eva-antataḥ pratitiṣṭhati | so 'tra juhoti | viṣṇave svāhā yajñāya svāhā | pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā-iti |
analyzed: atha etam viṣṇave carum nirvapati yajñaḥ vai viṣṇuḥ yajñe eva antatas pratitiṣṭhati saḥ tra juhoti viṣṇave svāhā yajñāya svāhā pratiṣṭhāyai svāhā iti

original: prapāṭhaka: 2 anuvāka 1 { 3.2.1.1} tṛtīyasyām ito divi soma āsīt | taṃ gāyatry āharat | tasya parṇam acchidyata | tat parṇo 'bhavat | tat parṇasya parṇatvam | brahma vai parṇaḥ | yat parṇaśākhayā vatsān apākaroti | brahmaṇā-evainān apākaroti | gāyatro vai parṇaḥ | gāyatrāḥ paśavaḥ |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 2 anuvāka 1 3211 tṛtīyasyām itas divi somaḥ āsīt tam gāyatrī āharat tasya parṇam acchidyata tat parṇaḥ bhavat tat parṇasya parṇa tvam brahma vai parṇaḥ yat parṇa śākhayā vatsān apākaroti brahmaṇā eva enān apākaroti gāyatraḥ vai parṇaḥ gāyatrāḥ paśavaḥ

original: { 3.2.1.2} tasmāt trīṇi-trīṇi parṇasya palāśāni | tripadā gāyatrī | yat parṇaśākhayā gāḥ prārpayati | svayā-evainā devatayā prārpayati | yaṃ kāmayeta-apaśuḥ syād iti | aparṇāṃ tasmai śuṣkāgrām āharet | apaśur eva bhavati | yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānt syād iti | bahuparṇāṃ tasmai bahuśākhām āharet | paśumantam evainaṃ karoti |
analyzed: tasmāt trīṇi trīṇi parṇasya palāśāni tripadā gāyatrī yat parṇa śākhayā gāḥ prārpayati svayā eva enāḥ devatayā prārpayati yam kāmayeta apaśuḥ syāt iti a parṇām tasmai śuṣka agrām āharet apaśuḥ eva bhavati yam kāmayeta paśumān syāt iti bahu parṇām tasmai bahu śākhām āharet paśumantam eva enam karoti

original: { 3.2.1.3} yat prācīm āharet | devalokam abhijayet | yad udīcīṃ manuṣyalokam | prācīm udīcīm āharati | ubhayor lokayor abhijityai | iṣe tvā-ūrje tvā-ity āha | iṣam eva-ūrjaṃ yajamāne dadhāti | vāyavaḥ stha-ity āha | vāyur vā antarikṣasya-adhyakṣāḥ | antarikṣadevatyāḥ khalu vai paśavaḥ |

original: anuvāka 2 { 3.2.2.1} devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ity aśvaparśum ādatte prasūtyai | aśvinor bāhubhyām ity āha | aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyām ity āha yatyai | yo vā oṣadhīḥ parvaśo veda | na-enāḥ sa hinasti | prajāpatir vā oṣadhīḥ parvaśo veda | sa enā na hinasti aśvaparśvā barhir acchaiti | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ sayonitvāya |
analyzed: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti aśva parśum ādatte prasūtyai aśvinoḥ bāhubhyām iti āha aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām pūṣṇaḥ hastābhyām iti āha yatyai yaḥ vai oṣadhīḥ parvaśas veda na enāḥ sa hinasti prajāpatiḥ vai oṣadhīḥ parvaśas veda saḥ enāḥ na hinasti aśva parśvā barhiḥ acchaiti prājāpatyaḥ vai aśvaḥ sayoni tvāya

original: { 3.2.2.2} oṣadhīnām ahiṃsāyai | yajñasya ghoṣad asi-ity āha | yajamāna eva rayiṃ dadhāti | pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity āha | rakṣasām apahatyai | pra-iyam agād dhiṣaṇā barhir acchā-ity āha | vidyā vai dhiṣaṇā | vidyayā-evainad acchaiti | manunā kṛtā svadhayā vitaṣṭa-ity āha | mānavī hi parśuḥ svadhākṛtā |
analyzed: oṣadhīnām ahiṃsāyai yajñasya ghoṣat asi iti āha yajamānaḥ eva rayim dadhāti pratyuṣṭam rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭāḥ arātayaḥ iti āha rakṣasām apahatyai pra iyam agāt dhiṣaṇā barhiḥ acchā iti āha vidyā vai dhiṣaṇā vidyayā eva enat acchaiti manunā kṛtā svadhayā vitaṣṭā eti āha mānavī hi parśuḥ svadhākṛtā

original: { 3.2.2.3} ta āvahanti kavayaḥ purastād ity āha | śuśruvāṃso vai kavayaḥ | yajñaḥ purastāt | mukhata eva yajñam ārabhate | atho yad etad uktvā yataḥ kutaś ca-āharati | tat prācyā eva diśo bhavati | devebhyo juṣṭam iha barhir āsada ity āha | barhiṣaḥ samṛddhyai | karmaṇo 'naparādhāya | devānāṃ pariṣūtam asi-ity āha |
analyzed: te āvahanti kavayaḥ purastāt iti āha śuśruvāṃsaḥ vai kavayaḥ yajñaḥ purastāt mukhataḥ eva yajñam ārabhate atha u yat etat uktvā yatas kutas ca āharati tat prācyāḥ eva diśaḥ bhavati devebhyaḥ juṣṭam iha barhiḥ āsade iti āha barhiṣaḥ samṛddhyai karmaṇaḥ na aparādhāya devānām pariṣūtam asi iti āha

original: { 3.2.2.4} yad vā idaṃ kiṃ ca | tad devānāṃ pariṣūtam | atho yathā vasyase pratiprocya-āha-idaṃ kariṣyāmi-iti | evam eva tad adhvaryur devebhyaḥ pratiprocya barhir dāti | ātmano 'hiṃsāyai | yāvataḥ stambān paridiśet | yat teṣām ucchiṃṣyāt | ati tad yajñasya recayet | ekaṃ ṃ stambaṃ paridiśet | taṃ sarvaṃ dāyāt |
analyzed: yat vai idam kim ca tat devānām pariṣūtam atha u yathā vasyase pratiprocya āha edam kariṣyāmi iti evam eva tat adhvaryuḥ devebhyaḥ pratiprocya barhiḥ dāti ātmanaḥ hiṃsāyai yāvataḥ stambān paridiśet yat teṣām ucchiṃṣyāt ati tat yajñasya recayet ekam stambam paridiśet tam sarvam dāyāt

original: { 3.2.2.5} yajñasya-anatirekāya | varṣavṛddham asi-ity āha | varṣavṛddhā vā oṣadhayaḥ | devabarhir ity āha | devebhya eva-enat karoti | mā tvā-anvaṅ mā tiryag ity āha-ahiṃsāyai | parva te rādhyāsam ity āha-ṛdhyai | ācchettā te mā riṣam ity āha | na-asya-ātmano mīyate | ya evaṃ veda |
analyzed: yajñasya an atirekāya varṣa vṛddham asi iti āha varṣa vṛddhāḥ vai oṣadhayaḥ deva barhiḥ iti āha devebhyaḥ eva enat karoti mā tvā anvak mā tiryak iti āha ahiṃsāyai parva te rādhyāsam iti āha ṛdhyai ācchettā te mā riṣam iti āha na asya ātmanaḥ mīyate yaḥ evam veda

original: { 3.2.2.6} deva barhiś śatavalśaṃ viroha-ity āha | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajānāṃ prajananāya | sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhema-ity āha | āśiṣam eva-etām āśāste | pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi-ity āha pratiṣṭhityai | ayuṃ gāyuṃ gān {ḍyumoṇṭa ayuṅgāyuṅgān} muṣṭīn-lunoti | mithunatvāya prajātyai | susaṃbhṛtā tvā saṃbharāmi-ity āha | brahmaṇā-evainat saṃbharati |
analyzed: deva barhiḥ śata valśam viroha iti āha prajāḥ vai barhiḥ prajānām prajananāya sahasra valśāḥ vi vayam ruhema iti āha āśiṣam eva etām āśāste pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhi iti āha pratiṣṭhityai ayum gān gān ayuṅga ayuṅgān muṣṭīn lunoti mithuna tvāya prajātyai su saṃbhṛtā tvā saṃbharāmi iti āha brahmaṇā eva enat saṃbharati

original: { 3.2.2.7} adityai rāsnā-asi-ity āha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainad rāsnāṃ karoti | indrāṇyai saṃnahanam ity āha | indrāṇī vā agre devatānāṃ samanahyata | sordhnot | ṛddhyai saṃnahyati | prajā vai barhiḥ | prajānām aparāvāpāya | tasmāt snāvasaṃtatāḥ prajā jāyante
analyzed: adityai rāsnā asi iti āha iyam vai aditiḥ asyai eva enat rāsnām karoti indrāṇyai saṃnahanam iti āha indrāṇī vai agre devatānām samanahyata sā ūrdhnot ṛddhyai saṃnahyati prajāḥ vai barhiḥ prajānām a parāvāpāya tasmāt snāva saṃtatāḥ prajāḥ jāyante

original: { 3.2.2.8} pūṣā te granthiṃ grathnātv ity āha | puṣṭim eva yajamāne dadhāti | sa te mā sthād ity āha-ahiṃsāyai |paścāt prāñcam upagūhati | paścād vai prācīnaṃ reto dhīyate | paścād evāsmai prācīnaṃ reto dadhāti | indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyaccha ity āha | indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti | bṛhaspater mūrdhnā harāmi-ity āha |
analyzed: pūṣā te granthim grathnātu iti āha puṣṭim eva yajamāne dadhāti sa te mā sthāt iti āha ahiṃsāyai paścāt prāñcam upagūhati paścāt vai prācīnam retaḥ dhīyate paścāt eva asmai prācīnam retaḥ dadhāti indrasya tvā bāhubhyām udyacche iti āha indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti bṛhaspateḥ mūrdhnā harāmi iti āha

original: brahma vai devānāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ |
analyzed: brahma vai devānām bṛhaspatiḥ

original: { 3.2.2.9} brahmaṇā-evainad dharati | urv antarikṣam anvihītyāha gatyai | devaṃgamam asīty āha | devān eva-enad gamayati | anadhaḥ sādayati | garbhāṇāṃ dhṛtyā aprapādāya | tasmād garbhāḥ prajānām aprapādukāḥ | uparīva nidadhāti | uparīva hi suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai |
analyzed: brahmaṇā eva enat dharati uru antarikṣam anvihi iti āha gatyai devaṃgamam asi iti āha devān eva enat gamayati anadhas sādayati garbhāṇām dhṛtyai a prapādāya tasmāt garbhāḥ prajānām a prapādukāḥ upari iva nidadhāti upari iva hi suvargaḥ lokaḥ suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

original: anuvāka 3 { 3.2.3.1} pūrvedyur idhmābarhiḥ karoti | yajñam evā''rabhya gṛhītvā-upavasati | prajāpatir yajñam asṛjata | tasya-ukhe asraṃsetām | yajño vai prajāpatiḥ | yat sāṃnāyya-ukhe bhavataḥ | yajñasyaiva tad ukhe upadadhāty aprasraṃsāya | śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyā ity āha | devayajyāyā eva-enāni śundhati |
analyzed: pūrvedyus idhmābarhiḥ karoti yajñam eva ārabhya gṛhītvā upavasati prajāpatiḥ yajñam asṛjata tasya okhe asraṃsetām yajñaḥ vai prajāpatiḥ yat sāṃnāyya okhe bhavataḥ yajñasya eva tat ukhe upadadhāti a prasraṃsāya śundhadhvam daivyāya karmaṇe deva yajyāyai iti āha deva yajyāyai eva enāni śundhati
