analyzed: antarikṣam vai mātariśvanaḥ gharmaḥ eṣām lokānām vidhṛtyai dyauḥ asi pṛthivī asi iti āha divaḥ ca hi eṣā pṛthivyāḥ ca saṃbhṛtā yat ukhā tasmāt evam āha viśva dhāyāḥ asi parameṇa dhāmnā iti āha vṛṣṭiḥ vai viśva dhāyāḥ vṛṣṭim eva avarundhe dṛṃhasva mā hvār iti āha dhṛtyai

original: { 3.2.3.3} vasūnāṃ pavitram asīty āha | prāṇā vai vasavaḥ | teṣāṃ vā etad bhāgadheyam | yat pavitram | tebhya eva-enat karoti | śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāram ity āha | prāṇeṣv evāyur dadhāti sarvatvāya | trivṛt palāśaśākhāyāṃ darbhamayaṃ bhavati | trivṛd vai prāṇaḥ | trivṛtam eva prāṇaṃ madhyato yajamāne dadhāti |
analyzed: vasūnām pavitram asi iti āha prāṇāḥ vai vasavaḥ teṣām vai etat bhāgadheyam yat pavitram tebhyaḥ eva enat karoti śata dhāram sahasra dhāram iti āha prāṇeṣu eva āyuḥ dadhāti sarva tvāya trivṛt palāśa śākhāyām darbha mayam bhavati trivṛt vai prāṇaḥ trivṛtam eva prāṇam madhyatas yajamāne dadhāti

original: { 3.2.3.4} saumyaḥ parṇaḥ sayonitvāya | sākṣāt pavitraṃ darbhāḥ | prāk sāyam adhinidadhāti | tat prāṇāpānayo rūpam | tiryak prātaḥ | tad darśasya rūpam | dārśyaṃ hy etad ahaḥ | annaṃ vai candramāḥ | annaṃ prāṇāḥ | ubhayam eva-upaity ajāmitvāya |
analyzed: saumyaḥ parṇaḥ sayoni tvāya sākṣāt pavitram darbhāḥ prāk sāyam adhinidadhāti tat prāṇa apānayoḥ rūpam tiryak prātar tat darśasya rūpam dārśyam hi etat ahar annam vai candramāḥ annam prāṇāḥ ubhayam eva aupaiti ajāmi tvāya

original: { 3.2.3.5} tasmād ayaṃ sarvataḥ pavate | hutaḥ stoko huto drapsa ity āha pratiṣṭhityai | haviśo 'skandāya | na hi hutaṃ svāhākṛtaṃ skandati | divi nāko nāmāgniḥ | tasya vipruṣo bhāgadheyam | agnaye bṛhate nākāya-ity āha | nākam evāgniṃ bhāgadheyena samardhayati | svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām ity āha | dyāvāpṛthivyor eva-enat pratiṣṭhāpayati |
analyzed: tasmāt ayam sarvatas pavate hutaḥ stokaḥ hutaḥ drapsaḥ iti āha pratiṣṭhityai haviśaḥ skandāya na hi hutam svāhākṛtam skandati divi nākaḥ nāma agniḥ tasya vipruṣaḥ bhāgadheyam agnaye bṛhate nākāya eti āha nākam eva agnim bhāgadheyena samardhayati svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyām iti āha dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ eva enat pratiṣṭhāpayati

original: { 3.2.3.6} pavitravaty ānayati | apāṃ caiva-oṣadhīnāṃ ca rasaṃ saṃsṛjati | atho oṣadhīṣv eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati | anvārabhya vācaṃ yacchati | yajñasya dhṛtyai | dhārayann āste | dhārayanta iva hi duhanti | kām adhukṣa ity āha-ā tṛtīyasyai | traya ime lokāḥ | imān eva lokān yajamāno duhe |
analyzed: pavitravati ānayati apām ca eva oṣadhīnām ca rasam saṃsṛjati atha u oṣadhīṣu eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati anvārabhya vācam yacchati yajñasya dhṛtyai dhārayan āste dhārayantaḥ iva hi duhanti kām adhukṣaḥ iti āha ā tṛtīyasyai trayaḥ ime lokāḥ imān eva lokān yajamānaḥ duhe

original: { 3.2.3.7} amūm iti nāma gṛhṇāti | bhadram evāsāṃ karmāviṣkaroti | sā viśvāyuḥ sā viśvavyacāḥ sā viśvakarma-ity āha | iyaṃ vai viśvāyuḥ | antarikṣaṃ viśvavyacāḥ | asau viśvakarmā | imān eva-etābhir lokān yathāpūrvaṃ duhe | atho yathā pradātre puṇyam āśāste | evam eva-enā etad upastauti |
analyzed: amūm iti nāma gṛhṇāti bhadram eva āsām karma āviṣkaroti sā viśvāyuḥ sā viśva vyacāḥ sā viśva karmā iti āha iyam vai viśvāyuḥ antarikṣam viśva vyacāḥ asau viśva karmā imān eva etābhiḥ lokān yathāpūrvam duhe atha u yathā pradātre puṇyam āśāste evam eva enāḥ etat upastauti

original: tasmāt prādād ity unnīya vandamānā upastuvantaḥ paśūn duhanti |
analyzed: tasmāt prādāt iti unnīya vandamānāḥ upastuvantaḥ paśūn duhanti

original: { 3.2.3.8} bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyo havir iti vācaṃ visṛjate | yathādevatam eva prasauti | daivyasya ca mānuṣasya ca vyāvṛttyai | trir āha | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | avācaṃyamo 'nanvārabhya-uttarāḥ | aparimitam evāvarundhe | na dārupātreṇa duhyāt | agnivad vai dārupātram | yad dārupātreṇa duhyāt |
analyzed: bahu dugdhi indrāya devebhyaḥ haviḥ iti vācam visṛjate yathādevatam eva prasauti daivyasya ca mānuṣasya ca vyāvṛttyai tris āha triṣatyāḥ hi devāḥ avācaṃyamaḥ nanu ārabhya auttarāḥ aparimitam eva avarundhe na dāru pātreṇa duhyāt agnivat vai dāru pātram yat dāru pātreṇa duhyāt

original: { 3.2.3.9} yātayāmnā haviṣā yajeta | atho khalv āhuḥ | puroḍāśamukhāni vai havīṃṣi | na-itaitaḥ puroḍāśaṃ haviṣo yāmo 'stīti | kāmam eva dārupātreṇa duhyāt | śūdra eva na duhyāt | asato vā eṣa saṃbhūtaḥ | yat-śūdraḥ | ahavir eva tad ity āhuḥ | yat-śūdro dogdhīti |
analyzed: yātayāmnā haviṣā yajeta atha u khalu āhuḥ puroḍāśa mukhāni vai havīṃṣi puroḍāśam haviṣaḥ yāmaḥ u sti iti kāmam eva dāru pātreṇa duhyāt śūdraḥ eva na duhyāt asataḥ vai eṣa saṃbhūtaḥ yat śūdraḥ a haviḥ eva tat iti āhuḥ yat śūdraḥ dogdhi iti

original: { 3.2.3.10} agnihotram eva na duhyāt-śūdraḥ | tad dhi na-utpunanti | yadā khalu vai pavitram atyeti | atha tad dhavir iti | saṃpṛcyadhvam ṛtāvarīr ity āha | apāṃ caiva-oṣadhīnāṃ ca rasaṃ saṃsṛjati | tasmād apāṃ ca-oṣadhīnāṃ ca rasam upajīvāmaḥ | mandrā dhanasya sātaya ity āha | puṣṭim eva yajamāne dadhāti | somena tvātanacmīndrāya dadhīty āha |
analyzed: agnihotram eva na duhyāt śūdraḥ tat hi na utpunanti yadā khalu vai pavitram atyeti atha tat haviḥ iti saṃpṛcyadhvam ṛtāvarīḥ iti āha apām ca eva oṣadhīnām ca rasam saṃsṛjati tasmāt apām ca oṣadhīnām ca rasam upajīvāmaḥ mandrāḥ dhanasya sātaye iti āha puṣṭim eva yajamāne dadhāti somena tvā atanacmi indrāya dadhi iti āha

original: { 3.2.3.11} somam eva-enat karoti | yo vai somaṃ bhakṣayitvā | saṃvatsaraṃ somaṃ na pibati | punarbhakṣyo 'sya somapītho bhavati | somaḥ khalu vai sāṃnāyyam | ya evaṃ vidvānt sāṃnāyyaṃ pibati | apunarbhakṣyo 'sya somapītho bhavati | na mṛnmayenāpidadhyāt | yan mṛnmayenāpidadhyāt | pitṛdevatyaṃ syāt |
analyzed: somam eva enat karoti yaḥ vai somam bhakṣayitvā saṃvatsaram somam na pibati punar bhakṣyaḥ sya soma pīthaḥ bhavati somaḥ khalu vai sāṃnāyyam yaḥ evam vidvān sāṃnāyyam pibati a punar bhakṣyaḥ sya soma pīthaḥ bhavati na mṛd mayena apidadhyāt yat mṛd mayena apidadhyāt pitṛ devatyam syāt

original: { 3.2.3.12} ayaspātreṇa vā dārupātreṇa vā-apidadhāti | tad dhi sadevam | udanvad bhavati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ | rakṣasām apahatyai | adastam asi viṣṇave tvā-ity āha | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñāya-eva-enad adastaṃ karoti | viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasva-ity āha guptyai | anadhaḥ sādayati | garbhāṇāṃ dhṛtyā aprapādāya | tasmād garbhāḥ prajānām aprapādukāḥ |
analyzed: ayaspātreṇa vā dāru pātreṇa vā apidadhāti tat hi sa devam udanvat bhavati āpaḥ vai rakṣaḥ ghnīḥ rakṣasām apahatyai a dastam asi viṣṇave tvā iti āha yajñaḥ vai viṣṇuḥ yajñāya eva enat a dastam karoti viṣṇo havyam rakṣasva iti āha guptyai anadhas sādayati garbhāṇām dhṛtyai a prapādāya tasmāt garbhāḥ prajānām a prapādukāḥ

original: uparīva nidadhāti | uparīva hi suvargo lokaḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai |
analyzed: upari iva nidadhāti upari iva hi suvargaḥ lokaḥ suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

original: anuvāka 4 { 3.2.4.1} karmaṇe vāṃ devebhyaś śakeyam ity āha śaktyai | yajñasya vai saṃtatim anu prajāḥ paśavo yajamānasya saṃtāyante | yajñasya vicchittim anu prajāḥ paśavo yajamānasya vicchidyante | yajñasya saṃtatir asi yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi saṃtatyai tvā yajñasya-ity ā-āhavanīyāt saṃtanoti | yajamānasya prajāyai paśūnāṃ saṃtatyai |
analyzed: karmaṇe vām devebhyaḥ śakeyam iti āha śaktyai yajñasya vai saṃtatim anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ yajamānasya saṃtāyante yajñasya vicchittim anu prajāḥ paśavaḥ yajamānasya vicchidyante yajñasya saṃtatiḥ asi yajñasya tvā saṃtatyai stṛṇāmi saṃtatyai tvā yajñasya iti ā āhavanīyāt saṃtanoti yajamānasya prajāyai paśūnām saṃtatyai

original: apaḥ praṇayati | śraddhā vā āpaḥ śraddhām evā''rabhya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | yajño vā āpaḥ |
analyzed: apaḥ praṇayati śraddhā vai āpaḥ śraddhām eva ārabhya praṇīya pracarati apaḥ praṇayati yajñaḥ vai āpaḥ

original: { 3.2.4.2} yajñam evā''rabhya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | vajro vā āpaḥ | vajram eva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ prahṛtya praṇīya pracarati | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ | rakṣasām apahatyai | apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai devānāṃ priyaṃ dhāma | devānām eva priyaṃ dhāma praṇīya pracarati |
analyzed: yajñam eva ārabhya praṇīya pracarati apaḥ praṇayati vajraḥ vai āpaḥ vajram eva bhrātṛvyebhyaḥ prahṛtya praṇīya pracarati apaḥ praṇayati āpaḥ vai rakṣaḥ ghnīḥ rakṣasām apahatyai apaḥ praṇayati āpaḥ vai devānām priyam dhāma devānām eva priyam dhāma praṇīya pracarati

original: { 3.2.4.3} apaḥ praṇayati | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatā evārabhya praṇīya pracarati | veṣāya tvā-ity āha | veṣāya hy enad ādatte | pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity āha | rakṣasām apahatyai | dhūr asīty āha | eṣa vai dhuryo 'gniḥ | taṃ yad anupaspṛśyātīyāt |
analyzed: apaḥ praṇayati āpaḥ vai sarvāḥ devatāḥ devatāḥ eva ārabhya praṇīya pracarati veṣāya tvā iti āha veṣāya hi enat ādatte pratyuṣṭam rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭāḥ arātayaḥ iti āha rakṣasām apahatyai dhūḥ asi iti āha eṣa vai dhuryaḥ gniḥ tam yat an upaspṛśya atīyāt

original: { 3.2.4.4} adhvaryuṃ ca yajamānaṃ ca pradahet | upaspṛśyātyeti | adhvaryoś ca yajamānasya cāpradāhāya | dhūrva {ānaṃdā. dhūrvan} taṃ yo 'smān dhūrvati taṃ dhūrva yaṃ vayaṃ dhūrvāma ity āha | dvau vāva puruṣau | yaṃ caiva dhūrvati | yas cainaṃ dhūrvati | tāv ubhau śucā-arpayati |
analyzed: adhvaryum ca yajamānam ca pradahet upaspṛśya atyeti adhvaryoḥ ca yajamānasya ca a pradāhāya dhūrve ānandāḥ dhūrvan tam yaḥ smān dhūrvati tam dhūrva yam vayam dhūrvāmaḥ iti āha dvau vāva puruṣau yam ca eva dhūrvati yaḥ ca enam dhūrvati tau ubhau śucā arpayati

original: tvaṃ devānām asi sasnitamaṃ papritamaṃ juṣṭatamaṃ vahnitamaṃ devahūtamam ity āha | yathāyajur eva-etat |
analyzed: tvam devānām asi sasnitamam papritamam juṣṭatamam vahnitamam devahūtamam iti āha yathāyajus eva etat

original: { 3.2.4.5} ahrutam asi havirdhānam ity āha-anārtyai | dṛṃhasva mā hvār ity āha dhṛtyai | mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣa ity āha mitratvāya | mā bher mā saṃvikthā mā tvā hiṃsiṣam ity āhāhiṃsāyai | yad vai kiṃ ca vāto na-abhivāti | tat sarvaṃ varuṇadevatyam | uru vātāya-ity āha | avāruṇam eva-enat karoti |
analyzed: ahrutam asi havirdhānam iti āha anārtyai dṛṃhasva mā hvār iti āha dhṛtyai mitrasya tvā cakṣuṣā prekṣe iti āha mitra tvāya mā bheḥ mā saṃvikthāḥ mā tvā hiṃsiṣam iti āha ahiṃsāyai yat vai kim ca vātaḥ na abhivāti tat sarvam varuṇa devatyam uru vātāya iti āha avāruṇam eva enat karoti

original: devasya tvā savituḥ prasava ity āha prasūtyai | aśvinor bāhubhyām ity āha |
analyzed: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti āha prasūtyai aśvinoḥ bāhubhyām iti āha

original: { 3.2.4.6} aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyām ity āha | yatyai | agnaye juṣṭaṃ nirvapāmīty āha | agnaya eva-enāñ juṣṭaṃ nirvapati | trir yajuṣā | traya ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānām āptyai | tūṣṇīṃ caturtham | aparimitam eva-avarundhe | sa evam eva-anupūrvaṃ havīṃṣi nirvapati |
analyzed: aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām pūṣṇaḥ hastābhyām iti āha yatyai agnaye juṣṭam nirvapāmi iti āha agnaye eva enān juṣṭam nirvapati tris yajuṣā trayaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣām lokānām āptyai tūṣṇīm caturtham aparimitam eva avarundhe saḥ evam eva anupūrvam havīṃṣi nirvapati

original: { 3.2.4.7} idaṃ devānām idam u naḥ saha-ity āha vyāvṛttyai | sphātyai tvā na-arātyā ity āha guptyai | tamasīva vā eṣo 'ntaś carati | yaḥ parīṇahi | suvar abhi vikhyeṣaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ jyotir ity āha | suvar eva-abhi vipaśyati vaiśvānaraṃ jyotiḥ | dyāvāpṛthivī haviṣi gṛhīta udavepetām | dṛṃhantāṃ duryā dyāvāpṛthivyor ity āha |
analyzed: idam devānām idam u naḥ saha eti āha vyāvṛttyai sphātyai tvā na arātyai iti āha guptyai tamasi iva vai eṣaḥ ntar carati yaḥ parīṇahi suvar abhi vikhyeṣam vaiśvānaram jyotiḥ iti āha suvar eva abhi vipaśyati vaiśvānaram jyotiḥ dyāvāpṛthivī haviṣi gṛhīte udavepetām dṛṃhantām duryāḥ dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ iti āha

original: gṛhāṇāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyor dhṛtyai | urv antarikṣam anvihīty āha gatyai | adityās tvā-upasthe sādayāmīty āha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā eva-enad upasthe sādayati | agne havyaṃ rakṣasva-ity āha guptyai |
analyzed: gṛhāṇām dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ dhṛtyai uru antarikṣam anvihi iti āha gatyai adityāḥ tvā upasthe sādayāmi iti āha iyam vai aditiḥ asyāḥ eva enat upasthe sādayati agne havyam rakṣasva eti āha guptyai

original: anuvāka 5 { 3.2.5.1} indro vṛtram ahann | so 'paḥ | abhyamriyata | tāsāṃ yan medhyaṃ yajñiyaṃ sadevam āsīt | tad apodakrāmat | te darbhā abhavann | yad darbhair apa utpunāti | yā eva medhyā yajñiyāḥ sadevā āpaḥ | tābhir eva-enā utpunāti | dvābhyām utpunāti |
analyzed: indraḥ vṛtram ahan saḥ paḥ abhyamriyata tāsām yat medhyam yajñiyam sa devam āsīt tat apodakrāmat te darbhāḥ abhavan yat darbhaiḥ apaḥ utpunāti yāḥ eva medhyāḥ yajñiyāḥ sa devāḥ āpaḥ tābhiḥ eva enāḥ utpunāti dvābhyām utpunāti

original: { 3.2.5.2} dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | devo vaḥ savitā-utpunātv ity āha | savitṛprasūta eva-enā utpunāti | acchidreṇa pavitreṇā-ity āha | asau vā adityo 'cchidraṃ pavitram | tena-eva-enā utpunāti | vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhir ity āha | prāṇā vā āpaḥ { |} prāṇā vasavaḥ | prāṇā raśmayaḥ |
analyzed: dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai devaḥ vaḥ savitā utpunātu iti āha savitṛ prasūtaḥ eva enāḥ utpunāti acchidreṇa pavitreṇa iti āha asau vai adityā u chidram pavitram tena eva enāḥ utpunāti vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ iti āha prāṇāḥ vai āpaḥ prāṇāḥ vasavaḥ prāṇāḥ raśmayaḥ

original: { 3.2.5.3} prāṇair eva prāṇānt saṃpṛṇakti | sāvitriyā-ṛcā | savitṛprasūtaṃ me karmāsad iti | savitṛprasūtam eva-asya karma bhavati | paccho gāyatriyā triṣṣamṛddhatvāya | āpo devīr agrepuvo agreguva ity āha | rūpam evā''sām etan mahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | agra imaṃ yajñaṃ nayatāgre yajñapatim ity āha | agre eva yajñaṃ nayanti | agre yajñapatim |
analyzed: prāṇaiḥ eva prāṇān saṃpṛṇakti sāvitriyā ṛcā savitṛ prasūtam me karma asat iti savitṛ prasūtam eva asya karma bhavati pacchas gāyatriyā āpaḥ devīḥ agrepuvaḥ agreguvaḥ iti āha rūpam eva āsām etat mahimānam vyācaṣṭe agre imam yajñam nayata agre yajñapatim iti āha agre eva yajñam nayanti agre yajñapatim

original: { 3.2.5.4} yuṣmān indro 'vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyam indram avṛṇīdhvaṃ vṛtratūrya ity āha | vṛtraṃ ha haniṣyann indra āpo vavre | āpo ha-indraṃ vavrire | saṃjñām evā''sām etat sāmānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | prokṣitāḥ stha-ity āha | tenāpaḥ prokṣitāḥ | agnaye vo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmy agnīṣomābhyām ity āha | yathādevatam eva-enān prokṣati | triḥ prokṣati |
analyzed: yuṣmān indraḥ vṛṇīta vṛtratūrye yūyam indram avṛṇīdhvam vṛtratūrye iti āha vṛtram ha haniṣyan indraḥ āpaḥ vavre āpaḥ ha aindram vavrire saṃjñām eva āsām etat sāmānam vyācaṣṭe prokṣitāḥ stha eti āha tena apaḥ prokṣitāḥ agnaye vaḥ juṣṭam prokṣāmi agnīṣomābhyām iti āha yathādevatam eva enān prokṣati tris prokṣati

original: tryāvṛd dhi yajñaḥ |
analyzed: tri āvṛt hi yajñaḥ

original: { 3.2.5.5} atho rakṣasām apahatyai | śundhadhvaṃ daivyāya karmaṇe devayajyāyā ity āha | devayajyāyā eva-enāni śundhati | triḥ prokṣati | tryāvṛd dhi yajñaḥ | atho medhyatvāya | avadhūtaṃ rakṣo 'vadhūtā arātaya ity āha | rakṣasām apahatyai | adityās tvag asīty āha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ |
analyzed: atha u rakṣasām apahatyai śundhadhvam daivyāya karmaṇe deva yajyāyai iti āha deva yajyāyai eva enāni śundhati tris prokṣati tri āvṛt hi yajñaḥ atha u medhya tvāya avadhūtam rakṣaḥ vadhūtāḥ arātayaḥ iti āha rakṣasām apahatyai adityāḥ tvac asi iti āha iyam vai aditiḥ

original: { 3.2.5.6} asyā eva-enat tvacaṃ karoti | prati tvā pṛthivī vettv {ānaṃdā. vetv} ity āha pratiṣṭhityai | purastāt pratīcīnagrīvam uttaraloma-upastṛṇāti medhyatvāya | tasmāt purastāt pratyañcaḥ paśāvo medham upatiṣṭhante | tasmāt prajā mṛgaṃ grāhukāḥ | yajño devebhyo nilāyata | kṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | yat kṛṣṇājine havir adhyavahanti |
analyzed: asyāḥ eva enat tvacam karoti prati tvā pṛthivī vettu ānaṃdā vetu iti āha pratiṣṭhityai purastāt pratīcīna grīvam uttara loma upastṛṇāti medhya tvāya tasmāt purastāt pratyañcaḥ paśāvaḥ medham upatiṣṭhante tasmāt prajāḥ mṛgam grāhukāḥ yajñaḥ devebhyaḥ nilāyata kṛṣṇaḥ rūpam kṛtvā yat kṛṣṇājine haviḥ adhyavahanti

original: yajñād eva tad yajñaṃ prayuṅkte | haviṣo 'skandāya |
analyzed: yajñāt eva tat yajñam prayuṅkte haviṣaḥ skandāya

original: { 3.2.5.7} adhiṣavaṇam asi vānaspatyam ity āha | adhiṣavaṇam eva-enat karoti | prati tvā-ādityās tvag vettv {ānaṃdā. vetv} ity āha sayatvāya | agnes tanūr asīty āha | agner vā eṣā tanūḥ | yad oṣadhayaḥ | vāco visarjanam ity āha | yadā hi prajā oṣadhīnām aśnanti | atha vācaṃ visṛjante | devavītaye tvā gṛhṇāmīty āha |
analyzed: adhiṣavaṇam asi vānaspatyam iti āha adhiṣavaṇam eva enat karoti prati tvā ādityāḥ tvac vettu ānaṃdā vetu iti āha sayatvāya agneḥ tanūḥ asi iti āha agneḥ vai eṣā tanūḥ yat oṣadhayaḥ vācaḥ visarjanam iti āha yadā hi prajāḥ oṣadhīnām aśnanti atha vācam visṛjante deva vītaye tvā gṛhṇāmi iti āha

original: { 3.2.5.8} devatābhir eva-enat samardhayati | adrir asi vānaspatya ity āha | grāvāṇam eva-enat karoti | sa idaṃ devebhyo havyaṃ suśami śamiṣva-ity āha śāntyai | haviṣkṛd ehīty āha | ya eva devānāṃ haviṣkṛtaḥ | tān hvyati | trir hvayati | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | iṣam āvada-ūrjam āvada-ity āha |
analyzed: devatābhiḥ eva enat samardhayati adriḥ asi vānaspatyaḥ iti āha grāvāṇam eva enat karoti saḥ idam devebhyaḥ havyam suśami śamiṣva eti āha śāntyai haviṣkṛt ehi iti āha ye eva devānām haviṣkṛtaḥ tān hvyati tris hvayati triṣatyāḥ hi devāḥ iṣam āvada ūrjam āvada iti āha

original: { 3.2.5.9} iṣam eva-ūrjaṃ yajamāne dadhāti | dyumad vadata vayaṃ saṃghātaṃ jeṣma-ity āha bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | manoḥ śraddhādevasya yajamānasya-asuraghnī vāk | yajñāyudheṣu praviṣṭāsīt | te 'surā yāvanto yajñāyudhānām udvadatām upāśṛṇvann | te parābhavan | tasmāt svānāṃ madhye 'vasāya yajeta |
analyzed: iṣam eva ūrjam yajamāne dadhāti dyumat vadata vayam saṃghātam jeṣma iti āha bhrātṛvya abhibhūtyai manoḥ śraddhādevasya yajamānasya asura ghnī vāc yajñāyudheṣu praviṣṭā āsīt te surāḥ yāvantaḥ yajñāyudhānām udvadatām upāśṛṇvan te parābhavan tasmāt svānām madhye vasāya yajeta

original: yāvanto 'sya bhrātṛvyā yajñāyudhānām udvadatām upaśṛṇvanti | te parābhavanti | uccaiḥ samāhantavā āha vijityai |
analyzed: yāvantaḥ sya bhrātṛvyāḥ yajñāyudhānām udvadatām upaśṛṇvanti te parābhavanti uccais samāhantavai āha vijityai

original: { 3.2.5.10} vṛṅkta eṣām indriyaṃ vīryam | śreṣṭha eṣāṃ bhavati | varṣavṛddham asi prati tvā varṣavṛddhaṃ vettv {ānaṃdā. vetv} ity āha | varṣavṛddhā vā oṣadhayaḥ | varṣavṛddhā iṣīkāḥ samṛddhyai | yajñaṃ rakṣāṃsy anu prāviśan | tāny asnā paśubhyo niravādayanta | tuṣair oṣadhībhyaḥ | parāpūtaṃ rakṣaḥ parāpūtā arātaya ity āha | rakṣasām apahatyai |

original: { 3.2.8.9} prāṇāḥ paśavaḥ | prāṇair eva paśūnt saṃpṛṇakti | na pramāyukā bhavanti | yajamāno vai puroḍāśaḥ | prajā paśavaḥ purīṣam | yad evam abhivāsayati | yajamānam eva prajayā paśubhiḥ samardhayati | devā vai havir bhṛtvā {ḍyumoṇṭa mṛtvā?}-abruvann | kasminn idaṃ mrakṣyāmaha iti | so 'gnir abravīt |
analyzed: prāṇāḥ paśavaḥ prāṇaiḥ eva paśūn saṃpṛṇakti na pramāyukāḥ bhavanti yajamānaḥ vai puroḍāśaḥ prajā paśavaḥ purīṣam yat evam abhivāsayati yajamānam eva prajayā paśubhiḥ samardhayati devāḥ vai haviḥ bhṛtvā mṛtvā abruvan kasmin idam mrakṣyāmahe iti saḥ agniḥ abravīt

original: { 3.2.8.10} mayi tanūḥ saṃ nidhaddhvam { nidhadhvam} | ahaṃ vas taṃ janayiṣyāmi | yasmin mrakṣyadhva iti | te devā agnau tanūḥ saṃ nyadadhata | tasmād āhuḥ | agniḥ sarvā devatā iti | so 'ṅgāreṇāpaḥ | abhyapātayat | tata ekato 'jāyata | sa dvitīyam abhyapātayat |
analyzed: mayi tanūḥ sam nidhaddhvam nidhadhvam aham vaḥ tam janayiṣyāmi yasmin mrakṣyadhve iti te devāḥ agnau tanūḥ sam nyadadhata tasmāt āhuḥ agniḥ sarvāḥ devatāḥ iti saḥ u ṅgāreṇa apaḥ abhyapātayat tatas ekatas jāyata sa dvitīyam abhyapātayat

original: { 3.2.8.11} tato dvito 'jāyata | sa tṛtīyam abhyapātayat | tatas trito 'jāyata | yad adbhyo 'jāyanta | tad āpyānām āpyatvam | yad ātmabhyo 'jāyanta | tad ātmyānām ātmyatvam | te devā āpyeṣv amṛjata | āpyā amṛjata sūryābhyudite | sūryābhyuditaḥ sūryābhinimrukte |
analyzed: tatas dvitaḥ jāyata sa tṛtīyam abhyapātayat tatas tritaḥ jāyata yat adbhyaḥ jāyanta tat āpyānām āpya tvam yat ātmabhyaḥ jāyanta tat ātmyānām ātmya tvam te devāḥ āpyeṣu amṛjata āpyāḥ amṛjata sūrya abhyudite sūrya abhyuditaḥ sūrya abhinimrukte

original: { 3.2.8.12} sūryābhinimruktaḥ kunakhini | kunakhī śyāvadati | śyāvadann agradidhiṣau | agradidhiṣuḥ parivitte | parivitto vīrahaṇi | vīrahā brahmahaṇi tad brahmahaṇaṃ na-atyacyavata | antarvedi ninayaty avarudhyai | ulmukena-abhigṛhṇāti śṛtatvāya | śṛtakāmā iva hi devāḥ |
analyzed: sūrya abhinimruktaḥ kunakhini kunakhī śyāvadati śyāvadan agradidhiṣau agradidhiṣuḥ parivitte parivittaḥ vīra haṇi vīra hā brahma haṇi tat brahma haṇam na atyacyavata antarvedi ninayati avarudhyai ulmukena abhigṛhṇāti śṛta tvāya śṛta kāmāḥ iva hi devāḥ

original: anuvāka 9 { 3.2.9.1} devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti sphyam ādatte prasūtyai | aśvinor bāhubhyām ity āha | aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyām ity āha yatyai | ādada indrasya bāhur asi dakṣiṇa ity āha | indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti | sahasrabhṛṣṭiḥ śatatejā ity āha | rūpam eva-asyaitan mahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe |
analyzed: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti sphyam ādatte prasūtyai aśvinoḥ bāhubhyām iti āha aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām pūṣṇaḥ hastābhyām iti āha yatyai ādade indrasya bāhuḥ asi dakṣiṇaḥ iti āha indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti sahasra bhṛṣṭiḥ śata tejāḥ iti āha rūpam eva asya etat mahimānam vyācaṣṭe

original: vāyur asi tigmatejā ity āha | tejo vai vāyuḥ |
analyzed: vāyuḥ asi tigma tejāḥ iti āha tejaḥ vai vāyuḥ

original: { 3.2.9.2} teja eva-asmin dadhāti | viṣād vai nāma-āsura āsīt | so 'bibhet | yajñena mā devā abhibhaviṣyantīti | sa pṛthivīm abhyavamīt | somedhyā-abhavat | atho yad indro vṛtram ahan | tasya lohitaṃ pṛthivīm anu vyadhāvat | somedhyā-abhavat | pṛthivi devayajanīty āha |
analyzed: tejaḥ eva asmin dadhāti viṣāt vai nāma āsuraḥ āsīt saḥ bibhet yajñena mā devāḥ abhibhaviṣyanti iti sa pṛthivīm abhyavamīt sā umedhyā abhavat atha u yat indraḥ vṛtram ahan tasya lohitam pṛthivīm anu vyadhāvat sā umedhyā abhavat pṛthivi deva yajani iti āha

original: { 3.2.9.3} medhyām eva-enāṃ devayajanīṃ karoti | oṣadhyās te mūlaṃ mā hiṃsiṣam ity āha | oṣadhīnām ahiṃsāyai | vrajaṃ gaccha gosthānam ity āha | chandāṃsi vai vrajo gosthānaḥ | chandāṃsy eva-asmai vrajaṃ gosthānaṃ karoti | varṣatu te dyaur ity āha | vṛṣṭir vai dyauḥ | vṛṣṭim eva-avarundhe | badhāna deva savitaḥ paramasyāṃ parāvatīty āha |
analyzed: medhyām eva enām devayajanīm karoti oṣadhyāḥ te mūlam mā hiṃsiṣam iti āha oṣadhīnām ahiṃsāyai vrajam gaccha go sthānam iti āha chandāṃsi vai vrajaḥ go sthānaḥ chandāṃsi eva asmai vrajam go sthānam karoti varṣatu te dyauḥ iti āha vṛṣṭiḥ vai dyauḥ vṛṣṭim eva avarundhe badhāna deva savitar paramasyām parāvati iti āha

original: { 3.2.9.4} dvau vāva puruṣau | yaṃ caiva dveṣṭi | yaś cainaṃ dveṣṭi | tāv ubhau badhnāti paramasyāṃ parāvati śatena pāśaiḥ | yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas tam ato mā maug ity āhānimruktyai {ḍyumoṇṭa āhānirmuktyai} | ararur vai nāma-āsura āsīt | sa pṛthivyām upamlupto 'śayat | taṃ devā apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā iti pṛthivyā apāghnann |
analyzed: dvau vāva puruṣau yam ca eva dveṣṭi yaḥ ca enam dveṣṭi tau ubhau badhnāti paramasyām parāvati śatena pāśaiḥ smān dveṣṭi yam ca vayam dviṣmaḥ tam atas mā mauk iti āha a nimruktyai ḍyumoṇṭaḥ āha a nirmuktyai araruḥ vai nāma a asuraḥ āsīt sa pṛthivyām upamluptaḥ śayat tam devāḥ apahataḥ raruḥ pṛthivyāḥ iti pṛthivyāḥ apāghnan

original: bhrātṛvyo vā araruḥ | apahato 'raruḥ pṛthivyā iti yad āha |
analyzed: bhrātṛvyaḥ vai araruḥ apahataḥ raruḥ pṛthivyāḥ iti yat āha

original: { 3.2.9.5} bhrātṛvyam eva pṛthivyā apahanti | te 'manyanta | divaṃ vā ayam itaḥ patiṣyatīti | tam araruste divaṃ mā skān iti divaḥ paryabādhanta | bhrātṛvyo vā araruḥ | ararus te divaṃ mā skān iti yad āha | bhrātṛvyam eva divaḥ paribādhate | stambayajur harati | pṛthivyā eva bhrātṛvyam apahanti | dvitīyaṃ harati |
analyzed: bhrātṛvyam eva pṛthivyāḥ apahanti te manyanta divam vai ayam itas patiṣyati iti tam araruḥ te divam mā skān iti divaḥ paryabādhanta bhrātṛvyaḥ vai araruḥ araruḥ te divam mā skān iti yat āha bhrātṛvyam eva divaḥ paribādhate stambayajuḥ harati pṛthivyāḥ eva bhrātṛvyam apahanti dvitīyam harati

original: { 3.2.9.6} antarikṣād eva-enam apahanti | tṛtīyaṃ harati | diva eva-enam apahanti | tūṣṇīṃ caturthaṃ harati | aparimitād eva-enam apahanti | asurāṇāṃ vā iyam agra āsīt | yāvad āsīnaḥ parāpaśyati | tāvad devānām | te devā abruvan | astv eva no 'syām apīti |
analyzed: antarikṣāt eva enam apahanti tṛtīyam harati divaḥ eva enam apahanti tūṣṇīm caturtham harati aparimitāt eva enam apahanti asurāṇām vai iyam agre āsīt yāvat āsīnaḥ parāpaśyati tāvat devānām te devāḥ abruvan astu eva naḥ syām api iti

original: { 3.2.9.7} kyan no dāsyatha-iti | yāvat svayaṃ parigṛhṇītha-iti | te vasavas tvā-iti dakṣiṇataḥ paryagṛhṇann | rudrās tvā-iti paścāt | ādityās tvā-ity uttarataḥ | te 'gninā prāñco 'jayann | vasubhir dakṣiṇā | rudraiḥ pratyañcaḥ | ādityair udañcaḥ | yasyaivaṃ viduṣo vediṃ parigṛhṇanti |
analyzed: kyat naḥ dāsyatha eti yāvat svayam parigṛhṇītha eti te vasavaḥ tvā iti dakṣiṇatas paryagṛhṇan rudrāḥ tvā iti paścāt ādityāḥ tvā iti uttaratas te gninā prāñcaḥ jayan vasubhiḥ dakṣiṇāḥ rudraiḥ pratyañcaḥ ādityaiḥ udañcaḥ yasya evam viduṣaḥ vedim parigṛhṇanti

original: { 3.2.9.8} bhavaty ātmanā | parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | devasya savituḥ sava ity āha prasūtyai | karma kṛṇvanti vedhasa ity āha | iṣitaṃ hi karma kriyate | pṛthivyai medhyaṃ cāmedhyaṃ ca vyudakrāmatām | prācīnam udīcīnaṃ medhyam | pratīcīnaṃ dakṣiṇā-amedhyam | prācīm udīcīṃ pravaṇāṃ karoti | medhyām eva-enāṃ devayajanīṃ karoti |
analyzed: bhavati ātmanā parā asya bhrātṛvyaḥ bhavati devasya savituḥ save iti āha prasūtyai karma kṛṇvanti vedhasaḥ iti āha iṣitam hi karma kriyate pṛthivyai medhyam ca amedhyam ca vyudakrāmatām prācīnam udīcīnam medhyam pratīcīnam dakṣiṇā amedhyam prācīm udīcīm pravaṇām karoti medhyām eva enām devayajanīm karoti

original: { 3.2.9.9} prāñcau vedyaṃsāv unnayati | āhavanīyasya parigṛhītyai | pratīcī śroṇī | gārhapatyasya parigṛhītyai | atho mithunatvāya | uddhanti | yad evāsyā amedhyam | tad apahanti | uddhanti tasmād oṣadhayaḥ parābhavanti |
analyzed: prāñcau vedi aṃsau unnayati āhavanīyasya parigṛhītyai pratīcī śroṇī gārhapatyasya parigṛhītyai atha u mithuna tvāya uddhanti yat eva asyāḥ amedhyam tat apahanti uddhanti tasmāt oṣadhayaḥ parābhavanti

original: { 3.2.9.10} mūlaṃ cchinatti | bhrātṛvyasyaiva mūlaṃ cchinatti | mūlaṃ vā atitiṣṭhad rakṣāṃsy anu-utpipate | yad dhastena chindyāt | kunakhinīḥ prajāḥ syuḥ | sphyena cchinatti | vajro vai sphyaḥ | vajreṇaiva yajñād rakṣāṃsy apahanti | pitṛdevatyā-atikhātā | iyatīṃ khanati |
analyzed: mūlam chinatti bhrātṛvyasya eva mūlam chinatti mūlam vai atitiṣṭhat rakṣāṃsi anuutpipate yat hastena chindyāt kunakhinīḥ prajāḥ syuḥ sphyena chinatti vajraḥ vai sphyaḥ vajreṇa eva yajñāt rakṣāṃsi apahanti pitṛ devatyāḥ atikhātāḥ iyatīm khanati

original: { 3.2.9.11} prajāpatinā yajñamukhena saṃmitām | vedir devebhyo nilāyata | tāṃ caturaṅgule 'nvavindann | tasmāc caturaṅgulaṃ kheyā | caturaṅgulaṃ khanati | caturaṅgule hy oṣadhayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | ā pratiṣṭhāyai khanati | yajamānam eva pratiṣṭhāṃ gamayati | dakṣiṇato varṣīyasīṃ karoti | devayajanasyaiva rūpam akaḥ |
analyzed: prajāpatinā yajña mukhena saṃmitām vediḥ devebhyaḥ nilāyata tām catur aṅgule nvavindan tasmāt catur aṅgulam kheyā catur aṅgulam khanati catur aṅgule hi oṣadhayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ā pratiṣṭhāyai khanati yajamānam eva pratiṣṭhām gamayati dakṣiṇatas varṣīyasīm karoti devayajanasya eva rūpam akaḥ

original: { 3.2.9.12} purīṣavatīṃ karoti | prajā vai paśavaḥ purīṣam | prajayā-evainaṃ paśubhiḥ purīṣavantaṃ karoti | uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti | etāvatī vai pṛthivī | yāvatī vediḥ | tasyā etāvata eva bhrātṛvyaṃ nirbhajya | ātmana uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti | ṛtam asy ṛtasadanam asy ṛtaśrīr asīty āha | yathāyajur evaitat |
analyzed: purīṣavatīm karoti prajāḥ vai paśavaḥ purīṣam prajayā eva enam paśubhiḥ purīṣavantam karoti uttaram parigrāham parigṛhṇāti etāvatī vai pṛthivī yāvatī vediḥ tasyāḥ etāvataḥ eva bhrātṛvyam nirbhajya ātmanaḥ uttaram parigrāham parigṛhṇāti ṛtam asi ṛta sadanam asi ṛta śrīḥ asi iti āha yathāyajus eva etat

original: { 3.2.9.13} krūram iva vā etat karoti | yad vediṃ karoti | dhā asi svadhā asīti yoyupyate śāntyai | urvī cāsi vasvī cāsīty āha | urvīm evaināṃ vasvīṃ karoti | purā krūrasya visṛpo virapśinn ity āha medhyatvāya | udādāya pṛthivīṃ jīradānur yām airayan candramasi svadhābhir ity āha | yad evāsyā amedhyam | tad apahatya | medhyāṃ devayajanīṃ kṛtvā |
analyzed: krūram iva vai etat karoti yat vedim karoti dhāḥ asi svadhā asi iti yoyupyate śāntyai urvī ca asi vasvī ca asi iti āha urvīm eva enām vasvīm karoti purā krūrasya visṛpaḥ virapśin iti āha medhya tvāya udādāya pṛthivīm jīra dānuḥ yām airayan candramasi svadhābhiḥ iti āha yat eva asyāḥ amedhyam tat apahatya medhyām devayajanīm kṛtvā

original: { 3.2.9.81} yad adaś candramasi medhyam | tad asyām erayati | tāṃ dhīrāso anudṛśya yajanta ity āhānukhyātyai | {j} prokṣaṇīr āsādaya | idhmābarhir upasādaya | sruvaṃ ca srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi | patnīṃ saṃnahya | ājyena-udehīty āhānupūrvatāyai | prokṣaṇīr āsādayati | āpo vai rakṣoghnīḥ |
analyzed: yat adaḥ candramasi medhyam tat asyām erayati tām dhīrāsaḥ anudṛśya yajante iti āha anukhyātyai j prokṣaṇīḥ āsādaya idhmābarhiḥ upasādaya sruvam ca srucaḥ ca saṃmṛḍḍhi patnīm saṃnahya ājyena odehi iti āha anupūrva tāyai prokṣaṇīḥ āsādayati āpaḥ vai rakṣaḥ ghnīḥ

original: { 3.2.9.15} rakṣasām apahatyai | sphyasya vartmant sādayati | yajñasya saṃtatyai | uvāca hāsito daivalaḥ | etāvatīr vā amuṣmin-loka āpa āsann | yāvatīḥ prokṣaṇīr iti | tasmād bahvīr āsādyāḥ | sphyam udasyan | yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet | śucā-evainam arpayati |
analyzed: rakṣasām apahatyai sphyasya vartman sādayati yajñasya saṃtatyai uvāca ha asitaḥ daivalaḥ etāvatīḥ vai amuṣmin loke āpaḥ āsan yāvatīḥ prokṣaṇīḥ iti tasmāt bahvīḥ āsādyāḥ sphyam udasyan yam dviṣyāt tam dhyāyet śucā eva enam arpayati

original: anuvāka 10 { 3.2.10.1} vajro vai sphyaḥ | yad anvañcaṃ dhārayet | vajre 'dhvaryuḥ kṣaṇvīta | purastāt tiryañcaṃ dhārayati | varjo vai sphyaḥ | vajreṇaiva yajñasya dakṣiṇato rakṣāṃsy apahanti | agnibhyāṃ prācaś ca pratīcaś ca | sphyena-udīcaś ca-adharācaś ca | sphyena vā eṣa vajreṇāsyai pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam apahatya | utkare 'dhi pravṛścati |
analyzed: vajraḥ vai sphyaḥ yat anvañcam dhārayet vajre dhvaryuḥ kṣaṇvīta purastāt tiryañcam dhārayati varjaḥ vai sphyaḥ vajreṇa eva yajñasya dakṣiṇatas rakṣāṃsi apahanti agnibhyām prācaḥ ca pratīcaḥ ca sphyena audīcaḥ ca adharācaḥ ca sphyena vai eṣa vajreṇa asyai pāpmānam bhrātṛvyam apahatya utkare dhi pravṛścati

original: { 3.2.10.2} yathā-upadhāya vṛścanty evam | hastāv avanenikte | ātmānam eva pavayate | sphyaṃ prakṣālayati medhyatvāya | atho pāpmana eva bhrātṛvyasya nyaṅgaṃ cchinatti | idhmābarhir upasādayati yuktyai | yajñasya mithunatvāya | atho purorucam evaitāṃ dadhāti | uttarasya karmaṇo 'nukhyātyai | na purastāt pratyag upasādayet |
analyzed: yathā upadhāya vṛścanti evam hastau avanenikte ātmānam eva pavayate sphyam prakṣālayati medhya tvāya atha u pāpmanaḥ eva bhrātṛvyasya nyaṅgam chinatti idhmābarhiḥ upasādayati yuktyai yajñasya mithuna tvāya atha u purorucam eva etām dadhāti uttarasya karmaṇaḥ nukhyātyai na purastāt pratyak upasādayet

original: { 3.2.10.3} yat purastāt pratyag upasādayet | anyatra-āhutipathād idhmaṃ pratipādayet | prajā vai barhiḥ | aparādhnuyād barhiṣā prajānāṃ prajananam | paścāt prāg upasādayati | āhutipathena-idhmaṃ pratipādayati | saṃpraty eva barhiṣā prajānāṃ prajananam upaiti | dakṣiṇam idhmam | uttaraṃ barhiḥ | ātmā vā idhmaḥ | prajā barhiḥ |
analyzed: yat purastāt pratyak upasādayet anyatra āhuti pathāt idhmam pratipādayet prajāḥ vai barhiḥ aparādhnuyāt barhiṣā prajānām prajananam paścāt prāk upasādayati āhuti pathena edhmam pratipādayati saṃprati eva barhiṣā prajānām prajananam upaiti dakṣiṇam idhmam uttaram barhiḥ ātmā vai idhmaḥ prajāḥ barhiḥ

original: prajā hy ātmana uttaratarā tīrthe | tato medham upanīya | yathādevatam evainat pratiṣṭhāpayati | pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhir yajamānaḥ |
analyzed: prajā hi ātmanaḥ uttaratarā tīrthe tatas medham upanīya yathādevatam eva enat pratiṣṭhāpayati pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhiḥ yajamānaḥ

original: prapāṭhaka: 3 anuvāka 1 { 3.3.1.1} pratyuṣṭaṃ rakṣaḥ pratyuṣṭā arātaya ity āha | rakṣasām apahatyai | agner vas tejiṣṭhena tejasā niṣṭapāmīty āha medhyatvāya | srucaḥ saṃmārṣṭi | sruvam agre | pumāṃsam eva-abhyaḥ saṃśyati mithunatvāya | atha juhūm | atha-upabhṛtam | atha dhruvām | asau vai juhūḥ |

original: oṣadhībhiḥ paśūn | paśubhir yajamānam | śukraṃ tvā śukrāyāṃ jyotis tvā jyotiṣy arcis tvā-arciṣīty āha sarvatvāya | paryāptyā anantarāyāya |

original: { 3.3.7.9} suvargo vai loko bṛhad bhāḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai yajamānadevatyā vai juhūḥ | bhrātṛvyadevatyā-upabhṛt | prāṇa āghāraḥ | yat saṃsparśayet | bhrātṛvye 'sya prāṇaṃ dadhyāt | asaṃsparśayann atyākrāmati | yajamāna eva prāṇaṃ dadhāti | pāhi mā-agne duścaritād ā mā sucarite bhaja-ity āha |
analyzed: suvargaḥ vai lokaḥ bṛhat bhās suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai yajamāna devatyā vai juhūḥ bhrātṛvya devatyā upabhṛt prāṇaḥ āghāraḥ yat saṃsparśayet bhrātṛvye sya prāṇam dadhyāt a saṃsparśayan atyākrāmati yajamānaḥ eva prāṇam dadhāti pāhi mā agne duścaritāt ā mā su carite bhaja iti āha

original: { 3.3.7.10} agnir vāva pavitram | vṛjinam anṛtaṃ duścaritam | ṛjukarmaṃ satyaṃ sucaritam | agnir evainaṃ vṛjinād anṛtād duścaritāt pāti | ṛjukarme satye sucarite bhajati tasmād evam āśāste | ātmano gopīthāya | śiro vā etad yajñasya | yad āghāraḥ | ātmā dhruvā |
analyzed: agniḥ vāva pavitram vṛjinam anṛtam duścaritam ṛju karmam satyam su caritam agniḥ eva enam vṛjināt anṛtāt duścaritāt pāti ṛju karme satye su carite bhajati tasmāt evam āśāste ātmanaḥ gopīthāya śiraḥ vai etat yajñasya yat āghāraḥ ātmā dhruvā

original: { 3.3.7.11} āghāram āghārya dhruvāṃ samanakti | ātmann eva yajñasya śiraḥ pratidadhāti | dviḥ samanakti | dvau hi prāṇāpānau | tad āhuḥ | trir eva samañjyāt | tridhātu hi śira iti | śira iva-etad yajñasya | atho trayo vai prāṇāḥ | prāṇān evāsmin dadhāti | makhasya śiro 'si saṃ jyotiṣā jyotir aṅktām ity āha | jyotir evāsmā upariṣṭād dadhāti |
analyzed: āghāram āghārya dhruvām samanakti ātman eva yajñasya śiraḥ pratidadhāti dvis samanakti dvau hi prāṇa apānau tat āhuḥ tris eva samañjyāt tri dhātu hi śiraḥ iti śiraḥ iva etat yajñasya atha u trayaḥ vai prāṇāḥ prāṇān eva asmin dadhāti makhasya śiraḥ si sam jyotiṣā jyotiḥ aṅktām iti āha jyotiḥ eva asmai upariṣṭāt dadhāti

original: suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai |
analyzed: suvargasya lokasya anukhyātyai

original: anuvāka 8 { 3.3.8.1} dhiṣṇiyā vā ete nyupyante | yad brahmā | yad hotā | yad adhvaryuḥ | yad agnīt | yad yajamānaḥ | tān yad antareyāt | yajamānasya prāṇānt saṃkarṣet | pramāyukaḥ syāt | puroḍāśam apagṛhya saṃcaraty adhvaryuḥ |
analyzed: dhiṣṇiyāḥ vai ete nyupyante yat brahmā yat hotā yat adhvaryuḥ yat agnīdh yat yajamānaḥ tān yat antareyāt yajamānasya prāṇān saṃkarṣet pramāyukaḥ syāt puroḍāśam apagṛhya saṃcarati adhvaryuḥ

original: { 3.3.8.2} yajamānāya-eva tal lokaṃ śiṃṣati | na-asya prāṇānt saṃkarṣati | na pramāyuko bhavati | purastāt pratyaṅṅ āsīnaḥ | iḍāyā iḍām ādadhāti | hastyāṃ hotre | paśavo vā iḍā | paśavaḥ puruṣaḥ | paśuṣv eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati | iḍāyai vā eṣā prajātiḥ |
analyzed: yajamānāya eva tat lokam śiṃṣati na asya prāṇān saṃkarṣati na pramāyukaḥ bhavati purastāt pratyaṅ āsīnaḥ iḍāyai iḍām ādadhāti hastyām hotre paśavaḥ vai iḍā paśavaḥ puruṣaḥ paśuṣu eva paśūn pratiṣṭhāpayati iḍāyai vai eṣā prajātiḥ

original: { 3.3.8.3} tāṃ prajātiṃ yajamāno 'nu prajāyate | dvir aṅgulāv anakti parvaṇoḥ | dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | sakṛd upastṛṇāti | dvir ādadhāti | sakṛd abhighārayati | catuḥ saṃpadyate | catvāri vai paśoḥ pratiṣṭhānāni | yāvān eva paśuḥ | tam upahvayate |
analyzed: tām prajātim yajamānaḥ nu prajāyate dvis aṅgulau anakti parvaṇoḥ dvipād yajamānaḥ pratiṣṭhityai sakṛt upastṛṇāti dvis ādadhāti sakṛt abhighārayati catuḥ saṃpadyate catvāri vai paśoḥ pratiṣṭhānāni yāvān eva paśuḥ tam upahvayate

original: { 3.3.8.4} mukham iva praty upahvayeta | saṃmukhān eva paśūnupahvayate | paśavo vā iḍā | tasmāt sonvārabhyā | adhvaryuṇā ca yajamānena ca | upahūtaḥ paśumān asānīty āha | upa hy enau hvayate hotā | iḍāyai devatānām upahave | upahūtaḥ paśumān bhavati | ya evaṃ veda |
analyzed: mukham iva prati upahvayeta saṃmukhān eva paśūn upahvayate paśavaḥ vai iḍā tasmāt sonu ārabhyāḥ adhvaryuṇā ca yajamānena ca upahūtaḥ paśumān asāni iti āha upa hi enau hvayate hotā iḍāyai devatānām upahave upahūtaḥ paśumān bhavati yaḥ evam veda

original: { 3.3.8.5} yāṃ vai hastyām iḍām ādadhāti | vācaḥ sā bhāgadheyam | yām upahvayate | prāṇānāṃ sā | vācaṃ caiva prāṇāṃś cāvarundhe | atha vā etarhy upahūtāyām iḍāyām | puroḍāśasyaiva barhiṣado mīmāṃsā | yajamānaṃ devā abruvan | havir no nirvapa-iti | na-aham abhāgo nirvapsyāmīty abravīt |
analyzed: yām vai hastyām iḍām ādadhāti vācaḥ sā bhāgadheyam yām upahvayate prāṇānām sā vācam ca eva prāṇān ca avarundhe atha vai etarhi upahūtāyām iḍāyām puroḍāśasya eva barhiṣadaḥ mīmāṃsā yajamānam devāḥ abruvan haviḥ naḥ nirvapa eti na aham a bhāgaḥ nirvapsyāmi iti abravīt

original: { 3.3.8.6} na mayā-abhāgayā-anuvakṣyatha-iti vāg abravīt | na-aham abhāgā puro'nuvākyā bhaviṣyāmīti puro'nuvākyā | na-aham abhāgā yājyā bhaviṣyāmīti yājyā | na mayā-abhāgena vaṣaṭkariṣyatha-iti vaṣaṭkāraḥ | yad yajamānabhāgaṃ nidhāya puroḍāśaṃ barhiṣadaṃ karoti | tān eva tad bhāginaḥ karoti | caturdhā karoti | catasro diśaḥ |
analyzed: na mayā abhāgayā anuvakṣyatha eti vāc abravīt na aham abhāgā puronuvākyā bhaviṣyāmi iti puronuvākyā na aham abhāgā yājyā bhaviṣyāmi iti yājyā na mayā abhāgena vaṣaṭkariṣyatha eti vaṣaṭkāraḥ yat yajamāna bhāgam nidhāya puroḍāśam barhiṣadam karoti tān eva tat bhāginaḥ karoti caturdhā karoti catasraḥ diśaḥ

original: dikṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati | barhiṣadaṃ karoti |
analyzed: dikṣu eva pratitiṣṭhati barhiṣadam karoti

original: { 3.3.8.7} yajamāno vai puroḍāśaḥ | prajā barhiḥ | yajamānameva prajāsu pratiṣṭhāpayati | tasmād asthnā'nyāḥ prajāḥ pratitiṣṭhanti | māṃsenānyāḥ | atho khalv āhuḥ | dakṣiṇā vā etā haviryajñasyāntarvedy avarudhyante | yat puroḍāśaṃ barhiṣadaṃ karotīti | caturdhā karoti | catvāro hy ete haviryajñasya-ṛtvijaḥ |
analyzed: yajamānaḥ vai puroḍāśaḥ prajāḥ barhiḥ yajamānam eva prajāsu pratiṣṭhāpayati tasmāt asthnā anyāḥ prajāḥ pratitiṣṭhanti māṃsena anyāḥ atha u khalu āhuḥ dakṣiṇāḥ vai etāḥ haviḥ yajñasya antarvedi avarudhyante yat puroḍāśam barhiṣadam karoti iti caturdhā karoti catvāraḥ hi ete haviḥ yajñasya ṛtvijaḥ

original: { 3.3.8.8} brahmā hotā-adhvaryur agnīt | tam abhimṛśet | idaṃ brahmaṇaḥ | idaṃ hotuḥ | idam adhvaryoḥ | idam agnīdha iti | yathā-evādaḥ saumye 'dhvare | ādeśam ṛtvigbhyo dakṣiṇā nīyante | tādṛg eva tat | agnīdhe prathamāyā-ādadhāti |
analyzed: brahmā hotā adhvaryuḥ agnīdh tam abhimṛśet idam brahmaṇaḥ idam hotuḥ idam adhvaryoḥ idam agnīdhe iti yathā eva adaḥ saumye dhvare ādeśam ṛtvigbhyaḥ dakṣiṇāḥ nīyante tādṛś eva tat agnīdhe prathamāya ādadhāti

original: { 3.3.8.9} agnimukhā hy ṛddhiḥ | agnimukhām eva-ṛddhiṃ yajamāna ṛdhnoti | sakṛd upastīrya dvir ādadhat | upastīrya dvir abhighārayati | ṣaṭ saṃpadyante | ṣaḍ vā ṛtavaḥ | ṛtūn eva prīṇāti | vedena brahmaṇe brahmabhāgaṃ pariharati | prājāpatyo vai vedaḥ | prājāpatyo brahmā |
analyzed: agni mukhā hi ṛddhiḥ agni mukhām eva ṛddhim yajamānaḥ ṛdhnoti sakṛt upastīrya dvis ādadhat upastīrya dvis abhighārayati ṣaṭ saṃpadyante ṣaṭ vai ṛtavaḥ ṛtūn eva prīṇāti vedena brahmaṇe brahma bhāgam pariharati prājāpatyaḥ vai vedaḥ prājāpatyaḥ brahmā

original: { 3.3.8.10} savitā yajñasya prasūtyai | atha kāmam anyena | tato hotre | madhyaṃ vā etad yajñasya | yad hotā | madhyata eva yajñaṃ prīṇāti | athādhvaryave | pratiṣṭhā vā eṣā yajñasya | yad adhvaryuḥ | tasmād haviryajñasyaitām evā''vṛtam anu |
analyzed: savitā yajñasya prasūtyai atha kāmam anyena tatas hotre madhyam vai etat yajñasya yat hotā madhyataḥ eva yajñam prīṇāti atha adhvaryave pratiṣṭhā vai eṣā yajñasya yat adhvaryuḥ tasmāt haviḥ yajñasya etām eva āvṛtam anu

original: { 3.3.8.11} anyā dakṣiṇā nīyante | yajñasya pratiṣṭhityai | agnim agnīt sakṛt-sakṛt saṃmṛḍhḍhīty āha | parāṅ iva hy etarhi yajñaḥ | iṣitā daivyā hotāra ity āha | iṣitaṃ hi karma kriyate | bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhīty āha | āśiṣam evaitām āśāste | svagā daivyā hotṛbhya ity āha | yajñam eva tat svagā karoti |
analyzed: anyāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ nīyante yajñasya pratiṣṭhityai agnim agnīdh sakṛt sakṛt saṃmṛḍhḍhi iti āha parāṅ iva hi etarhi yajñaḥ iṣitāḥ daivyāḥ hotāraḥ iti āha iṣitam hi karma kriyate bhadra vācyāya preṣitaḥ mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi iti āha āśiṣam eva etām āśāste svagā daivyāḥ hotṛbhyaḥ iti āha yajñam eva tat svagā karoti

original: svastir mānuṣebhya ity āha | āśiṣam evaitām āśāste | śaṃyor brūhīty āha | śaṃyum eva bārhaspatyaṃ bhāgadheyena samardhayati |
analyzed: svastiḥ mānuṣebhyaḥ iti āha āśiṣam eva etām āśāste śaṃyoḥ brūhi iti āha śaṃyum eva bārhaspatyam bhāgadheyena samardhayati

original: anuvāka 9 { 3.3.9.1} atha srucāv anuṣṭugbhyāṃ vājavatībhyāṃ vyūhati | pratiṣṭhā vā anuṣṭuk | annaṃ vājaḥ pratiṣṭhityai | annādyasyāvarudhyai | prācīṃ juhūmūhati | jātān eva bhrātṛvyān praṇudate | pratīcīm upabhṛtam | janiṣyamāṇān eva pratinudate | sa viṣūca eva-apohya sapatnān yajamānaḥ | asmin loke pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: atha srucau anuṣṭugbhyām vājavatībhyām vyūhati pratiṣṭhā vai anuṣṭubh annam vājaḥ pratiṣṭhityai annādyasya avarudhyai prācīm juhūm ūhati jātān eva bhrātṛvyān praṇudate pratīcīm upabhṛtam janiṣyamāṇān eva pratinudate sa viṣūcaḥ eva apohya sapatnān yajamānaḥ asmin loke pratitiṣṭhati

original: { 3.3.9.2} dvābhyām | dvipratiṣṭho hi | vasubhyas tvā rudrebhyas tvā-ādityebhyas tvā-ity āha | yathāyajur evaitat | srukṣu prastaram anakti | ime vai lokāḥ srucaḥ | yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ | yajamānam eva tejasonakti | tredhā-anakti | traya ime lokāḥ |
analyzed: dvābhyām dvi pratiṣṭhaḥ hi vasubhyaḥ tvā rudrebhyaḥ tvā ādityebhyaḥ tvā iti āha yathāyajus eva etat srukṣu prastaram anakti ime vai lokāḥ srucaḥ yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ yajamānam eva tejasā nakti tredhā anakti trayaḥ ime lokāḥ

original: { 3.3.9.3} ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyo 'nakti | abhipūrvam anakti | abhipūrvam eva yajamānaṃ tejasānakti | aktaṃ rihāṇā ity āha | tejo vā ājyam | yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ | yajamānam eva tejasānakti | viyantu vaya ity āha | vaya evainaṃ kṛtvā | suvargaṃ lokaṃ gamayati |
analyzed: ebhyaḥ eva enam lokebhyaḥ nakti abhipūrvam anakti abhipūrvam eva yajamānam tejasā anakti aktam rihāṇāḥ iti āha tejaḥ vai ājyam yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ yajamānam eva tejasā anakti viyantu vayaḥ iti āha vayaḥ eva enam kṛtvā suvargam lokam gamayati

original: { 3.3.9.4} prajāṃ yoniṃ mā nirmṛkṣam ity āha | prajāyai gopīthāya | āpyāyantām āpa oṣadhaya ity āha | āpa eva-oṣadhīr āpyāyayati | marutāṃ pṛṣatayaḥ stha-ity āha | maruto vai vṛṣṭyā īśate | vṛṣṭim eva-avarundhe | divaṃ gaccha tato no vṛṣṭim eraya-ity āha | vṛṣṭir vai dyauḥ | vṛṣṭim eva-avarundhe |
analyzed: prajām yonim mā nirmṛkṣam iti āha prajāyai gopīthāya āpyāyantām āpaḥ oṣadhayaḥ iti āha āpaḥ eva oṣadhīḥ āpyāyayati marutām pṛṣatayaḥ stha eti āha marutaḥ vai vṛṣṭyai īśate vṛṣṭim eva avarundhe divam gaccha tatas naḥ vṛṣṭim eraya iti āha vṛṣṭiḥ vai dyauḥ vṛṣṭim eva avarundhe

original: { 3.3.9.5} yāvad vā adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ praharati | tāvad asya-āyur mīyate | āyuṣpā agne 'sya-āyur me pāhīty āha | āyur evā''tman dhatte | yāvad vā adhvaryuḥ prastaraṃ praharati | tāvad asya cakṣur mīyate | cakṣuṣpā agne 'si cakṣur me pāhīty āha | cakṣur evā''tman dhatte | dhruvā-asīty āha pratiṣṭhityai | yaṃ paridhiṃ paryadhatthā ity āha |
analyzed: yāvat vai adhvaryuḥ prastaram praharati tāvat asya āyuḥ mīyate āyuṣpāḥ agne sya āyuḥ me pāhi iti āha āyuḥ eva ātman dhatte yāvat vai adhvaryuḥ prastaram praharati tāvat asya cakṣuḥ mīyate cakṣuṣpāḥ agne si cakṣuḥ me pāhi iti āha cakṣuḥ eva ātman dhatte dhruvā asi iti āha pratiṣṭhityai yam paridhim paryadhatthāḥ iti āha

original: { 3.3.9.6} yathāyajur evaitat | agne deva paṇibhir vīyamāṇa ity āha | agnaya evainaṃ juṣṭaṃ karoti | taṃ ta etam anu joṣaṃ bharāmīty āha | sajātān evāsmā anukān karoti | na-id eṣa tvad apacetayātā ity āhānukhyātyai | yajñasya pātha upa samitam ity āha | bhūmānam eva-upaiti | paridhīn praharati | yajñasya samiṣṭyai |
analyzed: yathāyajus eva etat agne deva paṇibhiḥ vīyamāṇaḥ iti āha agnaye eva enam juṣṭam karoti tam te etam anu joṣam bharāmi iti āha sajātān eva asmai anukān karoti na ed eṣa tvat apacetayātai iti āha anukhyātyai yajñasya pāthaḥ upa samitam iti āha bhūmānam eva upaiti paridhīn praharati yajñasya samiṣṭyai

original: { 3.3.9.8} tān eva tena prīṇāti | vaiśvadevyā-ṛcā | ete hi viśve devāḥ | triṣṭug bhavati | indriyaṃ vai triṣṭuk | indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti | agner vām apannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmīty āha | iyaṃ vā agnir apannagṛhaḥ | asyā evaine sadane sādayati | sumnāya sumninī sumne mā dhattam ity āha |
analyzed: tān eva tena prīṇāti vaiśvadevyā ṛcā ete hi viśve devāḥ triṣṭubh bhavati indriyam vai triṣṭubh indriyam eva yajamāne dadhāti agneḥ vām a panna gṛhasya sadasi sādayāmi iti āha iyam vai agniḥ a panna gṛhaḥ asyāḥ eva ene sadane sādayati sumnāya sumninī sumne mā dhattam iti āha

original: { 3.3.9.9} prajā vai paśavaḥ sumnam | prajām eva paśūn ātman dhatte | dhuri dhuryau pātam ity āha | jāyāpatyor gopīthāya | agne 'dabdhāyo 'śītatano ity āha | yathāyajur evaitat | pāhi mā-adya divaḥ pāhi prasityai pāhi duriṣṭyai pāhi duradmanyai pāhi duścaritād ity āha | āśiṣam evaitām āśāste |
analyzed: prajā vai paśavaḥ sumnam prajām eva paśūn ātman dhatte dhuri dhuryau pātam iti āha jāyā patyoḥ gopīthāya agne śītatano iti āha yathāyajus eva etat pāhi mā adya divaḥ pāhi prasityai pāhi duriṣṭyai pāhi duradmanyai pāhi duścaritāt iti āha āśiṣam eva etām āśāste

original: aviṣaṃ naḥ pituṃ kṛṇu suṣadā yoniṃ svāhā-itīdhmasaṃvṛścanāny anvāhāryapacane 'bhyādhāya phalīkaraṇahomaṃ juhoti | atiriktāni vā idhmasaṃvṛścanāni |

original: { 3.3.9.10} atiriktāḥ phalīkaraṇāḥ | atiriktam ājya-uccheṣaṇam | atirikta eva-atiriktaṃ dadhāti | atho atiriktenaiva-atiriktam āptvā-avarundhe | vedir devebhyo nilāyata | tāṃ vedenānvavindan | vedena vediṃ vividuḥ pṛthivīm | sā paprathe pṛthivī pārthivāni | garbhaṃ bibharti bhuvaneṣv antaḥ |

original: { 3.3.9.11} atho yad vedaś ca vediś ca bhavataḥ | mithunatvāya prajātyai | prajāpater vā etāni śmaśrūṇi | yad vedaḥ | patniyā upastha āsyati | mithunam eva karoti | vindate prajām | vedaṃ hotā-āhavanīyāt stṛṇann eti | yajñam eva tat saṃtanoty ā-uttarasmād ardhamāsāt | taṃ saṃtatam uttare 'rdhamāsa ālabhate |
analyzed: atha u yat vedaḥ ca vediḥ ca bhavataḥ mithuna tvāya prajātyai prajāpateḥ vai etāni śmaśrūṇi yat vedaḥ patniyāḥ upasthe āsyati mithunam eva karoti vindate prajām vedam hotā āhavanīyāt stṛṇan eti yajñam eva tat saṃtanoti ā uttarasmāt ardha māsāt tam saṃtatam uttare ṛdh māse ālabhate

original: { 3.3.9.12} taṃ kāle-kāla āgate yajate | brahmavādino vadanti | sa tvā adhvaryuḥ syāt | yo yato yajñaṃ prayuṅkte | tad enaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayatīti | vātād vā adhvaryur yajñaṃ prayuṅkte | devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā { vitvā} gātum ita-ity āha | yata eva yajñaṃ prayuṅkte | tad enaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhir yajamānaḥ |
analyzed: tam kāle kāle āgate yajate brahma vādinaḥ vadanti sa tvai adhvaryuḥ syāt yaḥ yatas yajñam prayuṅkte tat enam pratiṣṭhāpayati iti vātāt vai adhvaryuḥ yajñam prayuṅkte devāḥ gātu vidaḥ gātum vittvā vitvā gātum itas eti āha yatas eva yajñam prayuṅkte tat enam pratiṣṭhāpayati pratitiṣṭhati prajayā paśubhiḥ yajamānaḥ

original: anuvāka 10 { 3.3.10.1} yo vā ayathādevataṃ yajñam upacarati | ā devatābhyo vṛścyate | pāpīyān bhavati | yo yathādevatam | na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati | vāruṇo vai pāśaḥ | imaṃ viṣyāmi varuṇasya pāśam ity āha | varuṇapāśād evaināṃ muñcati | savitṛprasūto yathādevatam |
analyzed: yaḥ vai a yathādevatam yajñam upacarati ā devatābhyaḥ vṛścyate pāpīyān bhavati yaḥ yathādevatam na devatābhyaḥ āvṛścyate vasīyān bhavati vāruṇaḥ vai pāśaḥ imam viṣyāmi varuṇasya pāśam iti āha varuṇa pāśāt eva enām muñcati savitṛ prasūtaḥ yathādevatam

original: { 3.3.10.2} na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati | dhātuś ca yonau sukṛtasya loka ity āha | agnir vai dhātā | puṇyaṃ karma sukṛtasya lokaḥ | agnir evaināṃ dhātā | puṇye karmaṇi sukṛtasya loke dadhāti | syonaṃ me saha patyā karomīty āha | ātmanaś ca yajamānasya cānātyai {ḍyumoṇṭa cānattyai?} saṃtvāya | sam āyuṣā saṃprajayā-ity āha |
analyzed: na devatābhyaḥ āvṛścyate vasīyān bhavati dhātuḥ ca yonau sukṛtasya loke iti āha agniḥ vai dhātā puṇyam karma sukṛtasya lokaḥ agniḥ eva enām dhātā puṇye karmaṇi sukṛtasya loke dadhāti syonam me saha patyā karomi iti āha ātmanaḥ ca yajamānasya ca anātyai ca anattyai saṃtvāya sam āyuṣā saṃprajayai iti āha

original: { 3.3.10.4} prajāḥ prajanayan | yad vai yajñasya brahmaṇā yujyate | brahmaṇā vai tasya vimokaḥ | adbhiḥ śāntiḥ | vimuktaṃ vā etarhi yoktraṃ brahmaṇā | ādāya-enat patnī saha-apa upagṛhṇīte śāntyai | añjalau pūrṇapātram ānayati | reta eva-asyāṃ prajāṃ dadhāti | prajayā hi manuṣyaḥ pūrṇaḥ | mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe | avabhṛthasyaiva rūpaṃ kṛtvā-uttiṣṭhati |

original: anuvāka 11 { 3.3.11.1} pariveṣo vā eṣa vanaspatīnām | yad upaveṣaḥ | ya evaṃ veda | vindate pariveṣṭāram | tam utkare | yaṃ devā manuṣyeṣu | upaveṣam adhārayan | ye asmad apacetasaḥ | tān asmabhyam iha-ākuru | upaveṣa-upaviḍḍhi naḥ |
analyzed: pariveṣaḥ vai eṣa vanaspatīnām yat upaveṣaḥ yaḥ evam veda vindate pariveṣṭāram tam utkare yam devāḥ manuṣyeṣu upaveṣam adhārayan ye asmat apacetasaḥ tān asmabhyam ihaākuru upaveṣa upaviḍḍhi naḥ

original: { 3.3.11.2} prajāṃ puṣṭim atho dhanam | dvipado naś catuṣpadaḥ | dhruvān anapagān kurv iti purastāt pratyañcam upagūhati | tasmāt purastāt pratyañcaḥ śūdrā avasyanti | sthavimata upagūhati | aprativādina evainān kurute | dhṛṣṭir vā upaveṣaḥ | śucā-ṛto vajro brahmaṇā saṃśitaḥ | yā-upaveṣe śuk | sāmum ṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣma iti |
analyzed: prajām puṣṭim atha u dhanam dvipadaḥ naḥ catuṣpadaḥ dhruvān anapagān kuru iti purastāt pratyañcam upagūhati tasmāt purastāt pratyañcaḥ śūdrāḥ avasyanti sthavimataḥ upagūhati a prativādinaḥ eva enān kurute dhṛṣṭiḥ vai upaveṣaḥ śucā āṛtaḥ vajraḥ brahmaṇā saṃśitaḥ yā a upaveṣe śuc sā amum ṛcchatu yam dviṣmaḥ iti

original: { 3.3.11.3} athāsmai nāmagṛhya praharati | nir amuṃ nuda okasaḥ | sapatno yaḥ pṛtanyati | nirbādhyena haviṣā | indra eṇaṃ parāśarīt | ihi tisraḥ parāvataḥ | ihi pañca janāṃ ati | ihi tisro 'ti rocanā, yāvat | sūryo asad divi | paramāṃ tvā parāvatam |
analyzed: atha asmai nāma gṛhya praharati niḥ amum nuda okasaḥ sapatnaḥ yaḥ pṛtanyati nirbādhyena haviṣā indraḥ eṇam parāśarīt ihi tisraḥ parāvataḥ ihi pañca janān ati ihi tisraḥ rocanā yāvat sūryaḥ asat divi paramām tvā parāvatam

original: { 3.3.11.4} indro nayatu vṛtrahā | yato na punar āyasi | śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhya iti | trivṛd vā eṣa vajro brahmaṇā saṃśitaḥ | śucā-evainaṃ viddhvā | ebhyo lokebhyo nirṇudya | vajreṇa brahmaṇā stṛṇute | hato 'sāv avadhiṣmāmum ity āha stṛtyai | yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet | śucā-evainam arpayati |
analyzed: indraḥ nayatu vṛtra hā yatas na punar āyasi śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ iti trivṛt vai eṣa vajraḥ brahmaṇā saṃśitaḥ śucā eva enam viddhvā ebhyaḥ lokebhyaḥ nirṇudya vajreṇa brahmaṇā stṛṇute hataḥ u sau avadhiṣma amum iti āha stṛtyai yam dviṣyāt tam dhyāyet śucā eva enam arpayati

original: { 3.6.2.3} hotā yakṣat tisro devīr apasām apastamā acchidram adya-idam apas tanvatām | devebhyo devīr devam apo viyantv ājyasya hotar yaja | hotā yakṣat tvaṣṭāram aciṣṭum apākaṃ retodhāṃ viśravasaṃ yaśodhām | pururūpam akāmakarśanaṃ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ syāt suvīro vīrair vetv ājyasya hotar yaja |
analyzed: hotā yakṣat tisraḥ devīḥ apasām apastamāḥ acchidram adya edam apaḥ tanvatām devebhyaḥ devīḥ devam apaḥ viyantu ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣat tvaṣṭāram aciṣṭum apākam retaḥ dhām viśravasam yaśaḥ dhām puru rūpam a kāma karśanam su poṣaḥ poṣaiḥ syāt su vīraḥ vīraiḥ vetu ājyasya hotar yaja

original: hotā yakṣad vanaspatim upāvasrakṣad dhiyo joṣṭāraṃ śaśaman naraḥ | svadāt svadhitir ṛtuthādya devo devebhyo havyāvāḍ vetv ājyasya hotar yaja | hotā yakṣad agniṃ svāhā-ājyasya svāhā medasaḥ svāhā stokānāṃ svāhā svāhākṛtīnāṃ svāhā havyasūktīnām | svāhā devāṃ ājyapānt svāhā-agniṃ hotrāj juṣāṇā agna ajyasya viyantu hotar yaja |
analyzed: hotā yakṣat vanaspatim upāvasrakṣat dhiyaḥ joṣṭāram śaśaman naraḥ svadāt svadhitiḥ ṛtuthā adya devaḥ devebhyaḥ havyāvāṭ vetu ājyasya hotar yaja hotā yakṣat agnim svāhā ājyasya svāhā medasaḥ svāhā stokānām svāhā svāhākṛtīnām svāhā havyasūktīnām svāhā devān ājya pān svāhā agnim hotrāt juṣāṇāḥ agne ajyasya viyantu hotar yaja

original: anuvāka 3 { 3.6.3.1} samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe | devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ | ā ca vaha mitramahaś cikitvān | tvaṃ dūtaḥ kavir asi pracetāḥ | tanūnapāt patha ṛtasya yānān | madhvā samañjant svadayā sujihva | manmāni dhībhir uta yajñam ṛndhan | devatrā ca kṛṇuhy adhvaraṃ naḥ | narāśaṃsasya mahimānameṣām | upastoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ |
analyzed: samiddhaḥ adya manuṣaḥ duroṇe devaḥ devān yajasi jātavedaḥ ā ca vaha mitra mahas cikitvān tvam dūtaḥ kaviḥ asi pracetāḥ tanūnapāt pathaḥ ṛtasya yānān madhvā samañjan svadaya sujihva manmāni dhībhiḥ uta yajñam ṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhi adhvaram naḥ narāśaṃsasya mahimānam eṣām upastoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ

original: { 3.6.3.2} te sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyaṃdhāḥ | svadantu devā ubhayāni havyā | ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaś ca | āyāhy agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ | tvaṃ devānām asi yahva hotā | sa enān yakṣīṣito yajīyān | prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyāḥ | vastor asyā vṛjyate agre ahnām | vy u prathate vitaraṃ varīyaḥ | devebhyo aditaye syonam |
analyzed: te sukratavaḥ śucayaḥ dhiyaṃdhāḥ svadantu devāḥ ubhayāni havyā ājuhvānaḥ īḍyaḥ vandyaḥ ca āyāhi agne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ tvam devānām asi yahva hotā saḥ enān yakṣi iṣitaḥ yajīyān prācīnam barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyāḥ vastoḥ asyāḥ vṛjyate agre ahnām vi u prathate vitaram varīyaḥ devebhyaḥ aditaye syonam

original: { 3.6.3.3} vyacasvatīr urviyā viśrayantām | patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ | devīr dvāro bṛhatīr viśvaminvāḥ | devebhyo bhavatha suprāyaṇāḥ | ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke | uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau | divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme | adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne | daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā | mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai |
analyzed: vyacasvatīḥ urviyā viśrayantām patibhyaḥ na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ devīḥ dvāraḥ bṛhatīḥ viśvaminvāḥ devebhyaḥ bhavatha su prāyaṇāḥ ā yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatām ni yonau divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī su rukme adhi śriyam śukrapiśam dadhāne daivyā hotārā prathamā su vācā mimānā yajñam manuṣaḥ yajadhyai

original: { 3.6.3.4} pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū | prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā | ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyam etu | iḍā manuṣvad iha cetayantī | tisro devīr barhir ā-idaṃ syonam | sarasvatīḥ svapasaḥ sadantu | ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī | rūpair apiṃśad bhuvanāni viśvā | tam adya hotar iṣito yajīyān | devaṃ tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān |
analyzed: pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnam jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantau ā naḥ yajñam bhāratī tūyam etu iḍā manuṣvat iha cetayantī tisraḥ devīḥ barhiḥ ā idam syonam sarasvatīḥ su apasaḥ sadantu yaḥ ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpaiḥ apiṃśat bhuvanāni viśvā tam adya hotar iṣitaḥ yajīyān devam tvaṣṭāram iha yakṣi vidvān

original: { 3.6.3.5} upāvasṛjat tmanyā samañjan | devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi | vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ | svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena | sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñam | agnir devānām abhavat purogāḥ | asya hotuḥ pradiśy ṛtasya vāci | svāhākṛtaṃ havir adantu devāḥ |
analyzed: upāvasṛjat tmanyā samañjan devānām pāthaḥ ṛtuthā havīṃṣi vanaspatiḥ śamitā devaḥ agniḥ svadantu havyam madhunā ghṛtena sadyas jātaḥ vyamimīta yajñam agniḥ devānām abhavat purogāḥ asya hotuḥ pradiśi ṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtam haviḥ adantu devāḥ

original: anuvāka 4 { 3.6.4.1} agnir hotā no adhvare | vājī san pariṇīyate | devo deveṣu yajñiyaḥ | pari triviṣṭy adhvaram | yāty agnī rathīr iva | ā deveṣu prayo dadhat | pari vājapatiḥ kaviḥ | agnir havyāny akramīt { havyā nyakramīt} | dadhad ratnāni dāśuṣe |
analyzed: agniḥ hotā naḥ adhvare vājī san pariṇīyate devaḥ deveṣu yajñiyaḥ pari tri viṣṭī adhvaram yāti agniḥ rathīḥ iva ā deveṣu prayaḥ dadhat pari vāja patiḥ kaviḥ agniḥ havyāni akramīt havyā nyakramīt dadhat ratnāni dāśuṣe

original: anuvāka 5 { 3.6.5.1} ajaid agniḥ | asanad vājaṃ ni | devo devebhyo havyā vāṭ | prāñjobhir hinvānaḥ | dhenābhiḥ kalpamānaḥ | yajñasya-āyuḥ pratiran | upapreṣya hotaḥ | havyā devebhyaḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 5 3651 ajait agniḥ asanat vājam ni devaḥ devebhyaḥ havyā vāṭ prāñjobhiḥ hinvānaḥ dhenābhiḥ kalpamānaḥ yajñasya āyuḥ pratiran upapreṣya hotar havyā devebhyaḥ

original: anuvāka 6 { 3.6.6.1} daivyāḥ śamitāra uta manuṣyā ārabhadhvam | upanayata medhyā duraḥ | āśāsānā medhapatibhyāṃ medham | prāsmā agniṃ bharata | stṛṇīta barhiḥ | anv enaṃ mātā manyatām | anu pitā | anu bhrātā sagarbhyaḥ | anu sakhā sayūthyaḥ | udīcīnāṃ asya pado nidhattāt |
analyzed: daivyāḥ śamitāraḥ uta manuṣyāḥ ārabhadhvam upanayata medhyāḥ duraḥ āśāsānāḥ medha patibhyām medham pra asmai agnim bharata stṛṇīta barhiḥ anu enam mātā manyatām anu pitā anu bhrātā sagarbhyaḥ anu sakhā sa yūthyaḥ udīcīnām asya padaḥ nidhattāt

original: { 3.6.6.2} sūryaṃ cakṣur gamayatāt | vātaṃ prāṇam anvavasṛjatāt | diśaḥ śrotram | antarikṣam asum | pṛthivīṃ śarīram | ekadhā-asya tvacam ācchyatāt | purā nābhyā apiśaso vapām utkhidatāt | antar eva-uṣmāṇaṃ vārayatāt | śyenam asya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt | praśasā bāhū |
analyzed: sūryam cakṣuḥ gamayatāt vātam prāṇam anvavasṛjatāt diśaḥ śrotram antarikṣam asum pṛthivīm śarīram ekadhā asya tvacam ācchyatāt purā nābhyāḥ apiśasaḥ vapām utkhidatāt antar eva ūṣmāṇam vārayatāt śyenam asya vakṣaḥ kṛṇutāt praśasā bāhū

original: { 3.6.6.3} śalā doṣaṇī | kaśyapā-ivāṃsā acchidre śroṇī | kavaṣā-ūrū srekaparṇā-aṣṭhīvantā | ṣaḍviṃśatir asya vaṅkrayaḥ | tā anuṣṭhyā-uccyāvayatāt | gātraṃ-gātram asyānūnaṃ kṛṇutāt | ūvadhyagūhaṃ {ānaṃdā. ūvadhyagohaṃ} pārthivaṃ khanatāt | asnā rakṣaḥ saṃsṛjatāt | vaniṣṭhum asya mā rāviṣṭa |
analyzed: śalā doṣaṇī kaśyapa aivāṃsā acchidre śroṇī kavaṣā ūrū srekaparṇā aṣṭhīvantā ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ asya vaṅkrayaḥ tāḥ anuṣṭhyā uccyāvayatāt gātram gātram asya anūnam kṛṇutāt ūvadhyagūham ānaṃdā ūvadhyagoham pārthivam khanatāt asnā rakṣaḥ saṃsṛjatāt vaniṣṭhum asya mā rāviṣṭa

original: { 3.6.6.4} urūkaṃ manyamānāḥ | na-id vas toke tanaye | ravitā ravat-śamitāraḥ | adhrigo śamīdhvam | suśami śamīdhvam | śamīdhvam adhrigo | adhriguś cāpāpaś ca | ubhau devānāṃ śamitārau | tāv imaṃ paśuṃ śrapayatāṃ pravidvāṃsau | yathā-yathā-asya śrapaṇaṃ tathā-tathā |
analyzed: urūkam manyamānāḥ na ait vaḥ toke tanaye ravitā ravat śamitāraḥ adhrigo śamīdhvam suśami śamīdhvam śamīdhvam adhrigo adhriguḥ ca apāpaḥ ca ubhau devānām śamitārau tau imam paśum śrapayatām pravidvāṃsau yathā yathā asya śrapaṇam tathā tathā

original: anuvāka 7 { 3.6.7.1} juṣasva saprathastamam | vaco devapsarastamam | havyā juhvāna āsani | imaṃ no yajñam amṛteṣu dhehi | imā havyā jātavedo juṣasva | stokānām agne medaso ghṛtasya | hotaḥ prāśāna prathamo niṣadya | ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te | stokāḥ { stokā} ścotanti medasaḥ | svadharmaṃ devavītaye |
analyzed: juṣasva saprathastamam vacaḥ deva psarastamam havyā juhvānaḥ āsani imam naḥ yajñam amṛteṣu dhehi imā havyā jātavedaḥ juṣasva stokānām agne medasaḥ ghṛtasya hotar prāśāna prathamaḥ niṣadya ghṛtavantaḥ pāvaka te stokāḥ stokāḥ ścotanti medasaḥ sva dharmam deva vītaye

original: { 3.6.7.2} śreṣṭhaṃ no dhehi vāryam | tubhyaṃ stokā ghṛtaścutaḥ | agne viprāya santya | ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase | yajñasya prāvitā bhava | tubhyaṃ ścotanty adhrigo śacīvaḥ | stokāso agne medaso ghṛtasya | kaviśasto bṛhatā bhānunā-āgāḥ | havyā juṣasva medhira | ojiṣṭhaṃ te madhyato meda udbhṛtam | pra te vayaṃ dadāmahe |
analyzed: śreṣṭham naḥ dhehi vāryam tubhyam stokāḥ ghṛtaścutaḥ agne viprāya santyaḥ ṛṣiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ samidhyase yajñasya prāvitā bhava tubhyam ścotanti adhrigo śacīvas stokāsaḥ agne medasaḥ ghṛtasya kavi śastaḥ bṛhatā bhānunā āgāḥ havyā juṣasva medhiraḥ ojiṣṭham te madhyataḥ medaḥ udbhṛtam pra te vayam dadāmahe

original: ścotanti te vaso stokā adhi tvaci | prati tān devaśo vihi |
analyzed: ścotanti te vaso stokāḥ adhi tvaci prati tān devaśas vihi

original: anuvāka 8 { 3.6.8.1} ā vṛtrahaṇā vṛtrahabhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ | indra yātaṃ namobhir agne arvāk | yuvaṃ rādhobhir akavebhir indra | agne asme bhavatam uttamebhiḥ | hotā yakṣad indrāgnī | chāgasya vapāyā medasaḥ | juṣetāṃ haviḥ | hotar yaja | vi hy akhyan manasā vasya icchan | indrāgnī jñāsa uta vā sajātān |
analyzed: ā vṛtra haṇā vṛtra habhiḥ śuṣmaiḥ indra yātam namobhiḥ agne arvāk yuvam rādhobhiḥ akavebhiḥ indra agne asme bhavatam uttamebhiḥ hotā yakṣat indra agnī chāgasya vapāyāḥ medasaḥ juṣetām haviḥ hotar yaja vi hi akhyat manasā vasyaḥ icchan indra agnī jñāsaḥ uta vā sajātān

original: { 3.6.8.2} nānyā yuvat pramatir asti mahyam | sa vāṃ dhiyaṃ vājayantīm atakṣam | hotā yakṣad indrāgnī | puroḍāśasya juṣetāṃ haviḥ | hotar yaja | tvām īḍate ajiraṃ dūtyāya | haviṣmantaḥ sadam in mānuṣāsaḥ | yasya devair āsado barhir agne | ahāny asmai sudinā bhavantu | hotā yakṣad agnim | puroḍāśasya juṣatāṃ haviḥ | hotar yaja |
analyzed: na anyā yuvat pramatiḥ asti mahyam sa vām dhiyam vājayantīm atakṣam hotā yakṣat indra agnī puroḍāśasya juṣetām haviḥ hotar yaja tvām īḍate ajiram dūtyāya haviṣmantaḥ sadam id mānuṣāsaḥ yasya devaiḥ āsadaḥ barhiḥ agne ahāni asmai su dinā bhavantu hotā yakṣat agnim puroḍāśasya juṣatām haviḥ hotar yaja

original: anuvāka 9 { 3.6.9.1} gīrbhir vipraḥ pramatim icchamānaḥ | īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam | indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā | pra ṇo navyebhis tirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ | mā cchedma raśmīṃr iti nādhamānāḥ | pitṛṇāṃ śaktīr anuyacchamānāḥ | indrāgnibhyāṃ kaṃ vṛṣaṇo madanti | tā hy adrī dhiṣaṇāyā upasthe | agniṃ sudītiṃ sudṛśaṃ gṛṇantaḥ |
analyzed: gīrbhiḥ vipraḥ pramatim icchamānaḥ īṭṭe rayim yaśasam pūrvabhājam indra agnī vṛtra haṇā su vajrā pra naḥ navyebhiḥ tiratam deṣṇaiḥ mā chedma raśmīṃr iti nādhamānāḥ pitṛṇām śaktīḥ anuyacchamānāḥ indra agnibhyām kam vṛṣaṇaḥ madanti tā hi adrī dhiṣaṇāyāḥ upasthe agnim su dītim sudṛśam gṛṇantaḥ

original: namasyāmas tvā-ī́ḍyaṃ jātavedaḥ | tvāṃ dūtam aratiṃ havyavāham | devā akṛṇvann amṛtasya nābhim |

analyzed: devāḥ pitaraḥ pitaraḥ devāḥ yaḥ ham asmi ānaṃdāḥ asmi sa san yaje yasya asmi na tam antar emi svam me iṣṭam svam dattam svam pūrtam svam śrāntam svam hutam tasya me gniḥ upadraṣṭā vāyuḥ upaśrotā ādityaḥ nu khyātā dyauḥ pitā

original: { 3.7.5.6} ājyena pratyanajmy enat | tat ta āpyāyatāṃ punaḥ | ajyāyo yavamātrāt | āvyādhāt kṛtyatām idam | mā rūrupāma yajñasya | śuddhaṃ sviṣṭam idaṃ haviḥ | manunā dṛṣṭāṃ ghṛtapadīm | mitrāvaruṇasamīritām | dakṣiṇārdhād asaṃbhindan | avadyāmy ekatomukhām |
analyzed: ājyena pratyanajmi enat tat te āpyāyatām punar ajyāyaḥ yava mātrāt āvyādhāt kṛtyatām idam mā rūrupāma yajñasya śuddham su iṣṭam idam haviḥ manunā dṛṣṭām ghṛtapadīm mitrāvaruṇa samīritām dakṣiṇa ardhāt a sambhindan avadyāmi ekatomukhām

original: { 3.7.5.7} iḍe bhāgaṃ juṣasva naḥ | jinva gā jinvārvataḥ | tasyās te bhakṣivāṇaḥ syāma | sarvātmānaḥ sarvagaṇāḥ | bradhna pinvasva | dadato me mā kṣāyi | kurvato me mā-upadasat | diśāṃ klṛptir asi | diśo me kalpantām | kalpantāṃ me diśaḥ |
analyzed: iḍe bhāgam juṣasva naḥ jinva gāḥ jinva arvataḥ tasyāḥ te bhakṣivāṇaḥ syāma sarva ātmānaḥ sarva gaṇāḥ bradhna pinvasva dadataḥ me mā kṣāyi kurvataḥ me mā a upadasat diśām klṛptiḥ asi diśaḥ me kalpantām kalpantām me diśaḥ

original: { 3.7.5.8} daivīś ca mānuṣīś ca | ahorātre me kalpetām | ardhamāsā me kalpantām | māsā me kalpantām | ṛtavo me kalpantām | saṃvatsaro me kalpatām | klṛptir asi kalpatāṃ me | āśānāṃ tvā-āśāpālebhyaḥ | caturbhyo amṛtebhyaḥ | idaṃ bhūtasyādhyakṣebhyaḥ |
analyzed: daivīḥ ca mānuṣīḥ ca ahar rātre me kalpetām ardha māsāḥ me kalpantām māsāḥ me kalpantām ṛtavaḥ me kalpantām saṃvatsaraḥ me kalpatām klṛptiḥ asi kalpatām me āśānām tvā āśā pālebhyaḥ caturbhyaḥ amṛtebhyaḥ idam bhūtasya adhyakṣebhyaḥ

original: { 3.7.5.9} vidhema haviṣā vayam | bhajatāṃ bhāgī bhāgam | mā-abhāgo bhakta { 'bhakta) | nir abhāgaṃ bhajāmaḥ | apas pinva | oṣadhīr jinva | dvipāt pāhi | catuṣpād ava | divo vṛṣṭim eraya | brāhmaṇānām idaṃ haviḥ |
analyzed: vidhema haviṣā vayam bhajatām bhāgī bhāgam mā abhāgaḥ bhakta bhakta niḥ abhāgam bhajāmaḥ apaḥ pinva oṣadhīḥ jinva dvipād pāhi catuṣpād ava divaḥ vṛṣṭim eraya brāhmaṇānām idam haviḥ

original: { 3.7.5.10} somyānāṃ somapīthinām | nirbhakto 'brāhmaṇaḥ | na-ihābrāhmaṇasyāsti | samaṅktāṃ barhir haviṣā ghṛtena | sam ādityair vasubhiḥ saṃ marudbhiḥ | sam indreṇa viśvebhir devebhir aṅktām | divyaṃ nabho gacchatu yat svāhā | indrāṇīvāvidhavā bhūyāsam | aditir iva suputrā | asthūri tvā gārhapatya |
analyzed: somyānām soma pīthinām nirbhaktaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ na iha abrāhmaṇasya asti samaṅktām barhiḥ haviṣā ghṛtena sam ādityaiḥ vasubhiḥ sam marudbhiḥ sam indreṇa viśvebhiḥ devebhiḥ aṅktām divyam nabhaḥ gacchatu yat svāhā indrāṇī iva a vidhavā bhūyāsam aditiḥ iva su putrā asthūri tvā gārhapatya

original: { 3.7.5.11} upa niṣade suprajāstvāya | saṃ patnī patyā sukṛtena gacchatām | yajñasya yuktau dhuryāv abhūtām | saṃjānānau vijahatām arātīḥ | divi jyotir ajaram ārabhetām | daśa te tanuvo yajña yajñiyāḥ | tāḥ prīṇātu yajamāno ghṛtena | nāriṣṭhayoḥ praśiṣam īḍamānaḥ | devānāṃ daivye 'pi yajamāno 'mṛto 'bhūt | yaṃ vāṃ devā akalpayan |
analyzed: upa niṣade suprajāstvāya sam patnī patyā sukṛtena gacchatām yajñasya yuktau dhuryau abhūtām saṃjānānau vijahatām arātīḥ divi jyotiḥ ajaram ārabhetām daśa te tanuvaḥ yajña yajñiyāḥ tāḥ prīṇātu yajamānaḥ ghṛtena nāriṣṭhayoḥ praśiṣam īḍamānaḥ devānām daivye pi yajamānaḥ mṛtaḥ bhūt yam vām devāḥ akalpayan

original: { 3.7.5.12} ūrjo bhāgaṃ śatakratū | etad vāṃ tena prīṇāni | tena tṛpyatam aṃhahau {ḍyumoṇṭa aṃhohau} | ahaṃ devānāṃ sukṛtām asmi loke | mama-idam iṣṭaṃ na mithur bhavāti | ahaṃ nāriṣṭhāv anuyajāmi vidvān | yad ābhyām indro adadhād bhāgadheyam | adārasṛd bhavata {ḍyumoṇṭa bhavatu} deva soma | asmin yajñe maruto mṛḍatā naḥ |
analyzed: ūrjaḥ bhāgam śatakratū etat vām tena prīṇāni tena tṛpyatam aṃhahau ḍyumoṇṭa aṃhohau aham devānām sukṛtām asmi loke mama edam iṣṭam na mithuḥ bhavāti aham nāriṣṭhau anuyajāmi vidvān yat ābhyām indraḥ adadhāt bhāgadheyam a dāra sṛt bhavata ḍyumoṇṭa bhavatu deva soma asmin yajñe marutaḥ mṛḍata naḥ

original: mā no vidad abhi bhāmo aśastiḥ |
analyzed: mā naḥ vidat abhi bhāmaḥ aśastiḥ

original: { 3.7.5.13} mā no vidad vṛjanā dveṣyā yā | ṛṣabhaṃ vājinaṃ vayam | pūrṇamāsaṃ yajāmahe | sa no dohatāṃ suvīryam | rāyas poṣaṃ sahasriṇam | prāṇāya surādhase | pūrṇamāsāya svāhā | amāvāsyā subhagā suśevā | dhenur iva bhūya āpyāyamānā | sā no dohatāṃ suvīryam | rāyas poṣaṃ sahasriṇam | apānāya surādhase | amāvāsyāyai svāhā |
analyzed: mā naḥ vidat vṛjanā dveṣyā yāḥ ṛṣabham vājinam vayam pūrṇamāsam yajāmahe sa naḥ dohatām su vīryam rāyaḥ poṣam sahasriṇam prāṇāya su rādhase pūrṇamāsāya svāhā amāvāsyā subhagā su śevā dhenuḥ iva bhūyas āpyāyamānā sā naḥ dohatām su vīryam rāyaḥ poṣam sahasriṇam apānāya su rādhase amāvāsyāyai svāhā

original: abhistṛṇīhi paridhehi vedim | jāmiṃ mā hiṃsīr amuyā śayānā | hotṛṣadanā haritāḥ suvarṇāḥ | niṣkā ime yajamānasya bradhne |
analyzed: abhistṛṇīhi paridhehi vedim jāmim mā hiṃsīḥ amuyā śayānā hotṛṣadanā haritāḥ su varṇāḥ niṣkāḥ ime yajamānasya bradhne

original: anuvāka 6 { 3.7.6.1} paristṛṇīta paridhattāgnim | parihito 'gniryajamānaṃ bhunaktu | apāṃ rasa oṣadhīnāṃ suvarṇaḥ | niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu kāmadughāḥ | amutrāmuṣmin-loke | bhūpate bhuvanapate | mahato bhūtasya pate | brahmāṇaṃ tvā vṛṇīmahe | ahaṃ bhūpatir ahaṃ bhuvanapatiḥ | ahaṃ mahato bhūtasya patiḥ |
analyzed: paristṛṇīta paridhatta agnim parihitaḥ gniḥ yajamānam bhunaktu apām rasaḥ oṣadhīnām suvarṇaḥ niṣkāḥ ime yajamānasya santu kāmadughāḥ amutra amuṣmin loke bhūpate bhuvana pate mahataḥ bhūtasya pate brahmāṇam tvā vṛṇīmahe aham bhūpatiḥ aham bhuvana patiḥ aham mahataḥ bhūtasya patiḥ

original: { 3.7.6.2} devena savitrā prasūta ārtvijyaṃ kariṣyāmi | deva savitar etaṃ tvā vṛṇate | bṛhaspatiṃ daivyaṃ brahmāṇam | tad ahaṃ manase prabravīmi | mano gāyatriyai | gāyatrī triṣṭubhe | triṣṭub jagatyai | jagaty anuṣṭubhe | anuṣṭuk paṅktyai | paṅktiḥ prajāpataye |
analyzed: devena savitrā prasūtaḥ ārtvijyam kariṣyāmi deva savitar etam tvā vṛṇate bṛhaspatim daivyam brahmāṇam tat aham manase prabravīmi manaḥ gāyatriyai gāyatrī triṣṭubhe triṣṭubh jagatyai jagatī anuṣṭubhe anuṣṭubh paṅktyai paṅktiḥ prajāpataye

original: { 3.7.6.3} prajāpatir viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ | viśve devā bṛhaspataye | bṛhaspatir brahmaṇe | brahma bhūr bhuvaḥ suvah | bṛhaspatir devānāṃ brahmā | ahaṃ manuṣyāṇām | bṛhaspate yajñaṃ gopāya | idaṃ tasmai harmyaṃ karomi | yo vo devāś carati brahmacaryam | medhāvī dikṣu manasā tapasvī |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ viśvebhyaḥ devebhyaḥ viśve devāḥ bṛhaspataye bṛhaspatiḥ brahmaṇe brahma bhūḥ bhuvaḥ suvar bṛhaspatiḥ devānām brahmā aham manuṣyāṇām bṛhaspate yajñam gopāye idam tasmai harmyam karomi yaḥ vaḥ devāḥ carati brahmacaryam medhāvī dikṣu manasā tapasvī

original: { 3.7.6.4} antar dūtaś carati mānuṣīṣu | catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā bhuvanasya madhye | marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya | mahyaṃ dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān | bhūmir bhūtvā mahimānaṃ pupoṣa | tato devī vardhayate payāṃsi | yajñiyā yajñaṃ vi ca yanti saṃ ca | oṣadhīr āpa iha śakvarīś ca | yo mā hṛdā manasā yaś ca vācā |
analyzed: antar dūtaḥ carati mānuṣīṣu catur śikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ ghṛta pratīkā bhuvanasya madhye marmṛjyamānā mahate saubhagāya mahyam dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān bhūmiḥ bhūtvā mahimānam pupoṣa tatas devī vardhayate payāṃsi yajñiyāḥ yajñam vi ca yanti sam ca oṣadhīḥ āpaḥ iha śakvarīḥ ca yaḥ mā hṛdā manasā yaḥ ca vācā

original: { 3.7.6.5} yo brahmaṇā karmaṇā dveṣti devāḥ | yaḥ śrutena hṛdayena-iṣṇatā ca | tasya-indra vajreṇa śiraś cchinadmi | ūrṇāmṛdu prathamānaṃ syonam | devebhyo juṣṭaṃ sadanāya barhiḥ | suvarge loke yajamānaṃ hi dhehi | māṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe parame vyoman | catuḥśikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ | ghṛtapratīkā vayunāni vaste | sā stīryamāṇā mahate saubhagāya |
analyzed: yaḥ brahmaṇā karmaṇā dveṣti devāḥ yaḥ śrutena hṛdayena eṣṇatā ca tasya aindra vajreṇa śiraḥ chinadmi ūrṇā mṛdu prathamānam syonam devebhyaḥ juṣṭam sadanāya barhiḥ suvarge loke yajamānam hi dhehi mām nākasya pṛṣṭhe parame vyoman catur śikhaṇḍā yuvatiḥ supeśāḥ ghṛta pratīkā vayunāni vaste sā stīryamāṇā mahate saubhagāya

original: { 3.7.6.6} sā me dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān | śivā ca me śagmā caidhi | syonā ca me suṣadā caidhi | ūrjasvatī ca me payasvatī caidhi | iṣamūrjaṃ me pinvasva | brahma tejo me pinvasva | kṣatram ojo me pinvasva | viśaṃ puṣṭiṃ me pinvasva | āyur annādyaṃ me pinvasva | prajāṃ paśūn me pinvasva |
analyzed: sā me dhukṣva yajamānāya kāmān śivā ca me śagmā ca edhi syonā ca me suṣadā ca edhi ūrjasvatī ca me payasvatī ca edhi iṣam ūrjam me pinvasva brahma tejaḥ me pinvasva kṣatram ojaḥ me pinvasva viśam puṣṭim me pinvasva āyuḥ annādyam me pinvasva prajām paśūn me pinvasva

original: { 3.7.6.7} asmin yajña upa bhūya in nu me | avikṣobhāya paridhīn dadhāmi | dhartā dharuṇo dharīyān | agnir dveṣāṃsi nir ito nudātai | vicchinadmi vidhṛtībhyāṃ sapatnān | jātān bhrātṛbyān ye ca janiṣyamānāḥ | viśo yantrābhyāṃ vidhamāmy enān | ahaṃ svānām uttamo 'sāni devāḥ | viśo yantre nudamāne arātim | viśvaṃ pāpmānam amatiṃ durmarāyum |
analyzed: asmin yajñe upa bhūyaḥ id nu me a vikṣobhāya paridhīn dadhāmi dhartā dharuṇaḥ dharīyān agniḥ dveṣāṃsi niḥ itas nudātai vicchinadmi vidhṛtībhyām sapatnān jātān bhrātṛbyān ye ca janiṣyamānāḥ viśaḥ yantrābhyām vidhamāmi enān aham svānām uttamaḥ sāni devāḥ viśaḥ yantre nudamāne arātim viśvam pāpmānam amatim durmarāyum

original: { 3.7.6.8} sīdantī devī sukṛtasya loke | dhṛtī stho vidhṛtī svadhṛtī | prāṇān mayi dhārayatam | prajāṃ mayi dhārayatam | paśūn mayi dhārayatam | ayaṃ prastara ubhayasya dhartā | dhartā prayājānām utānūyājānām | sa dādhāra samidho viśvarūpāḥ | tasmint sruco adhy āsādayāmi | āroha patho juhu devayānān |
analyzed: sīdantī devī sukṛtasya loke dhṛtī sthaḥ vidhṛtī svadhṛtī prāṇān mayi dhārayatam prajām mayi dhārayatam paśūn mayi dhārayatam ayam prastaraḥ ubhayasya dhartā dhartā prayājānām uta anūyājānām sa dādhāra samidhaḥ viśva rūpāḥ tasmin srucaḥ adhi āsādayāmi āroha pathaḥ juhu deva yānān

original: { 3.7.6.9} yatra-ṛṣayaḥ prathamajā ye purāṇāḥ | hiraṇyapakṣā-ājirā sambhṛtāṅgā | vahāsi mā sukṛtāṃ yatra lokāḥ | avāhaṃ bādha upabhṛtā sapatnān | jātān bhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ | dohaṃ { dohai} yajñaṃ sudughām iva dhenum | aham uttaro bhūyāsam | adhare mat sapatnāḥ | yo mā vācā manasā durmarāyuḥ | hṛdā-arātīyād abhidāsad agne |
analyzed: yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathama jāḥ ye purāṇāḥ hiraṇya pakṣā ajirā sambhṛta aṅgā vahāsi mā sukṛtām yatra lokāḥ ava aham bādhe upabhṛtā sapatnān jātān bhrātṛvyān ye ca janiṣyamāṇāḥ doham dohai yajñam sudughām iva dhenum aham uttaraḥ bhūyāsam adhare mat sapatnāḥ yaḥ mā vācā manasā durmarāyuḥ hṛdā arātīyāt abhidāsat agne

original: { 3.7.6.10} idam asya cittam adharaṃ dhruvāyāḥ | aham uttaro bhūyāsam | adhare mat sapatnāḥ | ṛṣabho 'si śākvaraḥ | ghṛtācīnāṃ sūnuḥ | priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda | syono me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyām | prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke | divi sīda pṛthivyām antarikṣe | aham uttaro bhūyāsam |
analyzed: idam asya cittam adharam dhruvāyāḥ aham uttaraḥ bhūyāsam adhare mat sapatnāḥ ṛṣabhaḥ si śākvaraḥ ghṛtācīnām sūnuḥ priyeṇa nāmnā priye sadasi sīda syonaḥ me sīda suṣadaḥ pṛthivyām prathayi prajayā paśubhiḥ suvarge loke divi sīda pṛthivyām antarikṣe aham uttaraḥ bhūyāsam

original: { 3.7.6.11} adhare mat sapatnāḥ | iyaṃ sthālī ghṛtasya pūrṇā | acchinnapayāḥ śatadhāra utsaḥ | mārutena śarmaṇā daivyena | yajño 'si sarvataḥ śritaḥ | sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhavaiṣyat-śrayatām | śataṃ me santv āśiṣaḥ | sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtāḥ | irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ | prajāpatir asi sarvataḥ śritaḥ |
analyzed: adhare mat sapatnāḥ iyam sthālī ghṛtasya pūrṇā acchinna payāḥ śata dhāraḥ utsaḥ mārutena śarmaṇā daivyena yajñaḥ si sarvatas śritaḥ sarvatas mām bhūtam bhava eṣyat śrayatām śatam me santu āśiṣaḥ sahasram me santu sūnṛtāḥ irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ prajāpatiḥ asi sarvatas śritaḥ

original: { 3.7.6.12} sarvato māṃ bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyat-śrayatām | śataṃ me santv āśiṣaḥ | sahasraṃ me santu sūnṛtāḥ | irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ | idam indriyam amṛtaṃ vīryam | anena-indrāya paśavo 'cikitsan | tena devā avato 'pa { avatopa} mām | iha-iṣamūrjaṃ yaśaḥ saha ojaḥ saneyam | śṛtaṃ mayi śrayatām | yat pṛthivīm acarat tat praviṣṭam |
analyzed: sarvatas mām bhūtam bhaviṣyat śrayatām śatam me santu āśiṣaḥ sahasram me santu sūnṛtāḥ irāvatīḥ paśumatīḥ idam indriyam amṛtam vīryam anena aindrāya paśavaḥ cikitsan tena devāḥ avata u pa avata upa mām iha eṣam ūrjam yaśaḥ sahaḥ ojaḥ saneyam śṛtam mayi śrayatām yat pṛthivīm acarat tat praviṣṭam

original: { 3.7.6.13} yenāsiñcad balam indre prajāpatiḥ | idaṃ tat-śukraṃ madhu vājinīvat | yena-upariṣṭād adhinon mahendram | dadhi māṃ dhinotu | ayaṃ vedaḥ pṛthivīm anvavindat | guhā satīṃ gahane gahvareṣu | sa vindatu yajamānāya lokam | acchidraṃ yajñaṃ bhūrikarmā karotu | ayaṃ yajñaḥ samasadad dhaviṣmān | ṛcā sāmnā yajuṣā devatābhiḥ |
analyzed: yena asiñcat balam indre prajāpatiḥ idam tat śukram madhu vājinīvat yena aupariṣṭāt adhinot mahendram dadhi mām dhinotu ayam vedaḥ pṛthivīm anvavindat guhā satīm gahane gahvareṣu sa vindatu yajamānāya lokam acchidram yajñam bhūri karmā karotu ayam yajñaḥ samasadat haviṣmān ṛcā sāmnā yajuṣā devatābhiḥ

original: { 3.7.9.2} yuktāḥ stha vahata | devā grāvāṇa indur indra ity avādiṣuḥ | ā-indram {ānaṃdā. aindram} acucyavuḥ paramasyāḥ {ānaṃdā. param asyāḥ} parāvataḥ | ā-asmāt sadhasthāt | ā-uror antarikṣāt | ā subhūtam asuṣavuḥ | brahmavarcasaṃ ma āsuṣavuḥ | samare rakṣāṃsy avadhiṣuḥ | apahataṃ brahmajyasya | vāk ca tvā manaś ca śriṇītām |

original: { 3.7.9.3} prāṇaś ca tvā-apānaś ca śrīṇītām | cakṣuś ca tvā śrotraṃ ca śrīṇītām | dakṣaś ca tvā balaṃ ca śrīṇītām | ojaś ca tvā sahaś ca śrīṇītām | āyuś ca tvā jarā ca śrīṇītām | ātmā ca tvā tanūś ca śrīṇītām | śṛto 'si śṛtaṃkṛtaḥ | śṛtāya tvā śṛtebhyas tvā | yam indram āhur varuṇaṃ yam āhuḥ | yaṃ mitram āhur yam u satyam āhuḥ |
analyzed: prāṇaḥ ca tvā apānaḥ ca śrīṇītām cakṣuḥ ca tvā śrotram ca śrīṇītām dakṣaḥ ca tvā balam ca śrīṇītām ojaḥ ca tvā sahaḥ ca śrīṇītām āyuḥ ca tvā jarā ca śrīṇītām ātmā ca tvā tanūḥ ca śrīṇītām śṛtaḥ u si śṛtaṃkṛtaḥ śṛtāya tvā śṛtebhyaḥ tvā yam indram āhuḥ varuṇam yam āhuḥ yam mitram āhuḥ yam u satyam āhuḥ

original: { 3.7.9.4} yo devānāṃ devatamas tapojāḥ | tasmai tvā tebhyas tvā | mayi tyad indriyaṃ mahat | mayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ | mayi dhāyi suvīryam | triśug gharmo vibhātu me | ākūtyā manasā saha | virājā jyotiṣā saha | yajñena payasā saha | tasya doham aśīmahi |
analyzed: yaḥ devānām devatamaḥ tapaḥ jāḥ tasmai tvā tebhyaḥ tvā mayi tyad indriyam mahat mayi dakṣaḥ mayi kratuḥ mayi dhāyi su vīryam tri śuc gharmaḥ vibhātu me ākūtyā manasā saha virājā jyotiṣā saha yajñena payasā saha tasya doham aśīmahi

original: { 3.7.9.5} tasya sumnam aśīmahi | tasya bhakṣam aśīmahi | vāg juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu | mitro janān, pra sa mitra, | yasmān na jātaḥ paro anyo asti | ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā | prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ | trīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī | eṣa brahmā ya ṛtviyaḥ | indro nāma śruto gaṇe |
analyzed: tasya sumnam aśīmahi tasya bhakṣam aśīmahi vāc juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu mitraḥ janān pra sa mitra yasmāt na jātaḥ paraḥ anyaḥ asti yaḥ āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ trīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī eṣa brahmā yaḥ ṛtviyaḥ indraḥ nāma śrutaḥ gaṇe

original: { 3.7.9.6} pra te mahe vidathe 'śaṃsiṣaṃ harī | ya ṛtviyaḥ pra te vanve | vanuṣo haryataṃ madam | indro nāma ghṛtaṃ na yaḥ | haribhiś cāru secate | śruto gaṇa ā tvā viśantu | harivarpasaṃ giraḥ | indrādhipate 'dhipatis tvaṃ devānām asi | adhipatiṃ mām | āyuṣmantaṃ varcasvantaṃ manuṣyeṣu kuru |
analyzed: pra te mahe vidathe śaṃsiṣam harī yaḥ ṛtviyaḥ pra te vanve vanuṣaḥ haryatam madam indraḥ nāma ghṛtam na yaḥ haribhiḥ cāru secate śrutaḥ gaṇaḥ ā tvā viśantu hari varpasam giraḥ indra adhipate dhipatiḥ tvam devānām asi adhipatim mām āyuṣmantam varcasvantam manuṣyeṣu kuru

original: { 3.7.9.7} indraś ca samrāḍ varuṇaś ca rājā | tau te bhakṣaṃ cakratur agra etam | tayor anu bhakṣaṃ bhakṣayāmi | vāg juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu | prajāpatir viśvakarmā | tasya mano devaṃ yajñena rādhyāsam | arthegā asy ajahitaḥ {,ānaṃdā. asya jahitaḥ} | avasānapate 'vasānaṃ me vinda | namo rudrāya vāstoṣpataye | āyane vidravaṇe |
analyzed: indraḥ ca samrāj varuṇaḥ ca rājā tau te bhakṣam cakratuḥ agre etam tayoḥ anu bhakṣam bhakṣayāmi vāc juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu prajāpatiḥ viśvakarmā tasya manaḥ devam yajñena rādhyāsam arthegāḥ asi a jahitaḥ ānaṃdāḥ asya jahitaḥ avasāna pate vasānam me vinda namaḥ rudrāya vāstoṣpataye āyane vidravaṇe

original: { 3.7.9.8} udyāne yat parāyaṇe | āvartane vivartane | yo gopāyati taṃ huve | yāny apāmityāny apratīttāny {ānaṃdā. apratītāny} asmi | yamasya {ḍyumoṇṭa yena yamasya} balinā carāmi | ihaiva santaḥ prati tad yātayāmaḥ | jīvā jīvebhyo niharāma enat | anṛṇā asminn anṛṇāḥ parasmin | tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma | ye devayānā uta pitṛyāṇāḥ |
analyzed: udyāne yat parāyaṇe āvartane vivartane yaḥ gopāyati tam huve yāni apāmityāni apratīttāni ānaṃdāḥ apratītāni asmi yamasya yena yamasya balinā carāmi iha eva santaḥ prati tat yātayāmaḥ jīvāḥ jīvebhyaḥ niharāma enat anṛṇāḥ asmin anṛṇāḥ parasmin tṛtīye loke anṛṇāḥ syāma ye deva yānāḥ uta pitṛyāṇāḥ

original: { 3.7.9.9} sarvān patho anṛṇā ākṣīyema | idamū nu śreyo 'vasānam āganma | śive no dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime | gomad dhanavad aśvavad ūrjasvat | suvīrā vīrair anu saṃcarema | arkaḥ pavitraṃ rajaso vimānaḥ | punāti devānāṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | dyāvāpṛthivī payasā saṃvidāne | ghṛtaṃ duhāte amṛtaṃ prapīne | pavitram arko rajaso vimānaḥ |
analyzed: sarvān pathaḥ anṛṇāḥ ākṣīyema idam u nu śreyaḥ vasānam āganma śive naḥ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe ime gomat dhanavat aśvavat ūrjasvat su vīrāḥ vīraiḥ anu saṃcarema arkaḥ pavitram rajasaḥ vimānaḥ punāti devānām bhuvanāni viśvā dyāvāpṛthivī payasā saṃvidāne ghṛtam duhāte amṛtam prapīne pavitram arkaḥ rajasaḥ vimānaḥ

original: punāti devānāṃ bhuvanāni viśvā | suvar jyotir yaśo mahat | aśīmahi gādham uta pratiṣṭhām |

original: { 3.7.10.2} daivyaḥ ketur viśvaṃ bhuvanam āviveśa | sa naḥ pāhy ariṣṭyai svāhā | anu mā sarvo yajño 'yam etu | viśve devā marutaḥ sāmārkaḥ | āpriyaś chandāṃsi nivido yajūṃṣi | asyai pṛthivyai yad yajñiyam | prajāpater vartanim anuvartasva | anu vīrair anurādhyāma gobhiḥ | anv aśvair anu sarvair u puṣṭaiḥ | anu prajayā-anv indriyeṇa |

original: { 3.7.10.3} devā no yajñam ṛjudhā nayantu | prati kṣatre prati tiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre | praty aśveṣu pratitiṣṭhāmi goṣu | prati prajāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhāmi bhavye | viśvam anyā-abhivāvṛdhe | tad anyasyām adhi śritam | dive ca viśvakarmaṇe | pṛthivyai cākaraṃ namaḥ | askān dyauḥ pṛthivīm | askān ṛṣabho yuvā gāḥ |
