original: { 3.7.10.4} skannā-imā viśvā bhuvanā | skanno yajñaḥ prajanayatu | askān ajani prājani | ā skannāj jāyate vṛṣā | skannāt prajaniṣīmahi | ye devā yeṣām idaṃ bhāgadheyaṃ babhūva | yeṣāṃ prayājā utānūyājāḥ | indrajyeṣṭhebhyo varuṇarājabhyaḥ | agnihotṛbhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā | uta tyā no divā matiḥ |

original: { 3.7.10.5} aditir ūtyā-āgamat | sā śantācī {ḍyumoṇṭa śaṃtāti} mayas karat | apa sridhaḥ | uta tyā daivyā bhiṣajā | śaṃ nas karato aśvinā | yūyātām asmad rapaḥ | apa sridhaḥ | śam agnir agnibhis karat | śaṃ nas tapatu sūryaḥ | śaṃ vāto vātv arapāḥ |

original: { 3.7.14.5} abhi naḥ śīyatāṃ rayiḥ | sacatāṃ naḥ śacīpatiḥ | paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthām | yas te sva itaro devayānāt | cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi | mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mā-uta vīrān | idamū nu śreyo 'vasānam āganma | yad gojid dhanajid aśvajid yat | parṇaṃ vanaspater iva | abhi naḥ śīyatāṃ rayiḥ | sacatāṃ naḥ śacīpatiḥ |
analyzed: abhi naḥ śīyatām rayiḥ sacatām naḥ śacīpatiḥ param mṛtyo anu parehi panthām yaḥ te svaḥ itaraḥ deva yānāt cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajām rīriṣaḥ mā uta vīrān idam u nu śreyaḥ vasānam āganma yat go jit dhana jit aśva jit yat parṇam vanaspateḥ iva abhi naḥ śīyatām rayiḥ sacatām naḥ śacīpatiḥ

original: prapāṭhaka: 8 anuvāka 1 { 3.8.1.1} sāṃgrahaṇyā-iṣṭyā yajate | imāṃ janatāṃ saṃgṛhṇānīti | dvādaśāratnī raśanā bhavati | dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ | saṃvatsaram evāvarundhe | mauñjī́ bhavati | ūrg vai muñjāḥ | ūrjam evāvarundhe | citrā nakṣatraṃ bhavati | citraṃ vā etat karma |
analyzed: prapāṭhaka 8 anuvāka 1 3811 sāṃgrahaṇyā iṣṭyā yajate imām janatām saṃgṛhṇāni iti dvādaśa aratnī raśanā bhavati dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraḥ saṃvatsaram eva avarundhe mauñjī bhavati ūrj vai muñjāḥ ūrjam eva avarundhe citrā nakṣatram bhavati citram vai etat karma

original: { 3.8.1.2} yad aśvamedhaḥ samṛddhyai | puṇyanāma devayajanam adhyavasyati | puṇyām eva tena kīrtim abhijayati | apadātīn ṛtvijaḥ samāvahanty ā subrahmaṇyāyāḥ | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | keśaśmaśru vapate | nakhāni nikṛntate | dato dhāvate | snāti | ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte | pāpmano 'pahatyai | vācaṃ yatvā-upavasati |
analyzed: yat aśvamedhaḥ samṛddhyai puṇya nāma devayajanam adhyavasyati puṇyām eva tena kīrtim abhijayati apadātīn ṛtvijaḥ samāvahanti ā subrahmaṇyāyāḥ suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai keśa śmaśru vapate nakhāni nikṛntate dataḥ dhāvate snāti ahatam vāsaḥ paridhatte pāpmanaḥ upahatyai vācam yatvā upavasati

original: suvargasya lokasya guptyai | rātriṃ jāgarayanta āsate | suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai |
analyzed: suvargasya lokasya guptyai rātrim jāgarayantaḥ āsate suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai

original: anuvāka 2 { 3.8.2.1} catuṣṭayya āpo bhavanti | catuḥśapho vā aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai | tā digbhyaḥ samābhṛtā bhavanti | dikṣu vā āpaḥ | annaṃ vā āpaḥ | adbhyo vā annaṃ jāyate | yad evādbhyo 'nnaṃ jāyate | tad avarundhe | tāsu brahmaudanaṃ pacati | reta eva tad dadhāti |
analyzed: catuṣṭayyaḥ āpaḥ bhavanti catur śaphaḥ vai aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai tāḥ digbhyaḥ samābhṛtāḥ bhavanti dikṣu vai āpaḥ annam vai āpaḥ adbhyaḥ vai annam jāyate yat eva adbhyaḥ nnam jāyate tat avarundhe tāsu brahmaudanam pacati retaḥ eva tat dadhāti

original: { 3.8.2.2} catuḥśarāvo bhavati | dikṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati | ubhayato rukmau bhavataḥ | ubhayata evāsmin rucaṃ dadhāti | uddharati śṛtatvāya | sarpiṣvān bhavati medhyatvāya | catvāra ārṣeyāḥ prāśnanti | diśām eva jyotiṣi juhoti | catvāri hiraṇyāni dadāti | diśām eva jyotīṃṣy avarundhe |
analyzed: catur śarāvaḥ bhavati dikṣu eva prati tiṣṭhati ubhayatas rukmau bhavataḥ ubhayatas eva asmin rucam dadhāti uddharati śṛta tvāya sarpiṣvān bhavati medhya tvāya catvāraḥ ārṣeyāḥ prāśnanti diśām eva jyotiṣi juhoti catvāri hiraṇyāni dadāti diśām eva jyotīṃṣi avarundhe

original: { 3.8.2.3} yad ājyam ucchiṣyate | tasmin raśanāṃ nyunatti | prajāpatir vā odanaḥ | reta ājyam | yad ājye raśanāṃ nyunatti | prajāpatim eva retasā samardhayati | darbhamayī raśanā bhavati | bahu vā eṣa kucaro 'medhyam upagacchati | yad aśvaḥ | pavitraṃ vai darbhāḥ |
analyzed: yat ājyam ucchiṣyate tasmin raśanām nyunatti prajāpatiḥ vai odanaḥ retaḥ ājyam yat ājye raśanām nyunatti prajāpatim eva retasā samardhayati darbha mayī raśanā bhavati bahu vai eṣa kucaraḥ medhyam upagacchati yat aśvaḥ pavitram vai darbhāḥ

original: { 3.8.2.4} yad darbhamayī raśaṇā bhavati | punāty eva-enam | pūtam enaṃ medhyam ālabhate | aśvasya vā ālabdhasya mahimā-udakrāmat | sa mahartvijaḥ prāviśat | tan mahartvijāṃ mahartviktvam | yan mahartvijaḥ prāśnanti | mahimānam evāsmin tad dadhati | aśvasya vā ālabdhasya reta udakrāmat | tat suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyam abhavat |
analyzed: yat darbha mayī raśaṇā bhavati punāti eva enam pūtam enam medhyam ālabhate aśvasya vai ālabdhasya mahimā udakrāmat sa mahartvijaḥ prāviśat tat mahartvijām mahartvij tvam yat mahartvijaḥ prāśnanti mahimānam eva asmin tat dadhati aśvasya vai ālabdhasya retaḥ udakrāmat tat suvarṇam hiraṇyam abhavat

original: yat suvarṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ dadāti | reta eva tad dadhāti | odane dadāti | reto vā odanaḥ | reto hiraṇyam | retasā-evāsmin reto dadhāti |
analyzed: yat suvarṇam hiraṇyam dadāti retaḥ eva tat dadhāti odane dadāti retaḥ vai odanaḥ retaḥ hiraṇyam retasā eva asmin retaḥ dadhāti

original: anuvāka 3 { 3.8.3.1} yo vai brahmaṇe devebhyaḥ prajāpataye 'pratiprocyāśvaṃ medhyaṃ badhnāti | ā devatābhyo vṛścyate | pāpīyān bhavati | yaḥ pratiprocya | na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati | yad āha | brahmann aśvaṃ medhyaṃ bhantsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsam iti | brahma vai brahmā |
analyzed: yaḥ vai brahmaṇe devebhyaḥ prajāpataye pratiprocya aśvam medhyam badhnāti ā devatābhyaḥ vṛścyate pāpīyān bhavati yaḥ pratiprocya na devatābhyaḥ āvṛścyate vasīyān bhavati yat āha brahman aśvam medhyam bhantsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsam iti brahma vai brahmā

original: brahmaṇa eva devebhyaḥ prajāpataye pratiprocyāśvaṃ medhyaṃ badhnāti |
analyzed: brahmaṇe eva devebhyaḥ prajāpataye pratiprocya aśvam medhyam badhnāti

original: { 3.8.3.2} na devatābhya āvṛścyate | vasīyān bhavati | devasya tvā savituḥ prasava iti raśanām ādatte prasūtyai | aśvinor bāhubhyām ity āha | aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām | pūṣṇo hastābhyām ity āha yatyai | vyṛddhaṃ vā etad yajñasya | yad ayajuṣkeṇa kriyate | imām agṛbhṇan raśnām ṛtasya-ity adhivadati yajuṣkṛtyai | yajñasya samṛddhyai |
analyzed: na devatābhyaḥ āvṛścyate vasīyān bhavati devasya tvā savituḥ prasave iti raśanām ādatte prasūtyai aśvinoḥ bāhubhyām iti āha aśvinau hi devānām adhvaryū āstām pūṣṇaḥ hastābhyām iti āha yatyai vyṛddham vai etat yajñasya yat ayajuṣkeṇa kriyate imām agṛbhṇan raśnām ṛtasya eti adhivadati yajuṣkṛtyai yajñasya samṛddhyai

original: { 3.8.3.3} tad āhuḥ | dvādaśāratnī raśanā kartavyā3 trayodaśāratnī3r iti | ṛṣabho vā eṣa ṛtūnām | yathā {!} saṃvatsaraḥ | tasya trayodaśo māso viṣṭapam | ṛṣabha eṣa yajñānām | yad aśvamedhaḥ | yathā vā ṛṣabhasya viṣṭapam | evam etasya viṣṭapam | trayodaśam aratniṃ raśanāyām upādadhāti |
analyzed: tat āhuḥ dvādaśa aratniḥ raśanā kartavyā trayodaśa aratnīḥ iti ṛṣabhaḥ vai eṣaḥ ṛtūnām yathā saṃvatsaraḥ tasya trayodaśaḥ māsaḥ viṣṭapam ṛṣabhaḥ eṣa yajñānām yat aśvamedhaḥ yathā vai ṛṣabhasya viṣṭapam evam etasya viṣṭapam trayodaśam aratnim raśanāyām upādadhāti

original: { 3.8.3.4} yathā-ṛṣabhasya viṣṭapaṃ saṃskaroti | tādṛg eva tat | pūrva āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavya-ity āha | āyur evāsmin dadhāti | tayā devāḥ sutam ābabhūvur ity āha | bhūtim eva-upāvartate | ṛtasya sāmant saram ārapantīty āha | satyaṃ vā ṛtam | satyena-evainam ṛtena-ārabhate | abhidhā asīty āha |
analyzed: yathā ā ṛṣabhasya viṣṭapam saṃskaroti tādṛś eva tat pūrve āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavya eti āha āyuḥ eva asmin dadhāti tayā devāḥ sutam ābabhūvuḥ iti āha bhūtim eva upāvartate ṛtasya sāman saram ārapanti iti āha satyam vai ṛtam satyena eva enam ṛtena ārabhate abhidhā asi iti āha

original: { 3.8.3.5} tasmād aśvamedhayājī sarvāṇi bhūtāny abhibhavati | bhuvanam asīty āha | bhūmānam eva-upaiti | yantā-asīty āha | yantāram evainaṃ karoti | dhartā-asīty āha | dhartāram evainaṃ karoti | so 'gniṃ vaiśvānaram ity āha | agnāv evainaṃ vaiśvānare juhoti | saprathasam ity āha |
analyzed: tasmāt aśvamedha yājī sarvāṇi bhūtāni abhibhavati bhuvanam asi iti āha bhūmānam eva upaiti yantā asi iti āha yantāram eva enam karoti dhartā asi iti āha dhartāram eva enam karoti saḥ gnim vaiśvānaram iti āha agnau eva enam vaiśvānare juhoti saprathasam iti āha

original: { 3.8.3.6} prajaya-evainaṃ paśubhiḥ prathayati | svāhākṛta ity āha | homa evāsyaiṣaḥ | pṛthivyām ity āha | asyām eva-enaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | yantā rāḍ yantā-asi yamano dhartā-asi dharuṇa ity āha | rūpam evāsyaitan mahimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā-ity āha | āśiṣam eva-etām āśāste | svagā tvā devebhya ity āha |
analyzed: prajayā eva enam paśubhiḥ prathayati svāhākṛtaḥ iti āha homaḥ eva asya eṣaḥ pṛthivyām iti āha asyām eva enam pratiṣṭhāpayati yantā rāj yantā asi yamanaḥ dhartā asi dharuṇaḥ iti āha rūpam eva asya etat mahimānam vyācaṣṭe kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā iti āha āśiṣam eva etām āśāste svagā tvā devebhyaḥ iti āha

original: devebhya eva-enaṃ svagā karoti | svāhā tvā prajāpataya ity āha | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | yasyā eva devatāyā ālabhyate | tayā-eva-enaṃ samardhayati |
analyzed: devebhyaḥ eva enam svagā karoti svāhā tvā prajāpataye iti āha prājāpatyaḥ vai aśvaḥ yasyāḥ eva devatāyai ālabhyate tayā eva enam samardhayati

original: anuvāka 4 { 3.8.4.1} yaḥ pitur anujāyāḥ putraḥ | sa purastān nayati | yo mātur anujāyāḥ putraḥ | sa paścān nayati | viṣvañcam evāsmāt pāpmānaṃ vivṛhataḥ | yo arvantaṃ jighāṃsati tam abhyamīti varuṇa iti śvānaṃ caturakṣaṃ prasauti | paro martaḥ paraḥ śvā-iti śunaś caturakṣasya prahanti | śvā-iva vai pāpmā bhrātṛvyaḥ |
analyzed: yaḥ pituḥ anujāyāḥ putraḥ sa purastāt nayati yaḥ mātuḥ anujāyāḥ putraḥ sa paścāt nayati viṣvañcam eva asmāt pāpmānam vivṛhataḥ yaḥ arvantam jighāṃsati tam abhyamīti varuṇaḥ iti śvānam catur akṣam prasauti paraḥ martaḥ paraḥ śvā iti śunaḥ catur akṣasya prahanti śvā iva vai pāpmā bhrātṛvyaḥ

original: pāpmānam evāsya bhrātṛvyaṃ hanti | saidhrakaṃ musalaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: pāpmānam eva asya bhrātṛvyam hanti saidhrakam musalam bhavati

original: { 3.8.4.2} karma-karma-evāsmai sādhayati | pauṃścaleyo hanti | puṃścalvāṃ vai devāḥ śucaṃ nyadadhuḥ | śucā-evāsya śucaṃ hanti | pāpmā vā etam īpsatīty āhuḥ | yo 'śvamedhena yajata iti | aśvasyādhaspadam upāsyati | vajrī vā aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ | vajreṇaiva pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyam avakrāmati | dakṣiṇā-apaplāvayati |
analyzed: karma karma eva asmai sādhayati pauṃścaleyaḥ hanti puṃścalvām vai devāḥ śucam nyadadhuḥ śucā eva asya śucam hanti pāpmā vai etam īpsati iti āhuḥ śvamedhena yajate iti aśvasya adhaspadam upāsyati vajrī vai aśvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ vajreṇa eva pāpmānam bhrātṛvyam avakrāmati dakṣiṇā apaplāvayati

original: { 3.8.4.3} pāpmānam evāsmāt-śamalam apaplāvayati | aiṣīka udūho bhavati | āyur vā iṣīkāḥ | āyur evāsmin dadhati | amṛtaṃ vā iṣīkāḥ | amṛtam evāsmin dadhati | vetasaśākhā-upasaṃbaddhā bhavati | apsuyonir vā aśvaḥ | apsujo vetasaḥ | svād eva-enaṃ yonir nirmimīte | purastāt pratyañcam abhyudūhati | purastād evāsmin pratīcy amṛtaṃ dadhāti |
analyzed: pāpmānam eva asmāt śamalam apaplāvayati aiṣīkaḥ udūhaḥ bhavati āyuḥ vai iṣīkāḥ āyuḥ eva asmin dadhati amṛtam vai iṣīkāḥ amṛtam eva asmin dadhati vetasa śākhā upasaṃbaddhā bhavati apsuyoniḥ vai aśvaḥ apsujaḥ vetasaḥ svāt eva enam yoniḥ nirmimīte purastāt pratyañcam abhyudūhati purastāt eva asmin pratīci amṛtam dadhāti

original: ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca vṛtrahann iti brahmā yajamānasya hastaṃ gṛhṇāti | brahmakṣattre eva saṃdadhāti | abhi kratvā-indra bhūr adha jmann ity adhvaryur yajamānaṃ vācayaty abhijityai |
analyzed: aham ca tvam ca vṛtrahan iti brahmā yajamānasya hastam gṛhṇāti brahma kṣattre eva saṃdadhāti abhi kratvā indra bhūḥ adha jman iti adhvaryuḥ yajamānam vācayati abhijityai

original: anuvāka 5 { 3.8.5.1} catvāra ṛtvijaḥ samukṣanti | ābhya evainaṃ catasṛbhyo digbhyo 'bhisamīrayanti | śatena rājaputraiḥ sahādhvaryuḥ | purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | anenāśvena medhyena-iṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā vṛtraṃ vadhyād iti | rājyaṃ vā adhvaryuḥ | kṣattraṃ {= kṣatraṃ } rājaputraḥ | rājyena-evāsmin kṣattraṃ {= kṣatraṃ } dadhāti |
analyzed: catvāraḥ ṛtvijaḥ samukṣanti ābhyaḥ eva enam catasṛbhyaḥ digbhyaḥ bhisamīrayanti śatena rājaputraiḥ saha adhvaryuḥ purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati anena aśvena medhyena eṣṭvā ayam rājā vṛtram vadhyāt iti rājyam vai adhvaryuḥ kṣattram kṣatram rājaputraḥ rājyena eva asmin kṣattram kṣatram dadhāti

original: śatenārājabhir ugraiḥ saha brahmā |
analyzed: śatena a rājabhiḥ ugraiḥ saha brahmā

original: { 3.8.5.2} dakṣiṇata udaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | anenāśvena medhyena-iṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājāpratidhṛṣyo 'stv iti | balaṃ vai brahmā | balam arājā-ugraḥ | balena-evāsmin balaṃ dadhāti | śatena sūtagrāmaṇibhiḥ saha hotā | paścāt prāṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | anenāśvena medhyena-iṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā-asyai viśaḥ |
analyzed: dakṣiṇatas udaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati anena aśvena medhyena eṣṭvā ayam rājā apratidhṛṣyaḥ stu iti balam vai brahmā balam a rājā augraḥ balena eva asmin balam dadhāti śatena sūta grāmaṇibhiḥ saha hotā paścāt prāṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati anena aśvena medhyena eṣṭvā ayam rājā asyai viśaḥ

original: { 3.8.5.3} bahugvai bahvaśvāyai bahvajāvikāyai | bahuvrīhiyavāyai bahumāṣatilāyai | bahuhiraṇyāyai bahuhastikāyai | bahudāsapūruṣāyai rayimatyai puṣṭimatyai | bahurāyaspoṣāyai rājā-astv iti | bhūmā vai hotā | bhūmā sūtagrāmaṇyaḥ | bhūmnā-evāsmin bhūmānaṃ dadhāti | śatena kṣattasaṃgrahītṛbhiḥ saha-udgātā | uttarato dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan prokṣati |
analyzed: bahu gvai bahu aśvāyai bahu ajāvikāyai bahu vrīhi yavāyai bahu māṣa tilāyai bahu hiraṇyāyai bahu hastikāyai bahu dāsa pūruṣāyai rayimatyai puṣṭimatyai bahu rāyaspoṣāyai rājā astu iti bhūmā vai hotā bhūmā sūta grāmaṇyaḥ bhūmnā eva asmin bhūmānam dadhāti śatena kṣattṛ saṃgrahītṛbhiḥ saha audgātā uttaratas dakṣiṇā tiṣṭhan prokṣati

original: { 3.8.5.4} anenāśvena medhyena-iṣṭvā | ayaṃ rājā sarvam āyur etv iti | āyur vā udgātā | āyuḥ kṣattasaṃgrahītāraḥ | āyuṣā-evāsminn āyur dadhāti | śataṃ-śataṃ bhavanti | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata-indriyaḥ | āyuṣy eva-indriye pratitiṣṭhati catuḥśatā bhavanti | catasro diśaḥ | dikṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati |

original: asminn eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | etāṃ ha vāva so 'śvamedhasya saṃsthitim uvācāskandāya | askannaṃ hi tat | yad yajñasya saṃsthitasya skandati |
analyzed: asmin eva loke pratitiṣṭhati etām ha vāva saḥ śvamedhasya saṃsthitim uvāca a skandāya a skannam hi tat yat yajñasya saṃsthitasya skandati

original: anuvāka 7 { 3.8.7.1} prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīti purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati | prajāpatir vai devānām annādo vīryāvān | annādyam evāsmin vīryaṃ dadhāti | tasmād aśvaḥ paśūnām annādo vīryāvattamaḥ | indrāgnibhyāṃ tvā-iti dakṣiṇataḥ | indrāgnī vai devānām ojiṣṭhau baliṣṭhau | oja evāsmin balaṃ dadhāti |
analyzed: prajāpataye tvā juṣṭam prokṣāmi iti purastāt pratyaṅ tiṣṭhan prokṣati prajāpatiḥ vai devānām anna ādaḥ vīryāvān annādyam eva asmin vīryam dadhāti tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām anna ādaḥ vīryāvattamaḥ indra agnibhyām tvā iti dakṣiṇatas indra agnī vai devānām ojiṣṭhau baliṣṭhau ojaḥ eva asmin balam dadhāti

original: tasmād aśvaḥ paśūnām ojiṣṭho baliṣṭhaḥ | vāyave tvā-iti paścāt | vāyur vai devānām āśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām ojiṣṭhaḥ baliṣṭhaḥ vāyave tvā iti paścāt vāyuḥ vai devānām āśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ

original: { 3.8.7.2} javam evāsmin dadhāti | tasmād aśvaḥ | paśūnām āśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ | viśvebhyas tvā devebhya ity uttarataḥ | viśve vai devā devānāṃ yaśasvitamāḥ | yaśa evāsmin dadhāti | tasmād aśvaḥ paśūnāṃ yaśasvitamaḥ | devebhyas tvā-ity adhastāt | devā vai devānām apacitatamāḥ | apacitim evāsmin dadhāti | tasmād aśvaḥ paśūnām apacitatamaḥ |
analyzed: javam eva asmin dadhāti tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām āśuḥ sārasāritamaḥ viśvebhyaḥ tvā devebhyaḥ iti uttaratas viśve vai devāḥ devānām yaśasvitamāḥ yaśaḥ eva asmin dadhāti tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām yaśasvitamaḥ devebhyaḥ tvā iti adhastāt devāḥ vai devānām apacitatamāḥ apacitim eva asmin dadhāti tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām apacitatamaḥ

original: { 3.8.7.3} sarvebhyas tvā devebhya ity upariṣṭāt | sarve vai devās tviṣimanto harasvinaḥ | tviṣim evāsmin haro dadhāti | tasmād aśvaḥ paśūnāṃ tviṣimān harasvitamaḥ | dive tvā-antarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā-ity āha | ebhya evainaṃ lokebhyaḥ prokṣati | sate tvā-asate tvā-adbhyas tvā-oṣadhībhyas tvā viśvebhyas tvā bhutebhya ity āha |
analyzed: sarvebhyaḥ tvā devebhyaḥ iti upariṣṭāt sarve vai devāḥ tviṣimantaḥ harasvinaḥ tviṣim eva asmin haraḥ dadhāti tasmāt aśvaḥ paśūnām tviṣimān harasvitamaḥ dive tvā antarikṣāya tvā pṛthivyai tvā iti āha ebhyaḥ eva enam lokebhyaḥ prokṣati sate tvā asate tvā adbhyaḥ tvā oṣadhībhyaḥ tvā viśvebhyaḥ tvā bhutebhyaḥ iti āha

original: tasmād aśvamedhayājinaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāny upajīvanti | brahmavādino vadanti | yat prājāpatyo 'śvaḥ | atha kasmād enam anyābhyo devatābhyo 'pi prokṣatīti | aśve vai sarvā devatā anvāyattāḥ | taṃ yad viśvebhyas tvā bhūtebhya iti prokṣati | devatā evāsminn anvāyātayati | tasmād aśve sarvā devatā anvāyattāḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt aśvamedha yājinam sarvāṇi bhūtāni upajīvanti brahma vādinaḥ vadanti yat prājāpatyaḥ śvas atha kasmāt enam anyābhyaḥ devatābhyaḥ u pi prokṣati iti aśve vai sarvāḥ devatāḥ anvāyattāḥ tam yat viśvebhyaḥ tvā bhūtebhyaḥ iti prokṣati devatāḥ eva asmin anvāyātayati tasmāt aśve sarvāḥ devatāḥ anvāyattāḥ

original: anuvāka 8 { 3.8.8.1} yathā vai haviṣo gṛhītasya skandati | evaṃ vā etad aśvasya skandati | yat prokṣitam anālabdham utsṛjanti | yad aśvacaritāni juhoti | sarvahutam evainaṃ karoty askandāya | askannaṃ hi tat | yad dhutasya skandati | īṃkārāya svāhā-ī́ṃkṛtāya svāhā-ity āha | etāni vā aśvacaritāni | caritair evainaṃ samardhayati |
analyzed: yathā vai haviṣaḥ gṛhītasya skandati evam vai etat aśvasya skandati yat prokṣitam an ālabdham utsṛjanti yat aśva caritāni juhoti sarva hutam eva enam karoti a skandāya a skannam hi tat yat dhutasya skandati īṃkārāya svāhā īṃkṛtāya svāhā iti āha etāni vai aśva caritāni caritaiḥ eva enam samardhayati

original: { 3.8.8.2} tad āhuḥ | anāhutayo vā aśvacaritāni | na-etā hotavyā iti | atho khalv āhuḥ | hotavyā eva | atra vāva-evaṃ vidvān aśvamedhaṃ saṃsthāpayati | yad aśvacaritāni juhoti | tasmād dhotavyā iti | bahirdhā vā enam etad āyatanād dadhāti | bhrātṛvyam asmai janayati |
analyzed: tat āhuḥ an āhutayaḥ vai aśva caritāni na etāḥ hotavyāḥ iti atha u khalu āhuḥ hotavyāḥ eva atra vāva evam vidvān aśvamedham saṃsthāpayati yat aśva caritāni juhoti tasmāt hotavyāḥ iti bahirdhā vai enam etat āyatanāt dadhāti bhrātṛvyam asmai janayati

original: { 3.8.8.3} yasyānāyatane 'nyatrāgner āhutīr juhoti | sāvitriyā iṣṭyāḥ purastāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ | āhavanīye 'śvacaritāni juhoti | āyatana evāsya-āhutīr juhoti | nāsmai bhrātṛvyaṃ janayati | tad āhuḥ | yajñamukhe-yajñamukhe hotavyāḥ | yajñasya klṛptyai | suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyā iti | atho khalv āhuḥ |
analyzed: yasya anāyatane nyatra agneḥ āhutīḥ juhoti sāvitriyāḥ iṣṭyāḥ purastāt sviṣṭakṛtaḥ āhavanīye śva caritāni juhoti āyatane eva asya āhutīḥ juhoti na asmai bhrātṛvyam janayati tat āhuḥ yajña mukhe yajña mukhe hotavyāḥ yajñasya klṛptyai suvargasya lokasya anukhyātyai iti atha u khalu āhuḥ

original: { 3.8.8.4} yad yajñamukhe-yajñamukhe juhuyāt | paśubhir yajamānaṃ vyardhayet | ava suvargāl lokāt padyeta | pāpīyānt syād iti | sakṛd eva hotavyāḥ | na yajamānaṃ paśubhir vyardhayati | abhi suvargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | na pāpīyān bhavati | aṣṭācatvāriṃśatam aśvarūpāṇi juhoti | aṣṭācatvāriṃśadakṣarā jagatī | jāgato 'śvaḥ prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai |
analyzed: yat yajña mukhe yajña mukhe juhuyāt paśubhiḥ yajamānam vyardhayet ava suvargāt lokāt padyeta pāpīyān syāt iti sakṛt eva hotavyāḥ na yajamānam paśubhiḥ vyardhayati abhi suvargam lokam jayati na pāpīyān bhavati aṣṭācatvāriṃśatam aśvarūpāṇi juhoti aṣṭācatvāriṃśat akṣarā jagatī śvas prājāpatyaḥ samṛddhyai

original: ekam atiriktaṃ juhoti | tasmād ekaḥ prajāsv ardhukaḥ |
analyzed: ekam atiriktam juhoti tasmāt ekaḥ prajāsu ardhukaḥ

original: anuvāka 9 { 3.8.9.1} vibhūr mātrā prabhūḥ pitrā-ity āha | iyaṃ vai mātā | asau pitā | ābhyām evainaṃ paridadāti | aśvo 'si hayo 'sīty āha | śāsty evainam etat | tasmāt-śiṣṭāḥ prajā jāyante | atyo 'sīty āha | tasmād aśvaḥ sarvān paśūn atyeti | 0 tasmād aśvaḥ sarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ śreṣṭhyaṃ gacchati |
analyzed: vibhūḥ mātrā prabhūḥ pitrā iti āha iyam vai mātā asau pitā ābhyām eva enam paridadāti aśvaḥ si hayaḥ si iti āha śāsti eva enam etat tasmāt śiṣṭāḥ prajāḥ jāyante atyaḥ si iti āha tasmāt aśvaḥ sarvān paśūn atyeti tasmāt aśvaḥ sarveṣām paśūnām śreṣṭhyam gacchati

original: { 3.8.9.33} pra yaśaḥ śreṣṭhyam āpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | naro 'sy arvā-asi saptir asi vājy asīty āha | rūpam evāsyaitan māhimānaṃ vyācaṣṭe | yayur nāmāsīty āha | etad vā aśvasya priyaṃ nāmadheyam | priyeṇaivainaṃ nāmadheyenābhivadati | tasmād apy ā-amitrau saṃgatya | nāmnā ced dhvayete { cedhvayete} | mitram eva bhavataḥ |
analyzed: pra yaśaḥ śreṣṭhyam āpnoti yaḥ evam veda naraḥ si arvā asi saptiḥ asi vājī asi iti āha rūpam eva asya etat mā ahimānam vyācaṣṭe yayuḥ nāma asi iti āha etat vai aśvasya priyam nāmadheyam priyeṇa eva enam nāmadheyena abhivadati tasmāt api ā amitrau saṃgatya nāmnā ced dhvayete ced hvayete mitram eva bhavataḥ

original: { 3.8.9.3} ādityānāṃ patvā-anvihīty āha | ādityān evainaṃ gamayati | agnaye svāhā svāhā-indrāgnibhyām iti pūrvahomāñ juhoti | pūrva eva dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyam atikrāmati | bhūr asi bhuve tvā bhavyāya tvā bhaviṣyate tvā-ity utsṛjati sarvatvāya | devā āśāpālā etaṃ devebhyo 'śvaṃ medhāya prokṣitaṃ gopāyata-ity āha |
analyzed: ādityānām patvā anvihi iti āha ādityān eva enam gamayati agnaye svāhā svāhā indra agnibhyām iti pūrvahomān juhoti pūrvaḥ eva dviṣantam bhrātṛvyam atikrāmati bhūḥ asi bhuve tvā bhavyāya tvā bhaviṣyate tvā iti utsṛjati sarva tvāya devāḥ āśā pālāḥ etam devebhyaḥ śvam medhāya prokṣitam gopāyata iti āha

original: śataṃ vai talpyā rājaputrā devā āśāpālāḥ | tebhya evainaṃ paridadāti | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ | iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā-iha vidhṛtiḥ svāhā-iha rantiḥ svāhā-iha ramatiḥ svāhā-iti catṛṣu patsu juhoti |
analyzed: śatam vai talpyāḥ rāja putrāḥ devāḥ āśā pālāḥ tebhyaḥ eva enam paridadāti īśvaraḥ vai aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parām parāvatam gantoḥ iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā iha vidhṛtiḥ svāhā iha rantiḥ svāhā iha ramatiḥ svāhā iti catṛṣu patsu juhoti

original: { 3.8.9.4} etā vā aśvasya bandhanam | tābhir evainaṃ badhnāti | tasmād aśvaḥ pramukto bandhanam āgacchati | tasmād aśvaḥ pramukto bandhanaṃ na jahāti | rāṣṭraṃ vā aśvamedhaḥ | rāṣṭre khalu vā ete vyāyacchante | ye 'śvaṃ medhyaṃ rakṣanti | teṣāṃ ya udṛcaṃ gacchanti | rāṣṭrād eva te rāṣṭraṃ gacchanti | atha ya udṛcaṃ na gacchanti |
analyzed: etāḥ vai aśvasya bandhanam tābhiḥ eva enam badhnāti tasmāt aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ bandhanam āgacchati tasmāt aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ bandhanam na jahāti rāṣṭram vai aśvamedhaḥ rāṣṭre khalu vai ete vyāyacchante ye śvam medhyam rakṣanti teṣām ye udṛcam gacchanti rāṣṭrāt eva te rāṣṭram gacchanti atha ye udṛcam na gacchanti

original: { 3.8.9.5} rāṣṭrād eva te vyavacchidyante | parā vā eṣa sicyate | yo 'balo 'śvamedhena yajate | yad amitrā aśvaṃ vinderan | hanyetāsya yajñaḥ | catuśśatā rakṣanti | yajñasyāghātāya | athānyam ānīya prokṣeyuḥ | sā-eva tataḥ prāyaścittiḥ |
analyzed: rāṣṭrāt eva te vyavacchidyante parā vai eṣa sicyate yaḥ śvamedhena yajate yat amitrāḥ aśvam vinderan hanyeta asya yajñaḥ catuśśatā rakṣanti yajñasya āghātāya atha anyam ānīya prokṣeyuḥ sā eva tatas prāyaścittiḥ

original: anuvāka 10 { 3.8.10.1} prajāpatir akāmayatāśvamehena yajeya-iti | sa tapo 'tapyata | tasya tepānasya | sapta-ātmano devatā udakrāman | sā dīkṣā-abhavat | sa etāni vaiśvadevāny apaśyat | tāny ajuhot | tair vai sa dīkṣām avārundha | yad vaiśvadevāni juhoti | dīkṣām eva tair yajamāno 'varundhe |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ akāmayata aśvamehena yajeya eti sa tapaḥ u tapyata tasya tepānasya sapta ātmanaḥ devatāḥ udakrāman sā dīkṣā abhavat saḥ etāni vaiśvadevāni apaśyat tāni ajuhot taiḥ vai sa dīkṣām avārundha yat vaiśvadevāni juhoti dīkṣām eva taiḥ yajamānaḥ varundhe

original: { 3.8.10.2} sapta juhoti | sapta hi tā devatā udakrāman | anvahaṃ juhoti | anvaham eva dīkṣām avarundhe | trīṇi vaiśvadevāni juhoti | catvāry audgrahaṇāni | sapta saṃpadyante | sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ | prāṇā dīkṣā | prāṇair eva prāṇān dīkṣām avarundhe |
analyzed: sapta juhoti sapta hi tāḥ devatāḥ udakrāman anvaham juhoti anvaham eva dīkṣām avarundhe trīṇi vaiśvadevāni juhoti catvāri audgrahaṇāni sapta saṃpadyante sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇāḥ prāṇāḥ dīkṣā prāṇaiḥ eva prāṇān dīkṣām avarundhe

original: { 3.8.10.3} ekaviṃśatiṃ vaiśvadevāni juhoti | ekaviṃśatir vai devalokāḥ | dvādaśa māsāḥ pañca-ṛtavaḥ | traya ime lokāḥ | asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ | eṣa suvargo lokaḥ | tad daivyaṃ kṣattram { kṣatram} | sā śrīḥ | tad bradhnasya viṣṭapam | tat svārājyam ucyate |
analyzed: ekaviṃśatim vaiśvadevāni juhoti ekaviṃśatiḥ vai deva lokāḥ dvādaśa māsāḥ pañca ṛtavaḥ trayaḥ ime lokāḥ asau ādityaḥ ekaviṃśaḥ eṣa suvargaḥ lokaḥ tat daivyam kṣattram kṣatram sā śrīḥ tat bradhnasya viṣṭapam tat svārājyam ucyate

original: { 3.8.10.4} triṃśatam audgrahaṇāni juhoti | triṃśadakṣarā virāṭ | annaṃ virāṭ | virājā-evānnādyam avarundhe | tredhā vibhajya devatāṃ juhoti | tryāvṛto vai devāḥ | tryāvṛta ime lokāḥ | eṣāṃ lokānām āptyai | eṣāṃ lokānāṃ klṛptyai | apa vā etasmāt prāṇāḥ krāmanti |
analyzed: triṃśatam audgrahaṇāni juhoti triṃśat akṣarā virāj annam virāj virājā eva annādyam avarundhe tredhā vibhajya devatām juhoti tri āvṛtaḥ vai devāḥ tri āvṛtaḥ ime lokāḥ eṣām lokānām āptyai eṣām lokānām klṛptyai apa vai etasmāt prāṇāḥ krāmanti

original: { 3.8.10.5} yo dīkṣām atirecayati | saptāhaṃ pracaranti | sapta vai śīrṣanyāḥ prāṇaḥ | prāṇā dīkṣā | prāṇair eva prāṇān dīkṣām avarundhe | pūrṇāhutim uttamāṃ juhoti | sarvaṃ vai pūrṇāhutiḥ | sarvam evā''pnoti | atho iyaṃ vai pūrṇāhutiḥ | asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: yaḥ dīkṣām atirecayati sapta aham pracaranti sapta vai śīrṣaṇyāḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇāḥ dīkṣā prāṇaiḥ eva prāṇān dīkṣām avarundhe pūrṇāhutim uttamām juhoti sarvam vai pūrṇāhutiḥ sarvam eva āpnoti atha u iyam vai pūrṇāhutiḥ asyām eva pratitiṣṭhati

original: anuvāka 11 { 3.8.11.1} prajāpatir aśvamedham asṛjata | taṃ sṛṣṭaṃ na kiṃ cana-udayacchat | taṃ vaiśvadevāny eva-udayacchan | yad vaiśvadevāni juhoti | yajñasya-udyatyai | svāhā-ādhim ādhītāya svāhā | svāhā-ādhītaṃ manase svāhā | svāhā manaḥ prajāpataye svāhā | kāya svāha kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāhā-iti prājāpatye mukhye bhavataḥ |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ aśvamedham asṛjata tam sṛṣṭam na kim cana audayacchat tam vaiśvadevāni eva audayacchan yat vaiśvadevāni juhoti yajñasya audyatyai svāhā ādhim ādhītāya svāhā svāhā ādhītam manase svāhā svāhā manaḥ prajāpataye svāhā kāya svāha kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāhā iti prājāpatye mukhye bhavataḥ

original: prajāpatimukhābhir evainaṃ devatābhir udyacchate | { 3.8.11.2} adityai svāhā-adityai mahyai svāhā-adityai sumṛḍīkāyai svāhā-ity āha | iyaṃ vā aditiḥ | asyā evainaṃ pratiṣṭhāya-udyacchate | sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhā-ity āha | vāg vai sarasvatī | vācā-evainam udyacchate |
analyzed: prajāpati mukhābhiḥ eva enam devatābhiḥ udyacchate adityai svāhā adityai mahyai svāhā adityai su mṛḍīkāyai svāhā iti āha iyam vai aditiḥ asyai eva enam pratiṣṭhāya udyacchate sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhā iti āha vāc vai sarasvatī vācā eva enam udyacchate

original: pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe naraṃdhiṣāya svahā-ity āha | paśavo vai pūṣā | paśubhir evainam udyacchate | tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre pururūpāya svāhā-ity āha | tvaṣṭā vai paśūnāṃ mithunānāṃ rūpakṛt | rūpam eva paśuṣu dadhāti | atho rūpair evainam udyacchate |
analyzed: pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe naraṃdhiṣāya svahā iti āha paśavaḥ vai pūṣā paśubhiḥ eva enam udyacchate tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre puru rūpāya svāhā iti āha tvaṣṭā vai paśūnām mithunānām rūpa kṛt rūpam eva paśuṣu dadhāti atha u rūpaiḥ eva enam udyacchate

original: viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave nikhuryapāya svahā viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhā-ity āha | yajño vai viṣṇuḥ | yajñāya-evainam udyacchate | pūrṇāhutim uttamāṃ juhoti | pratyuttabdhyai sayatvāya |
analyzed: viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave nikhuryapāya svahā viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhā iti āha yajñaḥ vai viṣṇuḥ yajñāya eva enam udyacchate pūrṇāhutim uttamām juhoti pratyuttabdhyai sayatvāya

original: anuvāka 12 { 3.8.12.1} sāvitram aṣṭākapālaṃ prātar nirvapati | aṣṭākṣarā gāyatrī | gāyatraṃ prātaḥsavanam | prātaḥsavanād evainaṃ gāyatriyāś chandaso 'dhi nirmimīte | atho prātaḥsavanam eva tena-āpnoti | gāyatrīṃ chandaḥ | savitre prasavitra ekādaśakapālaṃ madhyaṃdine | ekādaśākṣarā triṣṭup | traiṣṭubhaṃ mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanam |
analyzed: sāvitram aṣṭākapālam prātar nirvapati aṣṭa akṣarā gāyatrī gāyatram prātaḥsavanam prātaḥsavanāt eva enam gāyatriyāḥ chandasaḥ dhi nirmimīte atha u prātaḥsavanam eva tena āpnoti gāyatrīm chandaḥ savitre prasavitre ekādaśa kapālam madhyaṃdine ekādaśa akṣarā triṣṭubh traiṣṭubham mādhyaṃdinam savanam

original: mādhyaṃdinād evainaṃ savanāt triṣṭubhaś chandaso 'dhi nirmimīte |
analyzed: mādhyaṃdināt eva enam savanāt triṣṭubhaḥ chandasaḥ dhi nirmimīte

original: { 3.8.12.2} atho mādhyaṃdinam eva savanaṃ tena-āpnoti | triṣṭubhaṃ chandaḥ | savitra āsavitre dvādaśakapālam aparāhṇe | dvādaśākṣarā jagatī | jāgataṃ tṛtīyasavanam | tṛtīyasavanād evainaṃ jagatyāś chandaso 'dhi nirmimīte | atho tṛtīyasavanam eva tena-āpnoti | jagatīṃ chandaḥ | īśvaro vā aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parāṃ parāvataṃ gantoḥ |
analyzed: atha u mādhyaṃdinam eva savanam tena āpnoti triṣṭubham chandaḥ savitre āsavitre dvādaśa kapālam aparāhṇe dvādaśa akṣarā jagatī jāgatam tṛtīyasavanam tṛtīyasavanāt eva enam jagatyāḥ chandasaḥ dhi nirmimīte atha u tṛtīyasavanam eva tena āpnoti jagatīm chandaḥ īśvaraḥ vai aśvaḥ pramuktaḥ parām parāvatam gantoḥ

original: iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā-iha vidhṛtiḥ svāhā-iha rantiḥ svāhā-iha rantiḥ svāhā-iti catasra āhutīr juhoti |
analyzed: iha dhṛtiḥ svāhā iha vidhṛtiḥ svāhā iha rantiḥ svāhā iha rantiḥ svāhā iti catasraḥ āhutīḥ juhoti

original: { 3.8.12.3} catasro diśaḥ | digbhir evainaṃ parigṛhṇāti | āśvattho vrajo bhavati | prajāpatir devebhyo nilāyata | aśvo rūpaṃ kṛtvā | so 'śvatthe saṃvatsaram atiṣṭhat | tad aśvatthasyāśvatthatvam | yad āśvattho vrajo bhavati | sva evainaṃ yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati |
analyzed: catasraḥ diśaḥ digbhiḥ eva enam parigṛhṇāti āśvatthaḥ vrajaḥ bhavati prajāpatiḥ devebhyaḥ nilāyata aśvaḥ rūpam kṛtvā saḥ śvatthe saṃvatsaram atiṣṭhat tat aśvatthasya aśvattha tvam yat āśvatthaḥ vrajaḥ bhavati sve eva enam yonau pratiṣṭhāpayati

original: anuvāka 13 { 3.8.13.1} ā brahman brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatām ity āha | brāhmaṇa eva brahmavarcasaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt purā brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasy ajāyata | ā-asmin rāṣṭre rājanya iṣavyaḥ śūro mahāratho jāyatām ity āha | rājanya eva śauryaṃ mahimānaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt purā rājanya iṣavyaḥ śūro mahāratho 'jāyata | dogdhrī dhenur ity āha |
analyzed: ā brahman brāhmaṇaḥ brahmavarcasī jāyatām iti āha brāhmaṇaḥ eva brahmavarcasam dadhāti tasmāt purā brāhmaṇaḥ brahmavarcasī ajāyata ā asmin rāṣṭre rājanyaḥ iṣavyaḥ śūraḥ mahā rathaḥ jāyatām iti āha rājanyaḥ eva śauryam mahimānam dadhāti tasmāt purā rājanyaḥ iṣavyaḥ śūraḥ mahā rathaḥ jāyata dogdhrī dhenuḥ iti āha

original: dhenvām eva payo dadhāti | tasmāt purā dogdhrī dhenur ajāyata | voḍhā-anaḍvān iy āha |
analyzed: dhenvām eva payaḥ dadhāti tasmāt purā dogdhrī dhenuḥ ajāyata voḍhā anaḍvān id āha

original: { 3.8.13.2} anaḍuhy eva vīryaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt purā voḍhā-anaḍvān ajāyata | āśuḥ saptir ity āha | aśva eva javaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt purā-āśur aśvo 'jāyata | puraṃdhir yoṣā-ity āha | yoṣity eva rūpaṃ dadhāti | tasmāt strī yuvatiḥ priyā bhāvukā | jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhā ity āha | ā ha vai tatra jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhā jāyate |
analyzed: anaḍuhi eva vīryam dadhāti tasmāt purā voḍhā anaḍvān ajāyata āśuḥ saptiḥ iti āha aśve eva javam dadhāti tasmāt purā āśuḥ aśvaḥ jāyata puraṃdhiḥ yoṣā iti āha yoṣiti eva rūpam dadhāti tasmāt strī yuvatiḥ priyā bhāvukā jiṣṇuḥ ratheṣṭhāḥ iti āha ā ha vai tatra jiṣṇuḥ ratheṣṭhāḥ jāyate

original: { 3.8.13.3} yatra-etena yajñena yajante | sabheyo yuvā-ity āha | yo vai pūrvavayasī | sa sabheyo yuvā | tasmād yuvā pumān priyo bhāvukaḥ | ā-asya yajamānasya vīro jāyatām ity āha | ā ha vai tatra yajamānasya vīro jāyate | yatra-etena yajñena yajante | nikāme-nikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatv ity āha | nikāme-nikāme ha vai tatra parjanyo varṣati |
analyzed: yatra etena yajñena yajante sabheyaḥ yuvā iti āha yaḥ vai pūrvavayasī sa sabheyaḥ yuvā tasmāt yuvā pumān priyaḥ bhāvukaḥ ā asya yajamānasya vīraḥ jāyatām iti āha ā ha vai tatra yajamānasya vīraḥ jāyate yatra etena yajñena yajante nikāmenikāme naḥ parjanyaḥ varṣatu iti āha nikāmenikāme ha vai tatra parjanyaḥ varṣati

original: yatra-etena yajñena yajante | phalinyo na oṣadhayaḥ pacyantām ity āha | phalinyo ha vai tatra-oṣadhayaḥ pacyante | yatra-etena yajñena yajante | yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām ity āha | kalpate ha vai tatra prajābhyo yogakṣemaḥ | yatra-etena yajñena yajante |
analyzed: yatra etena yajñena yajante phalinyaḥ naḥ oṣadhayaḥ pacyantām iti āha phalinyaḥ ha vai tatra oṣadhayaḥ pacyante yatra etena yajñena yajante yogakṣemaḥ naḥ kalpatām iti āha kalpate ha vai tatra prajābhyaḥ yogakṣemaḥ yatra etena yajñena yajante

original: anuvāka 14 { 3.8.14.1} prajāpatir devebhyo yajñān vyādiśat | sa ātmann aśvamedham adhatta | taṃ devā abruvan | eṣa vāva yajñaḥ | yad aśvamedhaḥ | apy eva no 'trāstv iti | tebhya etān annahomān prāyacchat | tān ajuhot | tair vai sa devān aprīṇāt | yad annahomāñ juhoti |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ devebhyaḥ yajñān vyādiśat saḥ ātman aśvamedham adhatta tam devāḥ abruvan eṣa vāva yajñaḥ yat aśvamedhaḥ api eva naḥ trāstu iti tebhyaḥ etān annahomān prāyacchat tān ajuhot taiḥ vai sa devān aprīṇāt yat annahomān juhoti

original: { 3.8.14.2} devān eva tair yajamānaḥ prīṇāti | ājyena juhoti | agner vā etad rūpam | yad ājyam | yad ājyena juhoti | agnim eva tat prīṇāti | madhunā juhoti | mahatyai vā etad devatāyai rūpam | yan madhu | yan madhunā juhoti |
analyzed: devān eva taiḥ yajamānaḥ prīṇāti ājyena juhoti agneḥ vai etat rūpam yat ājyam yat ājyena juhoti agnim eva tat prīṇāti madhunā juhoti mahatyai vai etat devatāyai rūpam yat madhu yat madhunā juhoti

original: { 3.8.14.3} mahatīm eva tad devatāṃ prīṇāti | taṇḍulair juhoti | vasūnāṃ vā etad rūpam | yat taṇḍulāḥ | yat taṇḍulair juhoti | vasūn eva tat prīṇāti | pṛthukair juhoti | rudrāṇāṃ vā etad rūpam | yat pṛthukāḥ | yat pṛthukair juhoti |
analyzed: mahatīm eva tat devatām prīṇāti taṇḍulaiḥ juhoti vasūnām vai etat rūpam yat taṇḍulāḥ yat taṇḍulaiḥ juhoti vasūn eva tat prīṇāti pṛthukaiḥ juhoti rudrāṇām vai etat rūpam yat pṛthukāḥ yat pṛthukaiḥ juhoti

original: { 3.8.14.4} rudrān eva tat prīṇāti | lājair juhoti | ādityānāṃ vā etad rūpam | yal lājāḥ | yal lājair juhoti | ādityān eva tat prīṇāti | karambair juhoti | viśveṣāṃ vā etad devānāṃ rūpam | yat karambāḥ | yat karambair juhoti |
analyzed: rudrān eva tat prīṇāti lājaiḥ juhoti ādityānām vai etat rūpam yat lājāḥ yat lājaiḥ juhoti ādityān eva tat prīṇāti karambaiḥ juhoti viśveṣām vai etat devānām rūpam yat karambāḥ yat karambaiḥ juhoti

original: { 3.8.14.5} viśvān eva tad devān prīṇāti | dhānābhir juhoti | nakṣatrāṇāṃ vā etad rūpam | yad dhānāḥ | yad dhānābhir juhoti | nakṣatrāṇy eva tat prīṇāti | saktubhir juhoti | prajāpater vā etad rūpam | yat saktavaḥ | yat saktubhir juhoti |
analyzed: viśvān eva tat devān prīṇāti dhānābhiḥ juhoti nakṣatrāṇām vai etat rūpam yat dhānāḥ yat dhānābhiḥ juhoti nakṣatrāṇi eva tat prīṇāti saktubhiḥ juhoti prajāpateḥ vai etat rūpam yat saktavaḥ yat saktubhiḥ juhoti

original: { 3.8.14.6} prajāpatim eva tat prīṇāti | masūsyair juhoti | sarvāsāṃ vā etad devatāṃ rūpam | yan masūsyāni | yan masūsyair juhoti | sarvā eva tad devatāḥ prīṇāti | priyaṅgutaṇḍulair juhoti | priyāṅgā ha vai nāmaite | etair vai devā aśvasyāṅgāni samadadhuḥ | yat priyaṅgutaṇḍulair juhoti | aśvasyaivāṅgāni saṃdadhāti | daśānnāni juhoti |
analyzed: prajāpatim eva tat prīṇāti masūsyaiḥ juhoti sarvāsām vai etat devatām rūpam yat masūsyāni yat masūsyaiḥ juhoti sarvāḥ eva tat devatāḥ prīṇāti priyaṅgu taṇḍulaiḥ juhoti priyāṅgāḥ ha vai nāma ete etaiḥ vai devāḥ aśvasya aṅgāni samadadhuḥ yat priyaṅgu taṇḍulaiḥ juhoti aśvasya eva aṅgāni saṃdadhāti daśa annāni juhoti

original: daśākṣarā virāṭ | virāṭ kṛtsnasyānnādyasyāvaruddhyai |
analyzed: daśa akṣarā virāj virāj kṛtsnasya annādyasya avaruddhyai

original: anuvāka 15 { 3.8.15.1} prajāpatir aśvamedham asṛjata | taṃ sṛṣṭaṃ rakṣāṃsy ajighāṃsan | sa etān prajāpatir naktaṃhomān apaśyat | tān ajuhoti | tair vai sa yajñād rakṣāṃsy apāhan | yan naktaṃhomāñ juhoti | yajñād eva tair yajamāno rakṣāṃsy apahanti | ājyena juhoti | vajro vā ājyam | vajreṇaiva yajñād rakṣāṃsy apahanti |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ aśvamedham asṛjata tam sṛṣṭam rakṣāṃsi ajighāṃsan saḥ etān prajāpatiḥ naktaṃhomān apaśyat tān ajuhoti taiḥ vai sa yajñāt rakṣāṃsi apāhan yat naktaṃhomān juhoti yajñāt eva taiḥ yajamānaḥ rakṣāṃsi apahanti ājyena juhoti vajraḥ vai ājyam vajreṇa eva yajñāt rakṣāṃsi apahanti

original: { 3.8.15.2} ājyasya pratipadaṃ karoti | prāṇo vā ājyam | mukhata evāsya prāṇaṃ dadhāti | annahomāñ juhoti | śarīravad evāvarundhe | vyatyāsaṃ juhoti | ubhayasyāvarudhyai | naktaṃ juhoti | rakṣasām apahatyai | ājyenāntato juhoti |
analyzed: ājyasya pratipadam karoti prāṇaḥ vai ājyam mukhataḥ eva asya prāṇam dadhāti annahomān juhoti śarīravat eva avarundhe vyatyāsam juhoti ubhayasya avarudhyai naktam juhoti rakṣasām apahatyai ājyena antatas juhoti

original: { 3.8.15.3} prāṇo vā ājyam | ubhayata evāsya prāṇaṃ dadhāti | purastāc copariṣṭāc ca | ekasmai svāhā-ity āha | asminn eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | dvābhyāṃ svāhā-ity āha | amuṣminn eva loke pratitiṣṭhati | ubhayor eva lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati | asmiṃś cāmuṣmiṃś ca | śatāya svāhā-ity āha | śatāyur vai puruṣaḥ śatavīryaḥ | āyur eva vīryam avarundhe |
analyzed: prāṇaḥ vai ājyam ubhayatas eva asya prāṇam dadhāti purastāt ca upariṣṭāt ca ekasmai svāhā iti āha asmin eva loke pratitiṣṭhati dvābhyām svāhā iti āha amuṣmin eva loke pratitiṣṭhati ubhayoḥ eva lokayoḥ pratitiṣṭhati asmin ca amuṣmin ca śatāya svāhā iti āha śata āyuḥ vai puruṣaḥ śata vīryaḥ āyuḥ eva vīryam avarundhe

original: sahasrāya svāhā-ity āha | āyur vai sahasram | āyur evāvarundhe | sarvasmai svāhā-ity āha | aparimitam evāvarundhe |

analyzed: ṛkṣīkāḥ puruṣa vyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇi āvyādhinīḥ taskarāḥ araṇyeṣu ājāyeran tat āhuḥ a paśavaḥ vai ete yat āraṇyāḥ yat āraṇyaiḥ saṃsthāpayet kṣipre yajamānam araṇyam mṛtam hareyuḥ araṇya āyatanāḥ hi āraṇyāḥ paśavaḥ iti yat paśūn na ālabheta an avaruddhāḥ asya paśavaḥ syuḥ yat paryagnikṛtān utsṛjet

analyzed: sam pitāputrau avasyataḥ sam adhvānaḥ krāmanti samantikam grāmayoḥ grāma antau bhavataḥ naṛkṣīkāḥ puruṣa vyāghrāḥ parimoṣiṇaḥ āvyādhinīḥ taskarāḥ araṇyeṣu ājāyante

original: { 3.9.2.2} amuṃ taiḥ | anavaruddho vā etasya saṃvatsara ity āhuḥ | ya ita-itaś cāturmāsyāni saṃvatsaraṃ prayuṅkta iti | etāvān vai saṃvatsaraḥ | yac cāturmāsyāni | yad ete cāturmāsyāḥ paśava ālabhyante | pratyakṣam eva taiḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yajamāno 'varundhe | vi vā eṣa prajayā paśubhir ṛdhyate | yaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ prayuṅkte | saṃvatsaraḥ suvargo lokaḥ |
analyzed: amum taiḥ an avaruddhaḥ vai etasya saṃvatsaraḥ iti āhuḥ yaḥ ita etaḥ cāturmāsyāni saṃvatsaram prayuṅkte iti etāvān vai saṃvatsaraḥ yat cāturmāsyāni yat ete cāturmāsyāḥ paśavaḥ ālabhyante pratyakṣam eva taiḥ saṃvatsaram yajamānaḥ varundhe vi vai eṣa prajayā paśubhiḥ ṛdhyate yaḥ saṃvatsaram prayuṅkte saṃvatsaraḥ suvargaḥ lokaḥ

analyzed: yathāyajus eva etat trayyaḥ sūcyaḥ bhavanti ayasmayyaḥ rajatāḥ hariṇyaḥ asya vai lokasya rūpam ayasmayyaḥ antarikṣasya rajatāḥ divaḥ hariṇyaḥ diśaḥ vai ayasmayyaḥ avāntaradiśāḥ rajatāḥ ūrdhvāḥ hariṇyaḥ diśaḥ eva asmai kalpayati kaḥ tvā chyati kaḥ tvā viśāsti iti āha ahiṃsāyai

original: anuvāka 7 { 3.9.7.1} apa vā etasmāt-śrī rāṣṭraṃ krāmati | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | ūrdhvām enām ucchrayatād ity āha | śrīr vai rāṣṭram aśvamedhaḥ | śriyam evāsmai rāṣṭramūrdhvam ucchrayati | veṇubhāraṃ girāv iva-ity āha | rāṣṭraṃ vai bhāraḥ | rāṣṭram evāsmai paryūhati | athāsyā madhyam edhatām ity āha | śrīr vai rāṣṭrasya madhyam |
analyzed: apa vai etasmāt śrī rāṣṭram krāmati yaḥ śvamedhena yajate ūrdhvām enām ucchrayatāt iti āha śrīḥ vai rāṣṭram aśvamedhaḥ śriyam eva asmai rāṣṭram ūrdhvam ucchrayati veṇu bhāram girau iva eti āha rāṣṭram vai bhāraḥ rāṣṭram eva asmai paryūhati atha asyāḥ madhyam edhatām iti āha śrīḥ vai rāṣṭrasya madhyam

original: { 3.9.7.2} śriyam evāvarundhe | śīte vāte punann iva-ity āha | kṣemo vai rāṣṭrasya śīto vātaḥ | kṣemam evāvarundhe | yad dhariṇī yavam attīty āha | viḍ vai hariṇī | rāṣṭraṃ yavaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | na puṣṭaṃ paśu manyata ity āha | tasmād rājā paśūn na puṣyati |
analyzed: śriyam eva avarundhe śīte vāte punan iva eti āha kṣemaḥ vai rāṣṭrasya śītaḥ vātaḥ kṣemam eva avarundhe yat hariṇī yavam atti iti āha viś vai hariṇī rāṣṭram yavaḥ viśam ca eva asmai rāṣṭram ca samīcī dadhāti na puṣṭam paśu manyate iti āha tasmāt rājā paśūn na puṣyati

original: { 3.9.7.3} śūdrā yad aryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyatīty āha | tasmād vaiśīpūtraṃ nābhiṣiñcante | iyaṃ yakā śakuntikā-ity āha | viḍ vai śakuntikā | rāṣṭram aśvamedhaḥ | viśaṃ caivāsmai | rāṣṭraṃ ca samīcī dadhāti | āhalam iti sarpatīty āha | tasmād rāṣṭrāya viśaḥ sarpanti | āhataṃ gabhe pasa ity āha | viḍ vai gabhaḥ |
analyzed: śūdrā yat arya jārā na poṣāya dhanāyati iti āha tasmāt vaiśīpūtram na abhiṣiñcante iyam śakuntikā iti āha viś vai śakuntikā rāṣṭram aśvamedhaḥ viśam ca eva asmai rāṣṭram ca samīcī dadhāti iti sarpati iti āha tasmāt rāṣṭrāya viśaḥ sarpanti āhatam gabhe pasaḥ iti āha viś vai gabhaḥ

original: { 3.9.7.4} rāṣṭraṃ pasaḥ | rāṣṭram eva viśy āhanti | tasmād rāṣṭraṃ viśaṃ ghātukam | mātā ca te pitā ca ta ity āha | iyaṃ vai mātā | asau pitā | ābhyām evainaṃ paridadāti | agraṃ vṛkṣasya rohata ity āha | śrīr vai vṛkṣasyāgram | śriyam evāvarundhe |
analyzed: rāṣṭram pasaḥ rāṣṭram eva viśi āhanti tasmāt rāṣṭram viśam ghātukam mātā ca te pitā ca te iti āha iyam vai mātā asau pitā ābhyām eva enam paridadāti agram vṛkṣasya rohataḥ iti āha śrīḥ vai vṛkṣasya agram śriyam eva avarundhe

original: { 3.9.7.5} prasulāmīti te pitā gabhe muṣṭim ataṃsayad ity āha | viḍ vai gabhaḥ | rāṣṭraṃ muṣṭiḥ | rāṣṭram eva viśy āhanti | tasmād rāṣṭraṃ viśa ghātukam | apa vā etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti | ye yajñe 'pūtaṃ vadanti | dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣam iti surabhimatīm ṛcaṃ vadanti | prāṇā vai surabhayaḥ | prāṇān evā''tman dadhate | na-ebhyaḥ prāṇā apakrāmanti |
analyzed: prasulāmi iti te pitā gabhe muṣṭim ataṃsayat iti āha viś vai gabhaḥ rāṣṭram muṣṭiḥ rāṣṭram eva viśi āhanti tasmāt rāṣṭram viśi ghātukam apa vai etebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ krāmanti ye yajñe pūtam vadanti dadhikrāvṇaḥ akāriṣam iti surabhimatīm ṛcam vadanti prāṇāḥ vai surabhayaḥ prāṇān eva ātman dadhate na ebhyaḥ prāṇāḥ apakrāmanti

original: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva ity adbhir mārjayante | āpo vai sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhir evā''tmānaṃ pavayante |
analyzed: āpaḥ hi stha mayobhuvaḥ iti adbhiḥ mārjayante āpaḥ vai sarvāḥ devatāḥ devatābhiḥ eva ātmānam pavayante

original: anuvāka 8 { 3.9.8.1} prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā preṇā-anuprāviśat | tābhyaḥ punaḥ saṃbhavituṃ nāśaknot | so 'bravīt | ṛdhnavad it saḥ | yo me 'taḥ punaḥ saṃbharad iti | taṃ devā aśvamedhena-eva samabharan | tato vai ta ārdhnuvan | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | prajāpatim eva sambharaty ṛdhnoti | puruṣam ālabhate |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā preṇā anuprāviśat tābhyaḥ punar saṃbhavitum na aśaknot saḥ bravīt ṛdhnavat id saḥ yaḥ me taḥ punar saṃbharat iti tam devāḥ aśvamedhena eva samabharan tatas vai te ārdhnuvan yaḥ śvamedhena yajate prajāpatim eva sambharati ṛdhnoti puruṣam ālabhate

original: { 3.9.8.2} vairājo vai puruṣaḥ | virājam evā''labhate | atho annaṃ vai virāṭ | annam evāvarundhe | aśvam ālabhate | prājāpatyo vā aśvaḥ | prajāpatim evā''labhate | atho śrīr vā ekaśapham | śriyam evāvarundhe | gām ālabhate |
analyzed: vairājaḥ vai puruṣaḥ virājam eva ālabhate atha u annam vai virāj annam eva avarundhe aśvam ālabhate prājāpatyaḥ vai aśvaḥ prajāpatim eva ālabhate atha u śrīḥ vai ekaśapham śriyam eva avarundhe gām ālabhate

original: { 3.9.8.3} yajño vai gauḥ | yajñam evā''labhate | atho annaṃ vai gauḥ | annam evāvarundhe | ajāvī ālabhate bhūmne | atho puṣṭir vai bhūmā | puṣṭim evāvarundhe | paryagnikṛtaṃ puruṣaṃ ca-āraṇyāṃś ca-utsṛjanty ahiṃsāyai | ubhau vā etau paśū ālabhyete | yaś cāvamo yaś ca paramaḥ | te 'sya-ubhaye yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ |
analyzed: yajñaḥ vai gauḥ yajñam eva ālabhate atha u annam vai gauḥ annam eva avarundhe aja avī ālabhate bhūmne atha u puṣṭiḥ vai bhūmā puṣṭim eva avarundhe paryagnikṛtam puruṣam ca āraṇyān ca a utsṛjanti ahiṃsāyai ubhau vai etau paśū ālabhyete yaḥ ca avamaḥ yaḥ ca paramaḥ te sya aubhaye yajñe baddhāḥ abhīṣṭāḥ abhiprītāḥ

original: abhijitā abhihutā bhavanti | na-enaṃ daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśavo yajñe baddhāḥ | abhīṣṭā abhiprītāḥ | abhijitā abhihutā hiṃsanti | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainam evaṃ veda |
analyzed: abhijitāḥ abhihutāḥ bhavanti na enam daṃkṣṇavaḥ paśavaḥ yajñe baddhāḥ abhīṣṭāḥ abhiprītāḥ abhijitāḥ abhihutāḥ hiṃsanti yaḥ śvamedhena yajate yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: anuvāka 9 { 3.9.9.1} prathamena vā eṣa stomena rādhvā | catuṣṭomena kṛtenāyānām uttare 'han | ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhāyāṃ pratitiṣṭhati | ekaviṃśāt pratiṣṭhāyā ṛtūn anvārohati | ṛtavo vai pṛṣṭhāni | ṛtavaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ | ṛtuṣv eva saṃvatsare pratiṣṭhāya | devatā abhyārohati | śakvarayaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavanty anyad-anyac chandaḥ |
analyzed: prathamena vai eṣa stomena rādhvā catuṣṭomena kṛtena āyānām uttare han ekaviṃśe pratiṣṭhāyām pratitiṣṭhati ekaviṃśāt pratiṣṭhāyāḥ ṛtūn anvārohati ṛtavaḥ vai pṛṣṭhāni ṛtavaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ ṛtuṣu eva saṃvatsare pratiṣṭhāya devatāḥ abhyārohati śakvarayaḥ pṛṣṭham bhavanti anyat anyat chandaḥ

original: anye-'nye vā ete paśava ālabhyante |
analyzed: anyenye vai ete paśavaḥ ālabhyante

original: { 3.9.9.2} uta-iva grāmyāḥ | uta-ivā''raṇyāḥ | ahar eva rūpeṇa samardhayati | atho ahna eva-eṣa balir hriyate | tad āhuḥ | apaśavo vā ete | yad ajāvayaś ca-āraṇyāś ca | ete vai sarve paśavaḥ | yad gavyā iti | gavyān paśūn uttame 'hann ālabhate |
analyzed: uta eva grāmyāḥ uta eva āraṇyāḥ ahar eva rūpeṇa samardhayati atha u ahne eva eṣa baliḥ hriyate tat āhuḥ a paśavaḥ vai ete yat aja avayaḥ ca āraṇyāḥ ca ete vai sarve paśavaḥ yat gavyāḥ iti gavyān paśūn uttame han ālabhate

original: { 3.9.9.3} tena-eva-ubhayān paśūn avarundhe | prājāpatyā bhavanti | anabhijitasyābhijityai | saurīr nava śvetā vaśā anūbandhā̀ bhavanti | antata eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe | somāya svarājñe 'novāhāv anaḍvāhāv iti dvandvínaḥ paśūn ālabhate | ahorātrāṇām abhijityai | paśubhir vā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yo 'śvamedhena yajate |
analyzed: tena eva aubhayān paśūn avarundhe prājāpatyāḥ bhavanti an abhijitasya abhijityai saurīḥ nava śvetāḥ vaśāḥ anūbandhāḥ bhavanti antatas eva brahmavarcasam avarundhe somāya sva rājñe novāhau anaḍvāhau iti dvandvínaḥ paśūn ālabhate ahar rātrāṇām abhijityai paśubhiḥ vai eṣa vyṛdhyate yaḥ śvamedhena yajate

original: chagalaṃ kalmāṣaṃ kikidīviṃ vidīgayam iti tvāṣṭrān paśūn ālabhate | paśubhir evā''tmānaṃ samardhayati | ṛtubhir vā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | piśaṅgās trayo vāsantā ity ṛtupaśūn ālabhate | ṛtubhir evā''tmānaṃ samardhayati | ā vā eṣa paśubhyo vṛścyate | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | paryagnikṛtā utsṛjanty anāvraskāya |
analyzed: chagalam kalmāṣam kikidīvim vidīgayam iti tvāṣṭrān paśūn ālabhate paśubhiḥ eva ātmānam samardhayati ṛtubhiḥ vai eṣa vyṛdhyate yaḥ śvamedhena yajate piśaṅgāḥ trayaḥ vāsantāḥ iti ṛtu paśūn ālabhate ṛtubhiḥ eva ātmānam samardhayati ā vai eṣa paśubhyaḥ vṛścyate yaḥ śvamedhena yajate paryagnikṛtāḥ utsṛjanti an āvraskāya

original: anuvāka 10 { 3.9.10.1} prajāpatir akāmayata mahān annādaḥ syām iti | sa etāv aśvamedhe mahimānāv apaśyat | tāv agṛhṇīta | tato vai sa mahān annādo 'bhavat | yaḥ kāmayeta mahān annādaḥ syām iti | sa etāv aśvamedhe mahimānau gṛhṇīta | mahān evānnādo bhavati | yajamānadevatyā vai vapā | rājā mahimā | yad vapāṃ mahimnā-ubhayataḥ pariyajati |
analyzed: prajāpatiḥ akāmayata mahān anna ādaḥ syām iti saḥ etau aśvamedhe mahimānau apaśyat tau agṛhṇīta tatas vai sa mahān anna ādaḥ bhavat yaḥ kāmayeta mahān anna ādaḥ syām iti saḥ etau aśvamedhe mahimānau gṛhṇīta mahān eva anna ādaḥ bhavati yajamāna devatyā vai vapā rājā mahimā yat vapām mahimnā ubhayatas pariyajati

original: yajamānam eva rājyena-ubhayataḥ parigṛhṇāti | purastātsvāhākārā vā anye devāḥ | upariṣṭātsvāhākārā anye | te vā ete 'śva eva medhya ubhaye 'varudhyante | yad vapāṃ mahimnā-ubhayataḥ pariyajati | tān eva-ubhayān prīṇāti |
analyzed: yajamānam eva rājyena ubhayatas parigṛhṇāti purastāt svāhākārāḥ vai anye devāḥ upariṣṭāt svāhākārāḥ anye te vai ete śvas eva medhye ubhaye varudhyante yat vapām mahimnā ubhayatas pariyajati tān eva aubhayān prīṇāti

original: anuvāka 11 { 3.9.11.1} vaiśvadevo vā aśvaḥ | taṃ yat prājāpatyaṃ kuryāt | yā devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena vyardhayet | devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhyāt | stegān daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ maṇḍūkāñ jambhyebhir iti | ājyam avadānaṃ kṛtvā pratisaṃkhyāyam āhutīr juhoti | yā eva devatā apibhāgāḥ | tā bhāgadheyena samardhayati | na devatābhyaḥ samadaṃ dadhāti |
analyzed: vaiśvadevaḥ vai aśvaḥ tam yat prājāpatyam kuryāt yāḥ devatāḥ apibhāgāḥ tāḥ bhāgadheyena vyardhayet devatābhyaḥ samadam dadhyāt stegān daṃṣṭrābhyām maṇḍūkān jambhyebhiḥ iti ājyam avadānam kṛtvā pratisaṃkhyāyam āhutīḥ juhoti yāḥ eva devatāḥ apibhāgāḥ tāḥ bhāgadheyena samardhayati na devatābhyaḥ samadam dadhāti

original: { 3.9.11.2} caturdaśa-etān anuvākāñ juhoty anantarityai | prayāsāya svāhā-iti pañcadaśam | pañcadaśa vā ardhamāsasya rātrayaḥ | ardhamāsaśaḥ saṃvatsara āpyate | devāsurāḥ saṃyattā āsan | te 'bruvann agnayaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ | aśvasya medhyasya vayam uddhāram uddharāmahai | atha-etān abhibhavāma-iti | te lohitam udaharanta | tato devā abhavan |
analyzed: caturdaśa etān anuvākān juhoti anantarityai prayāsāya svāhā iti pañcadaśam pañcadaśa vai ardha māsasya rātrayaḥ ardhamāsaśas saṃvatsaraḥ āpyate deva asurāḥ saṃyattāḥ āsan te bruvan agnayaḥ sviṣṭakṛtaḥ aśvasya medhyasya vayam uddhāram uddharāmahai atha etān abhibhavāma eti te lohitam udaharanta tatas devāḥ abhavan

original: { 3.9.11.3} parā-asurāḥ | yat sviṣṭakṛdbhyo lohitaṃ juhoti bhrātṛvyābhibhūtyai | bhavaty ātmanā | parā-asya bhrātṛvyo bhavati | gomṛgakaṇṭhena prathamām āhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vai gomṛgaḥ | rudro 'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrād eva paśūn antardadhāti | atho yatra-eṣā-āhutir hūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūn abhimanyate |
analyzed: parā asurāḥ yat sviṣṭakṛdbhyaḥ lohitam juhoti bhrātṛvya abhibhūtyai bhavati ātmanā parā asya bhrātṛvyaḥ bhavati gomṛga kaṇṭhena prathamām āhutim juhoti paśavaḥ vai gomṛgaḥ rudraḥ gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt rudrāt eva paśūn antardadhāti atha u yatra eṣā āhutiḥ hūyate na tatra rudraḥ paśūn abhimanyate

original: { 3.9.11.4} aśvaśaphena dvitīyām āhutiṃ juhoti | paśavo vā ekaśapham | rudro 'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt | rudrād eva paśūn antardadhāti | atho yatra-eṣā-āhutir hūyate | na tatra rudraḥ paśūn abhimanyate | ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā tṛtīyām āhutiṃ juhoty āyāsyo vai prajāḥ | rudro 'gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt |rudrād eva prajā antardadhāti | atho yatra-eṣā-āhutir hūyate |
analyzed: aśva śaphena dvitīyām āhutim juhoti paśavaḥ vai ekaśapham rudraḥ gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt rudrāt eva paśūn antardadhāti atha u yatra eṣā āhutiḥ hūyate na tatra rudraḥ paśūn abhimanyate ayasmayena kamaṇḍalunā tṛtīyām āhutim juhoti āyāsyaḥ vai prajāḥ rudraḥ gniḥ sviṣṭakṛt rudrāt eva prajāḥ antardadhāti atha u yatra eṣā āhutiḥ hūyate

original: na tatra rudraḥ prajā abhimanyate |
analyzed: na tatra rudraḥ prajāḥ abhimanyate

original: anuvāka 12 { 3.9.12.1} aśvasya vā ālabdhasya medha udakrāmat | tad aśvastomīyam abhavat | yad aśvastomīyaṃ juhoti | samedham evainam ālabhate | ājyena juhoti | medho vā ājyam | medho 'śvastomīyam | medhena-evāsmin medhaṃ dadhāti | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśad akṣarā bṛhatī |
analyzed: aśvasya vai ālabdhasya medhaḥ udakrāmat tat aśvastomīyam abhavat yat aśvastomīyam juhoti sa medham eva enam ālabhate ājyena juhoti medhaḥ vai ājyam medhaḥ śvastomīyam medhena eva asmin medham dadhāti ṣaṭtriṃśatam juhoti ṣaṭtriṃśat akṣarā bṛhatī

original: { 3.9.12.2} bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūn eva mātrayā samardhayati | tā yad bhūyasīr vā kanīyasīr vā juhuyāt | paśūn matrayā vyardhayet | ṣaṭtriṃśataṃ juhoti | ṣaṭtriṃśadakṣarā bṛhatī | bārhatāḥ paśavaḥ | sā paśūnāṃ mātrā | paśūn eva mātrayā samardhayati |

original: anuvāka 17 { 3.9.17.1} yady aśvam upatapad vindet | āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | saumyaṃ carum | sāvitram aṣṭākapālam | yad āgneyo bhavati | agniḥ sarvā devatāḥ | devatābhir evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yat saumyo bhavati | somo vā oṣadhīnāṃ rājā | yābhya evainaṃ vindati |
analyzed: yadi aśvam upatapat vindet āgneyam aṣṭākapālam nirvapet saumyam carum sāvitram aṣṭākapālam yat āgneyaḥ bhavati agniḥ sarvāḥ devatāḥ devatābhiḥ eva enam bhiṣajyati yat saumyaḥ bhavati somaḥ vai oṣadhīnām rājā yābhyaḥ eva enam vindati

original: { 3.9.17.2} tābhir evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | yat sāvitro bhavati | savitṛprasūta evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | etābhir evainaṃ devatābhir bhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | pauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi śloṇaḥ syāt | pūṣā vai śloṇyasya bhiṣak | sa evainaṃ bhiṣajyati | aśloṇo haiva bhavati |

original: { 3.9.17.3} raudraṃ caruṃ nirvapet | yadi mahatī devatā-abhimanyeta | etaddevatyo vā aśvaḥ | svayā-evainaṃ devatayā bhiṣajyati | agado haiva bhavati | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapen mṛgākhare yadi na-āgacchet | iyaṃ vā agnir vaiśvānaraḥ | iyam evainam arcibhyāṃ parirodham ānayati | ā haiva sutyam ahar gacchati | yady adhīyāt |
analyzed: raudram carum nirvapet yadi mahatī devatā abhimanyeta etad devatyaḥ vai aśvaḥ svayā eva enam devatayā bhiṣajyati agadaḥ ha eva bhavati vaiśvānaram dvādaśa kapālam nirvapet mṛga ākhare yadi na āgacchet iyam vai agniḥ vaiśvānaraḥ iyam eva enam arcibhyām parirodham ānayati ā ha eva sutyam ahar gacchati yadi adhīyāt

original: { 3.9.17.4} agnaye 'ṃhomuce 'ṣṭākapālaḥ | sauryaṃ payaḥ | vāyavya ājyabhāgaḥ | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | aṃhasā vā eṣa gṛhītaḥ | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito 'dhyeti | yad aṃhomuce nirvapati | aṃhasa eva tena mucyate | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | retasā vā eṣa vyṛdhyate |
analyzed: agnaye ṃhaḥ muce ṣṭākapālaḥ sauryam payaḥ vāyavyaḥ ājyabhāgaḥ yajamānaḥ vai aśvaḥ aṃhasā vai eṣa gṛhītaḥ yasya aśvaḥ medhāya prokṣitaḥ dhyeti yat aṃhaḥ muce nirvapati aṃhasaḥ eva tena mucyate yajamānaḥ vai aśvaḥ retasā vai eṣa vyṛdhyate

original: { 3.9.17.5} yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito 'dhyeti | sauryaṃ retaḥ | yat sauryaṃ payo bhavati | retasā-evainaṃ sa samardhayati | yajamāno vā aśvaḥ | garbhair vā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yasyāśvo medhāya prokṣito 'dhyeti | vāyavyā garbhāḥ | yad vāyavya ājyabhāgo bhavati | garbhair evainaṃ sa samardhayati | atho yasyaiṣāśvamedhe prāyaścitiḥ kriyate |
analyzed: yasya aśvaḥ medhāya prokṣitaḥ dhyeti sauryam retaḥ yat sauryam payaḥ bhavati retasā eva enam sa samardhayati yajamānaḥ vai aśvaḥ garbhaiḥ vai eṣa vyṛdhyate yasya aśvaḥ medhāya prokṣitaḥ dhyeti vāyavyāḥ garbhāḥ yat vāyavyaḥ ājyabhāgaḥ bhavati garbhaiḥ eva enam sa samardhayati atha u yasya eṣā aśvamedhe prāyaścitiḥ kriyate

original: { 3.9.19.4} sarvaṃ ha vai tatra payasvad bhavati | yatra-etena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vidhṛto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vidhṛtaṃ bhavati | yatra-etena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai vyāvṛtto nāma yajñaḥ | sarvaṃ ha vai tatra vyāvṛttaṃ bhavati | yatra-etena yajñena yajante | eṣa vai pratiṣṭhito nāma yajñaḥ |

original: anuvāka 20 { 3.9.20.1} tārpyeṇāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | yajño vai tārpyam | yajñena-evainaṃ samardhayanti | yāmena sāmnā prastotā-anūpatiṣṭhate | yamalokam evainaṃ gamayati | tārpye ca kṛtyadhīvāse cāśvaṃ saṃjñapayanti | etad vai paśūnāṃ rūpam | rūpeṇaiva paśūn avarundhe | hiraṇyakaśipu bhavati | tejaso 'varuddhyai |
analyzed: tārpyeṇa aśvam saṃjñapayanti yajñaḥ vai tārpyam yajñena eva enam samardhayanti yāmena sāmnā prastotā anūpatiṣṭhate yama lokam eva enam gamayati tārpye ca kṛti adhīvāse ca aśvam saṃjñapayanti etat vai paśūnām rūpam rūpeṇa eva paśūn avarundhe hiraṇya kaśipu bhavati tejasaḥ varuddhyai

original: { 3.9.20.2} rukmo bhavati | suvargasya lokasyānukhyātyai | aśvo bhavati | prajāpater āptyai | asya vai lokasya rūpaṃ tārpyam | antarikṣasya kṛtyadhīvāsaḥ | divo hiraṇyakaśipu | ādityasya rukmaḥ | prajāpater aśvaḥ | imam eva lokaṃ tārpyeṇa-āpnoti |
analyzed: rukmaḥ bhavati suvargasya lokasya anukhyātyai aśvaḥ bhavati prajāpateḥ āptyai asya vai lokasya rūpam tārpyam antarikṣasya kṛtī adhīvāsaḥ divaḥ hiraṇya kaśipu ādityasya rukmaḥ prajāpateḥ aśvaḥ imam eva lokam tārpyeṇa āpnoti

original: { 3.9.20.3} antarikṣaṃ kṛtyadhīvāsena | divaṃ hiraṇyakaśipunā | ādityaṃ rukmeṇa | aśvena-eva medhyena prajāpateḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | etāsām eva devatānāṃ sāyujyam | sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatām āpnoti | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainam evaṃ veda |
analyzed: antarikṣam kṛti adhīvāsena divam hiraṇyakaśipunā ādityam rukmeṇa aśvena eva medhyena prajāpateḥ sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti etāsām eva devatānām sāyujyam sārṣṭitām samāna loka tām āpnoti yaḥ u śvamedhena yajate yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: anuvāka 21 { 3.9.21.1} ādityāś cāṅgirasaś ca suvarge loke 'spardhanta | te 'ṅgirasa ādityebhyaḥ | amum ādityamaśvaṃ śvetaṃ bhūtaṃ dakṣiṇām anayan | te 'bruvan | yaṃ no 'neṣṭa | sa varyo 'bhūd iti | tasmād aśvaṃ savarya-ity āhvayanti | tasmād yajñe varo dīyate | yat prajāpatir ālabdho 'śvo 'bhavat | tasmād aśvo nāma |
analyzed: ādityāḥ ca aṅgirasaḥ ca suvarge loke spardhanta te ṅgirasaḥ ādityebhyaḥ amum ādityam aśvam śvetam bhūtam dakṣiṇām anayan te bruvan yam naḥ neṣṭa sa varyaḥ bhūt iti tasmāt aśvam savaryaḥ eti āhvayanti tasmāt yajñe varaḥ dīyate yat prajāpatiḥ ālabdhaḥ u śvas bhavat tasmāt aśvaḥ nāma

original: { 3.9.21.2} yat-śvayad arur āsīt | tasmād arvā nāma | yat sadyo vājant samajayat | tasmād vājī nāma | yad asurāṇāṃ lokān ādatta | tasmād ādityo nāma | agnirvā aśvamedhasya yonir āyatanam | sūryo 'gner yonir āyatanam | yad aśvamedhe 'gnau citya uttaravedim upavapati | yonimantam evainam āyatanavantaṃ karoti |
analyzed: aruḥ āsīt tasmāt arvā nāma yat sadyas vājan samajayat tasmāt vājī nāma yat asurāṇām lokān ādatta tasmāt ādityaḥ nāma agniḥ vai aśvamedhasya yoniḥ āyatanam sūryaḥ gneḥ yoniḥ āyatanam yat aśvamedhe gnau citye uttaravedim upavapati yonimantam eva enam āyatanavantam karoti

original: { 3.9.21.78} yonimān āyatanavān bhavati | ya {ānaṃdā. sa} evaṃ veda | prāṇāpānau vā etau devānām | yad arkāśvamedhau | prāṇāpānāv evāvarundhe | ojo balaṃ vā etau devānām | yad arkāśvamedhau | ojo balam evāvarundhe | agnir vā aśvamedhasya yonir āyatanam | sūryo 'gner yonir āyatanam | yad aśvamedhe 'gnau citya uttaravediṃ cinoti |
analyzed: yonimān āyatanavān bhavati yaḥ ānaṃdā saḥ evam veda prāṇa apānau vai etau devānām yat arka aśvamedhau prāṇa apānau eva avarundhe ojaḥ balam vai etau devānām yat arka aśvamedhau ojaḥ balam eva avarundhe agniḥ vai aśvamedhasya yoniḥ āyatanam sūryaḥ gneḥ yoniḥ āyatanam yat aśvamedhe gnau citye uttaravedim cinoti

original: tāv arkāśvamedhau | arkāśvamedhāv evāvarundhe | atho arkāśvamedhayor eva pratitiṣṭhati |
analyzed: tau arka aśvamedhau arka aśvamedhau eva avarundhe atha u arka aśvamedhayoḥ eva pratitiṣṭhati

original: anuvāka 22 { 3.9.22.1} prajāpatiṃ vai devāḥ pitaram | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāya-ālabhanta | tam ālabhya-upāvasan | prātar yaṣṭāsmaha iti | ekaṃ vā etad devānām ahaḥ | yat saṃvatsaraḥ | tasmād aśvaḥ purastāt saṃvatsara ālabhyate | yat prajāpatir ālabdho 'śvo 'bhavat | tasmād aśvaḥ | yat sadyo medho 'bhavat |
analyzed: prajāpatim vai devāḥ pitaram paśum bhūtam medhāya ālabhanta tam ālabhya aupāvasan prātar yaṣṭāsmahe iti ekam vai etat devānām ahar yat saṃvatsaraḥ tasmāt aśvaḥ purastāt saṃvatsaraḥ ālabhyate yat prajāpatiḥ ālabdhaḥ u śvas bhavat tasmāt aśvaḥ yat sadyas medhaḥ bhavat

original: { 3.9.22.2} tasmād aśvamedhaḥ | veduko 'śvam āśuṃ bhavati | ya evaṃ veda | yad vai tat prajāpatir ālabdho 'śvo 'bhavat | tasmād aśvaḥ prajāpateḥ paśūnām anurūpatamaḥ | ā-asya putraḥ pratirūpo jāyate | ya evaṃ veda | sarvāṇi bhūtāni sambhṛtya-ālabhate | sam enaṃ devās tejase brahmavarcasāya bharanti | yo 'śvamedhena yajate |
analyzed: tasmāt aśvamedhaḥ śvam āśum bhavati yaḥ evam veda yat vai tat prajāpatiḥ ālabdhaḥ śvas bhavat tasmāt aśvaḥ prajāpateḥ paśūnām anurūpatamaḥ ā asya putraḥ pratirūpaḥ jāyate yaḥ evam veda sarvāṇi bhūtāni sambhṛtya ālabhate sam enam devāḥ tejase brahmavarcasāya bharanti yaḥ śvamedhena yajate

original: { 3.9.22.3} ya u cainam evaṃ veda | etad vai tad devā etāṃ devatām | paśuṃ bhūtaṃ medhāya-ālabhanta | yajñam eva | yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ | kāmapraṃ yajñam akurvata | te 'mṛtatvam akāmayanta | te 'mṛtatvam agacchan | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | devānām eva-āyanena-eti |
analyzed: yaḥ u ca enam evam veda etat vai tat devāḥ etām devatām paśum bhūtam medhāya ālabhanta yajñam eva yajñena yajñam ayajanta devāḥ kāmapram yajñam akurvata te mṛta tvam akāmayanta te mṛta tvam agacchan yaḥ śvamedhena yajate devānām eva āyanena eti

original: { 3.9.22.4} prājāpatyena-eva yajñena yajate kāmapreṇa | apunarmāram eva gacchati | etasya vai rūpeṇa purastāt prājāpatyam ṛṣabhaṃ tūparaṃ bahurūpam ālabhate | sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ | sarvasya-āptyai | sarvasya jityai | sarvam eva tena-āpnoti | sarvaṃ jayati | yo 'śvamedhena yajate | ya u cainam evaṃ veda |
analyzed: prājāpatyena eva yajñena yajate kāmapreṇa apunarmāram eva gacchati etasya vai rūpeṇa purastāt prājāpatyam ṛṣabham tūparam bahu rūpam ālabhate sarvebhyaḥ kāmebhyaḥ sarvasya āptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam eva tena āpnoti sarvam jayati yaḥ u śvamedhena yajate yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: anuvāka 23 { 3.9.23.83} yo vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃllomañjuhoti | ahorātre vā aśvasya medhyasya lomanī | yat sāyamprātar juhoti | aśvasyaiva medhyasya lomaṃllomañ juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya lomaṃllomañ juhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya pade veda |
analyzed: yaḥ vai aśvasya medhyasya lomanī veda aśvasya eva medhyasya loman loman juhoti ahar rātre vai aśvasya medhyasya lomanī yat sāyamprātar juhoti aśvasya eva medhyasya loman loman juhoti etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā aśvasya medhyasya loman loman juhvati yaḥ vai aśvasya medhyasya pade veda

original: aśvasyaiva medhyasya padepade juhoti | darśapūrṇamāsau vā aśvasya medhyasya pade |
analyzed: aśvasya eva medhyasya pade pade juhoti darśapūrṇamāsau vai aśvasya medhyasya pade

original: { 3.9.23.2} yad darśapūrṇamāsau yajate | aśvasyaiva medhyasya padepade juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya padepade juhvati | yo vā aśvasya medhyasya vivartanaṃ veda | aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti | asau vā ādityo 'śvaḥ | sa āhavanīyam āgacchati | tad vivartate | yad agnihotraṃ juhoti |
analyzed: yat darśa pūrṇamāsau yajate aśvasya eva medhyasya pade pade juhoti etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā aśvasya medhyasya pade pade juhvati yaḥ vai aśvasya medhyasya vivartanam veda aśvasya eva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti asau vai ādityaḥ śvas saḥ āhavanīyam āgacchati tat vivartate yat agnihotram juhoti

original: aśvasyaiva medhyasya vivartanevivartane juhoti | etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā | aśvasya medhyasya vivartanevivartane juhvati |
analyzed: aśvasya eva medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhoti etadanukṛti ha sma vai purā aśvasya medhyasya vivartane vivartane juhvati

original: { 3.10.9.7} atha yad āha | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatīti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hy eva tāny ahāni | eṣa rātrayaḥ | atha yad āha | citraḥ ketur dātā pradātā savitā prasavitā-abhiśāstā-anumantā-iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hy eva te 'hno muhūrtāḥ | eṣa rātreḥ |

original: { 3.10.9.8} atha yad āha | pavitraṃ pavayiṣyant sahasvānt sahīyān aruṇo 'ruṇarajā iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hy eva te 'rdhamāsāḥ | eṣa māsāḥ | atha yad āha | agniṣṭoma ukthyo 'gnir ṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvatsara iti | eṣa eva tat | eṣa hy eva te yajñakratavaḥ | eṣa ṛtavaḥ |

original: { 3.10.9.10} sarvam āyur eti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmin-loke 'nnaṃ kṣīyata iti | vijahad dha vai pāpmānam eti | sarvam āyur eti | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | nāsyāmuṣmin-loke 'nnaṃ kṣīyate | ya evaṃ veda | ahīnā ha-āśvatthyaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra |

original: { 3.10.9.11} sa ha haṃso hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokam iyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | haṃso ha vai hiraṇmayo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokam eti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | devabhāgo ha śrautarṣaḥ | sāvitraṃ vidāṃcakāra | taṃ ha vāg adṛśyamānā'bhyuvāca |

original: { 3.10.9.12} sarvaṃ bata gautamo veda | yaḥ sāvitraṃ veda-iti | sa ha-uvāca | kā-eṣā vāg asīti | ayam ahaṃ sāvitraḥ | devānām uttamo lokaḥ | guhyaṃ maho bibhrad iti | etāvati ha gautamaḥ | yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā-adho nipapāta | namo nama iti |
analyzed: sarvam bata gautamaḥ veda yaḥ sāvitram veda eti sa ha uvāca kā eṣā vāc asi iti ayam aham sāvitraḥ devānām uttamaḥ lokaḥ guhyam mahaḥ bibhrat iti etāvati ha gautamaḥ yajñopavītam kṛtvā adhas nipapāta namaḥ namaḥ iti

original: { 3.10.9.13} sa ha-uvāca | mā bhaiṣīr gautama | jito vai te loka iti | tasmād ye ke ca sāvitraṃ viduḥ | sarve te jitalokāḥ | sa yo ha vai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā-abhiṣiktaṃ veda | śriyā haivābhiṣicyate | ghṛṇir iti dve akṣare | sūrya iti trīṇi | āditya iti trīṇi |

original: { 3.10.9.14} etad vai sāvitrasyāṣṭākṣaraṃ padaṃ śriyā-abhiṣiktam | ya evaṃ veda | śriyā haivā-abhiṣicyate | tad etad ṛcā-abhyuktam | ṛco akṣare parame vyoman | yasmin devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ | yas tan na veda kim ṛcā kariṣyati | ya it tad vidus ta ime samāsata iti | na ha vā etasya-ṛcā na yajuṣā na sāmnā-artho 'sti | yaḥ sāvitraṃ veda |

original: { 3.10.9.15} tad etat pari yad devacakram | ārdraṃ pinvamānaṃ svarge loka eti | vijahad viśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyat | ārdro ha vai pinvamānaḥ svarge loka eti | vijahan viśvā bhūtāni saṃpaśyan | ya evaṃ veda | śūṣo ha vai vārṣṇeyaḥ | ādityena samājagāma | taṃ ha-uvāca | ehi sāvitraṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai svargyo 'gniḥ pārayiṣṇur amṛtāt saṃbhūta iti |

original: eṣa vāva sa sāvitraḥ | ya eṣa tapati | ehi māṃ viddhi | iti haivainaṃ tad uvāca |

original: anuvāka 10 sāvitracayanam { 3.10.10.1} iyaṃ vāva saraghā | tasyā agnir eva sāraghaṃ madhu | yā etāḥ pūrvapakṣāparapakṣayo rātrayaḥ | tā madhukṛtaḥ | yāny ahāni | te madhuvṛṣāḥ | sa yo ha vā etā madhukṛtaś ca madhuvṛṣāṃś ca veda | kruvanti hāsyaitā agnau madhu | nāsya-iṣṭāpūrtaṃ dhayanti | atha yo na veda |

original: { 3.10.10.2} na hāsyaitā agnau madhu kurvanti | dhayanty asya-iṣṭāpūrtam | yo ha vā ahorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | nāhorātreṣv ārtim ārcchati | saṃjñānaṃ vijñānaṃ darśā dṛṣṭā-iti | etāv anuvākau pūrvapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni | prastutaṃ viṣṭutaṃ sutā sunvatī-iti | etāv anuvākāv aparapakṣasyāhorātrāṇāṃ nāmadheyāni |

original: nāhorātreṣv ārtim ārcchati | ya evaṃ veda |

original: { 3.10.10.3} yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni veda | na muhūrteṣv ārtim ārcchati | citraḥ ketur dātā pradātā savitā prasavitā-abhiśāstā-anumantā-iti | ete 'nuvākā muhūrtānāṃ nāmadheyāni | na muhūrteṣv ārtim ārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni veda | nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣv ārtim ārcchati |

original: pavitraṃ paviyiṣyant sahasvānt sahīyān aruṇo 'ruṇarajā iti | ete 'nuvākā ardhamāsānāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca nāmadheyāni |
analyzed: pavitram paviyiṣyan sahasvān sahīyān aruṇaḥ ruṇarajāḥ iti ete nuvākāḥ ardha māsānām ca māsānām ca nāmadheyāni

original: { 3.10.10.4} nārdhamāseṣu na māseṣv ārtim ārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai yajñakratūnāṃ ca-ṛtūnāṃ ca saṃvatsarasya ca nāmadheyāni veda | na yajñakratuṣu na-ṛtuṣu na saṃvatsara ārtim ārcchati | agniṣṭoma ukthyo 'gnir ṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvatsara iti | ete 'nuvākā yajñakratūnāṃ ca-ṛtūnāṃ ca saṃvatsarasya ca nāmadheyāni |
analyzed: na ardha māseṣu na māseṣu ārtim ārcchati yaḥ evam veda yaḥ ha vai yajñakratūnām ca ṛtūnām ca saṃvatsarasya ca nāmadheyāni veda na yajñakratuṣu na ṛtuṣu na saṃvatsare ārtim ārcchati agniṣṭomaḥ ukthyaḥ gniḥ ṛtuḥ prajāpatiḥ saṃvatsaraḥ iti ete nuvākāḥ yajñakratūnām ca ṛtūnām ca saṃvatsarasya ca nāmadheyāni

original: na yajñakratuṣu na-ṛtuṣu na saṃvatsara ārtim ārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtān veda | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣv ārtim ārcchati |
analyzed: na yajñakratuṣu na ṛtuṣu na saṃvatsare ārtim ārcchati yaḥ evam veda yaḥ ha vai muhūrtānām muhūrtān veda na muhūrtānām muhūrteṣu ārtim ārcchati

original: { 3.10.10.5} idānīṃ tadānīm iti | ete vai muhūrtānāṃ muhūrtāḥ | na muhūrtānāṃ muhūrteṣv ārtim ārcchati | ya evaṃ veda | atho yathā kṣetrajño bhūtvā-anupraviśyānnam atti | evam eva-etān kṣetrajño bhūtvā-anupraviśyānnam atti | sa eteṣām eva salokatāṃ sāyujyam aśnute | apa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda |

original: anuvāka 11 sāvitracayanam { 3.10.11.1} kaś cid dha vā asmāl lokāt pretya | ātmānaṃ veda | āyam aham asmīti | kaś cit svaṃ lokaṃ na pratiprajānāti | agnimugdho haiva dhumatāntaḥ | svaṃ lokaṃ na pratiprajānāti | atha yo haivaitam agniṃ sāvitraṃ veda | sa evāsmāl lokāt pretya | ātmānaṃ veda | ayam aham asmīti |
analyzed: anuvāka 11 sāvitra cayanam kaḥ cit ha vai asmāt lokāt pretya ātmānam veda ā ayam aham asmi iti kaḥ cit svam lokam na pratiprajānāti agni mugdhaḥ ha eva dhumatā antar svam lokam na pratiprajānāti atha yaḥ ha eva etam agnim sāvitram veda saḥ eva asmāt lokāt pretya ātmānam veda ayam aham asmi iti

original: { 3.10.11.2} sa svaṃ lokaṃ pratiprajānāti | eṣa u caivainaṃ { uvevainaṃ} tat sāvitraḥ | svargaṃ lokam abhivahati | ahorātrair vā idaṃ sayugbhiḥ kriyate | itirātrāyā-adīkṣiṣata | itirātrāya vratam upāgur iti | tāni hānevaṃ viduṣaḥ | amuṣmin- loke śevadhiṃ dhayanti | dhītaṃ haiva sa śevadhim anuparaiti | atha yo haivaitam agniṃ sāvitraṃ veda |
analyzed: sa svam lokam pratiprajānāti eṣaḥ u ca eva enam u eva enam tat sāvitraḥ svargam lokam abhivahati ahorātraiḥ vai idam sayugbhiḥ kriyate itirātrāya adīkṣiṣata itirātrāya vratam upāguḥ iti tāni ha an evam viduṣaḥ amuṣmin loke śevadhim dhayanti dhītam ha eva sa śevadhim anuparaiti atha yaḥ ha eva etam agnim sāvitram veda

original: { 3.10.11.4} taṃ ha trīn girirūpān avijñātān iva darśayāṃ cakāra | teṣāṃ ha-ekaikasmān muṣṭin ādade | sa ha-uvāca | bharadvāja-ity āmantrya | vedā vā ete | anantā vai vedāḥ | etad vā etais tribhir āyurbhir anvavocathāḥ | atha ta itarad ananūktam eva | ehīmaṃ viddhi | ayaṃ vai sarvavidyā-iti |
analyzed: tam ha trīn giri rūpān a vijñātān iva darśayāṃ cakāra teṣām ha ekaikasmāt muṣṭin ādade sa ha uvāca bharadvāja eti āmantrya vedāḥ vai ete anantāḥ vai vedāḥ etat vai etaiḥ tribhiḥ āyurbhiḥ anvavocathāḥ atha te itarat an anūktam eva ehi imam viddhi ayam vai sarva vidyā iti

original: { 3.10.11.5} tasmai haitam agniṃ sāvitram uvāca | taṃ sa viditvā | amṛto bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokam iyāya | ādityasya sāyujyam | amṛto haiva bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokam eti | ādityasya sāyujyam | ya evaṃ veda | eṣo eva trayī vidyā |

original: { 3.10.11.6} yāvantaṃ ha vai trayyā vidyayā lokaṃ jayati | tāvantaṃ lokaṃ jayati | ya evaṃ veda | agner vā etāni nāmadheyāni | agner eva sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | vāyor vā etāni nāmadheyāni | vāyor eva sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | ya evaṃ veda | indrasya vā etāni nāmadheyāni |

original: { 3.11.7.2} atha yat saṃvāti | tad asya samañcanaṃ ca prasāraṇaṃ ca | atho sampad evāsya sā | saṃ ha vā asmai sa kāmaḥ padyate | yatkāmo yajate | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | yo ha vā agner nāciketasya-āyatanaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ veda | āyatanavān bhavati | gacchati pratiṣṭhām |

original: { 3.11.7.4} evam eva sa tejasā yaśasā | asmiṃś ca loke 'muṣmiṃś ca bhāti | uravo ha vai nāmaite lokāḥ | ye 'vareṇa-ādityam | atha haite varīyāṃso lokāḥ | ye pareṇa-ādityam | antavantaṃ ha vā eṣa kṣayyaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yo 'vareṇa-ādityam | atha haiṣo 'nantam apāram akṣayyaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yaḥ pareṇa-ādityam |

analyzed: iṣṭāpūrtayoḥ me kṣitim brūhi iti ha uvāca tasmai ha etam agnim nāciketam uvāca tatas vai tasyai ṣṭāpūrte na ā kṣīyete na asyai ṣṭāpūrte kṣīyete yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda tṛtīyam vṛṇīṣva eti punarmṛtyoḥ me ānaṃdā pacitim brūhi iti ha uvāca tasmai ha etam agnim nāciketam uvāca

original: tato vai so 'pa punarmṛtyum ajayat |
analyzed: tatas vai saḥ pa punarmṛtyum ajayat

original: { 3.11.8.6} apa punarmṛtyuṃ jayati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | prajāpatir vai prajākāmas tapo 'tapyata | sa hiraṇyam udāsyat | tad agnau prāsyat | tad asmai nācchadayat | tad dvitīyaṃ prāsyat | tad asmai na-evācchadayat | tat tṛtīyaṃ prāsyat |
analyzed: apa punarmṛtyum jayati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda prajāpatiḥ vai prajā kāmaḥ tapaḥ tapyata sa hiraṇyam udāsyat tat agnau prāsyat tat asmai na ācchadayat tat dvitīyam prāsyat tat asmai na eva acchadayat tat tṛtīyam prāsyat

original: { 3.11.8.7} tad asmai na-evācchadayat | tad ātmann eva hṛdayye 'gnau vaiśvānare prāsyat | tad asmā acchadayat | tasmād dhiraṇyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ dhanānām | bhuñjat priyatamam | hṛdayajaṃ hi | sa vai tam eva nāvindat | yasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇām aneṣyat | tāṃ svāya-eva hastāya dakṣiṇāyānayat | tāṃ pratyagṛhṇāt |
analyzed: tat asmai na eva acchadayat tat ātman eva hṛdayye gnau vaiśvānare prāsyat tat asmai acchadayat tasmāt hiraṇyam kaniṣṭham dhanānām bhuñjat priyatamam hṛdaya jam hi sa vai tam eva na avindat yasmai tām dakṣiṇām aneṣyat tām svāya eva hastāya dakṣiṇāya anayat tām pratyagṛhṇāt

original: { 3.11.8.8} dakṣāya tvā dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāmīti | so 'dakṣata dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya | dakṣate ha vai dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya | ya evaṃ veda | etad dha sma vai tad vidvāṃso vājaśravasā gotamāḥ | apy anūdeśyāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇanti | ubhayena vayaṃ dakṣiṣyāmaha eva dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya-iti | te 'dakṣanta dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya |
analyzed: dakṣāya tvā dakṣiṇām pratigṛhṇāmi iti saḥ dakṣata dakṣiṇām pratigṛhṇāmi iti saḥ dakṣata dakṣiṇām pratigṛhya dakṣate ha vai dakṣiṇām pratigṛhya yaḥ evam veda etat ha sma vai tat vidvāṃsaḥ vājaśravasāḥ gotamāḥ api anūdeśyām dakṣiṇām pratigṛhṇanti ubhayena vayam dakṣiṣyāmahe eva dakṣiṇām pratigṛhya eti te dakṣanta dakṣiṇām pratigṛhya

original: dakṣate ha vai dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhya | ya evaṃ veda | pra hānyaṃ vlīnāti |
analyzed: dakṣate ha vai dakṣiṇām pratigṛhya yaḥ evam veda pra ha anyam vlīnāti

original: anuvāka 9 nāciketāgnicayanam { 3.11.9.1} taṃ haitam eke paśubandha eva-uttaravedyāṃ cinvate | uttaravedisaṃmita eṣo 'gnir iti vadantaḥ | tan na tathā kuryāt | etam agniṃ kāmena vyardhayet | sa enaṃ kāmena vyṛddhaḥ | kāmena vyardhayet | saumye vāva-enam adhvare cinvīta | yatra vā bhūyiṣṭhā āhutayo hūyeran | etam agniṃ kāmena samardhayati |
analyzed: anuvāka 9 nāciketa agni cayanam tam ha etam eke paśubandhe eva auttaravedyām cinvate uttaravedi saṃmitaḥ eṣaḥ gniḥ iti vadantaḥ tat na tathā kuryāt etam agnim kāmena vyardhayet saḥ enam kāmena vyṛddhaḥ kāmena vyardhayet saumye vāva enam adhvare cinvīta yatra vā bhūyiṣṭhāḥ āhutayaḥ hūyeran etam agnim kāmena samardhayati

original: sa enaṃ kāmena samṛddhaḥ |
analyzed: saḥ enam kāmena samṛddhaḥ

original: { 3.11.9.2} kāmena samardhayati | atha hainaṃ purā-ṛṣayaḥ | uttaravedyām eva sattriyam acinvata | tato vai te 'vindanta prajām | abhi svargaṃ lokam ajayan | vindata eva prajām | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | atha hainaṃ vāyur ṛddhikāmaḥ |
analyzed: kāmena samardhayati atha ha enam purā ṛṣayaḥ uttaravedyām eva sattriyam acinvata tatas vai te vindanta prajām abhi svargam lokam ajayan vindate eva prajām abhi svargam lokam jayati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda atha ha enam vāyuḥ ṛddhi kāmaḥ

original: { 3.11.9.3} yathānyuptam eva-upadadhe | tato vai sa etām ṛddhim ārdhnot | yām idaṃ vāyur ṛddhaḥ | etām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti | yām idaṃ vāyur ṛddhaḥ | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | atha hainaṃ gobalo vārṣṇaḥ paśukāmaḥ | pāṅktam eva cikye | pañca purastāt |
analyzed: yathānyuptam eva aupadadhe tatas vai saḥ etām ṛddhim ārdhnot yām idam vāyuḥ ṛddhaḥ etām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti yām idam vāyuḥ ṛddhaḥ yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda atha ha enam gobalaḥ vārṣṇaḥ paśu kāmaḥ pāṅktam eva cikye pañca purastāt

original: { 3.11.9.4} pañca dakṣiṇataḥ | pañca paścāt | pañca-uttarataḥ | ekāṃ madhye | tato vai sa sahasraṃ paśūn prāpnot | pra sahasraṃ paśūn āpnoti | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | atha hainaṃ prajāpatir jyaiṣṭhyakāmo yaśaskāmaḥ prajananakāmaḥ | trivṛtam eva cikye |
analyzed: pañca dakṣiṇatas pañca paścāt pañca auttaratas ekām madhye tatas vai sa sahasram paśūn prāpnot pra sahasram paśūn āpnoti yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda atha ha enam prajāpatiḥ jyaiṣṭhya kāmaḥ yaśaskāmaḥ prajanana kāmaḥ trivṛtam eva cikye

original: { 3.11.9.5} sapta purastāt | tisro dakṣiṇataḥ | sapta paścāt | tisra uttarataḥ | ekāṃ madhye | tato vai sa pra yaśo jyaiṣṭhyam āpnot | etāṃ prajātiṃ prājāyata | yām idaṃ prajāḥ prajāyante | trivṛd vai jyaiṣṭhyam | mātā pitā putraḥ |
analyzed: sapta purastāt tisraḥ dakṣiṇatas sapta paścāt tisraḥ uttaratas ekām madhye tatas vai sa pra yaśaḥ jyaiṣṭhyam āpnot etām prajātim prājāyata yām idam prajāḥ prajāyante trivṛt vai jyaiṣṭhyam mātā pitā putraḥ

original: { 3.11.9.6} trivṛt prajananam | upastho yonir madhyamā | pra yaśo jyaiṣṭhyam āpnoti | etāṃ prajātiṃ prajāyate | yām idaṃ prajāḥ prajāyante | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | atha hainam indro jyaiṣṭhyakāmaḥ | ūrdhvā eva-upadadhe | tato vai sa jyaiṣṭhyamagacchat |
analyzed: trivṛt prajananam upasthaḥ yoniḥ madhyamā pra yaśaḥ jyaiṣṭhyam āpnoti etām prajātim prajāyate yām idam prajāḥ prajāyante yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda atha ha enam indraḥ jyaiṣṭhya kāmaḥ ūrdhvāḥ eva aupadadhe tatas vai sa jyaiṣṭhyam agacchat

original: { 3.11.9.7} jyaiṣṭhyaṃ gacchati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | atha hainam asāv ādityaḥ svargakāmaḥ | prācīr eva-upadadhe | tato vai so 'bhi svargaṃ lokam ajayat | abhi svargaṃ lokaṃ jayati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | sa yadīcchet |
analyzed: jyaiṣṭhyam gacchati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda atha ha enam asau ādityaḥ svarga kāmaḥ prācīḥ eva upadadhe tatas vai saḥ bhi svargam lokam ajayat abhi svargam lokam jayati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda sa yadi icchet

original: { 3.11.9.8} tejasvī yaśasvī brahmavarcasī syām iti | prāṅ ā hotur dhiṣṇyād utsarpet | yā-iyaṃ prāgād yaśasvatī | sā mā prorṇotu | tejasā yaśasā brahmavarcasena-iti | tejasvy eva yaśasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati | atha yadīcchet | bhūyiṣṭhaṃ me śraddadhīran | bhūyiṣṭhā dakṣiṇā nayeyur iti |
analyzed: tejasvī yaśasvī brahmavarcasī syām iti prāṅ ā hotuḥ dhiṣṇyāt utsarpet yā iyam prāgāt yaśasvatī sā mā prorṇotu tejasā yaśasā brahmavarcasena eti tejasvī eva yaśasvī brahmavarcasī bhavati atha yadi icchet bhūyiṣṭham me śraddadhīran bhūyiṣṭhāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ nayeyuḥ iti

original: dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsu prācy ehi prācy ehīti prācī juṣāṇā vetv ājyasya svāhā-iti sruveṇa-upahatya-āhavanīye juhuyāt |
analyzed: dakṣiṇāsu nīyamānāsu prācī ehi prācī ehi iti prācī juṣāṇā vetu ājyasya svāhā iti sruveṇa aupahatya āhavanīye juhuyāt
