original: { 3.11.9.9} bhūyiṣṭham evāsmai śraddadhate | bhūyiṣṭhā dakṣiṇā nayanti | purīṣam upadhāya | citiklṛptibhir abhimṛśya | agniṃ praṇīya-upasamādhāya | catasra etā āhutīr juhoti | tvam agne rudra iti | śatarudrīyasya rūpam | agnāviṣṇū iti vasordhārāyāḥ | annapata ity annahomaḥ | sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvā iti viśvaprīḥ |
analyzed: bhūyiṣṭham eva asmai śraddadhate bhūyiṣṭhāḥ dakṣiṇāḥ nayanti purīṣam upadhāya citi klṛptibhiḥ abhimṛśya agnim praṇīya upasamādhāya catasraḥ etāḥ āhutīḥ juhoti tvam agne rudraḥ iti śatarudrīyasya rūpam agnāviṣṇū iti vasordhārāyāḥ anna pate iti annahomaḥ sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ iti viśva prīḥ

original: anuvāka 10 nāciketāgnicayanam { 3.11.10.10} yāṃ prathamām iṣṭakām upadadhāti | imaṃ tayā lokam abhijayati | atho yā asmin-loke devatāḥ | tāsāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | yāṃ dvitīyām upadadhāti | antarikṣalokaṃ tayā-abhijayati | atho yā antarikṣaloke devatāḥ | tāsāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | yāṃ tṛtīyām upadadhāti | amuṃ tayā lokam abhijayati |
analyzed: anuvāka 10 nāciketa agni cayanam yām prathamām iṣṭakām upadadhāti imam tayā lokam abhijayati atha u yāḥ asmin loke devatāḥ tāsām sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti yām dvitīyām upadadhāti antarikṣa lokam tayā abhijayati atha u yāḥ antarikṣa loke devatāḥ tāsām sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti yām tṛtīyām upadadhāti amum tayā lokam abhijayati

original: { 3.11.10.2} atho yā amuṣmin-loke devatāḥ | tāsāṃ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | atho yā amūr itarā aṣṭādaśa | ya evāmī uravaś ca varīyāṃsaś ca lokāḥ | tān eva tābhir abhijayati | kāmacāro ha vā asya-uruṣu ca varīyaḥsu ca lokeṣu bhavati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | saṃvatsaro vā agnir nāciketaḥ | tasya vasantaḥ śiraḥ |
analyzed: atha u yāḥ amuṣmin loke devatāḥ tāsām sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti atha u yāḥ amūḥ itarāḥ aṣṭādaśa ye eva amī uravaḥ ca varīyāṃsaḥ ca lokāḥ tān eva tābhiḥ abhijayati kāmacāraḥ ha vai asya auruṣu ca varīyaḥsu ca lokeṣu bhavati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda saṃvatsaraḥ vai agniḥ nāciketaḥ tasya vasantaḥ śiraḥ

original: { 3.11.10.3} grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | varṣā uttaraḥ | śarat puccham | māsāḥ karmakārāḥ | ahorātre śatarudrīyam | parjanyo vasordhārā | yathā vai parjanyaḥ suvṛṣṭaṃ vṛṣṭvā | prajābhyaḥ sarvān kāmānt saṃpūrayati | evam eva sa tasya sarvān kāmānt saṃpūrayati | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute |
analyzed: grīṣmaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ varṣāḥ uttaraḥ śarad puccham māsāḥ karmakārāḥ ahorātre śatarudrīyam parjanyaḥ vasordhārā yathā vai parjanyaḥ su vṛṣṭam vṛṣṭvā prajābhyaḥ sarvān kāmān saṃpūrayati evam eva sa tasya sarvān kāmān saṃpūrayati yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute

original: { 3.11.10.4} ya u cainam evaṃ veda | saṃvatsaro vā agnir nāciketaḥ | tasya vasantaḥ śiraḥ | grīṣmo dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ | varṣāḥ puccham | śarad uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ | hemanto madhyam | pūrvapakṣāś citayaḥ | aparapakṣāḥ purīṣam | ahorātrāṇīṣṭakāḥ | eṣa vāva so 'gnir agnimayaḥ punarṇavaḥ | agnimayo ha vai punarṇavo bhūtvā | svargaṃ lokam eti |
analyzed: yaḥ u ca enam evam veda saṃvatsaraḥ vai agniḥ nāciketaḥ tasya vasantaḥ śiraḥ grīṣmaḥ dakṣiṇaḥ pakṣaḥ varṣāḥ puccham śarad uttaraḥ pakṣaḥ hemantaḥ madhyam pūrvapakṣāḥ citayaḥ aparapakṣāḥ purīṣam ahar rātrāṇi iṣṭakāḥ eṣa vāva saḥ gniḥ agni mayaḥ punarṇavaḥ agni mayaḥ ha vai punarṇavaḥ bhūtvā svargam lokam eti

original: ādityasya sāyujyam | yo 'gniṃ nāciketaṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda |
analyzed: ādityasya sāyujyam yaḥ gnim nāciketam cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda

original: prapāṭhaka: 12 anuvāka 1 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.1.1} tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama,-aśyāma taṃ kāmam agne | āśānāṃ tvā, viśvā āśāḥ | anu no 'dyānumatir, anv id anumate tvam | kāmo bhūtasya kāmas tad agre | brahma jajñānaṃ, pitā virājām | yajño rāyo 'yaṃ yajñaḥ | āpo bhadrā ād it paśyāmi | tubhyaṃ bharanti yo dehyaḥ |

original: anuvāka 2 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.2.1} devebhyo vai svargo lokas tiro 'bhavat | te prajāpatim abruvan | prajāpate svargo vai no lokas tiro 'bhūt | tam anv iccha-iti | taṃ yajñakratubhir anvaicchat | taṃ yajñakratubhir nānvavindat | tam iṣṭibhir anvaicchat | tam iṣṭibhir anvavindat | tad iṣṭīnām iṣṭitvam |
analyzed: anuvāka 2 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam devebhyaḥ vai svargaḥ lokaḥ tiras bhavat te prajāpatim abruvan prajāpate svargaḥ vai naḥ lokaḥ tiras bhūt tam anu iccha eti tam yajñakratubhiḥ anvaicchat tam yajñakratubhiḥ na anvavindat tam iṣṭibhiḥ anvaicchat tam iṣṭibhiḥ anvavindat tat iṣṭīnām iṣṭi tvam

original: { 3.12.2.2} tam āśā-abravīt | prajāpata āśayā vai śrāmyasi | aham u vā āśā-asmi | māṃ nu yajasva | atha te satyā-āśā bhaviṣyati | anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vetsyasīti | sa etam agnaye kāmāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapat | āśāyai carum | anumatyai carum | tato vai tasya satyā-āśā-abhavat | anu svargaṃ lokam avindat | satyā ha vā asya-āśā bhavati |

analyzed: tam agniḥ balimān abravīt prajāpate gnaye vai balimate sarvāṇi bhūtāni balim haranti aham u vai agniḥ balimān asmi mām nu yajasva atha te sarvāṇi bhūtāni balim hariṣyanti anu svargam lokam vetsyasi iti saḥ etam agnaye kāmāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam niravapat agnaye balimate carum anumatyai carum

analyzed: tatas vai tasmai sarvāṇi bhūtāni balim aharan anu svargam lokam avindat sarvāṇi ha vai asmai bhūtāni balim haranti anu svargam lokam vindati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti agnaye kāmāya svāhā agnaye balimate svāhā anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā svargāya lokāya svāhā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā iti

analyzed: tam anuvittiḥ abravīt prajāpate svargam vai lokam anuvivitsasi aham u vai anuvittiḥ asmi mām nu yajasva atha te satyā anuvittiḥ bhaviṣyati anu svargam lokam vetsyasi iti saḥ etam agnaye kāmāya puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālam niravapat anuvittyai carum anumatyai carum tatas vai tasya satyā anuvittiḥ abhavat

original: anu svargaṃ lokam avindat | satyā ha vā asyānuvittir bhavati | anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vindati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | agnaye kāmāya svāhā-anuvittyai svāhā | anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā | svargāya lokāya svāhā-agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā-iti |

original: { 3.12.2.9} tā vā etāḥ sapta svargasya lokasya dvāraḥ | divaḥ śyenayo 'nuvittayo nāma | āśā prathamāṃ rakṣati | kāmo dvitīyām | brahma tṛtīyām | yajñaś caturthīm | āpaḥ pañcamīm | agnir balimānt ṣaṣṭhīm | anuvittiḥ saptamīm | anu ha vai svargaṃ lokaṃ vindati | kāmacāro 'sya svarge loke bhavati | ya etābhir iṣṭibhir yajate | ya u cainā evaṃ veda |
analyzed: tāḥ vai etāḥ sapta svargasya lokasya dvāraḥ divaḥ śyenayaḥ nuvittayaḥ nāma āśā prathamām rakṣati kāmaḥ dvitīyām brahma tṛtīyām yajñaḥ caturthīm āpaḥ pañcamīm agniḥ balimān ṣaṣṭhīm anuvittiḥ saptamīm anu ha vai svargam lokam vindati kāma cāraḥ sya svarge loke bhavati yaḥ etābhiḥ iṣṭibhiḥ yajate yaḥ u ca enāḥ evam veda

original: { 3.12.4.5} taṃ mano 'bravīt | prajāpate manasā vai śrāmyasi | aham u vai mano 'smi | māṃ nu yajasva | atha te satyaṃ mano bhaviṣyati | anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vetsyasīti | sa etam āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapat | manase carum | anumatyai carum | tato vai tasya satyaṃ mano 'bhavat | anu svargaṃ lokam avindat | satyaṃ ha vā asya mano havati |
analyzed: tam manaḥ bravīt prajāpate manasā vai śrāmyasi aham u vai mano smi mām nu yajasva atha te satyam manaḥ bhaviṣyati anu svargam lokam vetsyasi iti saḥ etam āgneyam aṣṭākapālam niravapat manase carum anumatyai carum tatas vai tasya satyam manaḥ bhavat anu svargam lokam avindat satyam ha vai asya manaḥ havati

original: anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vindati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | agnaye svāhā manase svāhā | anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā | svargāya lokāya svāhā-agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā-iti |
analyzed: anu svargam lokam vindati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti agnaye svāhā manase svāhā anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā svargāya lokāya svāhā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā iti

original: { 3.12.4.6} taṃ caraṇam abravīt | prajāpate caraṇena vai śrāmyasi | aham u vai caraṇam asmi | māṃ nu yajasva | atha te satyaṃ caraṇaṃ bhaviṣyati | anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vetsyasīti | sa etam āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ niravapat | caraṇāya carum | anumatyai carum | tato vai tasya satyaṃ caraṇam abhavat | anu svargaṃ lokam avindat |
analyzed: tam caraṇam abravīt prajāpate caraṇena vai śrāmyasi aham u vai caraṇam asmi mām nu yajasva atha te satyam caraṇam bhaviṣyati anu svargam lokam vetsyasi iti saḥ etam āgneyam aṣṭākapālam niravapat caraṇāya carum anumatyai carum tatas vai tasya satyam caraṇam abhavat anu svargam lokam avindat

original: satyaṃ ha vā asya caraṇaṃ bhavati | anu svargaṃ lokaṃ vindati | ya etena haviṣā yajate | ya u cainad evaṃ veda | so 'tra juhoti | agnaye svāhā caraṇāya svāhā | anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā | svargāya lokāya svāhā-agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā-iti |
analyzed: satyam ha vai asya caraṇam bhavati anu svargam lokam vindati yaḥ etena haviṣā yajate yaḥ u ca enat evam veda saḥ tra juhoti agnaye svāhā caraṇāya svāhā anumatyai svāhā prajāpataye svāhā svargāya lokāya svāhā agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā iti

original: { 3.12.4.7} tā vā etāḥ pañca svargasya lokasya dvāraḥ | apāghā anuvittayo nāma | tapaḥ prathamāṃ rakṣati | śraddhā dvitīyām | satyaṃ tṛtīyām | manaś caturthīm | caraṇaṃ pañcamīm | anu ha vai svargaṃ lokaṃ vindati | kāmacāro 'sya svarge loke bhavati | ya etābhir iṣṭibhir yajate | ya u cainā evaṃ veda | tāsv anviṣṭi |
analyzed: tāḥ vai etāḥ pañca svargasya lokasya dvāraḥ apāghāḥ anuvittayaḥ nāma tapaḥ prathamām rakṣati śraddhā dvitīyām satyam tṛtīyām manaḥ caturthīm caraṇam pañcamīm anu ha vai svargam lokam vindati kāma cāraḥ sya svarge loke bhavati yaḥ etābhiḥ iṣṭibhiḥ yajate yaḥ u ca enāḥ evam veda tāsu anviṣṭi

original: paṣṭhauhīvarāṃ dadyāt kaṃsaṃ ca | striyai ca-ābhāraṃ samṛddhyai |
analyzed: paṣṭhauhī varām dadyāt kaṃsam ca striyai ca ābhāram samṛddhyai

original: anuvāka 5 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.5.1} brahma vai caturhotāraḥ | caturhotṛbhyo 'dhi yajño nirmitaḥ | na-enaṃ śaptam | nābhicaritam āgacchati | ya evaṃ veda | yo ha vai caturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvaṃ veda | atho pañcahotṛtvam | sarvā hāsmai diśaḥ kalpante | vācaspatir hotā daśahotṝṇām | pṛthivī hotā caturhotṝṇām |
analyzed: anuvāka 5 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam brahma vai catur hotāraḥ catur hotṛbhyaḥ dhi yajñaḥ nirmitaḥ na enam śaptam na abhicaritam āgacchati yaḥ evam veda yaḥ ha vai catur hotṛṇām catur hotṛ tvam veda atha u pañcahotṛ tvam sarvāḥ ha asmai diśaḥ kalpante vācaspatiḥ hotā daśahotṝṇām pṛthivī hotā caturhotṝṇām

original: { 3.12.5.2} agnir hotā pañcahotṝṇām | vāg ghotā ṣaḍḍhotṝṇām | mahāhavir hotā saptahotṝṇām | etad vai caturhotṛṇāṃ caturhotṛtvam | atho pañcahotṛtvam | sarvā hāsmai diśaḥ kalpante | ya evaṃ veda | eṣā vai sarvavidyā | etad bheṣajam | eṣā paṅktiḥ svargasya lokasyāñjasoyaniḥ srutiḥ |
analyzed: agniḥ hotā pañcahotṝṇām vāc ghotā ṣaḍḍhotṝṇām mahāhaviḥ hotā saptahotṝṇām etat vai caturhotṛṇām caturhotṛ tvam atha u pañcahotṛ tvam sarvāḥ ha asmai diśaḥ kalpante yaḥ evam veda eṣā vai sarva vidyā etat bheṣajam eṣā paṅktiḥ svargasya lokasya añjasoyaniḥ srutiḥ

original: { 3.12.5.3} etān yo 'dhyaity { 'dhyety} acchadir darśe yāvat tarasam | svar eti | anapabravaḥ sarvam āyur eti | vindate prajām | rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyam | brahmavarcasī bhavati | etān yo 'dhyaiti | spṛṇoty ātmānam | prajāṃ pitṝn | etān vā aruṇa aupaveśir vidāñcakāra |
analyzed: etān yaḥ dhyaiti dhyeti a chadiḥ darśe yāvat tarasam svar eti anapabravaḥ sarvam āyuḥ eti vindate prajām rāyaspoṣam gaupatyam brahmavarcasī bhavati etān yaḥ dhyaiti spṛṇoti ātmānam prajām pitṝn etān vai aruṇaḥ aupaveśiḥ vidāñcakāra

original: { 3.12.5.4} etair adhivādam apājayat | atho viśvaṃ pāpmānam | svar yayau | etān yo 'dhyaiti | adhivādaṃ jayati | atho viśvaṃ pāpmānam | svar eti | etair agniṃ cinvīta svargakāmaḥ | etair āyuṣkāmaḥ | prajāpaśukāmo vā |
analyzed: etaiḥ adhivādam apājayat atha u viśvam pāpmānam svar yayau etān yaḥ dhyaiti adhivādam jayati atha u viśvam pāpmānam svar eti etaiḥ agnim cinvīta svarga kāmaḥ etaiḥ āyuṣkāmaḥ prajā paśu kāmaḥ vā

original: { 3.12.5.5} purastād daśahotāram udañcam upadadhāti yāvatpadam | hṛdayaṃ yajuṣī patnyau ca | dakṣiṇataḥ prāñcaṃ caturhotāram | paścād udañcaṃ pañcahotāram | uttarataḥ prāñcaṃ ṣaḍḍhotāram | upariṣṭāt prāñcaṃ saptahotāram | hṛdayaṃ yajūṃṣi patnyaś ca { pantyaśca} | yathāvakāśaṃ grahān | yathāvakāśaṃ pratigrahān-lokaṃpṛṇāś ca |
analyzed: purastāt daśahotāram udañcam upadadhāti yāvat padam hṛdayam yajuṣī patnyau ca dakṣiṇatas prāñcam caturhotāram paścāt udañcam pañcahotāram uttaratas prāñcam ṣaḍḍhotāram upariṣṭāt prāñcam saptahotāram hṛdayam yajūṃṣi patnyaḥ ca pantyaḥ ca yathāvakāśam grahān yathāvakāśam pratigrahān lokaṃpṛṇāḥ ca

original: sarvā hāsyaitā devatāḥ prītā abhīṣṭā bhavanti |
analyzed: sarvāḥ ha asya etāḥ devatāḥ prītāḥ abhīṣṭāḥ bhavanti

original: { 3.12.5.6} sadevam agniṃ cinute | rathasaṃmitaś cetavyaḥ | vajro vai rathaḥ | vajreṇaiva pāpmānaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ stṛṇute | pakṣaḥsaṃmitaś cetavyaḥ | etāvān vai rathaḥ | yāvat pakṣaḥ | rathasaṃmitam eva cinute | imam eva lokaṃ paśubandhenābhijayati | atho agniṣṭomena |
analyzed: sa devam agnim cinute ratha saṃmitaḥ cetavyaḥ vajraḥ vai rathaḥ vajreṇa eva pāpmānam bhrātṛvyam stṛṇute pakṣaḥ saṃmitaḥ cetavyaḥ etāvān vai rathaḥ yāvat pakṣaḥ ratha saṃmitam eva cinute imam eva lokam paśubandhena abhijayati atha u agniṣṭomena

original: { 3.12.5.7} antarikṣam ukthyena | svar atirātreṇa | sarvān-lokān ahīnena | atho satreṇa | varo dakṣiṇā | vareṇaiva varaṃ spṛṇoti | ātmā hi varaḥ | ekaviṃśatir dakṣiṇā dadāti | ekaviṃśo vā itaḥ svargo lokaḥ | pra svargaṃ lokam āpnoti |
analyzed: antarikṣam ukthyena svar atirātreṇa sarvān lokān ahīnena atha u satreṇa varaḥ dakṣiṇā vareṇa eva varam spṛṇoti ātmā hi varaḥ ekaviṃśatiḥ dakṣiṇāḥ dadāti ekaviṃśaḥ vai itas svargaḥ lokaḥ pra svargam lokam āpnoti

original: { 3.12.5.8} asāv āditya ekaviṃśaḥ | amum evā''dityam āpnoti | śataṃ dadāti | śatāyuḥ puruṣaḥ śatendriyaḥ | āyuṣy eva-indriye pratitiṣṭhati | sahasraṃ dadāti | sahasrasaṃmitaḥ svargo lokaḥ | svargasya lokasyābhijityai | anviṣṭakaṃ dakṣiṇā dadāti | sarvāṇi vayāṃsi |
analyzed: asau ādityaḥ ekaviṃśaḥ amum eva ādityam āpnoti śatam dadāti śata āyuḥ puruṣaḥ śata indriyaḥ āyuṣi eva aindriye pratitiṣṭhati sahasram dadāti sahasra saṃmitaḥ svargaḥ lokaḥ svargasya lokasya abhijityai anviṣṭakam dakṣiṇāḥ dadāti sarvāṇi vayāṃsi

original: { 3.12.5.9} sarvasya-āptyai | sarvasyāvaruddhyai | yadi na vindeta | manthān etāvato dadyād odanān vā | aśnute taṃ kāmam | yasmai kāmāyāgniś cīyate | paṣṭhauhīṃ tv antarvatīṃ dadyāt | sā hi sarvāṇi vayāṃsi | sarvasya-āptyai | sarvasyāvaruddhyai |
analyzed: sarvasya āptyai sarvasya avaruddhyai yadi na vindeta manthān etāvataḥ dadyāt odanān vai aśnute tam kāmam yasmai kāmāya agniḥ cīyate paṣṭhauhīm tu antarvatīm dadyāt sā hi sarvāṇi vayāṃsi sarvasya āptyai sarvasya avaruddhyai

original: { 3.12.5.10} hiraṇyaṃ dadāti | hiraṇyajyotir eva svargaṃ lokam eti | vāso dadāti | tena-āyuḥ pratirate | veditṛtīye yajeta | triṣatyā hi devāḥ | sasatyam agniṃ cinute | tad etat paśubandhe brāhmaṇaṃ brūyāt | na-itareṣu yajñeṣu | yo ha vai caturhotṝn anusavanaṃ tarpayitavyān veda |
analyzed: hiraṇyam dadāti hiraṇya jyotiḥ eva svargam lokam eti vāsaḥ dadāti tena āyuḥ pratirate vedi tṛtīye yajeta triṣatyāḥ hi devāḥ sa satyam agnim cinute tat etat paśubandhe brāhmaṇam brūyāt na etareṣu yajñeṣu yaḥ ha vai caturhotṝn anusavanam tarpayitavyān veda

original: { 3.12.5.11} tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ | upa-enaṃ somapītho namati | ete vai caturhotāro 'nusavanaṃ tarpayitavyāḥ | ye brāhmaṇā bahuvidaḥ | tebhyo yad dakṣiṇā na nayet | duriṣṭaṃ syāt | agnim asya vṛñjīran | tebhyo yathāśraddhaṃ dadyāt | sviṣṭam eva-etat kriyate | nāsyāgniṃ vṛñjate |
analyzed: tṛpyati prajayā paśubhiḥ upa enam soma pīthaḥ namati ete vai catur hotāraḥ nusavanam tarpayitavyāḥ ye brāhmaṇāḥ bahu vidaḥ tebhyaḥ yat dakṣiṇāḥ na nayet duriṣṭam syāt agnim asya vṛñjīran tebhyaḥ yathāśraddham dadyāt su iṣṭam eva etat kriyate na asya agnim vṛñjate

original: { 3.12.5.12} hiraṇya-iṣṭako bhavati | yāvad uttamam aṅgulikāṇḍaṃ yajñaparuṣā saṃmitam | tejo hiraṇyam | yadi hiraṇyaṃ na vindet | śarkarā aktā upadadhyāt | tejo ghṛtam | satejasam evāgniṃ cinute | agniṃ citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta maitrāvaruṇyā vā | vīryeṇa vā eṣa vyṛdhyate | yo 'gniṃ cinute |
analyzed: hiraṇyaiṣṭakaḥ bhavati yāvat uttamam aṅguli kāṇḍam yajña paruṣā saṃmitam tejaḥ hiraṇyam yadi hiraṇyam na vindet śarkarāḥ aktāḥ upadadhyāt tejaḥ ghṛtam sa tejasam eva agnim cinute agnim citvā sautrāmaṇyā yajeta maitrāvaruṇyā vā vīryeṇa vai eṣa vyṛdhyate yaḥ gnim cinute

original: { 3.12.5.13} yāvad eva vīryam | tad asmin dadhāti | brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatām āpnoti | etāsām eva devatānāṃ sāyujyam | sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatām āpnoti | ya etam agniṃ cinute | ya u cainam evaṃ veda | etad eva sāvitre brāhmaṇam | atho nācikete |
analyzed: yāvat eva vīryam tat asmin dadhāti brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyam salokatām āpnoti etāsām eva devatānām sāyujyam sārṣṭitām samāna loka tām āpnoti yaḥ etam agnim cinute yaḥ u ca enam evam veda etat eva sāvitre brāhmaṇam atha u nācikete

original: anuvāka 6 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.6.1} yac cāmṛtaṃ yac ca martyam | yac ca prāṇiti yac ca na | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā | upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena- ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā | tayā devatayā-aṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda | sarvāḥ striyaḥ sarvān puṃsaḥ | sarvaṃ nastrīpumaṃ ca yat | sarvās tāḥ | yāvantaḥ pāṃsavo bhūmeḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 6 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam yat ca amṛtam yat ca martyam yat ca prāṇiti yat ca na sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda sarvāḥ striyaḥ sarvān puṃsaḥ sarvam ca yat sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvantaḥ pāṃsavaḥ bhūmeḥ

original: { 3.12.6.2} saṃkhyātā devamāyayā | sarvās tāḥ | yāvanta ūṣāḥ paśūnām | pṛthivyāṃ puṣṭir hitāḥ | sarvās tāḥ | yāvatīḥ sikatāḥ sarvāḥ | apsv antaś ca yāḥ sritāḥ | sarvās tāḥ | yāvatīḥ śarkarā dhṛtyai | asyāṃ pṛthivyām adhi |
analyzed: saṃkhyātāḥ deva māyayā sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvantaḥ ūṣāḥ paśūnām pṛthivyām puṣṭiḥ hitāḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvatīḥ sikatāḥ sarvāḥ apsu antar ca yāḥ sritāḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvatīḥ śarkarāḥ dhṛtyai asyām pṛthivyām adhi

original: { 3.12.6.3} sarvās tāḥ | yāvanto 'śmāno 'syāṃ pṛthivyām | pratiṣṭhāsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ | sarvās tāḥ | yāvatīr vīrudhaḥ sarvāḥ | viṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu | sarvās tāḥ | yāvatīr oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ | viṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu | sarvās tāḥ |
analyzed: sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvantaḥ śmānaḥ syām pṛthivyām pratiṣṭhāsu pratiṣṭhitāḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvatīḥ vīrudhaḥ sarvāḥ viṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvatīḥ oṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ viṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīm anu sarvāḥ tāḥ

original: { 3.12.6.4} yāvanto vanaspatayaḥ | asyāṃ pṛthivyām adhi | sarvās tāḥ | yāvanto grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ sarve | āraṇyāś ca ye | sarvās tāḥ | ye dvipādaś catuṣpādaḥ | apāda udarasarpiṇaḥ | sarvās tāḥ | yāvad āñjanam ucyate |
analyzed: yāvantaḥ vanaspatayaḥ asyām pṛthivyām adhi sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvantaḥ grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ sarve āraṇyāḥ ca ye sarvāḥ tāḥ ye dvipādaḥ catuṣpādaḥ a pādaḥ udara sarpiṇaḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvat āñjanam ucyate

original: { 3.12.6.5} devatrā yac ca mānuṣam | sarvās tāḥ | yāvat kṛṣṇāyasaṃ sarvam | devatrā yac ca mānuṣam | sarvās tāḥ | yāval lohāyasaṃ sarvam | devatrā yac ca mānuṣam | sarvās tāḥ | sarvaṃ sīsaṃ sarvaṃ trapu | devatrā yac ca mānuṣam |
analyzed: devatrā yat ca mānuṣam sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvat kṛṣṇāyasam sarvam devatrā yat ca mānuṣam sarvāḥ tāḥ yāvat lohāyasam sarvam devatrā yat ca mānuṣam sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvam sīsam sarvam trapu devatrā yat ca mānuṣam

original: { 3.12.6.6} sarvās tāḥ | sarvaṃ hiraṇyaṃ rajatam | devatrā yac ca mānuṣam | sarvās tāḥ | sarvaṃ suvarṇaṃ haritam | devatrā yac ca mānuṣam | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena- ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda |
analyzed: sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvam hiraṇyam rajatam devatrā yat ca mānuṣam sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvam suvarṇam haritam devatrā yat ca mānuṣam sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda

original: anuvāka 7 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.7.1} sarvā diśo dikṣu | yac cāntar bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā | upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena- ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda | antarikṣaṃ ca kevalam | yac cāsminn antarāhitam | sarvās tāḥ | āntarikṣyaś ca yāḥ prajāḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 7 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam sarvāḥ diśaḥ dikṣu yat ca antar bhūtam pratiṣṭhitam sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda antarikṣam ca kevalam yat ca asmin antar āhitam sarvāḥ tāḥ āntarikṣyaḥ ca yāḥ prajāḥ

original: { 3.12.7.2} gandharvāpsarasaś ca ye | sarvās tāḥ | sarvān udārānt salilān | antarikṣe pratiṣṭhitān | sarvās tāḥ | sarvān udārānt salilān | sthāvarāḥ proṣyāś ca ye | sarvās tāḥ | sarvāṃ dhuniṃ sarvān dhvaṃsān | himo yac ca śīyate |
analyzed: gandharva apsarasaḥ ca ye sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvān udārān salilān antarikṣe pratiṣṭhitān sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvān udārān salilān sthāvarāḥ proṣyāḥ ca ye sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvām dhunim sarvān dhvaṃsān himaḥ yat ca śīyate

original: { 3.12.7.3} sarvās tāḥ | sarvān marīcīn vitatān | nīhāro yac ca śīyate | sarvās tāḥ | sarvā vidyutaḥ sarvānt stanayitnūn | hrādunīr yac ca śīyate | sarvās tāḥ | sarvāḥ sravantīḥ saritaḥ | sarvam apsucaraṃ ca yat | sarvās tāḥ |
analyzed: sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvān marīcīn vitatān nīhāraḥ yat ca śīyate sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ vidyutaḥ sarvān stanayitnūn hrādunīḥ yat ca śīyate sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ sravantīḥ saritaḥ sarvam apsucaram ca yat sarvāḥ tāḥ

original: { 3.12.7.4} yāś ca kūpyā yāś ca nādyāḥ samudriyāḥ | yāś ca vaiśantīr uta prāsacīryāḥ | sarvās tāḥ | ye cottiṣṭhanti jīmūtāḥ | yāś ca varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ | sarvās tāḥ | tapas teja ākāśaṃ | yac ca-ākāśe pratiṣṭhitam | sarvās tāḥ | vāyuṃ vayāṃsi sarvāṇi |
analyzed: yāḥ ca kūpyāḥ yāḥ ca nādyāḥ samudriyāḥ yāḥ ca vaiśantīḥ uta prāsacīryāḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ ye ca uttiṣṭhanti jīmūtāḥ yāḥ ca varṣanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sarvāḥ tāḥ tapaḥ tejaḥ ākāśam yat ca ākāśe pratiṣṭhitam sarvāḥ tāḥ vāyum vayāṃsi sarvāṇi

original: { 3.12.7.5} antarikṣacaraṃ ca yat | sarvās tāḥ | agniṃ sūryaṃ candram | mitraṃ varuṇaṃ bhagam | sarvās tāḥ | satyaṃ śraddhāṃ tapo damam | nāma rūpaṃ ca bhūtānām | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena- ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda |
analyzed: antarikṣa caram ca yat sarvāḥ tāḥ agnim sūryam candram mitram varuṇam bhagam sarvāḥ tāḥ satyam śraddhām tapaḥ damam nāma rūpam ca bhūtānām sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda

original: anuvāka 8 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.8.1} sarvāṃ divaṃ sarvān devān divi | yac cāntar bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā | upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena- ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda | yāvatīs tārakāḥ sarvāḥ | vitatā rocane divi | sarvās tāḥ | ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni |
analyzed: anuvāka 8 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam sarvām divam sarvān devān divi yat ca antar bhūtam pratiṣṭhitam sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda yāvatīḥ tārakāḥ sarvāḥ vitatāḥ rocane divi sarvāḥ tāḥ ṛcaḥ yajūṃṣi sāmāni

original: { 3.12.8.2} atharvāṅgirasaś ca ye | sarvās tāḥ | itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca | sarpadevajanāś ca ye | sarvās tāḥ | ye ca lokā ye cālokāḥ | antar bhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | sarvās tāḥ | yac ca brahma yac cābrahma | antar brahman {brahman?} pratiṣṭhitam |
analyzed: atharva aṅgirasaḥ ca ye sarvāḥ tāḥ itihāsa purāṇam ca sarpa deva janāḥ ca ye sarvāḥ tāḥ ye ca lokāḥ ye ca a lokāḥ antar bhūtam pratiṣṭhitam sarvāḥ tāḥ yat ca brahma yat ca abrahma antar brahman brahman pratiṣṭhitam

original: { 3.12.8.3} sarvās tāḥ | ahorātrāṇi sarvāṇi | ardhamāsāṃś ca kevalān | sarvās tāḥ | sarvān ṛtūnt sarvān māsān | saṃvatsaraṃ ca kevalam | sarvās tāḥ | sarvaṃ bhūtaṃ {,ānaṃdā. bhūtaṃ} sarvaṃ bhavyam | yac cāto 'dhibhaviṣyati | sarvās tā iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā | upa kāmadughā dadhe | tena-ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā | tayā devatayāṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda |
analyzed: sarvāḥ tāḥ ahar rātrāṇi sarvāṇi ardha māsān ca kevalān sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvān ṛtūn sarvān māsān saṃvatsaram ca kevalam sarvāḥ tāḥ sarvam bhūtam ānandāḥ bhūtam sarvam bhavyam yat ca atas sarvāḥ tāḥ iṣṭakāḥ kṛtvā upa kāmadughāḥ dadhe tena ṛṣiṇā tena brahmaṇā tayā devatayā aṅgirasvat dhruvā sīda

original: anuvāka 9 cāturhotrāgnicayanam, vaiśvasṛjāgnicayanam { 3.12.9.1} ṛcāṃ prācī mahatī dig ucyate | dakṣiṇām āhur yajuṣām apārām | atharvaṇām aṅgirasāṃ pratīcī | sāmnām udīcī mahatī dig ucyate | ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇe divi deva īyate | yajurvede tiṣṭhati | madhye ahnaḥ | sāmavedenāstamaye mahīyate {ḍyumoṇṭa mahīyate ?} | vedair aśūnyas tribhir eti sūryaḥ |
analyzed: anuvāka 9 cāturhotrā agni cayanam vaiśvasṛja agni cayanam ṛcām prācī mahatī diś ucyate dakṣiṇām āhuḥ yajuṣām apārām atharvaṇām aṅgirasām pratīcī sāmnām udīcī mahatī diś ucyate ṛgbhiḥ pūrvāhṇe divi devaḥ īyate yajurvede tiṣṭhati madhye ahnaḥ sāmavedena astamaye mahīyate mahīyate vedaiḥ a śūnyaḥ tribhiḥ eti sūryaḥ

original: ṛgbhyo jātāṃ sarvaśo mūrtim āhuḥ | sarvā gatir yājuṣī haiva śaśvat |
analyzed: ṛgbhyaḥ jātām sarvaśas mūrtim āhuḥ sarvā gatiḥ yājuṣī ha eva śaśvat

original: { 3.12.9.2} sarvaṃ tejaḥ sāmarūpyaṃ ha śaśvat {,ānaṃdā. śaśvat} | sarvaṃ ha-idaṃ brahmaṇā haiva sṛṣṭam | ṛgbhyo jātaṃ vaiśyaṃ varṇam āhuḥ | yajurvedaṃ kṣatriyasya-āhur yonim | sāmavedo brāhmaṇānāṃ prasūtiḥ | pūrve pūrvebhyo vaca etad ūcuḥ | ādarśam agniṃ cinvānāḥ | pūrve viśvasṛjo 'mṛtāḥ | śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇi | dīkṣitāḥ sattram āsata |
analyzed: sarvam tejaḥ sāmarūpyam ha śaśvat ānaṃdā śaśvat sarvam ha edam brahmaṇā ha eva sṛṣṭam ṛgbhyaḥ jātam vaiśyam varṇam āhuḥ yajurvedam kṣatriyasya āhuḥ yonim sāmavedaḥ brāhmaṇānām prasūtiḥ pūrve pūrvebhyaḥ vacaḥ etat ūcuḥ ādarśam agnim cinvānāḥ pūrve viśva sṛjaḥ mṛtāḥ śatam varṣa sahasrāṇi dīkṣitāḥ sattram āsata

original: { 3.12.9.3} tapa āsīd gṛhapatiḥ | brahma brahmābhavat svayam | satyaṃ { sattyaṃ} ha hotā-eṣām āsīt {āsīt?} | yad viśvasṛja āsata | amṛtam ebhya udagāyat | sahasraṃ parivatsarān | bhūtaṃ ha prastotā-eṣām āsīt {āsīt?} | bhaviṣyat prati cāharat | prāṇo adhvaryur abhavat | idaṃ sarvaṃ siṣāsatām |
analyzed: tapaḥ āsīt gṛhapatiḥ brahma brahmā bhavat svayam satyam sattyam ha hotā eṣām āsīt āsīt yat viśvasṛjaḥ āsata amṛtam ebhyaḥ udagāyat sahasram parivatsarān bhūtam ha prastotā eṣām āsīt āsīt bhaviṣyat prati ca aharat prāṇaḥ adhvaryuḥ abhavat idam sarvam siṣāsatām

original: { 3.12.9.4} apāno vidvān āvṛtaḥ | prati prātiṣṭhad adhvare | ārtavā upagātāraḥ | sadasyā ṛtavo 'bhavan | ardhamāsāś ca māsāś ca | camasādhvaryavo 'bhavan | aśaṃsad brahmaṇas tejaḥ | acchāvāko 'bhavad yaśaḥ | ṛtam eṣāṃ praśāstā-āsīt | yad viśvasṛja āsata |
analyzed: apānaḥ vidvān āvṛtaḥ prati prātiṣṭhat adhvare ārtavāḥ upagātāraḥ sadasyāḥ ṛtavaḥ bhavan ardha māsāḥ ca māsāḥ ca camasādhvaryavaḥ bhavan aśaṃsat brahmaṇaḥ tejaḥ acchāvākaḥ bhavat yaśaḥ ṛtam eṣām praśāstā āsīt yat viśvasṛjaḥ āsata

original: { 3.12.9.5} ūrg rājānam udavahat | dhruvagopaḥ saho 'bhavat | ojo 'bhyaṣṭaud grāvṇaḥ | yad viśvasṛja āsata | apacitiḥ potrīyām ayajat | neṣṭrīyām ayajat tviṣiḥ | āgnīddhrād viduṣī satyam { sattyam} | śraddhā haivāyajat svayam | irā patnī viśvasṛjām | ākūtir apinaḍḍhaviḥ |
analyzed: ūrj rājānam udavahat dhruvagopaḥ sahaḥ bhavat ojaḥ bhyaṣṭaut grāvṇaḥ yat viśvasṛjaḥ āsata apacitiḥ potrīyām ayajat neṣṭrīyām ayajat tviṣiḥ viduṣī satyam sattyam śraddhā ha eva ayajat svayam irā patnī viśvasṛjām ākūtiḥ apinaṭ haviḥ

original: { 3.12.9.6} idhmaṃ ha kṣuc caibhya ugre | tṛṣṇā ca-āvahatāmubhe | vāg eṣāṃ subrahmaṇyā''sīt | chandoyogān vijānatī | kalpatantrāṇi tanvānā'haḥsaṃsthāś ca sarvaśaḥ {,ānaṃdā. kalpatantrāṇi tanvānāhaḥ | saṃsthāś ca} | ahorātre paśupālyau | muhūrtāḥ preṣyā abhavan | mṛtyus tad abhavad dhātā | śamitā-ugro viśāṃ patiḥ |
analyzed: idhmam ha kṣudh ca ebhyaḥ ugre tṛṣṇā ca āvahatām ubhe vāc eṣām subrahmaṇyā āsīt chandaḥ yogān vijānatī kalpa tantrāṇi tanu ānāhaḥsaṃsthāḥ ca sarvaśas ānaṃdā kalpa tantrāṇi tanu ānāhaḥsaṃsthāḥ ca ahar rātre paśupālyau muhūrtāḥ preṣyāḥ abhavat mṛtyuḥ tat abhavat dhātā śamitā augraḥ viśām patiḥ

original: { 3.12.9.7} viśvasṛjaḥ prathamāḥ sattram āsata | sahasrasamaṃ prasutena yantaḥ | tato ha jajñe bhuvanasya gopāḥ | hiraṇmayaḥ śakunir brahma nāma | yena sūryas tapati tejasā-iddhaḥ | pitā puttreṇa pitṛmān yoniyonau | nāvedavin manute taṃ bṛhantam | sarvānubhum ātmānaṃ saṃparāye | eṣa nityo mahimā brāhmaṇasya | na karmaṇā vardhate no kanīyān |
analyzed: viśvasṛjaḥ prathamāḥ sattram āsata sahasrasamam prasutena yantaḥ tatas ha jajñe bhuvanasya gopāḥ hiraṇmayaḥ śakuniḥ brahma nāma yena sūryaḥ tapati tejasā aiddhaḥ pitā puttreṇa pitṛmān yoni yonau na a veda vid manute tam bṛhantam sarva anubhum ātmānam saṃparāye eṣa nityaḥ mahimā brāhmaṇasya na karmaṇā vardhate na u kanīyān

original: { 3.12.9.8} tasyaivā''tmā padavit taṃ viditvā {,ānaṃdā. viditvā} | na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena | pañca paścāśatas trivṛtaḥ saṃvatsarāḥ | pañca pañcāśataḥ pañcadaśāḥ | pañca pañcāśataḥ saptadaśāḥ | pañca pañcāśata ekaviṃśāḥ | viśvasṛjāṃ sahasrasaṃvatsaram | etena vai viśvasṛja idaṃ viśvam asṛjanta | yad viśvam asṛjanta | tasmād viśvasṛjaḥ |
analyzed: tasya eva ātmā pada vid tam viditvā ānaṃdāḥ viditvā na karmaṇā lipyate pāpakena pañca paścāśataḥ trivṛtaḥ saṃvatsarāḥ pañca pañcāśataḥ pañcadaśāḥ pañca pañcāśataḥ saptadaśāḥ pañca pañcāśataḥ ekaviṃśāḥ viśvasṛjām sahasrasaṃvatsaram etena vai viśvasṛjaḥ idam viśvam asṛjanta yat viśvam asṛjanta tasmāt viśvasṛjaḥ

original: viśvam enān anu prajāyate | brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyaṃ salokatāṃ yanti | etāsām eva devatānāṃ sāyujyam | sārṣṭitāṃ samānalokatāṃ yanti | ya etad upayanti | ye cainat prāhuḥ | yebhyaś cainat prāhuḥ |
analyzed: viśvam enān anu prajāyate brahmaṇaḥ sāyujyam salokatām yanti etāsām eva devatānām sāyujyam sārṣṭi tām samāna loka tām yanti ye etat upayanti ye ca enat prāhuḥ yebhyaḥ ca enat prāhuḥ
